## `file_manager/logic_file_manager.py`
```python
"""File-manager domain logic: secure physical file operations constrained to the
configured file-manager roots, shared by REST, elFinder and the agent tools."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from editor.logic_editor import editor_files
from file_manager.schemas_file_manager import DirectoryListing, FileEntry


class FileBackendService:
    """Single service layer for every file-manager consumer."""

    CONFIG_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "tools" / "allowed_paths.json"
    SKIP_DIRECTORIES = {"__pycache__", "_pycache__"}

    def _read_config(self) -> dict:
        if not self.CONFIG_PATH.is_file():
            return {}
        try:
            config = json.loads(self.CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Could not read file-manager configuration '{self.CONFIG_PATH}': {exc}"
            ) from exc
        if not isinstance(config, dict):
            raise RuntimeError(f"File-manager configuration must be a JSON object: {self.CONFIG_PATH}")
        return config

    def configured_roots(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Configured roots whose folders exist; missing ones are skipped, not fatal."""
        roots, _missing = self._split_roots(self._read_config())
        if not roots:
            raise RuntimeError("None of the folders in 'file_manager_roots' exist on disk.")
        return roots

    def missing_roots(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Configured roots whose folders are gone (e.g. an unplugged drive)."""
        return self._split_roots(self._read_config())[1]

    def _split_roots(self, config: dict) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[dict[str, str]]]:
        roots = config.get("file_manager_roots")
        if roots is None:
            legacy_path = config.get("file_manager_root", str(editor_files.PROJECT_ROOT.resolve()))
            roots = [{"name": "Workspace", "path": legacy_path}]
        if not isinstance(roots, list):
            raise RuntimeError("'file_manager_roots' must be a JSON array.")

        result = []
        missing = []
        names = set()
        paths = set()
        for entry in roots:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                raise RuntimeError("Each file-manager root must have a name and path.")
            name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
            raw_path = os.path.expandvars(str(entry.get("path", ""))).strip()
            if not name or not raw_path:
                raise RuntimeError("Each file-manager root must have a non-empty name and path.")
            root = Path(raw_path).expanduser()
            if not root.is_absolute():
                raise RuntimeError(f"File-manager root must be an absolute path: {raw_path}")
            resolved = root.resolve()
            name_key = name.casefold()
            path_key = os.path.normcase(str(resolved))
            if name_key in names or path_key in paths:
                raise RuntimeError("File-manager root names and paths must be unique.")
            names.add(name_key)
            paths.add(path_key)
            (result if resolved.is_dir() else missing).append({"name": name, "path": str(resolved)})
        if not result and not missing:
            raise RuntimeError("Configure at least one entry in 'file_manager_roots'.")
        return result, missing

    def active_root_path(self) -> Path:
        config = self._read_config()
        roots = self.configured_roots()
        selected = config.get(
            "active_file_manager_root",
            config.get("file_manager_root", roots[0]["path"]),
        )
        for root in roots:
            if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(str(selected)):
                return Path(root["path"])
        if any(os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(str(selected))
               for root in self.missing_roots()):
            return Path(roots[0]["path"])
        raise RuntimeError(
            "The active file-manager root is not present in 'file_manager_roots'."
        )

    def workspace_root(self) -> Path:
        return self.active_root_path()

    def _write_config(self, config: dict) -> None:
        self.CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp_path = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                mode="w",
                encoding="utf-8",
                newline="\n",
                dir=self.CONFIG_PATH.parent,
                prefix=f".{self.CONFIG_PATH.name}.",
                suffix=".tmp",
                delete=False,
            ) as temp_file:
                temp_path = Path(temp_file.name)
                json.dump(config, temp_file, indent=2)
                temp_file.write("\n")
            temp_path.replace(self.CONFIG_PATH)
        finally:
            if temp_path is not None and temp_path.exists():
                temp_path.unlink()

    def select_root(self, path: str) -> dict:
        roots = self.configured_roots()
        selected = next(
            (root for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(path)),
            None,
        )
        if selected is None:
            raise ValueError("Choose a configured file-manager root.")

        config = self._read_config()
        config["file_manager_roots"] = roots + self._split_roots(config)[1]
        config["active_file_manager_root"] = selected["path"]
        config["file_manager_root"] = selected["path"]
        self._write_config(config)
        return {"roots": roots, "active_path": selected["path"]}

    def manage_roots(self, action: str, paths: list[str]) -> dict:
        """Add or remove configured file-manager directories."""
        if action not in {"add", "remove"}:
            raise ValueError("Action must be 'add' or 'remove'.")
        if not paths:
            raise ValueError("Provide at least one directory path.")

        config = self._read_config()
        available, missing = self._split_roots(config)
        roots = available + missing
        current_active = str(
            config.get("active_file_manager_root", config.get("file_manager_root", roots[0]["path"]))
        )
        normalized_paths = []
        for raw_path in paths:
            value = os.path.expandvars(str(raw_path)).strip()
            if not value:
                raise ValueError("Directory paths cannot be empty.")
            candidate = Path(value).expanduser()
            if not candidate.is_absolute():
                raise ValueError(f"Directory path must be absolute: {value}")
            resolved = candidate.resolve()
            if action == "add" and not resolved.is_dir():
                raise ValueError(f"Directory does not exist: {resolved}")
            normalized_paths.append(str(resolved))

        path_keys = {os.path.normcase(path) for path in normalized_paths}
        added = []
        removed = []
        unchanged = []
        if action == "add":
            existing_paths = {os.path.normcase(root["path"]) for root in roots}
            existing_names = {root["name"].casefold() for root in roots}
            for path in normalized_paths:
                path_key = os.path.normcase(path)
                if path_key in existing_paths:
                    unchanged.append(path)
                    continue
                folder_name = Path(path).name or path
                name = folder_name
                suffix = 2
                while name.casefold() in existing_names:
                    name = f"{folder_name} ({suffix})"
                    suffix += 1
                roots.append({"name": name, "path": path})
                existing_paths.add(path_key)
                existing_names.add(name.casefold())
                added.append(path)
        else:
            configured_paths = {os.path.normcase(root["path"]) for root in roots}
            removed = [root["path"] for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) in path_keys]
            unchanged = [
                path for path in normalized_paths
                if os.path.normcase(path) not in configured_paths
            ]
            roots = [root for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) not in path_keys]
            if not removed:
                raise ValueError("None of the provided paths are configured file-manager roots.")
            if not any(Path(root["path"]).is_dir() for root in roots):
                raise ValueError("At least one existing file-manager root must remain configured.")

        existing = [root for root in roots if Path(root["path"]).is_dir()]
        active_path = next(
            (root["path"] for root in existing if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(current_active)),
            existing[0]["path"] if existing else roots[0]["path"],
        )
        config["file_manager_roots"] = roots
        config["active_file_manager_root"] = active_path
        config["file_manager_root"] = active_path
        self._write_config(config)
        return {
            "roots": existing,
            "missing": [root for root in roots if root not in existing],
            "active_path": active_path,
            "added": added,
            "removed": removed,
            "unchanged": unchanged,
        }

    def resolve_workspace_path(self, relative_path: str = "") -> Path:
        if not isinstance(relative_path, str):
            raise ValueError("A workspace-relative path is required.")

        clean_path = relative_path.replace("\\", "/")
        if clean_path.startswith("/") or (len(clean_path) > 1 and clean_path[1] == ":"):
            raise ValueError("Absolute paths are not allowed.")
        base_root = self.workspace_root()
        parts = Path(clean_path).parts
        if any(part in {".", ".."} for part in parts):
            raise ValueError("Relative path traversal is not allowed.")
        candidate = base_root
        for part in parts:
            candidate = candidate / part
            if candidate.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Symbolic links are not supported by the file manager.")
        path = candidate.resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(base_root)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError("Access outside the workspace is forbidden.") from None
        return path

    def list_entries(self, relative_path: str = "") -> list[dict]:
        directory = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not directory.is_dir():
            if directory.exists():
                raise NotADirectoryError(f"Not a directory: {relative_path}")
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Directory not found: {relative_path}")

        entries = []
        for child in sorted(
            directory.iterdir(),
            key=lambda item: (
                not (not item.is_symlink() and item.is_dir()),
                item.name.lower(),
            ),
        ):
            if (
                child.is_symlink()
                or child.name.startswith(".")
                or (child.is_dir() and child.name.lower() in self.SKIP_DIRECTORIES)
                or (child.is_file() and child.suffix.lower() == ".pyc")
            ):
                continue
            try:
                resolved = child.resolve()
                resolved.relative_to(self.workspace_root())
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not resolved.exists():
                continue
            stat = resolved.stat()
            entries.append({
                "name": resolved.name,
                "path": resolved.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
                "type": "directory" if resolved.is_dir() else "file",
                "size": 0 if resolved.is_dir() else stat.st_size,
                "modified": stat.st_mtime,
            })
        return entries

    def directory_tree(self, relative_path: str = "") -> dict:
        directory = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not directory.is_dir():
            if directory.exists():
                raise NotADirectoryError(f"Not a directory: {relative_path}")
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Directory not found: {relative_path}")
        root = self.workspace_root()
        rel_path = directory.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        node = {
            "name": directory.name or root.name,
            "path": "" if rel_path == "." else rel_path,
            "type": "directory",
            "children": [],
        }
        for item in self.list_entries(node["path"]):
            if item["type"] == "directory":
                node["children"].append(self.directory_tree(item["path"]))
            else:
                node["children"].append({
                    "name": item["name"],
                    "path": item["path"],
                    "type": "file",
                })
        return node

    def read_file(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {relative_path}")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "content": path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        }

    def write_file(self, relative_path: str, content: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path.exists() and not path.is_file():
            raise IsADirectoryError(f"Path is not a file: {relative_path}")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "bytes_written": len(content.encode("utf-8")),
        }

    def create_path(self, relative_path: str, kind: str = "file") -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {relative_path}")
        if kind == "directory":
            path.mkdir(parents=True)
        elif kind == "file":
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.touch()
        else:
            raise ValueError("Kind must be 'file' or 'directory'.")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "created": kind,
        }

    def delete_path(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be deleted.")
        if path.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(path)
        elif path.is_file():
            path.unlink()
        else:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {relative_path}")
        return {"path": relative_path.replace("\\", "/"), "deleted": True}

    def move_path(self, source_path: str, destination_path: str) -> dict:
        source = self.resolve_workspace_path(source_path)
        destination = self.resolve_workspace_path(destination_path)
        if source == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be moved.")
        if not source.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {source_path}")
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {destination_path}")
        if source.is_dir():
            try:
                destination.relative_to(source)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError("A directory cannot be moved into itself.")
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
        return {
            "source_path": source_path.replace("\\", "/"),
            "destination_path": destination.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "moved": True,
        }

    def copy_path(self, source_path: str, destination_path: str) -> dict:
        source = self.resolve_workspace_path(source_path)
        destination = self.resolve_workspace_path(destination_path)
        if source == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be copied.")
        if not source.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {source_path}")
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {destination_path}")
        if source.is_dir():
            try:
                destination.relative_to(source)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError("A directory cannot be copied into itself.")
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copytree(source, destination, symlinks=True)
        else:
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(source, destination)
        return {
            "source_path": source_path.replace("\\", "/"),
            "destination_path": destination.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "copied": True,
        }

    def list_directory(self, path: str = "") -> dict:
        """Directory entries wrapped in the public ``DirectoryListing`` contract."""
        entries = self.list_entries(path)
        return DirectoryListing(
            path=path.replace("\\", "/"),
            entries=[FileEntry(**entry) for entry in entries],
        ).model_dump()


file_backend = FileBackendService()

```

## `file_manager/schemas_file_manager.py`
```python
"""File-manager data contracts: request bodies and directory listing models."""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class PathRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class FileContentRequest(PathRequest):
    content: str


class CreateRequest(PathRequest):
    kind: str = Field(default="file", pattern="^(file|directory)$")


class MoveRequest(BaseModel):
    source_path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    destination_path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class SelectRootRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class ManageRootsRequest(BaseModel):
    action: Literal["add", "remove"]
    paths: list[str] = Field(..., min_length=1)


class FileEntry(BaseModel):
    name: str
    path: str
    type: str
    size: int
    modified: float


class DirectoryListing(BaseModel):
    path: str
    entries: list[FileEntry]

```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Terminal — Novous Sandbox</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/style.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/codebuilder.css?v=3">
</head>
<body class="bg-dark text-light tw-terminal-page">
  <div id="terminal-root"></div>
  <script type="module">
    import { mountTerminal, TERMINAL_CHANNEL } from '/static/js/terminal.js?v=2';
    const terminal = mountTerminal(document.getElementById('terminal-root'));
    terminal.focus();

    const channel = 'BroadcastChannel' in window ? new BroadcastChannel(TERMINAL_CHANNEL) : null;
    if (channel) {
      channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-open' });
      channel.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (event.data?.type === 'close-popout') window.close();
        if (event.data?.type === 'ping') channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-open' });
      };
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-closed' }));
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```css
.codebuilder-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 560px;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

/* ---------- Toolbar ---------- */
.codebuilder-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}

.codebuilder-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.question-dialog.is-resizable {
  resize: both;
  overflow: auto;
  width: min(560px, 92vw);
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 240px;
  max-width: 96vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
}

.question-dialog.is-resizable .codebuilder-open-tree {
  max-height: none;
  min-width: 0;
}

.codebuilder-file-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.codebuilder-file-label > span:nth-child(2) {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.codebuilder-python-icon {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3776ab, #4b8bbe);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#run-code:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.75; }

/* ---------- Layout grid ----------
   Columns: chat | divider | editor | divider | console
   Panel widths are CSS variables; a hidden panel is 0px wide and its divider widens
   into a tab that brings it back. */
.codebuilder-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    var(--chat-w, 340px) var(--chat-gutter, 8px) minmax(0, 1fr) var(--console-gutter, 8px) var(--console-w, 320px);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 250px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="chat"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-editor-panel { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="console"] { grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 5; grid-row: 1; }

/* ---------- Panes ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-editor-panel,
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}

.codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ---------- Dividers (look shared via .panel-resizer in style.css) ---------- */
/* While a drag is past the hide point, preview that the panel will disappear. */
.codebuilder-shell.chat-hiding .codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-shell.console-hiding .codebuilder-console-panel { opacity: 0.35; }

/* Hidden panel: nothing on screen but a slim tab on the divider. */
.codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed { --chat-w: 0px; --chat-gutter: 18px; }
.codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed { --console-w: 0px; --console-gutter: 18px; }
.codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed .codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed .codebuilder-console-panel { visibility: hidden; border: 0; }
body.is-resizing .editor-surface { pointer-events: none; }

/* ---------- Code scratchpad dialog ---------- */
.codebuilder-scratchpad-dialog {
  width: min(760px, 92vw);
  max-height: 85vh;
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--text-main);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-content {
  max-height: 68vh;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-toolbar .cb-select { min-width: 9rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-run + .codebuilder-scratchpad-run { margin-top: 1rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { border-left-color: var(--text-muted); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-kind {
  padding: 0 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title { margin: 0.3rem 0; font-weight: 600; }

/* ---------- Editor panel ---------- */
.codebuilder-editor-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.codebuilder-open-tree {
  min-width: min(480px, 80vw);
  max-height: 55vh;
  overflow: auto;
}

.codebuilder-memory-dialog {
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #444);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev, #1f2430);
  color: inherit;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  width: min(420px, 92vw);
}

.codebuilder-memory-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog h3 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog label { display: block; margin-top: 0.7rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog .form-select,
.codebuilder-memory-dialog .form-input { width: 100%; margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }

.editor-surface {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-textarea {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  resize: none;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  tab-size: 4;
}

.codebuilder-statusbar {
  min-height: 25px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.codebuilder-statusbar span:first-child {
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* ---------- Console panel ---------- */
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ---------- Panel headings ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-heading,
.codebuilder-console-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.codebuilder-agent-select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.codebuilder-chat-status {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.codebuilder-console-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.2rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button {
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.codebuilder-console-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text-main); background: var(--bg-elev); }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button.active { color: var(--text-main); background: var(--bg-elev); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary); }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

.cb-section-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 32px; }
.cb-section-head h3 { margin: 0 auto 0 0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.cb-section-head .cb-btn-accent { height: 28px; font-size: 0.78rem; }

/* ---------- Chat composer ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.codebuilder-chat-form textarea {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 64px;
  max-height: 180px;
  resize: vertical;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}
.codebuilder-chat-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; }
.codebuilder-model { flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-muted); }

.codebuilder-workflow-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-color);
}
.cb-squad-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-right: 0.15rem; }
.codebuilder-workflow-actions .cb-btn { height: 30px; }

.codebuilder-output-section,
.codebuilder-problems-section {
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
}

.codebuilder-output-section {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.console-output {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 70px;
  max-height: 40vh;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0.55rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.codebuilder-problems-section {
  flex: 0 1 35%;
  overflow: auto;
}

.diagnostics-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
}

.diagnostics-list p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.diagnostic-item {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem;
  border: 0;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  color: var(--text-main);
  text-align: left;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

button.diagnostic-item {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.diagnostic-item[data-severity="warning"] {
  border-left-color: var(--warning);
}

.diagnostic-item[data-severity="info"] {
  border-left-color: var(--primary);
}

/* ---------- Chat panel (left column) ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-messages {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message {
  align-self: flex-start;
  max-width: 85%;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant {
  max-width: min(95%, 900px);
  min-width: 0;
  white-space: normal;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant .prompt-rich-markdown { font-size: inherit; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h1 { font-size: 1.3em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h2 { font-size: 1.15em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h3,
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h4 { font-size: 1.05em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant .md-code-block pre { font-size: 0.82rem; }

.codebuilder-chat-text {
  min-width: 0;
}

.codebuilder-code-block {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.45rem 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-language {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-transform: lowercase;
}

.codebuilder-code-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.codebuilder-copy-code,
.codebuilder-send-code,
.codebuilder-expand-code,
.codebuilder-modal-close {
  padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.codebuilder-chat-code {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor,
.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor .margin,
.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor-background {
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-block pre {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  tab-size: 4;
}

.codebuilder-code-block code {
  white-space: pre;
}

.codebuilder-chat-code > pre {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.system {
  align-self: center;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.codebuilder-orchestration-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-width: 0;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-summary span:first-child {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-bar p {
  grid-column: 1;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-bar button {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  align-self: center;
}
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="running"] { color: var(--primary); }
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="error"] { color: var(--danger); }
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="success"] { color: var(--success); }

/* ---------- Expanded code modal ---------- */
.codebuilder-code-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: rgba(8, 10, 16, 0.72);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: min(1100px, 94vw);
  max-height: 88vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-heading .codebuilder-code-actions {
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-body {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor,
.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor .margin,
.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor-background {
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

body.codebuilder-modal-open {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ---------- Responsive: medium ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .codebuilder-layout {
    grid-template-columns: var(--chat-w, 300px) var(--chat-gutter, 8px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: minmax(280px, 1.4fr) minmax(180px, 0.7fr);
  }
  .codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="chat"] { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="console"] { display: none; }
  .codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
  .codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed .codebuilder-console-panel { visibility: visible; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
}

/* ---------- Responsive: small ---------- */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .codebuilder-shell { height: auto; min-height: 900px; }
  .codebuilder-toolbar { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .codebuilder-toolbar-actions { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .codebuilder-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: 460px minmax(350px, 55vh) minmax(260px, 35vh);
    min-height: 900px;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .codebuilder-resizer { display: none; }
  .codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .codebuilder-editor-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; margin-top: 0; }
  .codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed .codebuilder-chat-panel { visibility: visible; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
  .codebuilder-statusbar { gap: 0.55rem; font-size: 0.65rem; }
}
/* ---------- Terminal (docked tab + pop-out page) ---------- */
.codebuilder-console-panel.show-terminal .codebuilder-output-section,
.codebuilder-console-panel.show-terminal .codebuilder-problems-section {
  display: none;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-section {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-section[hidden],
.codebuilder-terminal-popped[hidden],
.codebuilder-terminal-mount[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-mount {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-popped {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1.5rem 0.5rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.tw-terminal {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: #1e1e1e;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.5rem;
}

.tw-terminal-page,
.tw-terminal-page #terminal-root {
  height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
}

.tw-terminal-page .tw-terminal {
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border-radius: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.tw-terminal-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.tw-terminal-spacer { flex: 1; }

.tw-terminal-cwd {
  color: #9cdcfe;
  font: 0.72rem Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.tw-terminal-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #1f6f43;
  color: #fff;
}

.tw-terminal-links a {
  display: block;
  color: #4ec9b0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.tw-terminal-output {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 6rem;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: #d4d4d4;
  font: 0.78rem/1.45 Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
}

.tw-terminal-form {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #333;
  padding-top: 0.4rem;
}

.tw-terminal-prompt { color: #4ec9b0; font-family: Consolas, monospace; }

.tw-terminal-input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font: 0.8rem Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
}

.codebuilder-filename {
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Code squad progress strip and live agent messages */
.codebuilder-squad-steps {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin: 0.15rem 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.55rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="idle"] { opacity: 0.45; }
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="running"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  animation: codebuilder-step-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="success"] { border-color: var(--success); color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="error"],
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="nothing_found"] { border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-step-attempt { font-size: 0.65rem; opacity: 0.8; }
@keyframes codebuilder-step-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.55; } }

.codebuilder-agent-message { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="code-builder"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="tester"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="code-troubleshooter"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-agent-header {
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.codebuilder-agent-body.is-streaming {
  max-height: 14rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: normal;
}
.codebuilder-agent-body { white-space: normal; }
.codebuilder-workflow-stop { border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }
/* Run-scoped squad scratchpad, shared by CodeBuilder and the Runs page. */
.squad-scratchpad-dialog { width: min(1050px, 94vw); max-height: 90vh; overflow: auto; padding: 1rem; color: var(--text-main); background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); color-scheme: dark; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); }
.squad-scratchpad-header, .squad-scratchpad-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: end; gap: .6rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-header { justify-content: space-between; }
.squad-scratchpad-header h2 { margin: 0; }
.squad-scratchpad-controls label, .squad-scratchpad-note label { display: grid; gap: .25rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-content { max-height: 50vh; overflow: auto; margin: .75rem 0; }
.squad-scratchpad-note { margin: .75rem 0; }

/* ---------- Run scratchpad layout ----------
 * One fixed window: header and controls stay put, only the entry list scrolls. */
.reader-dialog.squad-scratchpad-dialog[open] {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: .6rem;
  width: min(1050px, 94vw);
  height: min(88vh, 900px);
  max-height: 94vh;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  resize: none;
}
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > * { flex: 0 0 auto; margin: 0; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > .squad-scratchpad-header { align-items: center; padding-bottom: .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sp-line, var(--border-color)); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; justify-content: space-between; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > .squad-scratchpad-header .scratchpad-switcher-bar { margin-left: auto; margin-right: .5rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > .squad-scratchpad-header h2 { font-size: 1.15rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > p.text-muted { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--sp-muted, var(--text-muted)); }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-controls {
  align-items: flex-end;
  padding: .6rem .7rem;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-controls label { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--sp-muted, var(--text-muted)); }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-controls .form-select { min-width: 12rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .reader-toolbar { margin: 0; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog > p[role="status"] { margin: 0; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text-main); }
.reader-dialog.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-content {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: .75rem;
  overflow: auto;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-note {
  margin: 0;
  padding: .5rem .7rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-note > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-note[open] { display: grid; gap: .5rem; padding-bottom: .7rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-note .form-input { width: 100%; }
/* Entry cards inside the run scratchpad: readable header, clear body. */
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > summary { font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.5; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > p.text-muted { margin: .2rem 0 .5rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.squad-scratchpad-dialog .prompt-rich-markdown { font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .reader-dialog.squad-scratchpad-dialog[open] { width: 96vw; height: 92vh; padding: .8rem; }
  .squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-controls label { flex: 1 1 100%; }
  .squad-scratchpad-dialog .squad-scratchpad-controls .form-select { min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
}

```

## `frontend/static/css/squads.css`
```css
/* Novous Squads — app shell (sidebar) and the Squads / Agents / Tools / Runs sections.
   Builds on the tokens in style.css. */

/* --- Shell: sections as tabs in the top bar --------------------------------- */
.navbar { padding: 0 1.25rem; min-height: 50px; gap: 1.25rem; }
.navbar .logo { flex-shrink: 0; }
.app-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 50px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.app-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.app-tab-group { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.1rem; }
.app-tab-divider { width: 1px; margin: 14px 0; background: var(--border-color); flex-shrink: 0; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 0.8rem;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.app-tabs .nav-btn:hover { color: var(--text-main); background: transparent; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 6px; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn.active { color: var(--text-main); border-bottom-color: var(--primary); }
#health-badge { flex-shrink: 0; }

/* --- Page scaffolding -------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; width: 100%; max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sq-page-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
.sq-page-head h2 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1.35rem; }
.sq-page-head p { margin: 0; }
.sq-page h4 { margin: 1rem 0 0.4rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }

.sq-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; align-items: center; }
.sq-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;
}
.sq-chip-x {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0 0.1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1;
}
.sq-chip-x:hover { color: var(--danger); }

.sq-link {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
}
.sq-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.sq-msg { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; margin: 0.35rem 0; }
.sq-msg-error { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); color: var(--danger); }
.sq-msg-warn { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); color: var(--warning); }
.sq-msg-ok {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35);
}
.sq-msg-ok .form-select { width: auto; }

.sq-empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 2rem 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

.sq-pre {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow: auto;
}

.sq-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; }
.sq-field > span:first-child { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-field-inline { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; }
.sq-field-inline .form-input { width: 5rem; }

.sq-segmented { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.sq-segmented label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-segmented label:last-child { border-right: none; }
.sq-segmented input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.sq-segmented label:has(input:checked) { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--text-main); }
.sq-segmented label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

.sq-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
.sq-search { max-width: 280px; }

/* --- Squads home ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-home { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
.sq-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-main);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
}
.sq-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-card.is-selected { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--primary); }
.sq-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; }
.sq-card-flow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.82rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.sq-architect-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-architect-head p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }
.sq-architect-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-inline-select { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; }
.sq-inline-select .form-select { width: auto; }
.sq-pattern-note { margin: 0.6rem 0; }
.sq-architect-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px; gap: 1rem; margin: 0.75rem 0; }

.sq-canvas-host {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(139, 148, 167, 0.18) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0 / 18px 18px,
    var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0.5rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.sq-canvas { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 520px; height: auto; }
.sq-node { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
.sq-node rect { fill: var(--bg-card); stroke: var(--border-color); stroke-width: 1.5; transition: stroke 0.15s; }
.sq-node-lead rect { stroke: var(--accent); }
.sq-node-subagent rect { stroke-dasharray: 5 3; }
.sq-node:hover rect, .sq-node:focus-visible rect { stroke: var(--primary); }
.sq-node.is-selected rect { stroke: var(--primary); stroke-width: 2.5; fill: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }
.sq-node-title { fill: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.sq-node-sub { fill: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.sq-edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--text-muted); stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.8; }
.sq-edge-return { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
.sq-arrow-head { fill: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-step { fill: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.sq-empty { fill: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; text-anchor: middle; }

.sq-inspector {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  min-width: 0;
}
.sq-inspector h4 { margin: 0.9rem 0 0.4rem; }
.sq-inspector .form-select, .sq-agent-card .form-select { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; }
.sq-inspector code { word-break: break-all; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-inspector-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-inspector-head strong { margin-right: auto; }
.sq-inspector-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 0.9rem; }

/* --- Builder ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.sq-stepper { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 1.1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-stepper button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem 0.4rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.sq-stepper button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }
.sq-step-num {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 1.4rem;
  height: 1.4rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.sq-stepper .is-current button { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--text-main); }
.sq-stepper .is-current .sq-step-num { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.sq-stepper .is-done .sq-step-num { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); color: var(--success); }

.sq-step-body { min-height: 220px; }
.sq-builder-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 0.85rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }

.sq-choice-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; }
.sq-choice {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.sq-choice input { position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; }
.sq-choice strong { padding-right: 1.5rem; }
.sq-choice:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-choice.is-selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }
.sq-choice:has(input:disabled) { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.sq-group-title { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: baseline; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.5rem; }
.sq-group-title:not(:first-child) { margin-top: 1.1rem; }

.sq-two-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 280px; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-order { position: sticky; top: 0; }
.sq-order-list { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; padding-left: 1.2rem; }
.sq-order-list li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.15rem 0; }
.sq-order-actions { display: inline-flex; }
.sq-order-actions .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.sq-toggle { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-toggle input { margin-top: 0.2rem; }

.sq-create { margin-top: 1rem; border: 1px dashed var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; }
.sq-create summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary); font-size: 0.88rem; }

.sq-tool-table { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
.sq-tool-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 1fr) 260px;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-elev);
}
.sq-tool-owner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: flex-start; }
.sq-tool-add { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-tool-add .form-select { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; }

.sq-review { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-validation h4 { margin-top: 0; }

/* --- Agents ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-create-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.sq-agent-groups { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem; }
.sq-squad-group { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; }
.sq-squad-group-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.sq-squad-group-header::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.sq-squad-group-header::before { content: "▸"; color: var(--text-muted); transition: transform 0.12s; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.sq-squad-group[open] > .sq-squad-group-header::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.sq-squad-color-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sq-squad-group-header strong { margin-right: auto; }
.sq-squad-group-header .sq-squad-link { margin-left: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.75rem; }
.sq-squad-group-unassigned {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-squad-group > .sq-agent-grid { padding: 0.75rem; }
.sq-agent-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; }
.sq-agent-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem; }
.sq-agent-card p { margin: 0; }

.sq-prompt-viewer { margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.sq-prompt-toggle {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.sq-prompt-toggle:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.sq-prompt-content { margin-top: 0.4rem; }
.sq-prompt-content .sq-pre {
  max-height: 320px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* --- Tools ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-tool-catalog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 420px; overflow-y: auto; }
.sq-tool-category { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
.sq-tool-category:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sq-tool-category h4 { margin: .75rem .25rem .25rem; }
.sq-tool-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(240px, 340px);
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-tool-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.sq-tool-item p { margin: 0.25rem 0; }
.sq-tool-item code { color: var(--text-muted); word-break: break-word; }
.sq-tool-users { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }

/* --- Runs ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-runs {
  display: grid;
  /* Left half: run form. Right half: live trace. Full-width result along the bottom. */
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: "form trace" "result result";
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.sq-runs > .card { min-width: 0; }
.sq-run-form { grid-area: form; }
/* The trace fills its half: the timeline takes the remaining height and the empty state is centred. */
.sq-trace { grid-area: trace; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.sq-trace .sq-timeline { flex: 1; min-height: 260px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.sq-trace .sq-timeline > li.text-muted:only-child { margin: auto; text-align: center; }
.sq-result { grid-area: result; }
.sq-run-form .btn-primary { width: 100%; }
.sq-recent { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
.sq-recent li { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; }

.sq-timeline {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  max-height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.sq-event {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 78px 150px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-event:nth-child(odd) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); }
.sq-event-time { color: var(--text-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sq-event-type { text-transform: capitalize; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-event-text { word-break: break-word; }
.sq-event-run_started, .sq-event-run_complete { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
.sq-event-agent_message { border-left-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-event-tool_call_start, .sq-event-tool_call_end { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.sq-event-scratchpad_handoff { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.sq-event.is-error, .sq-event-error { border-left-color: var(--danger); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08); }

.sq-answer {
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sq-output { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.sq-output summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.3rem 0; }
.sq-steps { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.sq-steps th, .sq-steps td { text-align: left; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); vertical-align: top; }
.sq-steps th { color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; }
.sq-steps tr.is-error td { color: var(--danger); }

/* --- Squad Map dialog ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sd-starter-dialog { width: min(1400px, 96vw); max-width: 96vw; height: 92vh; max-height: 92vh; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; overflow: hidden; }
.sd-starter-resize { position: absolute; z-index: 10; }
.sd-resize-n { top: -3px; left: 10px; right: 10px; height: 7px; cursor: n-resize; }
.sd-resize-s { bottom: -3px; left: 10px; right: 10px; height: 7px; cursor: s-resize; }
.sd-resize-e { right: -3px; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 7px; cursor: e-resize; }
.sd-resize-w { left: -3px; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 7px; cursor: w-resize; }
.sd-resize-ne { top: -3px; right: -3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: ne-resize; }
.sd-resize-nw { top: -3px; left: -3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: nw-resize; }
.sd-resize-se { bottom: -3px; right: -3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: se-resize; }
.sd-resize-sw { bottom: -3px; left: -3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: sw-resize; }
.sd-starter-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .75); }
.sd-starter-dialog[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .5rem; }
/* Embedded (non-modal) Prompt Starter: fills its host panel instead of floating. */
.sd-starter-embed {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: .5rem;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1rem;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sd-starter-head, .sd-starter-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sd-starter-head h2, .sd-starter-main h3, .sd-starter-fields h3 { margin: 0; }
.sd-starter-editor-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-layout { display: flex; gap: 0; flex: 1; min-height: 0; }
.sd-starter-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; gap: .4rem; flex: 2; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-divider { flex: 0 0 7px; cursor: col-resize; background: var(--border-color); transition: background 0.1s; position: relative; border-radius: 3px; margin: 0 .25rem; }
.sd-starter-divider::after { content: '⋮'; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; pointer-events: none; }
.sd-starter-divider:hover, .sd-starter-divider:active { background: var(--primary); }
.sd-starter-fields { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; }
.sd-starter-editor { flex: 1; min-height: 180px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1rem; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 14px/1.6 Consolas, monospace; background: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); }
.sd-starter-token { display: inline; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(88, 166, 255, .18); color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.sd-starter-token:hover, .sd-starter-token:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #58a6ff; }
.sd-starter-picker { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: min(320px, 85%); padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4); }
.sd-starter-picker[hidden] { display: none; }
.sd-starter-picker select, .sd-starter-picker input { width: 100%; margin-top: .4rem; }
.sd-starter-picker-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-fields { overflow: auto; min-height: 0; }
.sd-starter-fields-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-fields-head h3 { margin: 0; }
.sd-starter-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; padding: .5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
.sd-starter-field-description { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.sd-starter-field button { align-self: flex-start; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker { width: min(680px, 92vw); height: min(78vh, 700px); max-width: 92vw; max-height: 92vh; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-main); }
.sd-starter-tool-picker[open] { display: flex; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .72); }
.sd-starter-tool-picker-panel { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: .5rem; min-height: 0; padding: 1rem; overflow: hidden; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker-head h3, .sd-starter-tool-picker-panel > p { margin: 0; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker-panel .editor-tools-list { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.sd-starter-tool-picker-panel .workspace-save-actions { justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: .25rem; }
.sd-starter-field-actions { display: flex; gap: .4rem; }
.sd-starter-ai-dialog { width: min(640px, 92vw); max-height: 88vh; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-main); }
.sd-starter-ai-dialog[open] { display: flex; }
.sd-starter-ai-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .72); }
.sd-starter-ai-panel { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; min-height: 0; padding: 1rem; overflow: auto; }
.sd-starter-ai-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; }
.sd-starter-ai-pane[hidden] { display: none; }
.sd-starter-ai-pane > label.small { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; }
.sd-starter-ai-context { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .35rem; max-height: 180px; overflow: auto; padding: .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-primary); }
.sd-starter-ai-context label { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .5rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sd-starter-ai-context label span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-ai-context label span .small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sd-starter-ai-response { min-height: 240px; resize: vertical; }
.sd-starter-ai-pane .workspace-save-actions { display: flex; gap: .4rem; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: .25rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sd-starter-ai-pane .workspace-save-actions .spacer { flex: 1; }
.sd-starter-ai-preprompt-row { display: flex; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; }
.sd-starter-ai-preprompt-row select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-ai-results { margin-top: .75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-ai-results summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.sd-starter-ai-result { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; padding: .5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
.sd-starter-ai-result-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
.sd-starter-ai-result-preprompt { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sd-starter-ai-result-text { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; max-height: 20rem; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: .4rem; background: var(--bg-primary); }
.sd-starter-ai-result-actions { display: flex; gap: .3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sd-starter-field-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .25rem 0 .4rem; }
.sd-starter-field-nav select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-field-count { white-space: nowrap; }
.sd-starter-field-value { resize: vertical; }
.sd-starter-choice-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; max-height: 9rem; overflow: auto; }
.sd-starter-choice-row { display: flex; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-choice-row .sd-starter-choice { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.sd-starter-choice-delete { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1; padding: .2rem .4rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.sd-starter-choice-delete:hover, .sd-starter-choice-delete:focus-visible { border-color: #e5534b; color: #e5534b; }
.sd-starter-choice { text-align: left; font-size: .8rem; padding: .2rem .45rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-main); cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sd-starter-choice:hover, .sd-starter-choice:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary); }
.sd-starter-actions { justify-content: flex-start; }
.sd-starter-actions-sep { flex: 1; }
.sd-starter-template-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: .25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
.sd-starter-template-bar label { white-space: nowrap; }
.sd-starter-template-bar select { max-width: 240px; }
.sd-starter-create-form { padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-primary); }
.sd-starter-create-form[hidden] { display: none; }
.sd-starter-create-form h4 { margin: 0 0 .5rem; }
.sd-starter-create-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
.sd-starter-create-row[hidden], .sd-starter-create-row label[hidden] { display: none; }
.sd-starter-create-row label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .15rem; font-weight: 500; }
.sd-starter-create-row input, .sd-starter-create-row select { min-width: 140px; }
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .sd-starter-layout { flex-direction: column; overflow: auto; }
  .sd-starter-main { min-height: 360px; flex: none; }
  .sd-starter-editor { height: 300px; flex: none; }
  .sd-starter-divider { display: none; }
  .sd-starter-fields { overflow: visible; flex: none; }
}

/* --- Prompt Starter window controls --- */
.sd-starter-window-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
.sd-wc-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 26px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, color .12s; }
.sd-wc-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); color: var(--text-main); }
.sd-wc-btn:active { background: var(--bg-active, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); }
.sd-wc-close:hover { background: #e81123; color: #fff; }

/* Maximized state */
.sd-starter-dialog.sd-starter-maximized { border-radius: 0; }
.sd-starter-dialog.sd-starter-maximized .sd-starter-resize { display: none; }

/* Minimized bar */
.sd-starter-minimized-bar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 1000; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-bottom: none; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.sd-starter-minimized-bar span { font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; }

/* Pop-out mode dialog fills the window */
.sd-starter-popout-host { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
.sd-starter-dialog.sd-starter-popout-mode { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh; margin: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; }
.sd-starter-dialog.sd-starter-popout-mode .sd-starter-resize { display: none; }
.sd-starter-dialog.sd-starter-popout-mode::backdrop { background: transparent; }

.sq-map-dialog {
  width: min(1500px, 97vw);
  height: 92vh;
  max-height: 97vh;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  color: var(--text-main);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color-scheme: dark;
  transition: width 0.2s, height 0.2s;
}
.sq-map-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); }
.sq-map-expanded { width: 99vw; height: 98vh; max-height: 99vh; border-radius: 4px; }

/* Header */
.sq-map-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sq-map-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.sq-map-head p { margin: 0; flex: 1; min-width: 120px; }
.sq-map-font-controls, .sq-map-layout-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}
.sq-map-font-label {
  min-width: 3.2em;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.cb-btn-sm { padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.78rem; }
.cb-btn-active { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); border-color: var(--primary); }
.cb-btn-success { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); border-color: var(--success); color: var(--success); }

/* Body: graph sidebar + prompts side by side */
.sq-map-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Graph sidebar (left) */
.sq-map-graph {
  flex: 0 0 220px;
  width: 220px;
  padding: 0.6rem;
  overflow: auto;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(139, 148, 167, 0.12) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0 / 18px 18px,
    var(--bg-dark);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  transition: width 0.15s, flex-basis 0.15s;
}
.sq-map-graph-hidden { width: 0 !important; flex-basis: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; overflow: hidden; border-right: none; }
.sq-map-canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.sq-map-node { cursor: pointer; }
.sq-map-node:hover rect { stroke-width: 2.5; filter: brightness(1.1); }
.sq-map-node.is-selected rect { stroke-width: 2.5; fill: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); }

/* Clickable edge hit areas */
.sq-map-edge-hit { cursor: pointer; }
.sq-map-edge-hit:hover + .sq-map-edge-vis { stroke-width: 3.5 !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
.sq-map-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

/* Resize handle — vertical bar between graph and prompts */
.sq-map-resize-handle {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 8px;
  cursor: col-resize;
  background: var(--border-color);
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.1s;
}
.sq-map-resize-handle::after {
  content: '⋮';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.sq-map-resize-handle:hover,
.sq-map-resize-handle:active { background: var(--primary); }
.sq-map-resize-hidden { display: none; }
.sq-map-resizing { user-select: none; }

/* Prompts area (right) */
.sq-map-prompts {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sq-map-prompts-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
}
.sq-map-prompts-cols {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
}
.sq-map-prompt-col {
  flex: 1 0 320px;
  min-width: 200px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.sq-map-prompt-col:last-of-type { border-right: none; }
.sq-map-col-selected {
  outline: 3px solid var(--sel-color, #3b82f6);
  outline-offset: -3px;
  box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--sel-color, #3b82f6),
              0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sel-color, #3b82f6) 35%, transparent);
  z-index: 1;
  position: relative;
}
.sq-map-col-selected .sq-map-prompt-header {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sel-color, #3b82f6) 20%, var(--bg-elev));
  border-top-color: var(--sel-color, #3b82f6) !important;
}
.sq-map-col-selected .sq-map-editor {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sel-color, #3b82f6) 6%, var(--bg-dark));
}

/* Column resize divider */
.sq-map-col-divider {
  flex: 0 0 6px;
  cursor: col-resize;
  background: var(--border-color);
  transition: background 0.1s;
  position: relative;
}
.sq-map-col-divider:hover,
.sq-map-col-divider:active { background: var(--primary); }
.sq-map-prompt-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sq-map-prompt-header strong { font-size: 0.88rem; margin-right: auto; }
.sq-map-prompt-tools {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-map-prompt-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Monaco editor host */
.sq-map-editor-host {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fallback plain textarea */
.sq-map-editor {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  margin: 0;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  resize: none;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace;
  font-size: var(--map-font-size, 14px);
  line-height: 1.65;
  tab-size: 2;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.sq-map-editor:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }

/* Dirty indicator */
.sq-map-dirty-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--warning);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sq-map-dirty-dot[hidden] { display: none; }

/* Status bar */
.sq-map-status { margin: 0; padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.8rem; flex-shrink: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }

/* Edge popout overlay */
.sq-map-edge-popout {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 20;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}
.sq-map-edge-popout-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
}
.sq-map-edge-popout-head strong { margin-right: auto; font-size: 1rem; }
```
