```css
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}
.reader-nav button:hover { color: var(--text-main); border-color: var(--primary); }
/* Everything inside scales with the A− / A+ setting. */
.scratchpad-reader { font-size: var(--reader-size, 0.9rem); line-height: 1.55; }
.scratchpad-reader .small { font-size: 0.85em; }
.scratchpad-reader .scratchpad-section h3 { font-size: 1.05em; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-reader pre { max-height: 60vh; font-size: 0.9em; }
.scratchpad-reader .scratchpad-read > summary .badge { font-size: 0.8em; vertical-align: middle; }
.scratchpad-reader .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { font-size: 1em; }
.scratchpad-reader .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { font-size: 0.85em; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-run > summary { cursor: pointer; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > summary { cursor: pointer; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > summary .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { display: inline-flex; vertical-align: middle; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > summary .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title { display: block; }

/* ---------- Scratchpad readability ----------
 * Scoped to the scratchpad dialogs (.reader-dialog). Text meets WCAG AA contrast on every
 * surface: muted text and links are lifted from the global greys, and each level of
 * nesting (entry > passage > code) gets its own surface so the layers stay distinct. */
.reader-dialog {
  color-scheme: dark;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  --sp-text: #e6eaf2;
  --sp-muted: #aab3c5;
  --sp-link: #7cb2ff;
  --sp-code-bg: #0d0e11;
  --sp-surface: #1b1d23;
  --sp-raised: #252931;
  --sp-line: #3a3f4a;
  color: var(--sp-text);
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-reader,
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-section,
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read,
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry,
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-run > summary { color: var(--sp-text); }
.reader-dialog .text-muted,
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-run > summary,
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { color: var(--sp-muted); }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-section h3 {
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sp-line);
}
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read,
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry {
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  background: var(--sp-surface);
  border-color: var(--sp-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read > summary { line-height: 1.5; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read p { margin: 0.4rem 0; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read .scratchpad-read { background: var(--sp-raised); margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-result-query {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  color: var(--sp-text);
  background: var(--sp-raised);
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-read pre,
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-section > pre,
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-payload {
  color: var(--sp-text);
  background: var(--sp-code-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--sp-line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  font: 0.85em/1.6 Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace;
}
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-tree { background: var(--sp-surface); border-color: var(--sp-line); border-radius: 6px; }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-file-link,
.reader-dialog .reader-nav a,
.reader-dialog .reader-nav button { color: var(--sp-link); }
.reader-dialog .scratchpad-file-link:hover,
.reader-dialog .reader-nav button:hover { color: #ffffff; border-color: var(--sp-link); }
.reader-dialog .reader-nav a,
.reader-dialog .reader-nav span { border-color: var(--sp-line); }
.reader-dialog .text-danger { color: #ff8a8a; }
.reader-dialog .badge { font-weight: 700; }

/* Entry headers: a readable kind chip instead of a bare outlined word. */
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { border-left-width: 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { font-size: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title { margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem; font-size: 0.95em; color: var(--sp-text); }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-kind {
  padding: 0.05rem 0.55rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #0b0c0f;
  background: var(--kind-color, var(--accent));
}
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { --kind-color: #4ade80; border-left-color: #4ade80; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { --kind-color: #fbbf24; border-left-color: #fbbf24; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { --kind-color: #f87171; border-left-color: #f87171; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { --kind-color: #94a3b8; border-left-color: #94a3b8; }
.reader-dialog .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry > summary { padding: 0.1rem 0; }

```

## `frontend/static/css/test_panel.css`
```css
.test-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.test-panel-header {
  height: 48px;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 0 0.5rem 0 0.85rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: var(--bg-card);
}

.test-panel-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.test-panel-content {
  padding: 16px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.test-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
.test-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.test-group-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.test-group-buttons { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(135px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.todo-selector-section {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.todo-selector-section .form-select {
  width: 100%;
}

.suite-dialog-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68);
}

.suite-dialog {
  width: min(860px, 96vw);
  max-height: 94vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

.suite-dialog-header,
.suite-dialog-steps-heading,
.suite-output-heading,
.suite-dialog-footer,
.suite-dialog-footer-secondary,
.suite-result-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.suite-dialog-header h2,
.suite-dialog-steps-heading h3,
.suite-output-heading h3 {
  margin: 0;
}

.suite-dialog-header h2 { font-size: 1.1rem; }
.suite-dialog-header p { margin: 0.2rem 0 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.suite-dialog-config { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; }
.suite-dialog-config label { display: grid; gap: 0.3rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-dialog-config .form-select { width: 100%; }
.suite-dialog-steps-heading h3,
.suite-output-heading h3 { font-size: 0.9rem; }
.suite-step-list { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; max-height: 26vh; overflow-y: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0 0.25rem 0 1.8rem; }
.suite-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; }
.suite-step > input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: var(--primary); }
.suite-step .form-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0.42rem 0.55rem; }
.suite-step-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.15rem; }
.suite-step-action { min-width: 28px; padding: 0.25rem; line-height: 1; }
.suite-output-section { display: flex; flex: 1; min-height: 120px; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; }
.suite-evaluation-note { margin: 0; }
.suite-output { display: flex; min-height: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg-dark); }
.suite-output:empty::before { content: "Execution messages and model responses will appear here."; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-result { padding: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); }
.suite-result-heading { justify-content: flex-start; font-size: 0.78rem; }
.suite-result-heading strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.suite-result pre { margin: 0.4rem 0 0; max-height: 180px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-library { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; }
.suite-library label { display: grid; flex: 1; min-width: 200px; gap: 0.3rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-library .form-select { width: 100%; }
.suite-step-expect { grid-column: 2 / -1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.4rem; }
.suite-step-expect .form-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-history { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; }
.suite-history ul { display: grid; gap: 0.3rem; max-height: 14vh; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow-y: auto; list-style: none; }
.suite-history-run { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.suite-dialog-footer { flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 0.65rem; }
.suite-dialog-footer-secondary { justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.suite-dialog button:disabled,
.suite-dialog input:disabled,
.suite-dialog select:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* Compact icon + label buttons in the same family as .cb-btn. */
.test-function {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, color 0.12s;
}
.test-function:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2d323b; border-color: var(--primary); }
.test-function:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }
.test-function:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }

.test-function i,
.test-function svg {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  color: var(--primary);
}

.test-function span {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.test-function[data-test-function="wipeChat"] svg,
.test-function[data-test-function="clearScratchpad"] svg { color: var(--danger); }

.test-function.disabled,
.test-function:disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.test-function:disabled svg { color: var(--text-muted); }

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .suite-dialog { max-height: 96vh; padding: 0.75rem; }
  .suite-dialog-config { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .suite-step { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .suite-step-actions { grid-column: 2; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .suite-step-list { max-height: 22vh; }
  .suite-step-expect { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .suite-output-section { min-height: 140px; }
}

/* Floating (non-modal) runner window: the chat behind it stays visible and clickable. */
.suite-dialog-floating {
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: none;
}
.suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog {
  position: fixed;
  top: 4.5rem;
  right: 1.25rem;
  width: min(680px, calc(100vw - 2.5rem));
  height: min(78vh, 820px);
  max-height: none;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 360px;
  resize: both;
  overflow: auto;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog-header { cursor: move; user-select: none; }
.suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog-header button { cursor: pointer; }
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog {
    top: 0.5rem;
    right: 0.5rem;
    left: 0.5rem;
    width: auto;
    height: 80vh;
    resize: none;
  }
}

/* Window size controls: explicit width and height sliders for the floating runner. */
.suite-size-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem 1rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.suite-size-controls label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; }
.suite-size-controls input[type="range"] { width: 130px; accent-color: var(--primary); cursor: pointer; }
.suite-size-controls output { min-width: 4.2em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text); }
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .suite-size-controls { display: none; }
}

/* Window frame: the header stays put, the body scrolls, and resize handles sit on every edge. */
.suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog {
  right: auto;
  overflow: visible;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: none;
  resize: none;
  touch-action: none;
}
.suite-dialog-floating .suite-dialog-header { touch-action: none; }
.suite-window-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.suite-window-controls button { min-width: 30px; padding: 0.25rem 0.45rem; line-height: 1; }
.suite-window-body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
.suite-resize { position: absolute; z-index: 2; touch-action: none; }
.suite-resize-n, .suite-resize-s { left: 12px; right: 12px; height: 10px; cursor: ns-resize; }
.suite-resize-n { top: -5px; }
.suite-resize-s { bottom: -5px; }
.suite-resize-e, .suite-resize-w { top: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 10px; cursor: ew-resize; }
.suite-resize-e { right: -5px; }
.suite-resize-w { left: -5px; }
.suite-resize-ne, .suite-resize-sw, .suite-resize-nw, .suite-resize-se { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.suite-resize-ne { top: -5px; right: -5px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
.suite-resize-sw { bottom: -5px; left: -5px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
.suite-resize-nw { top: -5px; left: -5px; cursor: nwse-resize; }
.suite-resize-se { bottom: -5px; right: -5px; cursor: nwse-resize; }
.suite-dialog.is-minimized .suite-window-body,
.suite-dialog.is-minimized .suite-resize,
.suite-dialog.is-expanded .suite-resize { display: none; }
.suite-dialog.is-minimized .suite-dialog-header { border-bottom: 0; }

/* Pop-out window: the runner fills its own browser window; window-only controls are hidden. */
.suite-dialog.is-popout .suite-resize,
.suite-dialog.is-popout [data-suite-popout],
.suite-dialog.is-popout [data-suite-hide],
.suite-dialog.is-popout [data-suite-expand] { display: none; }
.suite-dialog-popout .suite-dialog { box-shadow: none; border: 0; }
```

## `frontend/static/js/agent_meters.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Per-agent meters for a squad run: each agent's state, how full its model's context window got,
 * and how its tool calls went. Live telemetry fills the meters while a run is going; the run's
 * saved agent_stats (from the server) replace them once it finishes.
 */
import { esc } from './shell.js';

const STATE_LABEL = { idle: 'Waiting', running: 'Running', success: 'Done', error: 'Failed', done: 'Done' };
const LEVEL_LABEL = { ok: 'OK', warn: 'Watch', crit: 'Limit', unknown: 'Unknown' };
const LEVEL_RANK = { ok: 0, warn: 1, crit: 2 };
const FAILURE_LABEL = {
  unknown_tool: 'unknown tool', bad_arguments: 'bad arguments', tool_error: 'tool error', model_error: 'model error'
};
const FLAG_LABEL = {
  context_full: 'context full', context_filling: 'context filling', rounds_exhausted: 'out of tool rounds',
  tool_failures: 'tool failures', unknown_tool: 'unknown tool', model_error: 'model error'
};
const CRITICAL_FLAGS = new Set(['context_full', 'rounds_exhausted', 'model_error']);

function nonZero(failures = {}) {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(failures).filter(([, count]) => count > 0));
}

function mergeUsage(previous, data) {
  const level = LEVEL_RANK[data.level] > LEVEL_RANK[previous?.level] ? data.level : (previous?.level || data.level);
  const numCtx = data.num_ctx || previous?.numCtx || 0;
  const peak = Math.max(previous?.peak || 0, data.peak_prompt_tokens || 0);
  const flags = new Set([...(previous?.flags || []), ...String(data.flags || '').split(',').filter(Boolean)]);
  return {
    numCtx,
    peak,
    percent: numCtx ? Math.round(peak / numCtx * 1000) / 10 : 0,
    level,
    flags: [...flags],
    llmCalls: (previous?.llmCalls || 0) + (data.calls || 0),
    toolsActive: data.tools_active ?? previous?.toolsActive ?? null,
    toolsTotal: data.tools_total ?? previous?.toolsTotal ?? null
  };
}

function meterCard(agent) {
  const usage = agent.usage;
  const percent = usage ? Math.min(100, usage.percent) : 0;
  const level = usage?.level || 'ok';
  const failureKinds = Object.entries(agent.failures)
    .map(([kind, count]) => `${count} ${FAILURE_LABEL[kind] || kind}`).join(' · ');
  const tools = usage?.toolsTotal != null ? ` · tools ${usage.toolsActive}/${usage.toolsTotal}` : '';
  const flags = (usage?.flags || []).filter(flag => FLAG_LABEL[flag]).map(flag =>
    `<span class="badge ${CRITICAL_FLAGS.has(flag) ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-warning'}">${esc(FLAG_LABEL[flag])}</span>`
  ).join(' ');
  const windowText = usage
    ? `Peak ${usage.percent}% of ${usage.numCtx} tokens`
    : 'No model usage yet';
  return `
    <article class="agent-meter" data-agent="${esc(agent.id)}">
      <div class="agent-meter-head">
        <strong>${esc(agent.id)}</strong>
        <span class="agent-meter-state" data-state="${esc(agent.state)}">${esc(STATE_LABEL[agent.state] || agent.state)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="agent-meter-bar" role="progressbar" aria-label="Context window used by ${esc(agent.id)}"
           aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="${Math.round(percent)}">
        <span class="agent-meter-fill" data-level="${esc(level)}" style="width: ${percent}%"></span>
      </div>
      <p class="text-muted small">${esc(windowText)} · ${agent.calls} tool calls · ${agent.errors ? `${agent.errors} failed` : 'no failures'}${failureKinds ? ` (${esc(failureKinds)})` : ''}${esc(tools)}</p>
      ${flags ? `<p class="agent-meter-flags">${flags}</p>` : ''}
    </article>`;
}

export function createAgentMeters(container) {
  const agents = new Map();

  function agentFor(id) {
    if (!agents.has(id)) {
      agents.set(id, { id, state: 'idle', calls: 0, errors: 0, failures: {}, usage: null });
    }
    return agents.get(id);
  }

  function render() {
    container.innerHTML = agents.size
      ? [...agents.values()].map(meterCard).join('')
      : '<p class="text-muted small">Agents appear here as the run starts.</p>';
  }

  function reset() {
    agents.clear();
    render();
  }

  /** Live telemetry: called for every event of the run, in order. */
  function onEvent(event) {
    const data = event.data || {};
    const id = data.agent_id || event.sender;
    if (!id || id === 'orchestrator' || id === 'unknown') return;
    const agent = agentFor(id);
    switch (event.event_type) {
      case 'AGENT_MESSAGE':
        if (data.status === 'running') agent.state = 'running';
        else if (data.status === 'error') agent.state = 'error';
        else if (data.status) agent.state = 'success';
        break;
      case 'TOOL_CALL_START':
        if (agent.state === 'idle') agent.state = 'running';
        break;
      case 'TOOL_CALL_END':
        agent.calls += 1;
        if (data.status === 'error') {
          agent.errors += 1;
          const kind = data.error_kind || 'tool_error';
          agent.failures[kind] = (agent.failures[kind] || 0) + 1;
        }
        break;
      case 'AGENT_USAGE':
        agent.usage = mergeUsage(agent.usage, data);
        break;
      default:
        return;
    }
    render();
  }

  /** A finished run's agent_stats, as saved on the server. */
  function setFromStats(stats) {
    agents.clear();
    for (const entry of stats?.agents || []) {
      agents.set(entry.agent_id, {
        id: entry.agent_id,
        state: 'done',
        calls: entry.tool_calls,
        errors: entry.tool_errors,
        failures: nonZero(entry.failures),
        usage: {
          numCtx: entry.num_ctx,
          peak: entry.peak_prompt_tokens,
          percent: entry.percent_peak,
          level: entry.level,
          flags: entry.flags || [],
          llmCalls: entry.llm_calls,
          toolsActive: entry.tools_active ?? null,
          toolsTotal: entry.tools_total ?? null
        }
      });
    }
    render();
  }

  return { reset, onEvent, setFromStats };
}

/** One line for a finished run: the worst window use, tool failures and scratchpad handoffs. */
export function runHealthHtml(stats) {
  const summary = stats?.summary;
  if (!summary) return '';
  const level = LEVEL_LABEL[summary.level] ? summary.level : 'unknown';
  return `<p class="run-health run-health-${esc(level)}"><strong>Run health ${esc(LEVEL_LABEL[level])}:</strong>
    worst context ${esc(summary.percent_peak)}% of its window · ${esc(summary.tool_calls)} tool calls, ${esc(summary.tool_errors)} failed ·
    ${esc(summary.scratchpad_reads)} scratchpad reads, ${esc(summary.scratchpad_writes)} writes.</p>`;
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/api.js`

```javascript
/**
 * Novous Unified API Client Wrapper
 */
async function jsonOrThrow(res) {
  let data = null;
  try { data = await res.json(); } catch (_) { /* empty body */ }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const detail = (data && (data.detail || data.message)) || res.statusText;
    throw new Error(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail));
  }
  return data;
}

function get(url) { return fetch(url).then(jsonOrThrow); }
function send(method, url, body) {
  return fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: body !== undefined ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {},
    body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  }).then(jsonOrThrow);
}

const SAVE_TYPES = {
  md: { description: 'Markdown file', mime: 'text/markdown' },
  html: { description: 'Web page', mime: 'text/html' },
};

export const Api = {
  async saveMarkdown(content, filename) {
    return this.saveTextFile(content, filename, 'md');
  },

  /** Save text through the browser's save dialog, or download it where that is unavailable. */
  async saveTextFile(content, filename, kind = 'md') {
    const { description, mime } = SAVE_TYPES[kind] || SAVE_TYPES.md;
    if (typeof window.showSaveFilePicker === 'function') {
      const handle = await window.showSaveFilePicker({
        suggestedName: filename,
        types: [{ description, accept: { [mime]: [`.${kind}`] } }]
      });
      const writable = await handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(new Blob([content], { type: `${mime};charset=utf-8` }));
      await writable.close();
      return { filename, locationChosen: true };
    }

    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob([content], { type: `${mime};charset=utf-8` })
    );
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = objectUrl;
    link.download = filename;
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 1000);
    return { filename, locationChosen: false };
  },

  // --- System ---
  async getHealth() {
    return get('/api/health');
  },

  // --- Agents & Chat (Core Engine) ---
  async getAgents(environment = 'workspace') {
    return get(`/api/agents?environment=${encodeURIComponent(environment)}`);
  },

  async createAgent(agentId, name, description, mode = 'chat', squad = '', environment = 'workspace', environmentName = '') {
    return send('POST', '/api/agents/create', {
      agent_id: agentId, name, description, mode, squad, environment, environment_name: environmentName
    });
  },

  async deleteAgent(agentId, environment = 'workspace') {
    return send('DELETE', `/api/agents/${encodeURIComponent(agentId)}?environment=${encodeURIComponent(environment)}`);
  },

  async getAgentTools(kind, agentId) {
    return get(`/api/agent-tools/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/${encodeURIComponent(agentId)}`);
  },

  async getAgentToolFit(agentId, environment = 'workspace') {
    return get(`/api/agents/${encodeURIComponent(agentId)}/tool-fit?environment=${encodeURIComponent(environment)}`);
  },

  async setAgentTools(kind, agentId, tools, mode = null, subagents = null) {
    return send('PUT', `/api/agent-tools/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/${encodeURIComponent(agentId)}`, { tools, mode, subagents });
  },

  async getCodeBuilderAgents() {
    return get('/api/codebuilder/agents');
  },

  async sendMessage(message, agentId, model = 'qwen2.5-coder:14b', sessionId = null, environment = 'workspace') {
    return send('POST', '/api/chat', {
      message, agent_id: agentId, model, session_id: sessionId, environment
    });
  },

  async getAgentScratchpad() {
    return get('/api/agent-memory/scratchpad');
  },

  async clearAgentScratchpad() {
    return send('DELETE', '/api/agent-memory/scratchpad');
  },

  async getCodeScratchpad(filters = {}) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(
      Object.entries(filters).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== '')
    );
    const query = params.toString();
    return get(`/api/agent-memory/code-scratchpad${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`);
  },

  async clearCodeScratchpad() {
    return send('DELETE', '/api/agent-memory/code-scratchpad');
  },

  async getChatScratchpad(sessionId = '') {
    const query = sessionId ? `?session_id=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}` : '';
    return get(`/api/agent-memory/chat-scratchpad${query}`);
  },

  async listChatScratchpadSessions() {
    return get('/api/agent-memory/chat-scratchpad/sessions');
  },

  async clearChatScratchpad(sessionId = '') {
    const query = sessionId ? `?session_id=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}` : '';
    return send('DELETE', `/api/agent-memory/chat-scratchpad${query}`);
  },

  async getSquadScratchpadRuns() {

  },

  async getSquadScratchpadRun(runId) {

  async getRagDocuments(baseId) {

  },

  async selectRagBase(baseId) {

  },

  async reindexRag(baseId) {

  },

  async getRagScan() {

  },

  async pauseRagScan() {

  },

  async decideRagScanError(decision) {
    return send('POST', '/api/rag/scan/decision', { decision });
  },

  async scheduleRagResume(resumeAt) {
    return send('POST', '/api/rag/scan/schedule', { resume_at: resumeAt });
  },

  async clearRagIndex(baseId) {
    const query = baseId ? `?base_id=${encodeURIComponent(baseId)}` : '';
    return send('DELETE', `/api/rag/index${query}`);
  },

  async streamMessage(
    message,
    agentId,
    model = 'qwen2.5-coder:14b',
    sessionId = null,
    environment = 'workspace',
    onEvent = () => {},
    signal
  ) {
    const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message, agent_id: agentId, model, session_id: sessionId, environment
      }),
      signal
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const detail = payload.detail || payload.message || response.statusText;
      throw new Error(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail));
    }
    if (!response.body) throw new Error('The chat stream returned no response body.');

    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = '';
    let completed = null;
    const consume = async frame => {
      const data = frame.split(/\r?\n/)
        .filter(line => line.startsWith('data:'))
        .map(line => line.slice(5).trimStart())
        .join('\n');
      if (!data) return;
      const event = JSON.parse(data);
      await onEvent(event);
      if (event.type === 'error') throw new Error(event.detail || 'The agent request failed.');
      if (event.type === 'done') completed = event;
    };

    try {
      for (;;) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: !done });
        const frames = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
        buffer = frames.pop() || '';
        for (const frame of frames) await consume(frame);
        if (done) break;
      }
      if (buffer.trim()) await consume(buffer);
    } finally {
      reader.releaseLock();
    }
    if (!completed) throw new Error('The agent stream ended before returning a completed response.');
    return completed;
  },

  async exportSession(sessionId) {
    const safeSessionId = String(sessionId).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]/g, '_');
    const suggestedName = `novous_${safeSessionId}_${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.md`;
    let pickerResult = null;
    if (typeof window.showSaveFilePicker === 'function') {
      pickerResult = window.showSaveFilePicker({
        suggestedName,
        types: [{
          description: 'Markdown file',
          accept: { 'text/markdown': ['.md'] }
        }]
      }).then(handle => ({ handle }), error => ({ error }));
    }

    const res = await fetch('/api/chat/export', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ session_id: sessionId })
    });
    if (!res.ok) await jsonOrThrow(res);
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const disposition = res.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '';
    const filenameMatch = disposition.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i);
    const filename = filenameMatch ? filenameMatch[1] : suggestedName;

    if (pickerResult) {
      const result = await pickerResult;
      if (result.error) throw result.error;
      const writable = await result.handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(blob);
      await writable.close();
      return { filename, locationChosen: true };
    }

    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = objectUrl;
    link.download = filename;
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 1000);
    return { filename, locationChosen: false };
  },
```

```javascript
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { renderEditorView } from './editor.js';
import { renderChatView } from './chat.js';
import { leavePromptCreationView, renderPromptCreationView } from './prompt_creation.js';
import { renderCodeBuilderView } from './codebuilder/codebuilder.js';
import { AppState, esc, refreshAgents, refreshSquads, updateHealthBadge } from './shell.js';
import { renderWorkspaceView } from './views/workspace_view.js';
import { renderFileManagerView } from './views/file_manager_view.js';
import { renderKnowledgeView } from './views/knowledge_view.js';
import { renderSquadsView } from './squads/squads_view.js';
import { renderAgentsView } from './squads/agents_view.js';
import { renderToolsView } from './squads/tools_view.js';
import { renderRunsView, stopRunStream } from './squads/runs_view.js';
import { renderModelsView } from './views/models_view.js';
import { leaveSquadDevelopment, renderSquadDevelopment } from './squad_development.js';

export { AppState };

const views = {
  squads: renderSquadsView,
  agents: renderAgentsView,
  tools: renderToolsView,
  models: renderModelsView,
  runs: renderRunsView,
  dashboard: renderWorkspaceView,
  files: renderFileManagerView,
  knowledge: renderKnowledgeView,
  editor: renderEditorView,
  codebuilder: renderCodeBuilderView,
  chat: renderChatView,
  'squad-development': renderSquadDevelopment,
  'prompt-creation': renderPromptCreationView
};

// Old links (?tab=testing, the former Prompt Testing page) land on their new section.
const TAB_ALIASES = { testing: 'tools' };

export function switchTab(tab, payload = null) {
  tab = TAB_ALIASES[tab] || tab;
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(views, tab)) tab = 'squads';
  if (AppState.activeTab === 'squad-development' && !leaveSquadDevelopment()) return;
  if (AppState.activeTab === 'prompt-creation') leavePromptCreationView();
  if (tab !== 'runs') stopRunStream();
  AppState.activeTab = tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b =>
    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tab));
  const container = document.getElementById('view-container');
  if (!container) return;
  container.replaceChildren();
  views[tab](container, payload);
}

window.addEventListener('novous:navigate', event => {
  switchTab(event.detail.tab, event.detail.payload);
});

window.addEventListener('novous:open-editor', event => {
  const file = event.detail;
  if (file && typeof file.path === 'string') {
    switchTab('editor', { path: file.path, managedFile: file.managedFile === true });
  }
});

async function boot() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(btn.dataset.tab));
  });

  try {
    await Promise.all([refreshAgents(), refreshSquads()]);
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('view-container').innerHTML =
      `<div class="error-panel">Failed to load workspace: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
    return;
  }

  try {
    const h = await Api.getHealth();
    AppState.health = h;
    updateHealthBadge(h);
  } catch (_) { /* badge stays default */ }

  switchTab(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab') || 'squads');
}

boot();

```

## `frontend/static/js/chat.js`
````javascript
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { createIcon, iconSvg } from './icons.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from './markdown.js';
import { ragWarningNodes } from './rag_warnings.js';
import { setupScratchpadReader } from './scratchpad_reader.js';
import { attachScratchpadSwitcher } from './scratchpad_switcher.js';
import { setupSidePanels } from './side_panels.js';
import { buildTestPanel } from './test_panel.js';
import { contextChipText, contextLevel, renderContextReport, summarizeReport } from './context_window.js';
import { openTestSuiteRunner } from './test_suite_runner.js';
import { renderTree } from './tree.js';

/** Saved sub-agent results, oldest first, including the latest one if history lacks it. */
function scratchpadSubagentHistory(memory) {
  const subagentHistory = Array.isArray(memory.subagent_history)
    ? [...memory.subagent_history]
    : [];
  const latestSubagent = memory.latest_subagent_result;
  if (
    latestSubagent
    && typeof latestSubagent === 'object'
    && Object.keys(latestSubagent).length
    && !subagentHistory.some(entry => entry.updated_at === latestSubagent.updated_at)
  ) {
    subagentHistory.push(latestSubagent);
  }
  return subagentHistory;
}

export function formatScratchpadMarkdown(memory) {
  const lines = ['# Agent Scratchpad', '', `Exported: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`, ''];
  const subagentHistory = scratchpadSubagentHistory(memory);

  lines.push('## Sub-agent Results', '');
  if (!subagentHistory.length) {
    lines.push('No sub-agent results are currently saved.', '');
  } else {
    subagentHistory.slice().reverse().forEach((entry, index) => {
      const payload = entry.payload && typeof entry.payload === 'object'
        ? entry.payload
        : {};
      lines.push(
        `### ${index === 0 ? 'Latest: ' : ''}${entry.subagent_id || 'Unknown sub-agent'}`,
        '',
        `- **Status:** ${entry.status || 'unknown'}`,
        `- **Task type:** ${entry.task_type || 'unspecified'}`
      );
      if (entry.updated_at) lines.push(`- **Updated:** ${entry.updated_at}`);
      if (payload.query) lines.push(`- **Query:** ${String(payload.query).replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ')}`);
      if (payload.knowledge_branch_name) {
        lines.push(`- **Knowledge branch:** ${payload.knowledge_branch_name}`);
      }
      if (payload.knowledge_branch_id) {
        lines.push(`- **Knowledge branch ID:** ${payload.knowledge_branch_id}`);
      }
      if (payload.error) lines.push(`- **Error:** ${payload.error}`);
      if (payload.skipped_incompatible_chunks) {
        lines.push(`- **Skipped incompatible vectors:** ${payload.skipped_incompatible_chunks}`);
      }

      const RETRIEVAL_KEYS = ['query', 'knowledge_branch_name', 'knowledge_branch_id', 'error',
        'skipped_incompatible_chunks', 'results'];
      const extraPayload = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(payload).filter(([key]) => !RETRIEVAL_KEYS.includes(key))
      );
      if (typeof entry.payload === 'string' && entry.payload.trim()) {
        lines.push('', '```', entry.payload, '```');
      } else if (Object.keys(extraPayload).length) {
        lines.push('', '```json', JSON.stringify(extraPayload, null, 2), '```');
      }

      const results = Array.isArray(payload.results) ? payload.results : [];
      if (results.length) {
        lines.push('', `#### Retrieved passages (${results.length})`, '');
        results.forEach((result, resultIndex) => {
          lines.push(`##### ${resultIndex + 1}. ${result.path || 'Retrieved passage'}`);
          if (result.score !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(result.score))) {
            lines.push('', `- **Relevance:** ${Number(result.score).toFixed(4)}`);
          }
          if (result.chunk_index !== undefined) {
            lines.push(`- **Chunk:** ${result.chunk_index}`);
          }
          lines.push('', '###### Passage', '');
          const content = String(result.content || '');
          const longestFence = Math.max(
            0,
            ...Array.from(content.matchAll(/`+/g), match => match[0].length)
          );
          const fence = '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, longestFence + 1));
          lines.push(fence, content || '(No passage text returned.)', fence, '');
        });
      } else {
        lines.push('', entry.status === 'nothing_found'
          ? 'Retrieval completed without relevant passages.'
          : 'No retrieved passages were saved.', '');
      }
      if (index < subagentHistory.length - 1) lines.push('---', '');
    });
  }

  const reads = Array.isArray(memory.read_history)
    ? memory.read_history
    : (memory.latest_read ? [memory.latest_read] : []);
  lines.push('## Recent File Reads', '');
  if (!reads.length) {
    lines.push('No file reads are currently saved.', '');
  } else {
    reads.forEach((entry, index) => {
      if (index) lines.push('---', '');
      lines.push(`### ${entry.path || 'Unknown file'}`, '');
      if (entry.updated_at) lines.push(`- **Read at:** ${entry.updated_at}`);
      if (entry.request) lines.push(`- **Request:** ${String(entry.request).replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ')}`);
      lines.push('', '#### Contents', '');
      const content = String(entry.content || '');
      const longestFence = Math.max(
        0,
        ...Array.from(content.matchAll(/`+/g), match => match[0].length)
      );
      const fence = '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, longestFence + 1));
      lines.push(fence, content, fence, '');
    });
  }

  lines.push('## Latest Workspace Map', '');
  if (memory.latest_map?.tree) {
    lines.push(`Requested path: ${memory.latest_map.requested_path || 'Workspace root'}`, '');
    const renderNode = (node, depth = 0) => {
      const indent = '  '.repeat(depth);
      (node.children || []).forEach(child => {
        const label = child.type === 'directory' ? `**${child.name}/**` : child.name;
        lines.push(`${indent}- ${label}${child.path ? ` — \`${child.path}\`` : ''}`);
        if (child.type === 'directory') renderNode(child, depth + 1);
      });
    };
    lines.push(`- **${memory.latest_map.tree.name || 'Workspace'}/**`);
    renderNode(memory.latest_map.tree);
    lines.push('');
  } else {
    lines.push('No workspace map is currently saved.', '');
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

/**
 * Interactive Chat Console Component: agent selection, message history,
 * and tool execution badges.
 */
export function renderChatView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="chat-layout">
      <aside class="chat-file-sidebar" aria-label="Workspace files">
        <div class="chat-panel-head">
          <div class="chat-panel-title">
            <h3>Workspace files</h3>
            <span class="text-muted small">Open a file in the editor</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" id="chat-files-toggle">${iconSvg('chevron-left')}</button>
        </div>
        <div id="chat-file-tree" class="tree-pane"></div>
      </aside>

      <div class="chat-resizer panel-resizer" data-resize="files" role="separator" tabindex="0"
           aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize files panel"><span class="cb-grip">${iconSvg('chevron-right', 14)}</span></div>

      <section class="chat-main" aria-label="Conversation">
        <div class="chat-main-head">
          <h3>Conversation</h3>
          <button type="button" class="ctx-chip" id="chat-context-chip" hidden
            title="Open the context window"></button>
          <button type="button" class="ctx-chip" id="chat-tools-chip" hidden
            title="Tool calls and failures for this chat"></button>
          <div class="chat-font-controls cb-group" role="group" aria-label="Chat text size">
            <button type="button" class="cb-btn" id="chat-font-smaller"
              title="Smaller text" aria-label="Decrease chat text size">A−</button>
            <button type="button" class="cb-btn" id="chat-font-larger"
              title="Larger text" aria-label="Increase chat text size">A+</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="chat-messages" class="messages-scroll">
          <div class="message system-msg">Select an agent and send a message to start reasoning.</div>
        </div>
        <form id="chat-form" class="chat-input-bar">
          <input type="text" id="chat-input" class="form-input" placeholder="Type a message or instruction…" autocomplete="off" required />
          <button type="submit" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" disabled title="Send (Enter)"><span>Send</span></button>
        </form>
        <div class="chat-quick-actions">
          <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-ghost" id="chat-reset-quick" disabled
            title="Start a fresh session with this agent">${iconSvg('reset')}<span>Reset session</span></button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="chat-resizer panel-resizer" data-resize="controls" role="separator" tabindex="0"
           aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize controls panel"><span class="cb-grip">${iconSvg('chevron-left', 14)}</span></div>

      <aside class="test-panel" aria-label="Chat and test controls">
        <div class="test-panel-header">
          <span class="test-panel-title">Chat &amp; test controls</span>
          <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" id="chat-controls-toggle">${iconSvg('chevron-right')}</button>
        </div>
        <div class="test-panel-content">
          <section class="chat-controls">
            <h3 class="chat-controls-title">Chat settings</h3>
            <label class="chat-field-label" for="chat-agent-select">Agent</label>
            <select id="chat-agent-select" class="cb-select">
              <option value="">Loading agents...</option>
            </select>
            <div id="agent-meta-card" class="card chat-agent-meta">
              <p class="text-muted">Select an agent to begin chatting.</p>
            </div>
            <details class="agent-tool-descriptions">
              <summary>Agent tool descriptions</summary>
              <div id="agent-tool-description-list" class="agent-tool-description-list">
                <p class="text-muted small">Loading registered tool descriptions…</p>
              </div>
            </details>
            <label class="checkbox-row">
              <input type="checkbox" id="chat-use-tools" checked>
              <span>Attach tools (agent mode)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="model-picker">
              <span class="model-picker-label">Model <span id="model-count" class="text-muted small"></span></span>
              <select id="chat-model-select" class="cb-select" disabled><option value="">Detecting models…</option></select>
            </label>
            <div class="chat-session-buttons">
              <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" id="chat-save-log" disabled><span>Save session log (.md)</span></button>
              <button class="cb-btn" id="chat-reset" disabled><span>Reset session</span></button>
            </div>
            <div id="chat-session-info" class="text-muted small"></div>
          </section>
          <div id="testPanelButtons" class="test-grid"></div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
    <dialog id="chat-scratchpad-dialog" class="scratchpad-dialog reader-dialog">
      <div class="scratchpad-dialog-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Agent Scratchpad</h2>
          <p class="text-muted small">Sub-agent results, retrieved evidence, recent file reads, and the latest workspace map. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-scratchpad-refresh>Refresh</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-scratchpad-close aria-label="Close">Close</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="chat-scratchpad-toolbar"></div>
      <p id="chat-scratchpad-status" class="small text-danger" role="status" hidden></p>
      <div id="chat-scratchpad-content" class="scratchpad-content"></div>
    </dialog>
    <dialog id="chat-knowledge-catalog-dialog" class="scratchpad-dialog">
      <div class="scratchpad-dialog-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Knowledge TOC</h2>
          <p class="text-muted small">Live catalog of saved knowledge branches. Expand a branch to see its indexed documents.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-catalog-refresh>Refresh</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-catalog-close aria-label="Close">Close</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="chat-knowledge-catalog-content" class="scratchpad-content" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </dialog>
    <dialog id="chat-rag-dialog" class="scratchpad-dialog">
      <div class="scratchpad-dialog-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Knowledge sources</h2>
          <p class="text-muted small">Each named branch links one folder to its own searchable index. Deleting a branch removes its saved index, not the folder or its files.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-rag-close aria-label="Close">Close</button>
      </div>
      <section class="scratchpad-section">
        <label class="chat-field-label" for="chat-rag-base">Choose a source</label>
        <select id="chat-rag-base" class="form-select"></select>
        <form id="chat-rag-base-form" class="rag-add-form">
          <h3>Add a folder</h3>
          <label class="small" for="chat-rag-base-name">Source name</label>
          <input id="chat-rag-base-name" class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Business decisions" required>
          <label class="small" for="chat-rag-base-path">Folder to search</label>
          <textarea id="chat-rag-base-path" class="form-input root-path-input" rows="2" placeholder="E:\\BUSN410\\Critical Thinking Strategies\\week 1" required></textarea>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm">Save source</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-archive" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Archive source</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-rename" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Rename source</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-delete" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Delete branch</button>
        </form>
        <p id="chat-rag-job" class="small text-muted" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <div id="chat-rag-error-actions" class="root-management-actions" hidden>
          <span class="small">Retry this file, skip just this one and ask again, or skip all remaining errors?</span>
          <button id="chat-rag-error-retry" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Retry file</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-error-skip" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Skip this file</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-error-skip-all" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Skip all errors</button>
        </div>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button id="chat-rag-scan" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Index selected source</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-pause" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Pause</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-stop" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Stop indexing</button>
          <button id="chat-rag-resume" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Resume</button>
        </div>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <label class="small" for="chat-rag-resume-at">Resume at</label>
          <input id="chat-rag-resume-at" class="form-input" type="datetime-local">
          <button id="chat-rag-schedule" type="button" class="btn btn-sm">Schedule resume</button>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div id="chat-rag-content" class="scratchpad-content"></div>
      <form id="chat-rag-form" class="rag-add-form">
        <h3>Add text to this source</h3>
        <input id="chat-rag-title" class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Text title (same title replaces it)" required>
        <textarea id="chat-rag-text" class="form-input" rows="4" placeholder="Text to add to this source" required></textarea>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Add text</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-rag-refresh>Refresh</button>
        </div>
        <p class="small" id="chat-rag-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </form>
    </dialog>
    <dialog id="chat-context-dialog" class="scratchpad-dialog context-dialog">
      <div class="scratchpad-dialog-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Context window</h2>
          <p class="text-muted small">What the model receives for this chat: the system prompt, the tool schemas and each message. Ollama's measured prompt size is shown after each reply.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-context-refresh>Refresh</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-context-close aria-label="Close">Close</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p id="chat-context-status" class="small text-danger" role="status" hidden></p>
      <div id="chat-context-content" class="scratchpad-content" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </dialog>`;

  const agentSelect = container.querySelector('#chat-agent-select');
  const metaCard = container.querySelector('#agent-meta-card');
  const agentToolDescriptionList = container.querySelector('#agent-tool-description-list');
  const messagesBox = container.querySelector('#chat-messages');
  const chatForm = container.querySelector('#chat-form');
  const chatInput = container.querySelector('#chat-input');
  const sendButton = chatForm.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
  const saveLogButton = container.querySelector('#chat-save-log');
  const resetButton = container.querySelector('#chat-reset');
  const quickResetButton = container.querySelector('#chat-reset-quick');
  const toolsToggle = container.querySelector('#chat-use-tools');
  const sessionInfo = container.querySelector('#chat-session-info');
  const modelSelect = container.querySelector('#chat-model-select');
  const modelCount = container.querySelector('#model-count');
  const scratchpadDialog = container.querySelector('#chat-scratchpad-dialog');
  const scratchpadContent = container.querySelector('#chat-scratchpad-content');
  const scratchpadStatus = container.querySelector('#chat-scratchpad-status');
  const scratchpadReader = setupScratchpadReader({
    content: scratchpadContent,
    toolbar: container.querySelector('#chat-scratchpad-toolbar'),
    prefsKey: 'novous2.chat.scratchpad.',
    title: 'Agent Scratchpad',
    filenameBase: 'novous-agent-scratchpad',
    getMarkdown: async () => formatScratchpadMarkdown(await Api.getAgentScratchpad()),
    onError: error => {
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = error.message;
      scratchpadStatus.hidden = false;
    },
  });
  const chatMain = container.querySelector('.chat-main');
  const chatLayout = container.querySelector('.chat-layout');
  setupSidePanels({
    shell: chatLayout,
    layout: chatLayout,
    prefsKey: 'novous2.chat.',
    centerMin: 360,
    panels: {
      files: {
        var: '--files-w', edge: 'left', min: 200, hideBelow: 130, default: 260, label: 'files',
        resizer: container.querySelector('.chat-resizer[data-resize="files"]'),
        toggle: container.querySelector('#chat-files-toggle'),
      },
      controls: {
        var: '--controls-w', edge: 'right', min: 260, hideBelow: 160, default: 330, label: 'controls',
        resizer: container.querySelector('.chat-resizer[data-resize="controls"]'),
        toggle: container.querySelector('#chat-controls-toggle'),
      },
    },
  });

  function scratchpadSection(title, count) {
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.className = 'scratchpad-section';
    const heading = document.createElement('h3');
    heading.textContent = count === undefined ? title : `${title} (${count})`;
    section.appendChild(heading);
    return section;
  }

  function emptyNote(text) {
    const empty = document.createElement('p');
    empty.className = 'text-muted';
    empty.textContent = text;
    return empty;
  }

  function renderSubagentEntry(entry, open) {
    const payload = entry.payload && typeof entry.payload === 'object' ? entry.payload : {};
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    details.className = 'scratchpad-read';
    details.dataset.readerItem = '';
    details.open = open;
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    const statusValue = String(entry.status || 'unknown');
    const status = document.createElement('span');
    status.className = `badge ${statusValue === 'success' ? 'badge-success' : statusValue === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-warning'}`;
    status.textContent = statusValue;
    const timestamp = entry.updated_at ? new Date(entry.updated_at).toLocaleString() : '';
    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = [entry.subagent_id || 'Unknown sub-agent', entry.task_type || '', timestamp]
      .filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    summary.append(status, ' ', label);
    details.appendChild(summary);

    if (payload.query) {
      const query = document.createElement('p');
      query.className = 'scratchpad-result-query';
      query.textContent = `Query: ${payload.query}`;
      details.appendChild(query);
    }
    if (payload.knowledge_branch_name) {
      const branch = document.createElement('p');
      branch.className = 'text-muted small';
      branch.textContent = `Knowledge branch: ${payload.knowledge_branch_name}`;
      details.appendChild(branch);
    }
    if (payload.error) {
      const error = document.createElement('p');
      error.className = 'text-danger';
      error.textContent = payload.error;
      details.appendChild(error);
    }

    const results = Array.isArray(payload.results) ? payload.results : [];
    // Payloads from other sub-agents and from write_agent_scratchpad have their own keys
    // (for example "answers" and "summary"); show them instead of claiming nothing was saved.
    const RETRIEVAL_KEYS = new Set(['query', 'knowledge_branch_name', 'error', 'results']);
    const extra = entry.payload && typeof entry.payload === 'object'
      ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entry.payload).filter(([key]) => !RETRIEVAL_KEYS.has(key)))
      : entry.payload;
    const hasExtra = typeof extra === 'string' ? extra.trim() !== '' : !!extra && Object.keys(extra).length > 0;
    if (!results.length && hasExtra) {
      const content = document.createElement('pre');
      content.className = 'scratchpad-payload';
      content.textContent = typeof extra === 'string' ? extra : JSON.stringify(extra, null, 2);
      details.appendChild(content);
      return details;
    }
    if (!results.length) {
      details.appendChild(emptyNote(statusValue === 'nothing_found'
        ? 'Retrieval completed; no relevant passages were found.'
        : statusValue === 'error'
          ? 'Retrieval failed. See the error above.'
          : 'No retrieved passages were saved.'));
      return details;
    }
    const count = document.createElement('p');
    count.className = 'text-muted small';
    count.textContent = `${results.length} retrieved passage${results.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    details.appendChild(count);
    results.forEach((result, index) => {
      const passage = document.createElement('details');
      passage.className = 'scratchpad-read scratchpad-result';
      passage.open = open && index === 0;
      const passageSummary = document.createElement('summary');
      const score = Number.isFinite(Number(result.score))
        ? ` · relevance ${Number(result.score).toFixed(3)}`
        : '';
      passageSummary.textContent = `${index + 1}. ${result.path || 'Retrieved passage'}${score}`;
      const excerpt = document.createElement('pre');
      excerpt.textContent = result.content || '';
      passage.append(passageSummary, excerpt);
      details.appendChild(passage);
    });
    return details;
  }

  function renderChatScratchpadEntries(entries) {
    const section = scratchpadSection('Current chat entries', entries.length);
    if (!entries.length) {
      section.appendChild(emptyNote('No entries are saved in this chat.'));
      return section;
    }
    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const details = document.createElement('details');
      details.className = 'scratchpad-read';
      details.dataset.readerItem = '';
      details.open = index === 0;
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      const timestamp = entry.created_at ? new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleString() : '';
      summary.textContent = [entry.author || 'Unknown agent', entry.title || '', timestamp]
        .filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      const content = document.createElement('div');
      content.className = 'prompt-rich-markdown';
      appendMarkdown(content, String(entry.content || ''));
      details.append(summary, content);
      section.appendChild(details);
    });
    return section;
  }

  function renderScratchpad(memory, chatEntries = []) {
    scratchpadContent.replaceChildren();
    const chatSection = renderChatScratchpadEntries(chatEntries);
    const subagents = scratchpadSubagentHistory(memory).reverse();
    const reads = Array.isArray(memory.read_history)
      ? memory.read_history
      : (memory.latest_read ? [memory.latest_read] : []);

    const subagentSection = scratchpadSection('Sub-agent results', subagents.length);
    if (!subagents.length) subagentSection.appendChild(emptyNote('No sub-agent results are saved.'));
    subagents.forEach((entry, index) => subagentSection.appendChild(renderSubagentEntry(entry, index === 0)));

    const readsSection = scratchpadSection('Recent file reads', reads.length);
    if (!reads.length) readsSection.appendChild(emptyNote('No file reads are saved.'));
    [...reads].reverse().forEach((entry, index) => {
      const details = document.createElement('details');
      details.className = 'scratchpad-read';
      details.dataset.readerItem = '';
      details.open = index === 0;
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      const timestamp = entry.updated_at ? new Date(entry.updated_at).toLocaleString() : '';
      summary.textContent = [entry.path || 'Unknown file', timestamp].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      const request = document.createElement('p');
      request.className = 'text-muted small';
      request.textContent = entry.request ? `Request: ${entry.request}` : 'No request context.';
      const content = document.createElement('pre');
      content.textContent = entry.content || '';
      details.append(summary, request, content);
      readsSection.appendChild(details);
    });

    const mapSection = scratchpadSection('Latest workspace map');
    if (memory.latest_map?.tree) {
      const path = document.createElement('p');
      path.className = 'text-muted small';
      path.textContent = memory.latest_map.requested_path || 'Workspace root';
      const tree = document.createElement('div');
      tree.className = 'scratchpad-tree';
      tree.dataset.readerItem = '';
      tree.appendChild(createScratchpadTreeNode(memory.latest_map.tree, true));
      mapSection.append(path, tree);
    } else {
      mapSection.appendChild(emptyNote('No workspace map is saved.'));
    }

    const nav = document.createElement('nav');
    nav.className = 'reader-nav';
    nav.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scratchpad sections');
    [
      [`Current chat entries (${chatEntries.length})`, chatSection],
      [`Sub-agent results (${subagents.length})`, subagentSection],
      [`File reads (${reads.length})`, readsSection],
      ['Workspace map', mapSection],
    ].forEach(([label, section]) => {
      const jump = document.createElement('button');
      jump.type = 'button';
      jump.textContent = label;
      jump.addEventListener('click', () => section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }));
      nav.appendChild(jump);
    });
    scratchpadContent.append(nav, chatSection, subagentSection, readsSection, mapSection);
    scratchpadReader.refresh();
  }

  function createScratchpadTreeNode(node, isRoot = false) {
    const list = document.createElement('ul');
    list.className = 'scratchpad-tree-list';
    (node.children || []).forEach(child => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      if (child.type === 'directory') {
        const details = document.createElement('details');
        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = `📁 ${child.name}`;
        details.append(summary, createScratchpadTreeNode(child));
        item.appendChild(details);
      } else {
        const openFile = document.createElement('button');
        openFile.type = 'button';
        openFile.className = 'scratchpad-file-link';
        openFile.textContent = `📄 ${child.name}`;
        openFile.title = child.path;
        openFile.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (document.getElementById('app')) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:open-editor', {
              detail: { path: child.path, managedFile: true }
            }));
          } else {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({ path: child.path, managed: '1' });
            window.location.assign(`/editor?${params}`);
          }
          scratchpadDialog.close();
        });
        item.appendChild(openFile);
      }
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    if (isRoot) {
      const root = document.createElement('details');
      root.open = true;
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      summary.textContent = `📁 ${node.name || 'Workspace'}`;
      root.append(summary, list);
      return root;
    }
    return list;
  }

  async function loadScratchpad() {
    scratchpadStatus.hidden = true;
    scratchpadContent.textContent = 'Loading scratchpad…';
    try {
      const sessionId = `chat-${agentSelect.value}`;
      const [memory, chatScratchpad] = await Promise.all([
        Api.getAgentScratchpad(),
        Api.getChatScratchpad(sessionId),
      ]);
      renderScratchpad(memory, chatScratchpad.entries || []);
    } catch (error) {
      scratchpadContent.textContent = `Could not load scratchpad: ${error.message}`;
    }
  }

  async function openScratchpad() {
    scratchpadDialog.showModal();
    await loadScratchpad();
  }

  container.querySelector('[data-scratchpad-close]').addEventListener('click', () => {
    scratchpadDialog.close();
  });
  container.querySelector('[data-scratchpad-refresh]').addEventListener('click', loadScratchpad);

  attachScratchpadSwitcher({
    toolbar: container.querySelector('#chat-scratchpad-toolbar'),
    content: scratchpadContent,
    nativeControls: [],
    currentStore: 'chat',
    onRestore: loadScratchpad,
    onNativeClear: async () => {
      if (!confirm("Clear this chat's scratchpad entries? This cannot be undone.")) return;
      await Api.clearChatScratchpad(`chat-${agentSelect.value}`);
      await loadScratchpad();
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = 'Scratchpad cleared.';
      scratchpadStatus.hidden = false;
    },
  });

  const knowledgeCatalogDialog = container.querySelector('#chat-knowledge-catalog-dialog');
  const knowledgeCatalogContent = container.querySelector('#chat-knowledge-catalog-content');

  async function loadKnowledgeCatalog() {
    knowledgeCatalogContent.textContent = 'Loading knowledge catalog…';
    try {
      const { bases } = await Api.getRagBases();
      knowledgeCatalogContent.replaceChildren();
      if (!bases.length) {
        const empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'text-muted';
        empty.textContent = 'No knowledge branches have been saved yet.';
        knowledgeCatalogContent.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }
      const list = document.createElement('div');
      list.className = 'knowledge-catalog-list';
      bases.forEach(base => {
        const branch = document.createElement('details');
        branch.className = 'knowledge-catalog-branch';
        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = base.name;
        const metadata = document.createElement('div');
        metadata.className = 'knowledge-catalog-meta small text-muted';
        metadata.textContent = `${base.active ? 'Active' : 'Archived'}${base.selected ? ' · Selected' : ''} · ${base.documents} document(s) · ${base.chunks} chunks`;
        const id = document.createElement('code');
        id.className = 'knowledge-catalog-id';
        id.textContent = `Branch ID: ${base.id}`;
        const documents = document.createElement('ul');
        documents.className = 'knowledge-catalog-documents';
        let loaded = false;
        branch.addEventListener('toggle', async () => {
          if (!branch.open || loaded) return;
          loaded = true;
          const loading = document.createElement('li');
          loading.className = 'text-muted small';
          loading.textContent = 'Loading indexed documents…';
          documents.replaceChildren(loading);
          try {
            const overview = await Api.getRagDocuments(base.id);
            documents.replaceChildren();
            if (!overview.files?.length) {
              const empty = document.createElement('li');
              empty.className = 'text-muted small';
              empty.textContent = 'No indexed documents.';
              documents.appendChild(empty);
            } else {
              overview.files.forEach(file => {
                const item = document.createElement('li');
                item.textContent = `${file.name} · ${file.chunks} chunk(s)`;
                item.title = file.path;
                documents.appendChild(item);
              });
            }
          } catch (error) {
            loaded = false;
            documents.replaceChildren();
            const failure = document.createElement('li');
            failure.className = 'text-danger small';
            failure.textContent = `Could not load documents: ${error.message}`;
            documents.appendChild(failure);
          }
        });
        branch.append(summary, metadata, ...ragWarningNodes(base.warnings), id, documents);
        list.appendChild(branch);
      });
      knowledgeCatalogContent.appendChild(list);
    } catch (error) {
      knowledgeCatalogContent.textContent = `Could not load knowledge catalog: ${error.message}`;
    }
  }

  async function openKnowledgeCatalog() {
    knowledgeCatalogDialog.showModal();
    await loadKnowledgeCatalog();
  }

  container.querySelector('[data-catalog-close]')
    .addEventListener('click', () => knowledgeCatalogDialog.close());
  container.querySelector('[data-catalog-refresh]')
    .addEventListener('click', loadKnowledgeCatalog);

  const ragDialog = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-dialog');
  const ragContent = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-content');
  const ragStatus = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-status');
  const ragForm = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-form');
  const ragBaseSelect = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-base');
  const ragJobStatus = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-job');
  let activeRagBaseId = null;
  let ragBases = [];
  let viewingArchivedBase = false;
  let ragPollInterval = null;

  function showRagStatus(message, kind = 'muted') {
    ragStatus.textContent = message;
    ragStatus.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  function renderRag(overview) {
    ragContent.replaceChildren();
    const summary = document.createElement('p');
    const typeText = Object.entries(overview.types || {})
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .map(([type, count]) => `${type}: ${count}`).join(', ') || 'none';
    summary.textContent = `${overview.name || 'Selected source'} — ${overview.documents} document(s), ${overview.chunks} chunks. Types: ${typeText}.`;
    const folder = document.createElement('p');
    folder.className = 'text-muted small';
    folder.textContent = `${overview.path}${overview.exists ? '' : ' (folder unavailable)'}` +
      (overview.cloud_provider ? ` · ${overview.cloud_provider} folder: online-only files are downloaded before indexing` : '');
    ragContent.append(summary, folder, ...ragWarningNodes(overview.warnings));

    const files = overview.files || [];
    if (!files.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('p');
      empty.className = 'text-muted';
      empty.textContent = 'No information has been indexed from this folder yet.';
      ragContent.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }
    const list = document.createElement('ul');
    list.className = 'rag-file-list';
    files.forEach(file => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      const name = document.createElement('span');
      name.className = 'rag-file-name';
      name.textContent = file.name;
      name.title = file.path;
      const meta = document.createElement('span');
      meta.className = file.chunks ? 'text-muted small' : 'text-danger small';
      meta.textContent = `${file.type} · ${file.chunks} chunk(s)`;
      const remove = document.createElement('button');
      remove.type = 'button';
      remove.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
      remove.textContent = 'Delete';
      remove.disabled = viewingArchivedBase;
      remove.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm(`Remove "${file.name}" from the RAG index? Files on disk are not touched.`)) return;
        try {
          await Api.deleteRagDocument(file.path, activeRagBaseId);
          showRagStatus(`Removed ${file.name}.`, 'success');
          await loadRag();
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not delete: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      item.append(name, meta, remove);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    ragContent.appendChild(list);
  }

  async function loadRag() {
    try {
      const { bases } = await Api.getRagBases();
      ragBases = bases;
      const selected = bases.find(base => base.selected && base.active);
      activeRagBaseId = selected?.id || bases.find(base => base.active)?.id || bases[0]?.id || null;
      viewingArchivedBase = Boolean(
        activeRagBaseId && !bases.find(base => base.id === activeRagBaseId)?.active
      );
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-form [type="submit"]').disabled =
        !activeRagBaseId || viewingArchivedBase;
      ragBaseSelect.replaceChildren();
      if (!bases.length) {
        const emptyOption = document.createElement('option');
        emptyOption.value = '';
        emptyOption.textContent = 'No sources yet';
        ragBaseSelect.appendChild(emptyOption);
      }
      bases.forEach(base => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = base.id;
        option.textContent = `${base.name}${base.active ? '' : ' (archived)'}`;
        option.selected = base.id === activeRagBaseId;
        ragBaseSelect.appendChild(option);
      });
      updateRagBaseAction();
      if (activeRagBaseId) {
        renderRag(await Api.getRagDocuments(activeRagBaseId));
      } else {
        ragContent.textContent = 'No knowledge branches yet. Add a named source folder to create one.';
      }
    } catch (error) {
      ragContent.textContent = `Could not load the RAG index: ${error.message}`;
    }
    await loadRagScan();
  }

  function updateRagBaseAction() {
    const button = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-archive');
    const selected = ragBases.find(base => base.id === ragBaseSelect.value);
    const restoring = selected && !selected.active;
    button.textContent = restoring ? 'Restore source' : 'Archive source';
    button.disabled = !selected;
    container.querySelector('#chat-rag-rename').disabled = !selected;
    container.querySelector('#chat-rag-delete').disabled = !selected;
  }

  async function loadRagScan() {
    try {
      const job = await Api.getRagScan();
      const isActive = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'stopping'].includes(job.status);
      const blocksMutation = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'stopping', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
      const progress = `${job.completed || 0}/${job.discovered || 0} checked · ` +
        `${job.indexed || 0} indexed · ${job.unchanged || 0} unchanged · ` +
        `${job.skipped?.length || 0} skipped · ${job.errors?.length || 0} errors`;
      const current = job.current ? ` — ${job.current}${job.phase ? ` (${job.phase})` : ''}` : '';
      const firstError = job.errors?.[0];
      const errorSummary = job.errors?.length
        ? `; ${job.errors.length} error(s), e.g. ${firstError.path || ''} — ${firstError.error || 'see server log'}`
        : '';
      const pending = job.pending_error
        ? ` Needs your choice for ${job.pending_error.path}: ${job.pending_error.error}`
        : '';
      const schedule = job.resume_at
        ? `; scheduled to resume ${new Date(job.resume_at).toLocaleString()}`
        : '';
      const warning = job.warnings?.length ? ` ⚠ ${job.warnings.map(item => item.message).join(' ')}` : '';
      const state = {
        queued: 'Starting',
        running: 'Indexing',
        pausing: 'Pausing after current file',
        stopping: 'Stopping after current file',
        stopped: 'Stopped',
        awaiting_decision: 'Waiting for your choice',
        paused: 'Paused',
        completed: 'Complete',
        completed_with_skips: 'Complete (files skipped by choice)',
        completed_with_errors: 'Complete with errors',
        unavailable: 'Folder unavailable',
        failed: 'Failed'
      }[job.status] || job.status;
      ragJobStatus.textContent = job.status === 'idle'
        ? 'Index status: Waiting to start.'
        : `${job.base_name || 'Source'}: ${state} — ${progress}${pending || errorSummary}${schedule}${current}${warning}`;
      ragJobStatus.className = `small ${
        warning && ['completed', 'completed_with_skips'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
        : ['completed', 'completed_with_skips', 'running', 'queued'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-success'
          : ['paused', 'pausing', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
            : ['failed', 'completed_with_errors', 'unavailable'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-danger'
              : 'text-muted'
      }`;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-pause').disabled = !isActive;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-stop').disabled =
        !['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-resume').disabled =
        job.status !== 'paused' && job.status !== 'unavailable' && job.status !== 'failed';
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-scan').disabled =
        !activeRagBaseId || viewingArchivedBase || isActive;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-schedule').disabled = job.status !== 'paused';
      const errorActions = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-error-actions');
      errorActions.hidden = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
      errorActions.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
        button.disabled = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
      });
      const selectedBase = ragBases.find(base => base.id === ragBaseSelect.value);
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-delete').disabled =
        !selectedBase || (
          blocksMutation && job.status !== 'paused' && job.base_id === selectedBase.id
        );
    } catch (error) {
      ragJobStatus.textContent = `Could not load indexing status: ${error.message}`;
    }
  }

  async function openRag() {
    ragDialog.showModal();
    ragContent.textContent = 'Loading RAG index…';
    showRagStatus('');
    const resumeInput = container.querySelector('#chat-rag-resume-at');
    const suggestedResume = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000);
    suggestedResume.setMinutes(suggestedResume.getMinutes() - suggestedResume.getTimezoneOffset());
    resumeInput.value = suggestedResume.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
    await loadRag();
    if (ragPollInterval) clearInterval(ragPollInterval);
    ragPollInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (ragDialog.open) {
        loadRagScan();
      } else {
        clearInterval(ragPollInterval);
        ragPollInterval = null;
      }
    }, 1500);
  }

  container.querySelector('[data-rag-close]').addEventListener('click', () => ragDialog.close());
  ragDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
    if (ragPollInterval) clearInterval(ragPollInterval);
    ragPollInterval = null;
  });
  ragBaseSelect.addEventListener('change', async () => {
    const selected = ragBases.find(base => base.id === ragBaseSelect.value);
    if (selected && !selected.active) {
      activeRagBaseId = selected.id;
      updateRagBaseAction();
      showRagStatus(`"${selected.name}" is archived. Its index is preserved and can still be searched by agents.`, 'muted');
      viewingArchivedBase = true;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-form [type="submit"]').disabled = true;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-scan').disabled = true;
      renderRag(await Api.getRagDocuments(selected.id));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await Api.selectRagBase(ragBaseSelect.value);
      activeRagBaseId = ragBaseSelect.value;
      viewingArchivedBase = false;
      container.querySelector('#chat-rag-form [type="submit"]').disabled = false;
      await loadRag();
    } catch (error) {
      showRagStatus(`Could not select source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
    }
  });
````
