## `frontend/static/js/rag_warnings.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Knowledge-source scan warnings (e.g. Google Docs links that cannot be indexed),
 * rendered as a warning line with an expandable list of the affected files.
 */
export function ragWarningNodes(warnings) {
  return (warnings || []).map(warning => {
    const block = document.createElement('div');
    block.className = 'rag-warning small text-warning';
    block.setAttribute('role', 'note');
    const message = document.createElement('span');
    message.textContent = `⚠ ${warning.message}`;
    block.appendChild(message);
    const paths = warning.paths || [];
    if (paths.length) {
      const details = document.createElement('details');
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      summary.textContent = `Show ${paths.length} file(s)`;
      const list = document.createElement('ul');
      paths.forEach(path => {
        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.textContent = path.split('/').pop();
        item.title = path;
        list.appendChild(item);
      });
      details.append(summary, list);
      block.appendChild(details);
    }
    return block;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/sandbox_ui.js`
```javascript
// Shared UI for the isolated test environment (install missing packages, reset).

async function call(method, url, body) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = payload.detail;
    throw new Error(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : (detail?.message || `Request failed (${response.status})`));
  }
  return payload;
}

export const Sandbox = {
  check: (source, modules = []) => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/check', { source, modules }),
  install: packages => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/install', { packages }),
  reset: () => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/reset')
};

export function missingModulesFromOutput(text) {
  const names = [...String(text || '').matchAll(/No module named '([A-Za-z_][\w]*)/g)].map(m => m[1]);
  return [...new Set(names)];
}

export function dialog(title, buildBody) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'question-dialog-overlay';
  const modal = document.createElement('div');
  modal.className = 'card question-dialog';
  modal.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'question-dialog-head';
  const heading = document.createElement('h3');
  heading.textContent = title;
  head.appendChild(heading);
  modal.appendChild(head);
  overlay.appendChild(modal);
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  const close = () => overlay.remove();
  buildBody(modal, close);
  return close;
}

// Resolves true when packages were installed, false when cancelled or failed.
export function promptInstall(missing) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    dialog('Install missing packages?', (modal, close) => {
      const text = document.createElement('p');
      text.className = 'question-dialog-prompt';
      text.textContent = 'This code needs packages that are not in the test environment. ' +
        'Installing runs third-party code from PyPI. Edit the list if a package name is different.';
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.className = 'form-input question-dialog-input';
      input.value = missing.map(item => item.package).join(' ');
      input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Packages to install (space separated)');
      const log = document.createElement('pre');
      log.className = 'tool-workbench-output';
      log.hidden = true;
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
      const cancel = document.createElement('button');
      cancel.type = 'button';
      cancel.className = 'btn';
      cancel.textContent = 'Cancel';
      const install = document.createElement('button');
      install.type = 'button';
      install.className = 'btn btn-primary';
      install.textContent = 'Install';
      actions.append(cancel, install);
      modal.append(text, input, log, actions);
      input.focus();

      cancel.addEventListener('click', () => { close(); resolve(false); });
      install.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const packages = input.value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (!packages.length) return;
        install.disabled = cancel.disabled = input.disabled = true;
        install.textContent = 'Installing…';
        log.hidden = false;
        log.textContent = `pip install ${packages.join(' ')}\n`;
        try {
          const result = await Sandbox.install(packages);
          log.textContent += result.output || '';
          if (result.ok) {
            setTimeout(() => { close(); resolve(true); }, 600);
            return;
          }
          log.textContent += '\nInstall failed.';
        } catch (err) {
          log.textContent += `\nError: ${err.message}`;
        }
        install.disabled = cancel.disabled = input.disabled = false;
        install.textContent = 'Retry';
        cancel.textContent = 'Close';
      });
    });
  });
}

// Detects missing packages for the code and the run output, then offers to install them.
// Returns true when something was installed so the caller can re-run.
export async function offerInstallForRun(source, outputText) {
  const named = missingModulesFromOutput(outputText);
  if (!named.length) return false;
  let missing;
  try {
    missing = (await Sandbox.check(source, named)).missing;
  } catch {
    missing = named.map(module => ({ module, package: module }));
  }
  if (!missing.length) return false;
  return promptInstall(missing);
}

export async function offerInstallBeforeRun(source) {
  let missing;
  try {
    missing = (await Sandbox.check(source, [])).missing;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  return missing.length ? promptInstall(missing) : false;
}

export async function confirmReset() {
  if (!confirm('Reset the test environment? All packages installed for testing will be removed.')) return null;
  return Sandbox.reset();
}

```

```javascript
/**
 * Reader controls shared by the Agent and Code scratchpads: adjustable text size,
 * find, expand/collapse, a pop-out window, and saving as Markdown or a standalone HTML page.
 *
 * Content opts in by marking each searchable block with `data-reader-item`.
 */
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { iconSvg } from './icons.js';

const SIZE_STEP = 0.1;
const SIZE_MIN = 0.7;
const SIZE_MAX = 1.6;
const SIZE_DEFAULT = 0.9;

function readStoredSize(key) {
  try {
    const value = Number(localStorage.getItem(key));
    return value >= SIZE_MIN && value <= SIZE_MAX ? value : SIZE_DEFAULT;
  } catch {
    return SIZE_DEFAULT;
  }
}

function storeSize(key, value) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, String(value)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function button(label, title, icon) {
  const element = document.createElement('button');
  element.type = 'button';
  element.className = 'cb-btn';
  element.title = title;
  element.setAttribute('aria-label', title);
  element.innerHTML = icon ? `${iconSvg(icon)}<span></span>` : '<span></span>';
  element.querySelector('span').textContent = label;
  return element;
}

/** A copy of the content without app-only controls, every entry visible. */
function staticCopy(content) {
  const copy = content.cloneNode(true);
  copy.removeAttribute('id');
  copy.querySelectorAll('.md-code-actions, iframe, .reader-empty-filter').forEach(node => node.remove());
  copy.querySelectorAll('[hidden]').forEach(node => node.removeAttribute('hidden'));
  // Labels (section shortcuts, map file names) stay as text; other controls are dropped.
  copy.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(node => {
    if (!node.matches('.reader-nav button, .scratchpad-file-link')) {
      node.remove();
      return;
    }
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = node.className;
    span.textContent = node.textContent;
    if (node.title) span.title = node.title;
    node.replaceWith(span);
  });
  copy.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(node => node.removeAttribute('id'));
  return copy;
}

const STANDALONE_CSS = `
:root { color-scheme: dark; --bg: #0d0e11; --card: #1b1d23; --elev: #252931; --text: #e6eaf2;
  --muted: #aab3c5; --border: #3a3f4a; --primary: #7cb2ff; --accent: #a78bfa; --success: #4ade80;
  --warning: #fbbf24; --danger: #f87171; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root { color-scheme: light; --bg: #f4f6f9; --card: #ffffff; --elev: #eef1f6; --text: #1c2129;
    --muted: #4b5563; --border: #d0d6df; --primary: #1d4ed8; --accent: #6d28d9; --success: #166534;
    --warning: #92400e; --danger: #b91c1c; }
}
body { line-height: 1.6; }
h3 { padding-bottom: 0.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.scratchpad-read .scratchpad-read { background: var(--elev); margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }
.scratchpad-read summary { line-height: 1.5; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.scratchpad-read[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.scratchpad-result-query { padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; background: var(--elev); border-radius: 6px; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { font-size: 0.85rem; border-left-width: 4px; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8em; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title { font-size: 0.95em; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-kind { padding: 0.05rem 0.55rem; border: 0; font-size: 0.85em; font-weight: 700; color: #0b0c0f; background: var(--kind-color, var(--accent)); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { --kind-color: #4ade80; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { --kind-color: #fbbf24; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { --kind-color: #f87171; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { --kind-color: #94a3b8; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { --kind-color: #86efac; }
  .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { --kind-color: #fcd34d; }
  .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { --kind-color: #fca5a5; }
  .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { --kind-color: #cbd5e1; }
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
  font: 1rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--card); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

header p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

.tools button { padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; }
main { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem; font-size: var(--reader-size, 0.95rem); }
main > div { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
section { min-width: 0; }
h2, h3, h4 { margin: 0.4rem 0 0.5rem; line-height: 1.3; }

pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.7rem; margin: 0.5rem 0; background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font: 0.9em/1.5 Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; }
code { font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.92em; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; } th, td { padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.text-muted { color: var(--muted); } .text-danger { color: var(--danger); } .text-warning { color: var(--warning); }
.small { font-size: 0.85em; }
.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.45rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 600; }
.badge-success { color: var(--success); } .badge-danger { color: var(--danger); } .badge-warning { color: var(--warning); }
.scratchpad-read, .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; }
.scratchpad-result { background: var(--elev); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { border-left-color: var(--muted); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; font-size: 0.85em; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-kind { padding: 0 0.4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; }
.reader-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; }
.reader-nav a, .reader-nav span { padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem; color: var(--primary); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.85em; }
.scratchpad-tree-list { list-style: none; padding-left: 1.15rem; margin: 0.2rem 0; }

.md-code-block { margin: 0.5rem 0; } .md-code-header { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8em; }
`;

const STANDALONE_SCRIPT = `
const main = document.querySelector('main');
let size = Number(getComputedStyle(main).getPropertyValue('--reader-size')) || 0.95;
const setSize = value => { size = Math.min(1.8, Math.max(0.7, value)); main.style.setProperty('--reader-size', size + 'rem'); };
document.querySelector('[data-smaller]').onclick = () => setSize(size - 0.1);
document.querySelector('[data-larger]').onclick = () => setSize(size + 0.1);
document.querySelector('[data-expand]').onclick = () => main.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => { d.open = true; });
document.querySelector('[data-collapse]').onclick = () => main.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => { d.open = false; });
`;

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

/** A self-contained page (styles and its own size/expand controls inline) of the current content. */
export function buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, sizeRem) {
  const exported = new Date().toLocaleString();
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title>
<style>${STANDALONE_CSS}</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <div><h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1><p>Exported ${escapeHtml(exported)}</p></div>
  <div class="tools">
    <button type="button" data-smaller title="Smaller text">A−</button>
    <button type="button" data-larger title="Larger text">A+</button>
    <button type="button" data-expand>Expand all</button>
    <button type="button" data-collapse>Collapse all</button>
  </div>
</header>
<main style="--reader-size: ${sizeRem}rem">${staticCopy(content).outerHTML}</main>
<script>${STANDALONE_SCRIPT}</script>
</body>
</html>`;
}

/**
 * Attach reader controls to ``toolbar`` for the scratchpad rendered into ``content``.
 * ``getMarkdown`` returns (or resolves to) the Markdown export; ``filenameBase`` names saved files.
 * Call ``refresh()`` on the returned controller after re-rendering the content.
 */
export function setupScratchpadReader({ content, toolbar, prefsKey, title, getMarkdown, filenameBase, onError }) {
  const sizeKey = `${prefsKey}readerSize`;
  let size = readStoredSize(sizeKey);
  content.classList.add('scratchpad-reader');
  const applySize = () => content.style.setProperty('--reader-size', `${size.toFixed(2)}rem`);
  applySize();

  const sizeGroup = document.createElement('div');
  sizeGroup.className = 'cb-group';
  sizeGroup.setAttribute('role', 'group');
  sizeGroup.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scratchpad text size');
  const smaller = button('A−', 'Smaller text');
  const larger = button('A+', 'Larger text');
  sizeGroup.append(smaller, larger);
  const resize = delta => {
    size = Math.min(SIZE_MAX, Math.max(SIZE_MIN, Math.round((size + delta) * 100) / 100));
    applySize();
    storeSize(sizeKey, size);
  };
  smaller.addEventListener('click', () => resize(-SIZE_STEP));
  larger.addEventListener('click', () => resize(SIZE_STEP));

  const find = document.createElement('input');
  find.type = 'search';
  find.className = 'form-input reader-find';
  find.placeholder = 'Find…';
  find.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Find in scratchpad');
  const findCount = document.createElement('span');
  findCount.className = 'small text-muted reader-find-count';
  findCount.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

  const expand = button('Expand all', 'Expand every entry');
  const collapse = button('Collapse all', 'Collapse every entry');
  const setOpen = open => content.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(details => { details.open = open; });
  expand.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(true));
  collapse.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));

  const popOut = button('Pop out', 'Open in a separate, resizable window', 'file-code');
  const saveMd = button('Save .md', 'Save as a Markdown file', 'save');
  const saveHtml = button('Save .html', 'Save as a web page you can open in any browser', 'save-as');

  const stamp = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const report = error => {
    if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return;
    onError?.(error);
  };
  popOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const html = buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, size);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' }));
    const opened = window.open(url, '_blank', 'popup,width=1000,height=800');
    if (!opened) report(new Error('The browser blocked the pop-out window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.'));
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
  });
  saveMd.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    saveMd.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.saveTextFile(await getMarkdown(), `${filenameBase}-${stamp()}.md`, 'md');
    } catch (error) {
      report(error);
    } finally {
      saveMd.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  saveHtml.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    saveHtml.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.saveTextFile(buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, size), `${filenameBase}-${stamp()}.html`, 'html');
    } catch (error) {
      report(error);
    } finally {
      saveHtml.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  const applyFilter = () => {
    const query = find.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const items = [...content.querySelectorAll('[data-reader-item]')];
    let shown = 0;
    items.forEach(item => {
      const match = !query || item.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      item.hidden = !match;
      if (match) {
        shown += 1;
        if (query) {
          if (item.tagName === 'DETAILS') item.open = true;
          item.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(details => { details.open = true; });
        }
      }
    });
    content.querySelector('.reader-empty-filter')?.remove();
    findCount.textContent = query ? `${shown} of ${items.length}` : '';
    if (query && !shown) {
      const empty = document.createElement('p');
      empty.className = 'text-muted reader-empty-filter';
      empty.textContent = `Nothing matches "${find.value.trim()}".`;
      content.prepend(empty);
    }
  };
  find.addEventListener('input', applyFilter);

  toolbar.classList.add('reader-toolbar');
  toolbar.append(sizeGroup, find, findCount, expand, collapse, popOut, saveMd, saveHtml);
  return { refresh: applyFilter };
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/scratchpad_switcher.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Scratchpad store switcher: a dropdown that lets every scratchpad dialog
 * show the entries from any of the three stores (Chat, Code, Squad),
 * plus a common Clear button that works on whichever store is visible.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const sw = attachScratchpadSwitcher({
 *     toolbar,          // element to prepend the <select> into
 *     content,          // the content container that shows entries
 *     nativeControls,   // elements to hide when viewing a foreign store
 *     currentStore,     // 'chat' | 'code' | 'squad'
 *     onSwitch(store),  // called when leaving the native store
 *     onRestore(),      // called when returning to the native store
 *     onNativeClear(),  // called after native store is cleared
 *   });
 *   sw.destroy();       // remove the switcher
 */

import { Api } from './api.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from './markdown.js';

const STORES = [
  { id: 'chat', label: 'Chat scratchpad' },
  { id: 'code', label: 'Code scratchpad' },
  { id: 'squad', label: 'Squad scratchpad' },
];

/* ── Unified entry renderer ────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderEntries(container, entries) {
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (!entries.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement('p');
    empty.className = 'text-muted small';
    empty.textContent = 'This scratchpad is empty.';
    container.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const card = document.createElement('details');
    card.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry';
    card.dataset.kind = entry.kind || 'note';
    card.dataset.readerItem = '';
    card.open = true;

    const heading = document.createElement('summary');
    heading.textContent = [entry.author, entry.kind, entry.title].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

    const meta = document.createElement('p');
    meta.className = 'text-muted small';
    const parts = [];
    if (entry.created_at) parts.push(new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleString());
    if (entry.truncated) parts.push('content truncated');
    meta.textContent = parts.join(' · ');

    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'prompt-rich-markdown';
    appendMarkdown(body, String(entry.content || ''));

    card.append(heading, meta, body);
    container.appendChild(card);
  }
}

/* ── Normalize agent (old) scratchpad → flat entries ───────────── */

function normalizeAgentScratchpad(memory) {
  const entries = [];
  const history = Array.isArray(memory.subagent_history) ? memory.subagent_history : [];
  const latest = memory.latest_subagent_result;
  if (latest && typeof latest === 'object' && Object.keys(latest).length
    && !history.some(e => e.updated_at === latest.updated_at)) {
    history.push(latest);
  }
  for (const entry of history) {
    const payload = entry.payload && typeof entry.payload === 'object' ? entry.payload : {};
    entries.push({
      author: entry.subagent_id || 'unknown',
      kind: 'result',
      title: entry.task_type || 'sub-agent result',
      content: payload.result || JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2),
      created_at: entry.updated_at || '',
    });
  }
  const reads = Array.isArray(memory.read_history)
    ? memory.read_history
    : (memory.latest_read ? [memory.latest_read] : []);
  for (const entry of reads) {
    entries.push({
      author: 'read_file',
      kind: 'read',
      title: entry.path || 'unknown file',
      content: entry.content || '',
      created_at: entry.updated_at || '',
    });
  }
  if (memory.latest_map?.tree) {
    entries.push({
      author: 'map_files',
      kind: 'map',
      title: memory.latest_map.requested_path || 'workspace root',
      content: memory.latest_map.tree?.name || '(workspace map)',
      created_at: '',
    });
  }
  return entries;
}

/* ── Foreign store controls ────────────────────────────────────── */

function createSquadControls(container) {
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'scratchpad-switcher-sub';
  wrapper.dataset.swForeign = '';
  const label = document.createElement('label');
  label.className = 'small';
  label.textContent = 'Run ';
  const runSelect = document.createElement('select');
  runSelect.className = 'form-select';
  runSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Select squad run');
  label.appendChild(runSelect);
  wrapper.appendChild(label);

  const load = async () => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = 'Loading…';
    const { runs } = await Api.getSquadScratchpadRuns();
    runSelect.replaceChildren();
    if (!runs.length) {
      container.replaceChildren();
      container.textContent = 'No squad scratchpads are available.';
      return;
    }
    for (const run of runs) {
      runSelect.add(new Option(`${run.squad_id} · ${run.status} · ${run.run_id}`, run.run_id));
    }
    await loadRun();
  };
  const loadRun = async () => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = 'Loading run…';
    const run = await Api.getSquadScratchpadRun(runSelect.value);
    renderEntries(container, run.entries || []);
  };
  runSelect.addEventListener('change', () => loadRun().catch(err => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = `Error: ${err.message}`;
  }));

  return { element: wrapper, runSelect, load, loadRun, destroy: () => wrapper.remove() };
}

function createChatSessionControls(container) {
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'scratchpad-switcher-sub';
  wrapper.dataset.swForeign = '';
  const label = document.createElement('label');
  label.className = 'small';
  label.textContent = 'Session ';
  const sessionSelect = document.createElement('select');
  sessionSelect.className = 'form-select';
  sessionSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Select chat session');
  label.appendChild(sessionSelect);
  wrapper.appendChild(label);

  const load = async () => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = 'Loading…';
    const { sessions } = await Api.listChatScratchpadSessions();
    sessionSelect.replaceChildren();
    if (!sessions.length) {
      container.replaceChildren();
      container.textContent = 'No chat sessions have scratchpad entries.';
      return;
    }
    for (const s of sessions) {
      sessionSelect.add(new Option(`${s.session_id} (${s.count} entries)`, s.session_id));
    }
    await loadSession();
  };
  const loadSession = async () => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = 'Loading session…';
    const { entries } = await Api.getChatScratchpad(sessionSelect.value);
    renderEntries(container, entries);
  };
  sessionSelect.addEventListener('change', () => loadSession().catch(err => {
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.textContent = `Error: ${err.message}`;
  }));

  return { element: wrapper, sessionSelect, load, destroy: () => wrapper.remove() };
}

/* ── Clear helpers per store ──────────────────────────────────── */

async function clearStore(storeId, foreignCtrl) {
  if (storeId === 'chat') {
    await Api.clearAgentScratchpad();
  } else if (storeId === 'code') {
    await Api.clearCodeScratchpad();
  } else if (storeId === 'squad') {
    if (!foreignCtrl?.runSelect?.value) throw new Error('No squad run selected.');
    const runId = foreignCtrl.runSelect.value;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/agent-memory/squad-scratchpads/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(body.detail || `Clear failed (${res.status})`);
    }
  }
}

/* ── Main export ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Add a store-switcher dropdown and a clear button to an existing scratchpad dialog.
 *
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {HTMLElement}  options.toolbar        - Element to prepend the dropdown into
 * @param {HTMLElement}  options.content        - Content area for entries
 * @param {HTMLElement[]} options.nativeControls - Elements to hide when viewing a foreign store
 * @param {string}       options.currentStore   - 'chat' | 'code' | 'squad'
 * @param {Function}     [options.onSwitch]     - Called when leaving the native store
 * @param {Function}     [options.onRestore]    - Called when returning to the native store
 * @param {Function}     [options.onNativeClear] - Called after the native store is cleared
 */
export function attachScratchpadSwitcher({ toolbar, content, nativeControls = [], currentStore, onSwitch, onRestore, onNativeClear }) {
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'scratchpad-switcher-bar';

  const select = document.createElement('select');
  select.className = 'form-select scratchpad-store-select';
  select.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Switch scratchpad store');
  for (const store of STORES) {
    const option = new Option(store.label, store.id);
    if (store.id === currentStore) option.selected = true;
    select.add(option);
  }

  const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
  clearBtn.type = 'button';
  clearBtn.className = 'cb-btn cb-btn-danger scratchpad-clear-btn';
  clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
  clearBtn.title = 'Clear the visible scratchpad';

  wrapper.append(select, clearBtn);

  let nativeContent = null;
  let foreignCtrl = null;
  let activeStore = currentStore;

  function hideNative() {
    if (!nativeContent) {
      nativeContent = [...content.childNodes];
      nativeContent.forEach(n => {
        if (n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) n.dataset._swHidden = n.hidden ? '1' : '';
      });
    }
    nativeContent.forEach(n => {
      if (n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) n.hidden = true;
      else if (n.parentNode === content) content.removeChild(n);
    });
    nativeControls.forEach(el => { el.dataset._swDisplay = el.style.display; el.style.display = 'none'; });
  }

  function restoreNative() {
    content.querySelectorAll('[data-sw-foreign]').forEach(n => n.remove());
    if (nativeContent) {
      nativeContent.forEach(n => {
        if (!n.isConnected) content.appendChild(n);
        if (n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
          n.hidden = n.dataset._swHidden === '1';
          delete n.dataset._swHidden;
        }
      });
      nativeContent = null;
    }
    nativeControls.forEach(el => { el.style.display = el.dataset._swDisplay || ''; delete el.dataset._swDisplay; });
    if (foreignCtrl) { foreignCtrl.destroy(); foreignCtrl = null; }
  }

  function foreignDiv() {
    let el = content.querySelector('[data-sw-foreign="entries"]');
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('div');
      el.dataset.swForeign = 'entries';
      content.appendChild(el);
    }
    return el;
  }

  async function switchTo(storeId) {
    activeStore = storeId;
    if (storeId === currentStore) {
      restoreNative();
      onRestore?.();
      return;
    }
    hideNative();
    if (foreignCtrl) { foreignCtrl.destroy(); foreignCtrl = null; }
    const target = foreignDiv();
    target.replaceChildren();
    target.textContent = 'Loading…';
    onSwitch?.(storeId);

    try {
      if (storeId === 'chat') {
        const memory = await Api.getAgentScratchpad();
        const entries = normalizeAgentScratchpad(memory);
        if (entries.length) {
          renderEntries(target, entries);
        } else {
          foreignCtrl = createChatSessionControls(target);
          content.insertBefore(foreignCtrl.element, target);
          await foreignCtrl.load();
        }
      } else if (storeId === 'code') {
        const data = await Api.getCodeScratchpad({ limit: 100 });
        renderEntries(target, data.entries || []);
      } else if (storeId === 'squad') {
        foreignCtrl = createSquadControls(target);
        content.insertBefore(foreignCtrl.element, target);
        await foreignCtrl.load();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      target.replaceChildren();
      target.textContent = `Could not load scratchpad: ${err.message}`;
    }
  }

  async function handleClear() {
    const storeName = STORES.find(s => s.id === activeStore)?.label || activeStore;
    if (activeStore === currentStore) {
      if (onNativeClear) {
        await onNativeClear();
      } else {
        if (!confirm(`Clear the ${storeName}? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
        clearBtn.disabled = true;
        try { await clearStore(activeStore, null); } finally { clearBtn.disabled = false; }
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!confirm(`Clear the ${storeName}? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    clearBtn.disabled = true;
    try {
      await clearStore(activeStore, foreignCtrl);
      await switchTo(activeStore);
    } catch (err) {
      const target = content.querySelector('[data-sw-foreign="entries"]');
      if (target) target.textContent = `Could not clear: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      clearBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  select.addEventListener('change', () => switchTo(select.value));
  clearBtn.addEventListener('click', handleClear);
  toolbar.prepend(wrapper);

  return {
    element: wrapper,
    destroy() {
      restoreNative();
      wrapper.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Shared app-shell state and navigation. Views import from here instead of app.js so the
 * router and its views never import each other.
 */
import { Api } from './api.js';

export const AppState = {
  activeTab: 'squads',
  agents: [],
  squads: [],
  health: null,
  currentPath: '',
  ragScanJob: null
};

export function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

/** Ask the shell to open another section; app.js owns the actual routing. */
export function navigate(tab, payload = null) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:navigate', { detail: { tab, payload } }));
}

export function openInEditor(path) {
  navigate('editor', { path, managedFile: false });
}

export async function refreshAgents() {
  const data = await Api.getAgents();
  AppState.agents = data.agents || [];
  return AppState.agents;
}

export async function refreshSquads() {
  const data = await Api.getSquads();
  AppState.squads = data.squads || [];
  return AppState.squads;
}

export function updateHealthBadge(health) {
  const badge = document.getElementById('health-badge');
  if (!badge || !health) return;
  const ok = health.ollama?.reachable;
  badge.className = 'badge ' + (ok ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning');
  badge.textContent = ok ? 'Engine Ready' : 'Ollama Offline';
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/side_panels.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Draggable side panels shared by the Code Builder and the Chat Console.
 *
 * Each panel's width lives in a CSS variable on the layout. Dragging its divider resizes it;
 * releasing narrower than `hideBelow` hides the panel completely (`<name>-collapsed` on the
 * shell), and the divider becomes a slim tab that brings it back on click or drag. Panels can
 * widen until only `centerMin` pixels remain for the middle pane. Widths and hidden state are
 * remembered per `prefsKey`.
 */

const COLLAPSED_GUTTER = 18;

/**
 * @param {{
 *   shell: HTMLElement, layout: HTMLElement, prefsKey: string, centerMin?: number,
 *   panels: Record<string, {var: string, edge: 'left'|'right', min: number, hideBelow: number,
 *     default: number, label: string, resizer: HTMLElement, toggle?: HTMLElement|null}>
 * }} options
 */
export function setupSidePanels({ shell, layout, prefsKey, centerMin = 280, panels }) {
  const readPref = key => {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(prefsKey + key); } catch { return null; }
  };
  const writePref = (key, value) => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(prefsKey + key, value); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
  };
  const readVar = name => parseFloat(
    layout.style.getPropertyValue(name) || getComputedStyle(layout).getPropertyValue(name)
  );
  const isCollapsed = name => shell.classList.contains(name + '-collapsed');

  // Widest a panel may get: the layout minus the middle pane's minimum and the other panels.
  const maxSize = name => {
    const others = Object.keys(panels)
      .filter(other => other !== name && !isCollapsed(other))
      .reduce((sum, other) => sum + (readVar(panels[other].var) || 0), 0);
    const gutters = Object.keys(panels).length * COLLAPSED_GUTTER;
    return Math.max(panels[name].min, layout.clientWidth - others - centerMin - gutters);
  };
  const clampSize = (name, value) =>
    Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(value, panels[name].min), maxSize(name)));

  const refreshToggle = name => {
    const { toggle, resizer, label } = panels[name];
    const collapsed = isCollapsed(name);
    const text = `${collapsed ? 'Show' : 'Hide'} ${label} panel`;
    if (toggle) {
      toggle.title = text;
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!collapsed));
    }
    resizer.title = collapsed
      ? `Click or drag to show the ${label} panel`
      : 'Drag to resize · drag to the edge or double-click to hide';
    resizer.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!collapsed));
  };

  const setCollapsed = (name, collapsed) => {
    const conf = panels[name];
    if (collapsed) {
      const current = readVar(conf.var);
      if (!isCollapsed(name) && Number.isFinite(current) && current >= conf.min) {
        writePref(name + 'Width', String(current));
      }
      shell.classList.add(name + '-collapsed');
      layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, '0px');
    } else {
      const saved = parseFloat(readPref(name + 'Width'));
      shell.classList.remove(name + '-collapsed');
      layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, clampSize(name, Number.isFinite(saved) ? saved : conf.default) + 'px');
    }
    writePref(name + 'Collapsed', collapsed ? '1' : '0');
    refreshToggle(name);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
  };

  for (const [name, conf] of Object.entries(panels)) {
    const saved = parseFloat(readPref(name + 'Width'));
    if (Number.isFinite(saved)) layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, Math.max(saved, conf.min) + 'px');
    if (readPref(name + 'Collapsed') === '1') {
      shell.classList.add(name + '-collapsed');
      layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, '0px');
    }

    const { resizer, toggle } = conf;
    // Dragging toward the panel's own edge shrinks it.
    const direction = conf.edge === 'left' ? 1 : -1;

    resizer.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      const startX = event.clientX;
      const wasCollapsed = isCollapsed(name);
      const start = wasCollapsed ? 0 : (readVar(conf.var) || conf.default);
      let moved = false;
      resizer.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      document.body.classList.add('is-resizing');
      resizer.classList.add('is-dragging');

      const onMove = moveEvent => {
        const delta = (moveEvent.clientX - startX) * direction;
        if (!moved && Math.abs(delta) < 4) return;
        moved = true;
        const raw = start + delta;
        if (isCollapsed(name)) shell.classList.remove(name + '-collapsed');
        // Below the minimum the panel follows the pointer down to nothing, then hides on release.
        const width = raw < conf.min ? Math.max(0, Math.round(raw)) : clampSize(name, raw);
        shell.classList.toggle(name + '-hiding', raw < conf.hideBelow);
        layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, width + 'px');
      };
      const onUp = () => {
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
        document.body.classList.remove('is-resizing');
        resizer.classList.remove('is-dragging');
        shell.classList.remove(name + '-hiding');
        if (!moved) {
          // A click on the slim tab of a hidden panel brings it back.
          if (wasCollapsed) setCollapsed(name, false);
          return;
        }
        const width = readVar(conf.var);
        if (!Number.isFinite(width) || width < conf.hideBelow) {
          setCollapsed(name, true);
          return;
        }
        const final = clampSize(name, width);
        layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, final + 'px');
        writePref(name + 'Width', String(final));
        writePref(name + 'Collapsed', '0');
        refreshToggle(name);
      };
      resizer.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
      resizer.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
      resizer.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
    });

    resizer.addEventListener('dblclick', () => setCollapsed(name, !isCollapsed(name)));
    resizer.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
        event.preventDefault();
        setCollapsed(name, !isCollapsed(name));
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (isCollapsed(name)) { setCollapsed(name, false); return; }
        const step = (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) * direction * (event.shiftKey ? 80 : 24);
        const next = clampSize(name, (readVar(conf.var) || conf.default) + step);
        layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, next + 'px');
        writePref(name + 'Width', String(next));
      }
    });
    toggle?.addEventListener('click', () => setCollapsed(name, !isCollapsed(name)));
    refreshToggle(name);
  }

  // Keep panels inside the window when it shrinks.
  const onWindowResize = () => {
    if (!layout.isConnected) { window.removeEventListener('resize', onWindowResize); return; }
    for (const [name, conf] of Object.entries(panels)) {
      if (isCollapsed(name)) continue;
      const current = readVar(conf.var);
      if (Number.isFinite(current) && current > maxSize(name)) {
        layout.style.setProperty(conf.var, clampSize(name, current) + 'px');
      }
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);

  return { isCollapsed, setCollapsed };
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Squad Development — two-pane prompt editor with run and error feedback.
 *
 * Layout: squad tabs, run bar, error panel, two side-by-side Monaco editors
 * with dropdown agent selectors. Agents are ordered by execution sequence
 * (members first, lead last).
 */
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { esc, navigate } from './shell.js';
import { loadMonaco } from './codebuilder/codebuilder_editor.js';
import { formatPastedMarkdown } from './studio_paste_markdown.js';
import { createPromptStarter } from './prompt_starter.js';

const MIN_FONT = 11, MAX_FONT = 22, DEFAULT_FONT = 14, FONT_STEP = 1;
const STORAGE_KEY = 'sd-test-queries';

let activeStudio = null;

function loadSavedQueries(squadId) {
  try {
    const all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
    return all[squadId] || [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

function saveSavedQueries(squadId, queries) {
  try {
    const all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
    all[squadId] = queries;
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

export function leaveSquadDevelopment() {
  if (!activeStudio || activeStudio.canLeave()) {
    activeStudio?.close();
    activeStudio = null;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function renderSquadDevelopment(container) {
  const editors = new Map();

          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const errorEl = container.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
  const squadTabs = container.querySelector('[data-role="squad-tabs"]');
  const workspace = container.querySelector('[data-role="workspace"]');
  const fontLabel = container.querySelector('[data-role="font-label"]');
  const runQuery = container.querySelector('[data-role="run-query"]');

  const runErrorsHost = container.querySelector('[data-role="run-errors"]');
  const errorsBanner = container.querySelector('[data-role="errors-banner"]');
  const runErrorsBody = container.querySelector('[data-role="run-errors-body"]');
  const sidebar = container.querySelector('[data-role="sidebar"]');
  const sidebarDivider = container.querySelector('[data-role="sidebar-divider"]');
  const sbQueryList = container.querySelector('[data-role="sb-query-list"]');
  const sbQueriesEmpty = container.querySelector('[data-role="sb-queries-empty"]');
  const wrapBtn = container.querySelector('[data-action="toggle-wrap"]');
  const outputStatus = container.querySelector('[data-role="output-status"]');
  const outputEmpty = container.querySelector('[data-role="output-empty"]');
  const flowList = container.querySelector('[data-role="flow-list"]');
  const flowFooter = container.querySelector('[data-role="flow-footer"]');
  const navPanel = container.querySelector('[data-role="nav-panel"]');
  const navDivider = container.querySelector('[data-role="nav-divider"]');

  function showError(err) { errorEl.textContent = err?.message || String(err); }
  function clearError() { errorEl.textContent = ''; }
  const starter = createPromptStarter(container);
  function canDiscard() { return !dirty.size || confirm('Discard unsaved prompt changes?'); }

  activeStudio = {
    canLeave: () => (!dirty.size && !starter.hasChanges()) || confirm('Discard unsaved prompt and Prompt Starter changes?'),
    close() {
      for (const ed of editors.values()) ed.dispose();
      editors.clear(); dirty.clear(); baselines.clear(); prompts.clear();
      eventSource?.close();
      starter.dispose();
    },
  };

  function updateSaveAll() {
    const btn = container.querySelector('[data-action="save-all-sb"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const n = dirty.size;
    btn.textContent = n ? `Save All (${n})` : 'Save All';
  }

  function setFontSize(size) {
    fontSize = Math.max(MIN_FONT, Math.min(MAX_FONT, size));
    fontLabel.textContent = `${fontSize}px`;
    for (const ed of editors.values()) ed.updateOptions({ fontSize });
  }

  function agentLabel(a) {
    const idx = agents.indexOf(a);
    const step = a.id === leadId ? 'synthesis' : `step ${idx + 1}`;
    return `${a.name || a.id} (${step})`;
  }

  // --- Squad tabs ---
  async function loadSquads() {
    try {
      const overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
      const squads = overview.squads || [];
      if (!squads.length) {
        squadTabs.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted small">No registered squads found.</span>';
        return;
      }
      squadTabs.innerHTML = squads.map(s =>
        `<button class="btn btn-sm${s.squad_id === currentSquadId ? ' cb-btn-active' : ''}" data-squad="${esc(s.squad_id)}">${esc(s.name || s.squad_id)}</button>`
      ).join('');
    } catch (err) { showError(err); }
  }

  squadTabs.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('[data-squad]');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (btn.dataset.squad === currentSquadId) return;
    if (!canDiscard()) return;
    clearError();
    selectSquad(btn.dataset.squad);
  });

  // --- Select squad ---
  async function selectSquad(squadId) {
    for (const ed of editors.values()) ed.dispose();
    editors.clear(); dirty.clear(); baselines.clear(); prompts.clear();
    failedAgents.clear();
    eventSource?.close(); eventSource = null;
    currentSquadId = squadId;
    orderChanged = false;
    updateSaveAll();

    squadTabs.querySelectorAll('.btn').forEach(b =>
      b.classList.toggle('cb-btn-active', b.dataset.squad === squadId));

    runStatus.textContent = '';
    runErrorsHost.classList.add('sd-hidden');
    outputStatus.textContent = '';
    outputEmpty.hidden = false;
    workspace.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="padding:2rem;text-align:center">Loading…</p>';

    try {
      const blueprint = await Api.getSquadBlueprint(squadId);
      const lead = blueprint.lead;
      const members = (blueprint.members || []).filter(m => m && m.id !== lead?.id);
      agents = [...members, lead].filter(Boolean);
      leadId = lead?.id || null;

      if (!agents.length) {
        workspace.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="padding:2rem;text-align:center">This squad has no agents.</p>';
        return;
      }

      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
        agents.map(async a => {
          const { prompt } = await Api.getAgentPrompt(a.id);
          return { id: a.id, prompt };
        })
      );
      for (const r of results) {
        if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && r.value.prompt != null) {
          prompts.set(r.value.id, r.value.prompt);
          baselines.set(r.value.id, r.value.prompt);
        }
      }

      loadRunErrors(squadId);
      renderQueryList();
      renderPanes();
    } catch (err) {
      workspace.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger" style="padding:2rem;text-align:center">${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
      showError(err);
    }
  }

  // --- Mount editor in a pane ---
  async function mountEditor(side) {
    const pane = workspace.querySelector(`[data-pane="${side}"]`);
    if (!pane) return;
    const agentId = paneState[side];
    const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === agentId);
    if (!agent) return;

    const infoEl = pane.querySelector('[data-role="pane-info"]');
    const editorEl = pane.querySelector('[data-role="pane-editor"]');
    const isLead = agent.id === leadId;
    const lang = agent.path?.endsWith('.yaml') || agent.path?.endsWith('.yml') ? 'yaml' : 'markdown';
    const langLabel = lang === 'yaml' ? 'yaml' : 'md';
    const failed = failedAgents.has(agentId);

    infoEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sd-pane-chips">
        <span class="badge${isLead ? ' badge-accent' : ''}">${isLead ? 'lead · synthesis' : `step ${agents.indexOf(agent) + 1}`}</span>
        <span class="badge" style="opacity:0.6">${esc(langLabel)}</span>
        ${failed ? '<span class="badge badge-danger">error in last run</span>' : ''}
        <span class="text-muted small">${(agent.tools || []).length} tools</span>
      </div>`;

    const oldEd = editors.get(side);
    if (oldEd) { oldEd.dispose(); editors.delete(side); }

    const text = prompts.get(agentId);
    if (text == null) {
      editorEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-danger small" style="padding:0.5rem">Could not load prompt.</p>';
      return;
    }

    let monaco;
    try { monaco = await loadMonaco(); } catch { monaco = null; }

    if (monaco) {
      editorEl.innerHTML = '';
      editorEl.classList.add('sd-editor-host');
      const ed = monaco.editor.create(editorEl, {
        value: text, language: lang, theme: 'vs-dark', automaticLayout: true, fontSize,
        fontFamily: "'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace",
        lineNumbers: 'on', minimap: { enabled: false }, scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
        wordWrap: wordWrap ? 'on' : 'off', wrappingIndent: 'indent',
        padding: { top: 8, bottom: 8 }, renderLineHighlight: 'line',
        folding: true, glyphMargin: false, lineDecorationsWidth: 4, lineNumbersMinChars: 3,
        ariaLabel: `Prompt for ${agentId} (${lang})`,
      });
      editors.set(side, ed);

      if (lang === 'markdown') {
        ed.onDidPaste(() => {
          const model = ed.getModel();
          if (!model) return;
          const full = model.getValue();
          const converted = formatPastedMarkdown(full);
          if (converted !== full) model.setValue(converted);
        });
      }

      ed.onDidChangeModelContent(() => {
        const current = ed.getValue();
        prompts.set(agentId, current);
        if (current !== baselines.get(agentId)) dirty.set(agentId, true);
        else dirty.delete(agentId);
        const dot = pane.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${side}"]`);
        if (dot) dot.hidden = !dirty.has(agentId);
        updateSaveAll();
      });

      const dot = pane.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${side}"]`);
      if (dot) dot.hidden = !dirty.has(agentId);
    } else {
      editorEl.innerHTML = `<textarea class="sd-editor-textarea" aria-label="Prompt for ${esc(agentId)}">${esc(text)}</textarea>`;
      const ta = editorEl.querySelector('textarea');
      ta.addEventListener('paste', e => {
        if (lang !== 'markdown') return;
        const clip = e.clipboardData?.getData('text/plain');
        if (!clip) return;
        const converted = formatPastedMarkdown(clip);
        if (converted !== clip) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const start = ta.selectionStart, end = ta.selectionEnd;
          ta.value = ta.value.slice(0, start) + converted + ta.value.slice(end);
          ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = start + converted.length;
          ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
        }
      });
      ta.addEventListener('input', () => {
        prompts.set(agentId, ta.value);
        if (ta.value !== baselines.get(agentId)) dirty.set(agentId, true);
        else dirty.delete(agentId);
        const dot = pane.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${side}"]`);
        if (dot) dot.hidden = !dirty.has(agentId);
        updateSaveAll();
      });
    }
  }

  function updatePaneLabel(side) {
    const label = workspace.querySelector(`[data-pane="${side}"] [data-role="pane-label"]`);
    if (!label) return;
    const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === paneState[side]);
    label.textContent = agent ? agentLabel(agent) : '';
  }

  // --- Two-pane editor layout ---
  function renderPanes() {
    const leftDefault = agents[0]?.id || '';
    const rightDefault = agents.length > 1 ? agents[1].id : agents[0]?.id || '';

    workspace.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sd-panes">
        <section class="sd-pane" data-pane="left">
          <header class="sd-pane-header">
            <button class="btn btn-sm sd-pane-nav" data-action="pane-prev" data-pane="left" title="Previous agent">◀</button>
            <span class="sd-pane-label" data-role="pane-label"></span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm sd-pane-nav" data-action="pane-next" data-pane="left" title="Next agent">▶</button>
            <span class="sd-dirty-dot" data-dirty="left" hidden title="Unsaved changes"></span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="save-pane" data-pane="left">Save</button>
          </header>
          <div class="sd-pane-info" data-role="pane-info"></div>
          <div class="sd-pane-body" data-role="pane-editor"></div>
        </section>
        <div class="sd-pane-divider" title="Drag to resize"></div>
        <section class="sd-pane" data-pane="right">
          <header class="sd-pane-header">
            <button class="btn btn-sm sd-pane-nav" data-action="pane-prev" data-pane="right" title="Previous agent">◀</button>
            <span class="sd-pane-label" data-role="pane-label"></span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm sd-pane-nav" data-action="pane-next" data-pane="right" title="Next agent">▶</button>
            <span class="sd-dirty-dot" data-dirty="right" hidden title="Unsaved changes"></span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="save-pane" data-pane="right">Save</button>
          </header>
          <div class="sd-pane-info" data-role="pane-info"></div>
          <div class="sd-pane-body" data-role="pane-editor"></div>
        </section>
      </div>`;

    setupColumnResize(workspace);
    paneState.left = leftDefault;
    paneState.right = rightDefault;
    updatePaneLabel('left');
    updatePaneLabel('right');
    mountEditor('left');
    mountEditor('right');
    renderFlowPanel();

    workspace.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action="save-pane"]');
      if (!btn) return;
      const side = btn.dataset.pane;
      const agentId = paneState[side];
      if (agentId) saveAgent(agentId, side);
    });
  }

  // --- Run errors ---
  function showRunResult(run) {
    failedAgents.clear();
    outputEmpty.hidden = true;
    if (!run || !run.execution_trace) {
      runErrorsHost.classList.add('sd-hidden');
      outputStatus.textContent = '';
      outputEmpty.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    const errors = (run.execution_trace || []).filter(s => s.status === 'failure' || s.status === 'error');
    for (const step of errors) {
      if (step.agent_id) failedAgents.add(step.agent_id);
    }

    if (!errors.length && run.status !== 'error') {
      runErrorsHost.classList.add('sd-hidden');
      errorsBanner.innerHTML = '';
      runErrorsBody.innerHTML = '';
      outputStatus.textContent = 'Last run completed successfully.';
      outputStatus.className = 'sd-sb-output-status text-success small';
      return;
    }
    outputStatus.textContent = '';
    runErrorsHost.classList.remove('sd-hidden');
    const firstError = errors[0];
    const summary = run.status === 'error'
      ? run.final_answer || 'Run failed'
      : `${firstError?.agent_id || 'unknown'}: ${(firstError?.result || '').slice(0, 200)}`;
    errorsBanner.innerHTML = `<span class="sd-errors-icon">Run failed</span> <span class="sd-errors-text">${esc(summary)}</span>`;

    let html = '';
    if (run.status === 'error' && run.final_answer) {
      html += `<div class="sd-error-item"><strong>Final answer</strong><pre class="sq-pre">${esc(run.final_answer)}</pre></div>`;
    }
    for (const step of run.execution_trace || []) {
      const isFail = step.status === 'failure' || step.status === 'error';
      html += `<div class="sd-error-item${isFail ? ' sd-error-fail' : ''}">
        <strong>${esc(step.agent_id || 'unknown')}</strong>
        <span class="badge${isFail ? ' badge-danger' : ''}">${esc(step.status)}</span>
        <span class="text-muted small">step ${step.step_number || '?'}</span>
        <pre class="sq-pre">${esc(step.result || '')}</pre>
      </div>`;
    }
    runErrorsBody.innerHTML = html;
    refreshPaneSelectors();
  }

  async function loadRunErrors(squadId) {
    try {
      const data = await Api.getLatestOrchestrationRun(squadId);
      showRunResult(data?.result);
    } catch {
      runErrorsHost.classList.add('sd-hidden');
    }
  }

  function refreshPaneSelectors() {
    updatePaneLabel('left');
    updatePaneLabel('right');
    renderFlowPanel();
    workspace.querySelectorAll('[data-role="pane-info"]').forEach(info => {
      const pane = info.closest('[data-pane]');
      const select = pane?.querySelector('[data-role="agent-select"]');
      const agentId = select?.value;
      if (!agentId) return;
      const badge = info.querySelector('.badge-danger');
      if (failedAgents.has(agentId) && !badge) {
        const chips = info.querySelector('.sd-pane-chips');
        if (chips) chips.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<span class="badge badge-danger">error in last run</span>');
      } else if (!failedAgents.has(agentId) && badge) {
        badge.remove();
      }
    });
  }

  // --- Run squad ---
  async function runSquad() {
    if (!currentSquadId) return;
    const query = runQuery.value.trim();
    if (!query) { showError(new Error('Enter a task description to run.')); return; }
    clearError();
    runStatus.textContent = 'Starting…';
    const runBtn = container.querySelector('[data-action="run-squad"]');
    runBtn.disabled = true;

    try {
      const started = await Api.startOrchestrationRun(currentSquadId, query);
      runStatus.textContent = `Running (${started.trace_id.slice(0, 12)}…)`;
      eventSource?.close();
      eventSource = new EventSource(`/api/orchestration/stream/${encodeURIComponent(started.trace_id)}`);

      eventSource.addEventListener('telemetry', async msg => {
        if (!container.isConnected) { eventSource.close(); return; }
        const event = JSON.parse(msg.data);
        if (event.event_type !== 'RUN_COMPLETE') {
          runStatus.textContent = `${event.sender || ''}: ${event.event_type || ''}`.trim();
          return;
        }
        eventSource.close(); eventSource = null;
        try {
          const result = await Api.getOrchestrationRunResult(started.trace_id);
          runStatus.textContent = `Run ${result.status}`;
          if (result.status === 'error') runStatus.classList.add('text-danger');
          else runStatus.classList.remove('text-danger');
          showRunResult(result);
        } catch (err) { showError(err); }
        runBtn.disabled = false;
      });

      eventSource.onerror = () => {
        if (eventSource?.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED) {
          runStatus.textContent = 'Stream disconnected; run may still be active.';
          runBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      };
    } catch (err) {
      showError(err);
      runStatus.textContent = '';
      runBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // --- Save ---
  async function saveAgent(agentId, side) {
    const prompt = prompts.get(agentId);
    if (prompt == null) return;
    const pane = side ? workspace.querySelector(`[data-pane="${side}"]`) : null;
    const btn = pane?.querySelector('[data-action="save-pane"]');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.setAgentPrompt(agentId, prompt);
      baselines.set(agentId, prompt);
      dirty.delete(agentId);
      if (pane) {
        const dot = pane.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${side}"]`);
        if (dot) dot.hidden = true;
      }
      updateSaveAll();
      clearError();
    } catch (err) { showError(err); }
    finally { if (btn) btn.disabled = false; }
  }

  async function saveAll() {
    const ids = [...dirty.keys()];
    if (!ids.length) return;
    for (const id of ids) await saveAgent(id);
    updateSaveAll();
  }

  // --- Column resize ---
  function setupColumnResize(host) {
    let target = null, startX = 0, startW = 0;
    host.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      if (!e.target.classList.contains('sd-pane-divider')) return;
      target = e.target.previousElementSibling;
      if (!target) return;
      startX = e.clientX;
      startW = target.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      host.classList.add('sd-resizing');
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!target) return;
      target.style.flex = 'none';
      target.style.width = `${Math.max(280, startW + (e.clientX - startX))}px`;
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!target) return;
      target = null;
      host.classList.remove('sd-resizing');
    });
  }

  // --- Agent flow panel ---
  function renderFlowPanel() {
    if (!agents.length) {
      flowList.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small" style="padding:0.5rem">No agents loaded.</p>';
      flowFooter.classList.add('sd-hidden');
      return;
    }
    flowFooter.classList.toggle('sd-hidden', !orderChanged);
    const lastMemberIdx = leadId ? agents.length - 2 : agents.length - 1;
    let html = '';
    agents.forEach((a, i) => {
      const isLead = a.id === leadId;
      const isFailed = failedAgents.has(a.id);
      const isLeft = paneState.left === a.id;
      const isRight = paneState.right === a.id;
      const cls = ['sd-flow-node',
        isLead ? 'sd-flow-lead' : '',
        isFailed ? 'sd-flow-error' : '',
        isLeft ? 'sd-flow-active-l' : '',
        isRight ? 'sd-flow-active-r' : '',
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
      html += `<div class="${cls}" data-agent="${esc(a.id)}" data-action="flow-select">
        <div class="sd-flow-step">${isLead ? '★' : i + 1}</div>
        <div class="sd-flow-info">
          <span class="sd-flow-name">${esc(a.name || a.id)}</span>
          <span class="sd-flow-role">${isLead ? 'lead · synthesis' : `member · step ${i + 1}`}</span>
        </div>
        ${!isLead ? `<div class="sd-flow-actions">
          <button data-action="flow-up" data-agent="${esc(a.id)}" title="Move up" ${i === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>↑</button>
          <button data-action="flow-down" data-agent="${esc(a.id)}" title="Move down" ${i >= lastMemberIdx ? 'disabled' : ''}>↓</button>
        </div>` : ''}
      </div>`;
      if (i < agents.length - 1) html += '<div class="sd-flow-arrow">↓</div>';
    });
    flowList.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function selectAgent(agentId, side) {
    if (paneState[side] === agentId) return;
    paneState[side] = agentId;
    updatePaneLabel(side);
    mountEditor(side);
    renderFlowPanel();
  }

  function navigatePane(side, direction) {
    const currentId = paneState[side];
    const idx = agents.findIndex(a => a.id === currentId);
    const newIdx = idx + direction;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= agents.length) return;
    selectAgent(agents[newIdx].id, side);
  }

  function moveAgent(agentId, direction) {
    const idx = agents.findIndex(a => a.id === agentId);
    if (idx < 0 || agents[idx].id === leadId) return;
    const newIdx = idx + direction;
    const lastMemberIdx = leadId ? agents.length - 2 : agents.length - 1;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx > lastMemberIdx) return;
    [agents[idx], agents[newIdx]] = [agents[newIdx], agents[idx]];
    orderChanged = true;
    renderFlowPanel();
    updatePaneLabel('left');
    updatePaneLabel('right');
  }

  async function saveOrder() {
    if (!currentSquadId || !orderChanged) return;
    try {
      const memberIds = agents.filter(a => a.id !== leadId).map(a => a.id);
      await Api.saveSquadBlueprint({ squad_id: currentSquadId, primary_agent: leadId, subagents: memberIds });
      orderChanged = false;
      renderFlowPanel();
      clearError();
      showError({ message: 'Agent order saved.' });
    } catch (err) { showError(err); }
  }

  function setupNavResize() {
    let dragging = false, startX = 0, startW = 0;
    navDivider.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      dragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX;
      startW = navPanel.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      document.body.classList.add('sd-resizing');
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      const w = Math.max(140, Math.min(400, startW + (e.clientX - startX)));
      navPanel.style.width = `${w}px`;
      navPanel.style.minWidth = `${w}px`;
      navPanel.style.maxWidth = `${w}px`;
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      dragging = false;
      document.body.classList.remove('sd-resizing');
    });
  }
  setupNavResize();

  // --- Sidebar: test queries ---
  function renderQueryList() {
    if (!currentSquadId) { sbQueryList.innerHTML = ''; sbQueriesEmpty.hidden = false; return; }
    const queries = loadSavedQueries(currentSquadId);
    sbQueriesEmpty.hidden = queries.length > 0;
    sbQueryList.innerHTML = queries.map((q, i) =>
      `<li class="sd-sb-query-item">
        <button class="sd-sb-query-text" data-action="use-query" data-idx="${i}" title="Click to load">${esc(q)}</button>
        <button class="btn btn-sm sd-sb-query-del" data-action="del-query" data-idx="${i}" title="Delete">x</button>
      </li>`
    ).join('');
  }

  function addQuery() {
    if (!currentSquadId) return;
    const text = runQuery.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    const queries = loadSavedQueries(currentSquadId);
    if (queries.includes(text)) return;
    queries.unshift(text);
    saveSavedQueries(currentSquadId, queries);
    renderQueryList();
  }

  function useQuery(idx) {
    if (!currentSquadId) return;
    const queries = loadSavedQueries(currentSquadId);
    if (queries[idx] != null) runQuery.value = queries[idx];
  }

  function deleteQuery(idx) {
    if (!currentSquadId) return;
    const queries = loadSavedQueries(currentSquadId);
    queries.splice(idx, 1);
    saveSavedQueries(currentSquadId, queries);
    renderQueryList();
  }

  // --- Sidebar: features ---
  function toggleWordWrap() {
    wordWrap = !wordWrap;
    wrapBtn.textContent = `Word Wrap: ${wordWrap ? 'On' : 'Off'}`;
    for (const ed of editors.values()) ed.updateOptions({ wordWrap: wordWrap ? 'on' : 'off' });
  }

  function resetChanges() {
    if (!dirty.size) return;
    if (!confirm('Revert all unsaved changes to last saved state?')) return;
    for (const [agentId] of dirty) {
      const baseline = baselines.get(agentId);
      if (baseline != null) prompts.set(agentId, baseline);
    }
    dirty.clear();
    updateSaveAll();
    if (currentSquadId) renderPanes();
  }

  async function validatePrompts() {
    if (!currentSquadId) return;
    clearError();
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/squads-architect/squads/${encodeURIComponent(currentSquadId)}/validate`, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.detail || 'Validation failed');
      showError({ message: data?.valid ? 'All prompts valid.' : (data?.errors?.join('; ') || 'Validation issues found.') });
    } catch (err) { showError(err); }
  }

  function toggleSidebar() {
    sidebarOpen = !sidebarOpen;
    sidebar.classList.toggle('sd-hidden', !sidebarOpen);
    sidebarDivider.classList.toggle('sd-hidden', !sidebarOpen);
  }

  // --- Sidebar resize ---
  function setupSidebarResize() {
    let dragging = false, startX = 0, startW = 0;
    sidebarDivider.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      dragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX;
      startW = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      document.body.classList.add('sd-resizing');
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      const w = Math.max(180, Math.min(600, startW - (e.clientX - startX)));
      sidebar.style.flex = `0 0 ${w}px`;
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      dragging = false;
      document.body.classList.remove('sd-resizing');
    });
  }
  setupSidebarResize();

  // --- Event handlers (delegated to survive hidden/dynamic elements) ---
  container.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const el = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
    if (!el) return;
    const action = el.dataset.action;
    if (action === 'chat') navigate('prompt-creation');
    else if (action === 'prompt-starter') starter.open();
    else if (action === 'font-down') setFontSize(fontSize - FONT_STEP);
    else if (action === 'font-up') setFontSize(fontSize + FONT_STEP);
    else if (action === 'run-squad') runSquad();
    else if (action === 'save-all-sb') saveAll();
    else if (action === 'flow-select') { const aid = el.dataset.agent; if (aid) selectAgent(aid, (e.shiftKey || e.ctrlKey) ? 'right' : 'left'); }
    else if (action === 'flow-up') { const aid = el.dataset.agent; if (aid) moveAgent(aid, -1); }
    else if (action === 'flow-down') { const aid = el.dataset.agent; if (aid) moveAgent(aid, 1); }
    else if (action === 'save-order') saveOrder();
    else if (action === 'pane-prev') navigatePane(el.dataset.pane, -1);
    else if (action === 'pane-next') navigatePane(el.dataset.pane, 1);
    else if (action === 'toggle-wrap') toggleWordWrap();
    else if (action === 'reset-changes') resetChanges();
    else if (action === 'validate-prompts') validatePrompts();
    else if (action === 'toggle-sidebar') toggleSidebar();
    else if (action === 'add-query') addQuery();
    else if (action === 'use-query') useQuery(+el.dataset.idx);
    else if (action === 'del-query') deleteQuery(+el.dataset.idx);
  });
  runQuery.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) { e.preventDefault(); runSquad(); } });

  loadSquads();
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squad_scratchpad.js`
```javascript
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from './markdown.js';
import { buildStandaloneHtml, setupScratchpadReader } from './scratchpad_reader.js';
import { attachScratchpadSwitcher } from './scratchpad_switcher.js';

async function request(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(`/api/agent-memory/squad-scratchpads${path}`, options);
  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(body.detail || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
  }
  return response.json();
}

function renderEntries(target, entries) {
  target.replaceChildren();
  if (!entries.length) {
    target.textContent = 'No entries match this selection.';
    return;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const card = document.createElement('details');
    card.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry';
    card.dataset.kind = entry.kind;
    card.dataset.readerItem = '';
    card.open = true;
    const heading = document.createElement('summary');
    heading.textContent = `${entry.author} · ${entry.kind} · ${entry.title}`;
    const meta = document.createElement('p');
    meta.className = 'text-muted small';
    meta.textContent = `${new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleString()}${entry.truncated ? ' · content truncated' : ''}`;
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'prompt-rich-markdown';
    appendMarkdown(body, entry.content);
    card.append(heading, meta, body);
    target.append(card);
  }
}

function markdown(run, entries) {
  const lines = [`# Squad scratchpad: ${run.squad_id}`, '', `- Run: ${run.run_id}`,
    `- Status: ${run.status}`, `- Request: ${run.query}`, ''];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    lines.push(`## ${entry.title}`, '', `- Agent: ${entry.author}`, `- Type: ${entry.kind}`,
      `- Time: ${entry.created_at}`, ...(entry.truncated ? ['- Content truncated'] : []),
      '', entry.content, '');
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** Open a recoverable, run-scoped squad scratchpad. */
export async function openSquadScratchpad(preferredRun = '') {
  const dialog = document.createElement('dialog');
  dialog.className = 'squad-scratchpad-dialog reader-dialog';
  dialog.innerHTML = `
    <header class="squad-scratchpad-header"><h2>Squad scratchpad</h2>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-action="close">Close</button></header>
    <p class="text-muted small">Each run keeps its own scratchpad. Closing preserves it in the Run dropdown for later.</p>
    <div class="squad-scratchpad-controls">
      <label>Run <select class="form-select" data-role="run"></select></label>
      <label>Agent <select class="form-select" data-role="author"><option value="">All agents</option></select></label>
      <label>Type <select class="form-select" data-role="kind"><option value="">All types</option>
        <option>plan</option><option>code</option><option>test</option><option>fix</option>
        <option>summary</option><option>note</option></select></label>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-action="refresh">Refresh</button>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-action="print">Print / Save PDF</button>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" data-action="clear">Clear notepad</button>
    </div>
    <div data-role="reader"></div>
    <p data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="squad-scratchpad-content" data-role="content"></div>
    <details class="squad-scratchpad-note"><summary>Add a note</summary>
      <label>Title <input class="form-input" data-role="title" maxlength="200"></label>
      <label>Note <textarea class="form-input" data-role="note" maxlength="20000" rows="3"></textarea></label>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-action="note">Add note</button>
    </details>`;
  document.body.append(dialog);
  const select = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="run"]');
  const author = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="author"]');
  const kind = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="kind"]');
  const content = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="content"]');
  const status = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  let run = null;
  let displayed = [];
  const reader = setupScratchpadReader({
    content, toolbar: dialog.querySelector('[data-role="reader"]'),
    prefsKey: 'novous.squad.scratchpad.', title: 'Squad scratchpad',
    getMarkdown: () => markdown(run, displayed), filenameBase: 'novous-squad-scratchpad',
    onError: error => { status.textContent = `Could not save: ${error.message}`; },
  });
  const squadControls = dialog.querySelector('.squad-scratchpad-controls');
  attachScratchpadSwitcher({
    toolbar: dialog.querySelector('.squad-scratchpad-header'),
    content,
    nativeControls: squadControls ? [squadControls] : [],
    currentStore: 'squad',
    onRestore: () => loadRuns().catch(err => { status.textContent = err.message; }),
  });

  dialog.addEventListener('close', () => { dialog.remove(); });

  async function loadRuns() {
    const data = await request('');
    select.replaceChildren();
    for (const item of data.runs) {
      select.add(new Option(`${item.squad_id} · ${item.status} · ${item.run_id}`, item.run_id));
    }
    if ([...select.options].some(option => option.value === preferredRun)) select.value = preferredRun;
    if (!select.value) {
      run = null;
      content.textContent = 'No squad scratchpads are available.';
      status.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    await loadRun();
  }
  async function loadRun() {
    run = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(select.value)}`);
    const previous = author.value;
    author.replaceChildren(new Option('All agents', ''));
    for (const name of [...new Set(run.entries.map(entry => entry.author))].sort()) {
      author.add(new Option(name, name));
    }
    author.value = [...author.options].some(option => option.value === previous) ? previous : '';
    render();
  }
  function render() {
    displayed = run.entries.filter(entry =>
      (!author.value || entry.author === author.value) && (!kind.value || entry.kind === kind.value));
    renderEntries(content, displayed);
    reader.refresh();
    status.textContent = `${run.total} entries · ${run.status} · ${run.query}`;
  }
  function fullHtml() {
    const full = document.createElement('div');
    renderEntries(full, run.entries);
    return buildStandaloneHtml(`Squad scratchpad: ${run.squad_id} · ${run.run_id}`, full, 0.95);
  }
  async function clearNotepad() {
    if (!run) throw new Error('Select a run first.');
    if (!confirm('Clear this notepad? The entries will be permanently removed.')) return;
    await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(run.run_id)}?expected_version=${run.version || 0}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    status.textContent = 'Notepad cleared.';
    await loadRuns();
  }
  dialog.addEventListener('cancel', () => { dialog.close(); });
  dialog.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const action = event.target.closest('button')?.dataset.action;
    if (!action) return;
    try {
      if (action === 'close') { dialog.close(); return; }
      if (action === 'refresh') { preferredRun = select.value; await loadRuns(); }
      if (action === 'clear') await clearNotepad();
      if (!run && !['close', 'refresh', 'clear'].includes(action)) throw new Error('Select a run first.');
      if (action === 'print') {
        const popup = window.open('', '_blank');
        if (!popup) throw new Error('The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups and try again.');
        popup.document.open();
        popup.document.write(fullHtml());
        popup.document.close();
        popup.focus();
        popup.print();
      }
      if (action === 'note') {
        const title = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="title"]');
        const note = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="note"]');
        if (!title.value.trim() || !note.value.trim()) throw new Error('Enter a title and note.');
        await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(run.run_id)}/notes`, {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ title: title.value.trim(), content: note.value.trim() }),
        });
        title.value = ''; note.value = '';
        await loadRun();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') status.textContent = `Scratchpad: ${error.message}`;
    }
  });
  select.addEventListener('change', () => {
    loadRun().catch(error => { status.textContent = `Could not load scratchpad: ${error.message}`; });
  });
  author.addEventListener('change', render);
  kind.addEventListener('change', render);
  dialog.showModal();
  try { await loadRuns(); } catch (error) { status.textContent = `Could not load scratchpads: ${error.message}`; }
}
```
