          frame.title = 'HTML preview';
          frame.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts');
          frame.srcdoc = language === 'svg' ? `<!doctype html><body style="margin:0">${code}</body>` : code;
          block.appendChild(frame);
          previewButton.textContent = 'Hide preview';
        });
        actions.appendChild(previewButton);
      }

      const expandButton = document.createElement('button');
      expandButton.type = 'button';
      expandButton.className = 'btn btn-sm codebuilder-expand-code';
      expandButton.textContent = 'Expand';
      expandButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open this code block in a larger view');
      expandButton.addEventListener('click', () => openChatCodeModal(code, language));
      actions.appendChild(expandButton);
      heading.appendChild(actions);

      const body = document.createElement('div');
      body.className = 'codebuilder-chat-code';

      const pre = document.createElement('pre');
      const codeElement = document.createElement('code');
      codeElement.className = `language-${language}`;
      codeElement.textContent = code;
      pre.appendChild(codeElement);
      body.appendChild(pre);

      block.append(heading, body);
      message.appendChild(block);

      mountChatCodeEditor(body, pre, code, language, {
        maxHeight: 420,
        wordWrap: 'on',
        addToRegistry: true,
      });
    };

    while ((match = codeBlockPattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      appendText(content.slice(lastIndex, match.index));
      let rawLanguage = match[1].trim().split(/\s+/, 1)[0].toLowerCase();
      let snippet = match[2].trimEnd();
      if (rawLanguage === 'json' || ['text', 'txt', 'plaintext', ''].includes(rawLanguage)) {
        try {
          snippet = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(snippet), null, 2);
          rawLanguage = 'python';
        } catch { /* keep the raw snippet when it is not valid JSON */ }
      }
      buildCodeBlock(snippet, rawLanguage);
      lastIndex = codeBlockPattern.lastIndex;
    }

    appendText(content.slice(lastIndex));
  };

  const mountChatCodeEditor = (container, fallbackPre, code, rawLanguage, options = {}) => {
    const { maxHeight = 360, wordWrap = 'on', addToRegistry = true } = options;
    const language = CODE_LANGUAGE_MAP[rawLanguage] || rawLanguage || 'plaintext';
    const lineCount = code.split('\n').length;
    container.style.height = `${Math.min(maxHeight, Math.max(72, lineCount * 18 + 16))}px`;

    return loadMonaco().then(monaco => {
      if (!container.isConnected || !chatCodeEditors) return null;
      if (!monaco?.editor || typeof monaco.editor.create !== 'function') return null;
      fallbackPre.remove();
      const editor = monaco.editor.create(container, {
        value: code,
        language,
        theme: 'vs-dark',
        readOnly: true,
        automaticLayout: true,
        minimap: { enabled: false },
        folding: false,
        glyphMargin: false,
        lineDecorationsWidth: 0,
        lineNumbers: 'off',
        renderLineHighlight: 'none',
        scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
        wordWrap,
        contextmenu: false,
        fixedOverflowWidgets: true,
      });
      if (addToRegistry) chatCodeEditors.add(editor);
      return editor;
    }).catch(() => null);
  };

  const appendChatMessage = (role, content) => {
    const message = document.createElement('div');
    message.className = `codebuilder-chat-message ${role}`;
    if (role === 'assistant') {
      appendAssistantMessage(message, content);
    } else {
      message.textContent = content;
    }
    chatMessages.appendChild(message);
    chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
  };

  const updateChatControls = () => {
    const sendButton = chatForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    chatInput.disabled = chatPending;
    sendButton.disabled = chatPending || orchestrationRunning || !selectedAgent || !modelSelect.value || modelSelect.disabled;
    orchestrationButtons.forEach(button => { button.disabled = chatPending || orchestrationRunning; });
  };

  // Memory mode: the chat transcript is saved to a file the user picks.
  let memoryPath = null;
  let transcript = [];

  const notifyFilesChanged = () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:fs-changed'));

  const writeMemory = async () => {
    if (!memoryPath) return;
    const body = transcript
      .map(entry => `[${entry.role}]\n${entry.text}`)
      .join('\n\n');
    try {
      await Api.writeManagedFile(memoryPath, `${body}\n`);
      notifyFilesChanged();
    } catch (error) {
      appendChatMessage('system', `Memory mode stopped: could not write ${memoryPath} (${error.message}).`);
      memoryPath = null;
      renderAgents();
    }
  };

  // Opens the file manager: click a folder (or an existing file) and name the memory file.
  const pickMemoryLocation = () => new Promise(resolve => {
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace('T', '-').slice(0, 15);
    let folder = '';
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (value, close) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      close();
      resolve(value);
    };

    pickerDialog('Memory mode — choose where to save', (modal, close) => {
      modal.classList.add('is-resizable');
      const hint = document.createElement('p');
      hint.className = 'text-muted small';
      hint.textContent = 'Pick a folder in the file manager and name the file. The chat is saved after every reply.';

      const treeHost = document.createElement('div');
      treeHost.className = 'codebuilder-open-tree';

      const target = document.createElement('p');
      target.className = 'small codebuilder-memory-target';
      const nameInput = document.createElement('input');
      nameInput.className = 'form-input';
      nameInput.type = 'text';
      nameInput.value = `chat_memory_${stamp}.txt`;
      nameInput.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Memory file name');
      const error = document.createElement('p');
      error.className = 'text-danger small';

      const refreshTarget = () => {
        target.textContent = `Save to: ${folder || '(workspace root)'}/${nameInput.value.trim()}`;
      };
      nameInput.addEventListener('input', refreshTarget);
      refreshTarget();

      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
      const cancel = document.createElement('button');
      cancel.type = 'button';
      cancel.className = 'btn';
      cancel.textContent = 'Cancel';
      const start = document.createElement('button');
      start.type = 'button';
      start.className = 'btn btn-primary';
      start.textContent = 'Start';
      actions.append(cancel, start);
      modal.append(hint, treeHost, target, nameInput, error, actions);

      renderTree(treeHost, {
        manageRoots: true,
        onSelectDirectory: path => { folder = path; refreshTarget(); },
        onSelect: path => {
          const slash = path.lastIndexOf('/');
          folder = slash >= 0 ? path.slice(0, slash) : '';
          nameInput.value = path.slice(slash + 1);
          refreshTarget();
        }
      });

      cancel.addEventListener('click', () => finish(null, close));
      const submit = () => {
        const name = nameInput.value.trim();
        if (!name || name === '.' || name === '..' || /[\\/]/.test(name)) {
          error.textContent = 'Enter a file name without folder separators.';
          return;
        }
        finish([folder, name].filter(Boolean).join('/'), close);
      };
      start.addEventListener('click', submit);
      nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') submit(); });
    });
  });

  const toggleMemory = async () => {
    if (memoryPath) {
      memoryPath = null;
      appendChatMessage('system', 'Memory mode off.');
      renderAgents();
      return;
    }
    const path = await pickMemoryLocation();
    if (!path) return;
    memoryPath = path;
    transcript = [];
    appendChatMessage('system', `Memory mode on. Saving this chat to ${path}.`);
    renderAgents();
    await writeMemory();
  };

  const hasAgentFunctions = agent => Array.isArray(agent.tools) && agent.tools.length > 0;

  // The coding agents' shared scratchpad (the RAG agents keep their own in the Chat Console).
  let codeScratchpadCount = 0;
  const SCRATCHPAD_KIND_LABELS = {
    plan: 'Plan', code: 'Code', test: 'Test', fix: 'Fix', summary: 'Summary', note: 'Note',
  };

  const scratchpadAuthorName = author => {
    if (author === 'orchestrator') return '⚙️ Code squad';
    const squadAgent = WORKFLOW_AGENTS[author];
    if (squadAgent) return `${squadAgent.icon} ${squadAgent.name}`;
    const chatAgent = agents.find(agent => agent.id === author);
    return `💬 ${chatAgent?.name || author || 'Agent'}`;
  };

  const updateScratchpadTile = () => {
    const count = document.getElementById('codebuilder-scratchpad-count');
    if (count) count.textContent = String(codeScratchpadCount);
    scratchpadOpen.classList.toggle('has-count', codeScratchpadCount > 0);
  };

  const refreshScratchpadCount = async () => {
    try {
      codeScratchpadCount = (await Api.getCodeScratchpad({ limit: 1 })).total || 0;
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    updateScratchpadTile();
  };

  // Entries by run (or "chat" for agents outside a squad run), in the order received.
  const groupScratchpadEntries = entries => {
    const groups = new Map();
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      const key = entry.run_id || 'chat';
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
      groups.get(key).push(entry);
    });
    return groups;
  };

  const scratchpadRunHeading = (runId, items) => {
    const when = new Date(items[0].created_at).toLocaleString();
    return runId === 'chat' ? `Chat agents · ${when}` : `Squad run ${runId.slice(3, 11)} · ${when}`;
  };

  let shownScratchpadEntries = [];

  const formatCodeScratchpadMarkdown = entries => {
    const lines = ['# Code Scratchpad', '', `Exported: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`];
    const filters = [
      scratchpadAuthorFilter.value && `agent ${scratchpadAuthorName(scratchpadAuthorFilter.value)}`,
      scratchpadKindFilter.value && `type ${SCRATCHPAD_KIND_LABELS[scratchpadKindFilter.value]}`,
    ].filter(Boolean);
    if (filters.length) lines.push(`Filtered to: ${filters.join(', ')}`);
    lines.push('');
    if (!entries.length) lines.push('The code scratchpad is empty.', '');
    groupScratchpadEntries(entries).forEach((items, runId) => {
      lines.push(`## ${scratchpadRunHeading(runId, items)}`, '');
      items.forEach(entry => {
        lines.push(
          `### ${SCRATCHPAD_KIND_LABELS[entry.kind] || entry.kind}: ${entry.title || '(untitled)'}`,
          '',
          `- **Agent:** ${scratchpadAuthorName(entry.author)}`,
          `- **Time:** ${new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleString()}`,
          '',
          String(entry.content || '') + (entry.truncated ? '\n\n(truncated)' : ''),
          '',
          '---',
          ''
        );
      });
    });
    return lines.join('\n');
  };

  const scratchpadReader = setupScratchpadReader({
    content: scratchpadContent,
    toolbar: scratchpadReaderBar,
    prefsKey: 'novous2.codebuilder.scratchpad.',
    title: 'Code Scratchpad',
    filenameBase: 'novous-code-scratchpad',
    getMarkdown: () => formatCodeScratchpadMarkdown(shownScratchpadEntries),
    onError: error => { scratchpadStatus.textContent = `Could not save or open: ${error.message}`; },
  });

  const renderScratchpadEntries = entries => {
    shownScratchpadEntries = entries;
    scratchpadContent.replaceChildren();
    if (!entries.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('p');
      empty.className = 'text-muted small';
      empty.textContent = scratchpadAuthorFilter.value || scratchpadKindFilter.value
        ? 'No entries match these filters.'
        : 'The code scratchpad is empty. Squad runs and coding agents add entries here.';
      scratchpadContent.appendChild(empty);
      scratchpadReader.refresh();
      return;
    }
    groupScratchpadEntries(entries).forEach((items, runId) => {
      const section = document.createElement('details');
      section.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-run';
      section.open = true;
      const heading = document.createElement('summary');
      heading.textContent = `${scratchpadRunHeading(runId, items)} · ${items.length} entr${items.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}`;
      section.appendChild(heading);
      items.forEach(entry => {
        const card = document.createElement('details');
        card.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry';
        card.dataset.kind = entry.kind;
        card.dataset.readerItem = '';
        card.open = true;
        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        const meta = document.createElement('span');
        meta.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta';
        const kind = document.createElement('span');
        kind.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-kind';
        kind.textContent = SCRATCHPAD_KIND_LABELS[entry.kind] || entry.kind;
        const author = document.createElement('span');
        author.textContent = scratchpadAuthorName(entry.author);
        const time = document.createElement('span');
        time.className = 'text-muted';
        time.textContent = new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleTimeString();
        meta.append(kind, author, time);
        const title = document.createElement('span');
        title.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title';
        title.textContent = entry.title || '(untitled)';
        summary.append(meta, title);
        const body = document.createElement('div');
        body.className = 'codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-body';
        appendAssistantMessage(body, entry.content + (entry.truncated ? '\n\n(truncated)' : ''));
        card.append(summary, body);
        section.appendChild(card);
      });
      scratchpadContent.appendChild(section);
    });
    scratchpadReader.refresh();
  };

  const loadScratchpad = async () => {
    scratchpadStatus.textContent = 'Loading code scratchpad…';
    try {
      const author = scratchpadAuthorFilter.value;
      const kind = scratchpadKindFilter.value;
      const result = await Api.getCodeScratchpad({ limit: 60, author, kind });
      codeScratchpadCount = result.total || 0;
      updateScratchpadTile();
      const authors = new Set([...scratchpadAuthorFilter.options].map(option => option.value));
      (result.entries || []).forEach(entry => {
        if (!authors.has(entry.author)) {
          scratchpadAuthorFilter.add(new Option(scratchpadAuthorName(entry.author), entry.author));
          authors.add(entry.author);
        }
      });
      renderScratchpadEntries(result.entries || []);
      const shown = (result.entries || []).length;
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = `${codeScratchpadCount} entr${codeScratchpadCount === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}` +
        (author ? ` · showing ${scratchpadAuthorName(author)}` : '') +
        (kind ? ` · ${SCRATCHPAD_KIND_LABELS[kind]} only` : '') +
        (shown === 60 ? ' · newest 60 shown' : '');
    } catch (error) {
      scratchpadContent.replaceChildren();
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = `Could not load the code scratchpad: ${error.message}`;
    }
  };

  const viewScratchpad = async () => {
    scratchpadDialog.showModal();
    await loadScratchpad();
  };

  const clearScratchpad = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Clear the code scratchpad? This removes every plan, code, test, fix, and note entry.')) return;
    scratchpadClear.disabled = true;
    scratchpadStatus.textContent = 'Clearing code scratchpad…';
    try {
      await Api.clearCodeScratchpad();
      codeScratchpadCount = 0;
      updateScratchpadTile();
      scratchpadAuthorFilter.replaceChildren(new Option('All agents', ''));
      renderScratchpadEntries([]);
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = 'Code scratchpad cleared.';
    } catch (error) {
      scratchpadStatus.textContent = `Could not clear the code scratchpad: ${error.message}`;
    } finally {
      scratchpadClear.disabled = false;
    }
  };

  scratchpadRefresh.addEventListener('click', loadScratchpad);
  scratchpadClear.addEventListener('click', clearScratchpad);
  scratchpadAuthorFilter.addEventListener('change', loadScratchpad);
  scratchpadKindFilter.addEventListener('change', loadScratchpad);

  attachScratchpadSwitcher({
    toolbar: shell.querySelector('.codebuilder-scratchpad-toolbar'),
    content: scratchpadContent,
    nativeControls: [scratchpadAuthorFilter, scratchpadKindFilter, scratchpadRefresh, scratchpadClear],
    currentStore: 'code',
    onRestore: loadScratchpad,
    onNativeClear: clearScratchpad,
  });

  // The agent picker and its buttons live in the chat panel heading.
  const renderAgents = () => {
    agentPicker.replaceChildren();
    if (!agents.length) {
      selectedAgent = null;
      agentPicker.add(new Option('No agents found', ''));
    }
    agents.forEach(agent => {
      const toolCount = (agent.tools || []).length;
      const option = new Option(`${agent.name} · ${toolCount} tool${toolCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`, agent.id);
      option.disabled = !hasAgentFunctions(agent);
      option.title = (agent.tools || []).join(', ') || 'No tools';
      agentPicker.add(option);
    });
    if (selectedAgent) agentPicker.value = selectedAgent.id;
    agentPicker.disabled = chatPending || !agents.length;
    agentPicker.title = selectedAgent?.description || 'Choose agent';

    memoryToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(Boolean(memoryPath)));
    memoryToggle.classList.toggle('is-on', Boolean(memoryPath));
    memoryToggle.title = memoryPath
      ? `Memory mode on — saving to ${memoryPath}. Click to turn off.`
      : 'Memory mode: save this chat to a text file you choose';

    updateChatControls();
  };

  agentPicker.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const chosen = agents.find(agent => agent.id === agentPicker.value);
    if (chosen && chosen.id !== selectedAgent?.id) selectAgent(chosen);
  });
  memoryToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleMemory);
  scratchpadOpen.addEventListener('click', viewScratchpad);

  const selectAgent = (agent) => {
    selectedAgent = agent;
    renderAgents();
    const preferredModel = agent.model || defaultModel;
    if ([...modelSelect.options].some(option => option.value === preferredModel)) {
      modelSelect.value = preferredModel;
    }
    chatMessages.replaceChildren();
    disposeChatCodeEditors();
    appendChatMessage('system', `Chatting with ${agent.name}.`);
    chatStatus.textContent = agent.description || `Chatting with ${agent.name}.`;
  };

  const loadAgents = async () => {
    agentRefresh.disabled = true;
    try {
      const data = await fetch('/api/codebuilder/agents').then(async response => {
        const payload = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.detail || 'Could not load agents.');
        return payload;
      });
      agents = data.agents || [];
      const selectedId = selectedAgent?.id;
      selectedAgent = agents.find(agent => agent.id === selectedId) || agents[0] || null;
      renderAgents();
      if (selectedAgent) selectAgent(selectedAgent);
    } catch (error) {
      agentPicker.replaceChildren(new Option('Could not load agents', ''));
      chatStatus.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      agentRefresh.disabled = false;
    }
  };

  const loadModels = async () => {
    modelSelect.replaceChildren();
    const loadingOption = document.createElement('option');
    loadingOption.textContent = 'Loading models…';
    loadingOption.value = '';
    modelSelect.appendChild(loadingOption);
    modelSelect.disabled = true;
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/models');
      const payload = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.detail || 'Could not load models.');
      const models = (payload.models || []).slice().sort();
      defaultModel = payload.default || defaultModel;
      modelSelect.replaceChildren();

      const availableModels = models.length ? models : [defaultModel];
      availableModels.forEach(model => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = model;
        option.textContent = models.length ? model : `${model} (not detected)`;
        modelSelect.appendChild(option);
      });
      modelSelect.disabled = models.length === 0;
      if (models.length) {
        const preferredModel = selectedAgent?.model || defaultModel;
        modelSelect.value = models.includes(preferredModel) ? preferredModel : models[0];
      }
      if (!models.length) {
        chatStatus.textContent = payload.error || 'No installed models detected.';
      }
      updateChatControls();
    } catch (error) {
      modelSelect.replaceChildren();
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = '';
      option.textContent = 'Could not load models';
      modelSelect.appendChild(option);
      modelSelect.disabled = true;
      chatStatus.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      updateChatControls();
    }
  };

  demoButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    editor.setValue(DEMO_CODE);
    editor.setDiagnostics([]);
    status.textContent = 'Demo loaded';
    editor.focus();
  });
  clearButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    output.textContent = 'Console cleared.';
    renderDiagnostics([]);
    editor.setDiagnostics([]);
    status.textContent = 'Ready';
  });
  runButton.addEventListener('click', runCode);
  document.getElementById('reset-sandbox')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      const result = await confirmReset();
      if (result) status.textContent = result.output;
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = `Reset failed: ${err.message}`;
    }
  });
  editor.setRunHandler(runCode);

  const persistedRunMode = readPref(RUN_MODE_KEY);
  if (persistedRunMode === 'risky' || persistedRunMode === 'safe') {
    manualRunMode = persistedRunMode;
    runMode.value = persistedRunMode;
  }
  runMode.addEventListener('change', () => {
    manualRunMode = runMode.value;
    writePref(RUN_MODE_KEY, runMode.value);
  });
  const fileControls = setupFileControls({
    editor,
    status,
    label: document.getElementById('codebuilder-filename'),
    buttons: {
      save: document.getElementById('save-file'),
      saveAs: document.getElementById('save-file-as'),
      open: document.getElementById('open-file'),
      runTerminal: document.getElementById('run-in-terminal')
    },
    openTerminalWith: (command) => openTerminalWith(command)
  });

  const updateChangedLines = (lines, eventType) => {
    currentChangedLines = Array.isArray(lines)
      ? [...new Set(lines.filter(line => Number.isInteger(line) && line > 0))].sort((a, b) => a - b)
      : [];
    changeCount.textContent = `${currentChangedLines.length} changed line${currentChangedLines.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    changeViewToggle.disabled = currentChangedLines.length === 0;
    changeViewToggle.textContent = compactChangedLines ? 'Show full file' : 'Show changed area';
    editor.setHighlightedLines(currentChangedLines, eventType);
    editor.setChangeView(currentChangedLines, compactChangedLines);
  };

  const WORKFLOW_AGENTS = {
    'code-planer': { name: 'Code Planner', icon: '🧭' },
    'code-builder': { name: 'Code Builder', icon: '🛠️' },
    tester: { name: 'Code Tester', icon: '🧪' },
    'code-troubleshooter': { name: 'Code Troubleshooter', icon: '🩺' },
  };
  const workflowAgentName = agentId => WORKFLOW_AGENTS[agentId]?.name || agentId || 'Code squad';
  const STEP_LABELS = { plan: 'Plan', build: 'Build', test: 'Test', fix: 'Fix' };
  const ACTION_LABELS = { plan: 'Plan', build: 'Build', test: 'Test', fix: 'Fix', all: 'Run All' };
  // Agents whose streamed code block is painted into the editor while they type.
  const EDITOR_WRITING_AGENTS = new Set(['code-builder', 'code-troubleshooter']);

  let workflowTraceId = null;
  let workflowAction = null;
  let lastWorkflowPlan = '';
  let lastSequence = 0;
  let agentBubbles = new Map();

  const setActivity = (text, state = 'running') => {
    editorActivity.textContent = text;
    editorActivity.dataset.state = state;
  };

  const resetSteps = action => {
    const active = action === 'all' ? ['plan', 'build', 'test'] : [action];
    squadSteps.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach(item => {
      item.dataset.state = active.includes(item.dataset.step) ? 'pending' : 'idle';
      item.querySelector('.codebuilder-step-attempt').textContent = '';
    });
  };

  const markStep = (step, state, attempt) => {
    const item = squadSteps.querySelector(`[data-step="${step}"]`);
    if (!item) return;
    item.dataset.state = state;
    item.querySelector('.codebuilder-step-attempt').textContent = attempt ? `#${attempt}` : '';
  };

  const extractStreamingCode = text => {
    // Newest ```python fence; an unclosed fence counts as code still being written.
    let found = null;
    for (const match of text.matchAll(/```([\w+-]*)[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)(```|$)/g)) {
      if (['', 'python', 'py', 'python3'].includes(match[1].toLowerCase())) found = match[2];
    }
    return found;
  };

  const openAgentBubble = (agentId, step, attempt) => {
    const agent = WORKFLOW_AGENTS[agentId] || { name: agentId, icon: '🤖' };
    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'codebuilder-chat-message assistant codebuilder-agent-message';
    wrapper.dataset.agent = agentId;
    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'codebuilder-agent-header';
    header.textContent = `${agent.icon} ${agent.name}${attempt ? ` · attempt ${attempt}` : ''}`;
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'codebuilder-agent-body is-streaming';
    wrapper.append(header, body);
    chatMessages.appendChild(wrapper);
    chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
    const bubble = { agentId, step, body, text: '', liveCode: null, paintQueued: false };
    agentBubbles.set(agentId, bubble);
    setActivity(`${agent.name} is working…`);
    return bubble;
  };

  const paintAgentBubble = bubble => {
    bubble.paintQueued = false;
    bubble.body.classList.add('prompt-rich-markdown');
    bubble.body.replaceChildren();
    appendMarkdown(bubble.body, bubble.text);
    chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
    if (!EDITOR_WRITING_AGENTS.has(bubble.agentId)) return;
    const code = extractStreamingCode(bubble.text);
    if (code !== null && code !== bubble.liveCode) {
      bubble.liveCode = code;
      editor.setValue(code);
      editor.revealEnd?.();
      setActivity(`${workflowAgentName(bubble.agentId)} is writing code…`);
    }
  };

  const applyOrchestrationEvent = async eventData => {
    const detail = eventData.data || {};
    switch (eventData.event_type) {
      case 'RUN_STARTED':
        appendChatMessage('system', `Code squad started: ${ACTION_LABELS[workflowAction] || workflowAction}.`);
        return;
      case 'AGENT_STARTED':
        openAgentBubble(detail.agent_id || eventData.receiver, detail.step, detail.attempt);
        return;
      case 'AGENT_TOKEN': {
        const agentId = detail.agent_id || eventData.sender;
        const bubble = agentBubbles.get(agentId) || openAgentBubble(agentId);
        bubble.text += detail.text || '';
        if (!bubble.paintQueued) {
          bubble.paintQueued = true;
          requestAnimationFrame(() => paintAgentBubble(bubble));
        }
        return;
      }
      case 'AGENT_DONE': {
        const agentId = detail.agent_id || eventData.sender;
        const bubble = agentBubbles.get(agentId) || openAgentBubble(agentId);
        bubble.text = detail.text || bubble.text || '(no reply)';
        bubble.body.classList.remove('is-streaming');
        bubble.body.textContent = '';
        appendAssistantMessage(bubble.body, bubble.text);
        if (detail.step === 'plan') lastWorkflowPlan = bubble.text;
        agentBubbles.delete(agentId);
        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
        return;
      }
      case 'STEP_STATUS': {
        const step = detail.step;
        const label = STEP_LABELS[step] || step;
        markStep(step, detail.status, detail.attempt);
        if (detail.status === 'running') {
          setActivity(`${label}${detail.attempt ? ` (attempt ${detail.attempt})` : ''} running…`);
          orchestrationStatus.textContent = `${label} running…`;
          return;
        }
        const ok = detail.status === 'success';
        const message = `${ok ? '✓' : '✗'} ${label}${detail.summary ? `: ${detail.summary}` : (ok ? ' done' : ' failed')}`;
        setActivity(message, ok ? 'success' : 'error');
        orchestrationStatus.textContent = message;
        appendChatMessage('system', message);
        return;
      }
      case 'EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE': {
        editor.setValue(detail.content || '');
        editor.setDiagnostics([]);
        renderDiagnostics([]);
        workflowEditorDelivered = true;
        updateChangedLines(Array.isArray(detail.changed_lines) ? detail.changed_lines : [], 'applied');
        setActivity(`${workflowAgentName(eventData.sender)} updated the editor`, 'success');
        return;
      }
      case 'EDITOR_CODE_EXECUTION': {
        const execution = await Api.getOrchestrationEditorExecution(eventData.trace_id);
        const diagnosticsList = (Array.isArray(execution.diagnostics) ? execution.diagnostics : [])
          .filter(item => item.line);
        const outputParts = [`Workflow test run: ${execution.status || detail.status || 'complete'}`];
        if (execution.stdout) outputParts.push(execution.stdout.trimEnd());
        if (execution.stderr) outputParts.push(execution.stderr.trimEnd());
        if (!execution.stdout && !execution.stderr) outputParts.push('(no console output)');
        output.textContent = outputParts.join('\n\n');
        if (detail.status === 'error') {
          appendChatMessage('system', outputParts.join('\n\n').slice(0, 4_000));
        }
        renderDiagnostics(diagnosticsList);
        editor.setDiagnostics(diagnosticsList);
        const errorLines = Array.isArray(detail.diagnostic_lines) ? detail.diagnostic_lines : [];
        if (errorLines.length) editor.setHighlightedLines(errorLines, 'error');
        return;
      }
      case 'SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF':
        if (detail.direction === 'write') {
          codeScratchpadCount += 1;
          updateScratchpadTile();
        }
        return;
      case 'ERROR': {
        const message = detail.error || `${workflowAgentName(eventData.sender)} encountered an error.`;
        setActivity(message, 'error');
        orchestrationStatus.textContent = message;
        appendChatMessage('system', message);
        return;
      }
      default:
        return;
    }
  };

  changeViewToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    compactChangedLines = !compactChangedLines;
    updateChangedLines(currentChangedLines, 'preview');
  });

  const updateWorkflowControls = () => {
    const busy = orchestrationRunning || chatPending;
    orchestrationButtons.forEach(button => { button.disabled = busy; });
    workflowStop.hidden = !orchestrationRunning;
    workflowStop.disabled = false;
    editor.setReadOnly?.(orchestrationRunning);
  };

  const finishWorkflow = async (resultStatus, result) => {
    orchestrationSource?.close();
    orchestrationSource = null;
    agentBubbles.forEach(bubble => bubble.body.classList.remove('is-streaming'));
    agentBubbles = new Map();
    if (result?.final_answer) appendChatMessage('assistant', result.final_answer);
    if (result?.result_payload?.plan) lastWorkflowPlan = result.result_payload.plan;
    const changed = workflowEditorSource !== null && editor.getValue() !== workflowEditorSource;
    workflowRevert.hidden = !changed;
    orchestrationRunning = false;
    workflowTraceId = null;
    updateWorkflowControls();
    updateChatControls();
    const label = ACTION_LABELS[workflowAction] || workflowAction;
    orchestrationStatus.textContent = `${label} ${resultStatus}.`;
    orchestrationStatus.dataset.state = resultStatus;
    chatStatus.textContent = `Code squad ${resultStatus}`;
    setActivity(`${label} ${resultStatus}`, resultStatus === 'success' ? 'success' : resultStatus === 'cancelled' ? 'info' : 'error');
    if (changed && fileControls.getCurrentPath()) {
      const saved = await fileControls.save();
      if (saved) appendChatMessage('system', `Saved changes to ${fileControls.getCurrentPath()}. Use “Revert run” to undo.`);
    }
  };

  const startCodeWorkflow = async action => {
    if (orchestrationRunning || chatPending) return;
    const typed = chatInput.value.trim();
    const defaults = {
      test: 'Test the current editor code.',
      fix: 'Fix the errors in the current editor code.',
    };
    const query = typed || defaults[action] || '';
    if (!query) {
      orchestrationStatus.textContent = `Describe what to ${action === 'all' ? 'build' : action} in the message box first.`;
      chatInput.focus();
      return;
    }
    orchestrationRunning = true;
    workflowAction = action;
    lastSequence = 0;
    agentBubbles = new Map();
    workflowEditorSource = editor.getValue();
    workflowEditorDelivered = false;
    workflowRevert.hidden = true;
    updateWorkflowControls();
    updateChatControls();
    resetSteps(action);
    appendChatMessage('user', `[${ACTION_LABELS[action]}] ${query}`);
    if (typed) chatInput.value = '';
    changeCount.textContent = '0 changed lines';
    changeViewToggle.disabled = true;
    currentChangedLines = [];
    editor.setHighlightedLines([]);
    editor.setChangeView([], false);
    compactChangedLines = false;
    renderDiagnostics([]);
    editor.setDiagnostics([]);
    setActivity('Starting Code Development Squad…');
    orchestrationStatus.textContent = 'Starting…';
    chatStatus.textContent = `Code squad: ${ACTION_LABELS[action]}`;
    orchestrationSource?.close();

    let started;
    try {
      started = await Api.startOrchestrationRun('code-squad', query, action, {
        editor_code: workflowEditorSource,
        editor_path: fileControls.getCurrentPath(),
        model: modelSelect.value || undefined,
        plan: action === 'build' ? lastWorkflowPlan : undefined,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      appendChatMessage('system', `Could not start the code squad: ${error.message}`);
      await finishWorkflow('error', null);
      return;
    }
    workflowTraceId = started.trace_id;
    lastSquadScratchpadTrace = started.trace_id;
    const source = new EventSource(`/api/orchestration/stream/${encodeURIComponent(started.trace_id)}`);
    orchestrationSource = source;
    let eventQueue = Promise.resolve();
    let complete = false;
    const complete_ = resultStatus => {
      if (complete) return;
      complete = true;
      source.close();  // close before awaiting so a reconnect cannot replay the run
      eventQueue = eventQueue.then(async () => {
        let result = null;
        try {
          result = await Api.getOrchestrationRunResult(started.trace_id);
        } catch (error) {
          appendChatMessage('system', `The run finished, but its summary could not be loaded: ${error.message}`);
        }
        await finishWorkflow(result?.status || resultStatus, result);
      });
    };
    source.addEventListener('telemetry', event => {
      let eventData;
      try {
        eventData = JSON.parse(event.data);
      } catch (error) {
        orchestrationStatus.textContent = `Could not read workflow event: ${error.message}`;
        return;
      }
      if (eventData.event_type !== 'AGENT_TOKEN') {
        if (eventData.sequence <= lastSequence) return;
        lastSequence = eventData.sequence;
      }
      if (eventData.event_type === 'RUN_COMPLETE') {
        complete_(eventData.data?.status || 'complete');
        return;
      }
      eventQueue = eventQueue.then(() => applyOrchestrationEvent(eventData)).catch(error => {
        orchestrationStatus.textContent = `Could not display workflow event: ${error.message}`;
      });
    });
    source.addEventListener('error', () => {
      if (source.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED && !complete) complete_('error');
    });
  };

  orchestrationButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => startCodeWorkflow(button.dataset.codebuilderWorkflow));
  });
  workflowStop.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!workflowTraceId) return;
    workflowStop.disabled = true;
    orchestrationStatus.textContent = 'Stopping…';
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/orchestration/runs/${encodeURIComponent(workflowTraceId)}/cancel`, { method: 'POST' });
    } catch (error) {
      orchestrationStatus.textContent = `Could not stop the run: ${error.message}`;
      workflowStop.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  workflowRevert.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (workflowEditorSource === null || orchestrationRunning) return;
    editor.setValue(workflowEditorSource);
    updateChangedLines([], 'preview');
    workflowRevert.hidden = true;
    appendChatMessage('system', 'Reverted the editor to its state before the last run.');
    if (fileControls.getCurrentPath()) await fileControls.save();
  });
  editor.onChange(() => {
    fileControls.refreshLabel();
    if (manualRunMode) return;
    if (runMode.value !== detectRunMode()) runMode.value = detectRunMode();
  });
  agentRefresh.addEventListener('click', loadAgents);

  // The toolbar shows the same file name as the status bar.
  const statusFilename = document.getElementById('codebuilder-filename');
  const toolbarFilename = document.getElementById('codebuilder-toolbar-filename');
  if (statusFilename && toolbarFilename) {
    const mirror = () => {
      toolbarFilename.textContent = statusFilename.textContent;
      toolbarFilename.title = statusFilename.title;
    };
    new MutationObserver(mirror).observe(statusFilename, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true, attributes: true });
    mirror();
  }

  chatForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (!message || chatPending || orchestrationRunning) return;
    if (!selectedAgent) {
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Select an agent before sending a message.';
      return;
    }
    if (!modelSelect.value) {
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Select an installed model before sending a message.';
      return;
    }

    appendChatMessage('user', message);
    if (memoryPath) transcript.push({ role: 'user', text: message });
    chatInput.value = '';
    chatPending = true;
    chatStatus.textContent = `Waiting for ${selectedAgent.name}…`;
    updateChatControls();
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message,
          agent_id: selectedAgent.id,
          model: modelSelect.value,
          session_id: `codebuilder-${selectedAgent.id}`,
          environment: 'codebuilder',
        })
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || 'The agent request failed.');
      }

      const bubble = document.createElement('div');
      bubble.className = 'codebuilder-chat-message assistant';
      chatMessages.appendChild(bubble);

      let text = '';
      let liveCode = null;
      let paintQueued = false;
      let donePayload = null;
      let failure = null;

      // Newest ```python fence in the streamed text; an unclosed fence counts as in progress.
      const latestCode = () => {
        let found = null;
        for (const match of text.matchAll(/```([\w+-]*)[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)(```|$)/g)) {
          if (['', 'python', 'py'].includes(match[1].toLowerCase())) found = match[2];
        }
        return found;
      };
      const paint = () => {
        paintQueued = false;
        bubble.classList.add('prompt-rich-markdown');
        bubble.replaceChildren();
        appendMarkdown(bubble, text);
        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
        const code = latestCode();
        if (code !== null && code !== liveCode) {
          liveCode = code;
          editor.setValue(code);
          status.textContent = 'Agent is writing code…';
        }
      };
      const schedulePaint = () => {
        if (!paintQueued) { paintQueued = true; requestAnimationFrame(paint); }
      };

      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = '';
      const handleEvent = async item => {
        if (item.type === 'token') {
          text += item.text;
          schedulePaint();
        } else if (item.type === 'tool_event') {
          await handleCodeBuilderToolEvents([item.event]);
        } else if (item.type === 'done') {
          donePayload = item;
        } else if (item.type === 'error') {
          failure = item.detail || 'The agent request failed.';
        }
      };
      for (;;) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const frames = buffer.split('\n\n');
        buffer = frames.pop();
        for (const frame of frames) {
          const line = frame.split('\n').find(l => l.startsWith('data: '));
          if (line) await handleEvent(JSON.parse(line.slice(6)));
        }
      }

      paint();
      if (failure) {
        bubble.remove();
        throw new Error(failure);
      }
      const reply = donePayload?.reply || text || 'The agent returned an empty response.';
      bubble.textContent = '';
      appendAssistantMessage(bubble, reply);
      if (liveCode !== null) sendCodeToEditor(liveCode, 'agent');
      if (memoryPath) {
        transcript.push({ role: 'assistant', text: reply });
        await writeMemory();
      }
      chatStatus.textContent = `${selectedAgent.name} · ${donePayload?.model || modelSelect.value}`;
    } catch (error) {
      const messageText = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      appendChatMessage('system', `Request failed: ${messageText}`);
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Request failed';
    } finally {
      chatPending = false;
      updateChatControls();
      refreshScratchpadCount();
      chatInput.focus();
    }
  });
  chatInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {
      event.preventDefault();
      chatForm.requestSubmit();
    }
  });
  chatClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    chatInput.value = '';
    chatMessages.replaceChildren();
    disposeChatCodeEditors();
    if (selectedAgent) {
      appendChatMessage('system', 'Chat cleared. Ask a new question.');
      chatStatus.textContent = `Agent: ${selectedAgent.name}`;
    } else {
      appendChatMessage('system', 'Chat cleared.');
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Chat cleared';
    }
    chatInput.focus();
  });

  renderDiagnostics([]);
  status.textContent = 'Ready';
  updateChatControls();
  Promise.all([loadAgents(), loadModels()]).then(refreshScratchpadCount);

  return { editor, runCode, loadAgents };
}

export async function renderCodeBuilderView(container) {
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="codebuilder-shell">
      <div class="codebuilder-toolbar">
        <div class="codebuilder-file-label">
          <span class="codebuilder-python-icon">Py</span>
          <span id="codebuilder-toolbar-filename">Untitled</span>
        </div>
        <div class="codebuilder-toolbar-actions">
          <div class="cb-group" role="group" aria-label="File">
            <button id="open-file" class="cb-btn" type="button" title="Open a file from the file manager">${iconSvg('folder-open')}<span>Open</span></button>
            <button id="save-file" class="cb-btn" type="button" title="Save (Ctrl+S)">${iconSvg('save')}<span>Save</span></button>
            <button id="save-file-as" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon" type="button" title="Save as a new file" aria-label="Save as">${iconSvg('save-as')}</button>
          </div>
          <div class="cb-group" role="group" aria-label="Run settings">
            <select id="codebuilder-run-mode" class="cb-select" aria-label="Choose how to run Python code"
                    title="Safe runs in-process; Isolated runs in a separate process and streams output">
              <option value="safe">Safe</option>
              <option value="risky">Isolated · streams</option>
            </select>
            <select id="codebuilder-run-timeout" class="cb-select" aria-label="Time limit for a run" title="Time limit for a run">
              <option value="10">10 s limit</option>
              <option value="120">2 min limit</option>
              <option value="240">4 min limit</option>
              <option value="480">8 min limit</option>
              <option value="server">Server · no limit</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button id="stop-run" class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" title="Stop the running program" hidden>${iconSvg('square')}<span>Stop</span></button>
          <button id="run-code" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" type="button" title="Run Python (Ctrl+Enter)">${iconSvg('play')}<span class="cb-btn-label">Run</span><kbd>Ctrl ↵</kbd></button>
          <details class="cb-menu">
            <summary class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon" title="More actions" aria-label="More actions">${iconSvg('more-horizontal')}</summary>
            <div class="cb-menu-list" role="menu">
              <button id="run-in-terminal" type="button" role="menuitem">${iconSvg('terminal')}<span>Run in Terminal</span></button>
              <button id="load-demo" type="button" role="menuitem">${iconSvg('file-code')}<span>Load sample program</span></button>
              <button id="reset-sandbox" type="button" role="menuitem" class="is-danger">${iconSvg('reset')}<span>Reset environment</span></button>
            </div>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>

      <main class="codebuilder-layout">
        <section id="codebuilder-chat-panel" class="codebuilder-chat-panel" aria-label="Chat with an agent">
          <div class="codebuilder-chat-heading">
            <select id="codebuilder-agent-select" class="cb-select codebuilder-agent-select" aria-label="Choose agent">
              <option value="">Loading agents…</option>
            </select>
            <button id="codebuilder-agent-refresh" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" type="button" title="Reload agents" aria-label="Reload agents">${iconSvg('refresh')}</button>
            <button id="codebuilder-memory-toggle" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="Save this chat to a text file you choose" aria-label="Memory mode">${iconSvg('database')}</button>
            <button id="codebuilder-scratchpad-open" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost cb-count" type="button" title="Code scratchpad: plans, code, tests, fixes and notes" aria-label="Open the code scratchpad">${iconSvg('clipboard')}<span id="codebuilder-scratchpad-count">0</span></button>
            <button id="codebuilder-squad-scratchpad-open" class="cb-btn cb-btn-ghost" type="button" title="Open per-run squad scratchpads">Squad scratchpads</button>
            <button id="codebuilder-chat-expand" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-expanded="true" title="Hide chat panel" aria-label="Hide chat panel">${iconSvg('chevron-left')}</button>
          </div>
          <p id="codebuilder-chat-status" class="codebuilder-chat-status">Select an agent to start.</p>
          <div id="codebuilder-chat-messages" class="codebuilder-chat-messages" aria-live="polite">
            <div class="codebuilder-chat-message system">Messages with your selected agent appear here.</div>
          </div>
          <form id="codebuilder-chat-form" class="codebuilder-chat-form">
            <textarea id="codebuilder-chat-input" class="form-input" rows="3"
                      placeholder="Ask the agent, or describe a task for the code squad…"
                      aria-label="Message to agent or Code squad workflow"></textarea>
            <div class="codebuilder-chat-footer">
              <select id="codebuilder-model" class="cb-select codebuilder-model" aria-label="Choose model" title="Model">
                <option value="">Loading models…</option>
              </select>
              <button id="codebuilder-chat-clear" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" type="button" title="Clear the conversation" aria-label="Clear chat">${iconSvg('trash-2')}</button>
              <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" type="submit" disabled title="Send (Enter)">${iconSvg('send')}<span>Send</span></button>
            </div>
            <div class="codebuilder-workflow-actions" role="group" aria-label="Code squad orchestration">
              <span class="cb-squad-label">Squad</span>
              <div class="cb-segmented">
                <button type="button" data-codebuilder-workflow="plan" title="Code Planner writes a plan for your request">Plan</button>
                <button type="button" data-codebuilder-workflow="build" title="Code Builder writes the module into the editor (uses the last plan)">Build</button>
                <button type="button" data-codebuilder-workflow="test" title="Run the editor code and the Code Tester's checks">Test</button>
                <button type="button" data-codebuilder-workflow="fix" title="Code Troubleshooter fixes test failures, retesting up to 3 times">Fix</button>
              </div>
              <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-accent" type="button" data-codebuilder-workflow="all" title="Plan, build, test, and fix until the checks pass">${iconSvg('play')}<span>Run all</span></button>
              <button id="codebuilder-workflow-stop" class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" title="Stop the code squad" hidden>${iconSvg('square')}<span>Stop</span></button>
              <button id="codebuilder-workflow-revert" class="cb-btn" type="button" title="Restore the editor to how it was before the last run" hidden>${iconSvg('reset')}<span>Revert</span></button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </section>

        <div class="codebuilder-resizer panel-resizer" data-resize="chat" role="separator" tabindex="0"
             aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize chat panel"
             title="Drag to resize · drag to the edge or double-click to hide"><span class="cb-grip">${iconSvg('chevron-right', 14)}</span></div>

        <section class="codebuilder-editor-panel" aria-label="Python editor">

            <button id="codebuilder-scratchpad-clear" class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button">${iconSvg('trash-2')}<span>Clear</span></button>
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-scratchpad-close>Close</button>

        <div id="codebuilder-scratchpad-content" class="codebuilder-scratchpad-content" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </dialog>
    </div>
  `;

  const shell = container.querySelector('.codebuilder-shell');
  shell.querySelector('[data-scratchpad-close]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    shell.querySelector('#codebuilder-scratchpad-dialog')?.close();
  });
  // The "more" menu closes after a choice, on Escape, or on a click elsewhere.
  const moreMenu = shell.querySelector('.cb-menu');
  moreMenu?.querySelector('.cb-menu-list').addEventListener('click', () => { moreMenu.open = false; });
  moreMenu?.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') { moreMenu.open = false; moreMenu.querySelector('summary').focus(); }
  });
  const closeMenuOutside = event => {
    if (!moreMenu?.isConnected) { document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', closeMenuOutside); return; }
    if (!moreMenu.contains(event.target)) moreMenu.open = false;
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', closeMenuOutside);
  await setupCodeBuilderPage();
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && document.readyState !== 'loading') {
  const root = document.getElementById('codebuilder-editor');
  if (root) setupCodeBuilderPage();
}

```javascript
const MONACO_VS_PATH = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.52.2/min/vs';
let monacoPromise;

export function loadMonaco() {
  if (window.monaco?.editor) return Promise.resolve(window.monaco);
  if (monacoPromise) return monacoPromise;

  monacoPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof window.require !== 'function') {
      reject(new Error('The Monaco Editor loader is unavailable.'));
      return;
    }

    window.require.config({ paths: { vs: MONACO_VS_PATH } });
    window.require(['vs/editor/editor.main'], () => {
      if (!window.monaco?.editor) {
        reject(new Error('Monaco Editor failed to initialize.'));
        return;
      }
      resolve(window.monaco);
    }, reject);
  });
  return monacoPromise;
}

function createTextareaEditor(element, initialValue, ariaLabel) {
  const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
  textarea.className = 'codebuilder-textarea';
  textarea.value = initialValue;
  textarea.setAttribute('aria-label', ariaLabel);
  element.replaceChildren(textarea);
  let runHandler = null;
  let saveHandler = null;
  let changeHandler = null;
  let positionHandler = null;
  let pasteHandler = null;
  let transformPaste = null;
  textarea.addEventListener('paste', event => {
    if (!pasteHandler || textarea.readOnly || !event.clipboardData?.types.includes('text/plain')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = event.clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
    const fullDocument = textarea.selectionStart === 0 && textarea.selectionEnd === textarea.value.length;
    const normalized = text.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
    const formatted = transformPaste ? transformPaste(normalized) : normalized;
    if (!document.execCommand('insertText', false, formatted)) {
      textarea.setRangeText(formatted, textarea.selectionStart, textarea.selectionEnd, 'end');
      changeHandler?.();
    }
    pasteHandler({ fullDocument, snapshot: textarea.value, formatted: formatted !== normalized });
  });
  textarea.addEventListener('input', () => changeHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('keyup', () => positionHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('click', () => positionHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') {
        event.preventDefault();
        runHandler?.();
      } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 's' && saveHandler) {
        event.preventDefault();
        saveHandler?.();
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    getValue: () => textarea.value,
    setValue: (value) => { textarea.value = value; changeHandler?.(); },
    setLanguage: () => {},
    getPosition: () => {
      const lines = textarea.value.slice(0, textarea.selectionStart).split('\n');
      return { lineNumber: lines.length, column: lines[lines.length - 1].length + 1 };
    },
    setDiagnostics: () => {},
    setHighlightedLines: (lines) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(lines) || !lines.length) return;
      const sourceLines = textarea.value.split('\n');
      const targetLine = Math.max(1, Math.min(lines[0], sourceLines.length));
      const lineStart = sourceLines.slice(0, targetLine - 1).join('\n').length
        + (targetLine > 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const lineEnd = lineStart + sourceLines[targetLine - 1].length;
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(lineStart, lineEnd);
    },
    setChangeView: () => {},
    setRunHandler: (handler) => { runHandler = handler; },
    setSaveHandler: (handler) => { saveHandler = handler; },
    onChange: (handler) => { changeHandler = handler; },
    onPosition: (handler) => { positionHandler = handler; },
    onPaste: (handler, transform) => { pasteHandler = handler; transformPaste = transform; },
    replaceIfUnchanged: (snapshot, value) => {
      if (textarea.value !== snapshot || document.activeElement !== textarea) return false;
      textarea.select();
      if (!document.execCommand('insertText', false, value)) {
        textarea.setRangeText(value, 0, textarea.value.length, 'end');
        changeHandler?.();
      }
      return true;
    },
    revealLine: (line) => {
      const lineStart = textarea.value.split('\n').slice(0, Math.max(0, line - 1)).join('\n').length;
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(lineStart, lineStart);
    },
    focus: () => textarea.focus(),
    setReadOnly: (readOnly) => { textarea.readOnly = !!readOnly; },
    revealEnd: () => { textarea.scrollTop = textarea.scrollHeight; },
    dispose: () => textarea.remove(),
  };
}

export async function attachCodeBuilderEditor(
  element,
  initialValue = "print('Hello from Novous CodeBuilder!')\n",
  language = 'python',
  ariaLabel = 'Python code editor'
) {
  if (!element) {
    throw new Error('The CodeBuilder editor container was not found.');
  }

  try {
    const monaco = await loadMonaco();
    const editor = monaco.editor.create(element, {
      value: initialValue,
      language,
      theme: 'vs-dark',
      automaticLayout: true,
      ariaLabel,
      accessibilitySupport: 'auto',
      bracketPairColorization: { enabled: true },
      cursorBlinking: 'smooth',
      detectIndentation: false,
      folding: true,
      fontSize: 14,
      fontFamily: "'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace",
      fontLigatures: true,
      glyphMargin: true,
      formatOnPaste: true,
      guides: { bracketPairs: true, indentation: true },
      lineNumbers: 'on',
      minimap: { enabled: true, scale: 0.8 },
      padding: { top: 12, bottom: 12 },
      renderLineHighlight: 'all',
      scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
      smoothScrolling: true,
      stickyScroll: { enabled: true },
      tabSize: 4,
      insertSpaces: true,
      wordWrap: 'off',
    });
    let runHandler = null;
    let saveHandler = null;
    let changeHandler = null;
    let positionHandler = null;
    let pasteHandler = null;
    let transformPaste = null;
    const handlePaste = event => {
      if (!pasteHandler || !element.contains(event.target) || editor.getOption(monaco.editor.EditorOption.readOnly) || !event.clipboardData?.types.includes('text/plain')) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const model = editor.getModel();
      const selection = editor.getSelection();
      if (!model || !selection) return;
      const fullDocument = model.getOffsetAt(selection.getStartPosition()) === 0
        && model.getOffsetAt(selection.getEndPosition()) === model.getValueLength();
      const normalized = event.clipboardData.getData('text/plain').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
      const text = transformPaste ? transformPaste(normalized) : normalized;
      editor.pushUndoStop();
      editor.executeEdits('studio-paste', [{ range: selection, text, forceMoveMarkers: true }]);
      editor.pushUndoStop();
      pasteHandler({ fullDocument, snapshot: editor.getValue(), formatted: text !== normalized });
    };
    window.addEventListener('paste', handlePaste, true);
    editor.onDidChangeModelContent(() => changeHandler?.());
    editor.onDidChangeCursorPosition(() => positionHandler?.());
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'codebuilder.runPython',
      label: 'Run Python',
      keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.Enter],
      run: () => runHandler?.(),
    });
    let saveAction = null;
    let highlightDecorations = [];

    return {
      getValue: () => editor.getValue(),
      setValue: (value) => { editor.setValue(value); },
      setLanguage: (nextLanguage) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (model) monaco.editor.setModelLanguage(model, nextLanguage);
      },
      getPosition: () => editor.getPosition(),
      focus: () => editor.focus(),
      setRunHandler: (handler) => { runHandler = handler; },
      setSaveHandler: (handler) => {
        saveAction?.dispose();
        saveHandler = handler;
        if (handler) {
          saveAction = editor.addAction({
            id: 'codebuilder.save',
            label: 'Save',
            keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.KeyS],
            run: () => saveHandler?.(),
          });
        }
      },
      onChange: (handler) => { changeHandler = handler; },
      onPosition: (handler) => { positionHandler = handler; },
      onPaste: (handler, transform) => { pasteHandler = handler; transformPaste = transform; },
      replaceIfUnchanged: (snapshot, value) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (!model || editor.getValue() !== snapshot) return false;
        editor.pushUndoStop();
        editor.executeEdits('studio-format-paste', [{ range: model.getFullModelRange(), text: value }]);
        editor.pushUndoStop();
        return true;
      },
      revealLine: (line) => {
        editor.revealLineInCenter(line);
        editor.setPosition({ lineNumber: line, column: 1 });
        editor.focus();
      },
      setDiagnostics: (items) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (!model) return;
        monaco.editor.setModelMarkers(model, 'codebuilder', items.map(item => ({
          severity: item.severity === 'warning'
            ? monaco.MarkerSeverity.Warning
            : item.severity === 'info'
              ? monaco.MarkerSeverity.Info
              : monaco.MarkerSeverity.Error,
          message: item.message,
          startLineNumber: item.line || 1,
          endLineNumber: item.line || 1,
          startColumn: item.column || 1,
          endColumn: (item.column || 1) + 1,
        })));
      },
      setHighlightedLines: (lines, kind = 'preview') => {
        const applied = kind === 'applied';
        const error = kind === 'error';
        highlightDecorations = editor.deltaDecorations(
          highlightDecorations,
          (Array.isArray(lines) ? lines : [])
            .filter(line => Number.isInteger(line) && line > 0)
            .map(line => ({
              range: new monaco.Range(line, 1, line, 1),
              options: {
                isWholeLine: true,
                className: applied
                  ? 'code-change-applied-line'
                  : error
                    ? 'code-change-error-line'
                    : 'code-change-preview-line',
                glyphMarginClassName: applied
                  ? 'code-change-applied-glyph'
                  : error
                    ? 'code-change-error-glyph'
                    : 'code-change-preview-glyph',
                overviewRuler: {
                  color: applied ? '#22c55e' : error ? '#ef4444' : '#facc15',
                  position: monaco.editor.OverviewRulerLane.Right
                }
              }
            }))
        );
        if (lines?.length) editor.revealLineInCenter(lines[0]);
      },
      setChangeView: (lines, compact = true) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (typeof editor.setHiddenAreas !== 'function' || !model) return;
        if (!compact || !Array.isArray(lines) || !lines.length) {
          editor.setHiddenAreas([]);
          return;
        }
        const visible = new Set();
        lines.forEach(line => {
          for (let current = Math.max(1, line - 2); current <= line + 2; current += 1) {
            if (current <= model.getLineCount()) visible.add(current);
          }
        });
        const hidden = [];
        let start = null;
        for (let line = 1; line <= model.getLineCount() + 1; line += 1) {
          if (line <= model.getLineCount() && !visible.has(line)) {
            if (start === null) start = line;
          } else if (start !== null) {
            hidden.push(new monaco.Range(start, 1, line - 1, 1));
            start = null;
          }
        }
        editor.setHiddenAreas(hidden);
      },
      setReadOnly: (readOnly) => editor.updateOptions({ readOnly: !!readOnly }),
      revealEnd: () => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (model) editor.revealLine(model.getLineCount());
      },
      dispose: () => { window.removeEventListener('paste', handlePaste, true); editor.dispose(); },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Monaco Editor could not be loaded; using the basic editor instead.', error);
    return createTextareaEditor(element, initialValue, ariaLabel);
  }
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/codebuilder/files_ui.js`
```javascript
import { dialog } from '../sandbox_ui.js';
import { renderTree } from '../tree.js';
import { Api } from '../api.js';

async function call(method, url, body) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(typeof payload.detail === 'string' ? payload.detail : `Request failed (${response.status}).`);
  }
  return payload;
}

const Files = {
  list: () => call('GET', '/api/codebuilder/files'),
  read: path => call('GET', `/api/codebuilder/files/read?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`),
  save: (folder, name, content, overwrite) =>
    call('POST', '/api/codebuilder/files/save', { folder, name, content, overwrite }),
  runCommand: (path, content) => call('POST', '/api/codebuilder/files/run-command', { path, content })
};

function button(label, className = 'btn') {
  const el = document.createElement('button');
  el.type = 'button';
  el.className = className;
  el.textContent = label;
  return el;
}

// Save, Save As, Open and Run-in-terminal for the editor. `openTerminalWith(command)` prefills the terminal.
export function setupFileControls({ editor, status, label, buttons, openTerminalWith }) {
  let currentPath = '';
  let managedPath = ''; // set when the open file came from the file manager (saved through it too)
  let savedValue = editor.getValue();

  const isDirty = () => editor.getValue() !== savedValue;
  const nameOf = path => path.split(/[\\/]/).pop();

  const refreshLabel = () => {
    if (!label) return;
    label.textContent = currentPath ? `${nameOf(currentPath)}${isDirty() ? ' ●' : ''}` : (isDirty() ? 'Unsaved ●' : 'Untitled');
    label.title = currentPath || 'Not saved to a file yet';
  };

  const markSaved = (path) => {
    currentPath = path;
    savedValue = editor.getValue();
    refreshLabel();
  };

  const writeFile = async (folder, name, overwrite = false) => {
    const result = await Files.save(folder, name, editor.getValue(), overwrite);
    if (result.saved) {
      managedPath = '';
      markSaved(result.path);
      status.textContent = `Saved ${result.path}`;
      return result;
    }
    if (result.exists && confirm(`${result.name} already exists. Replace it?`)) {
      return writeFile(folder, name, true);
    }
    return null;
  };

  const saveAs = () => new Promise(resolve => {
    Files.list().then(info => {
      dialog('Save as', (modal, close) => {
        const nameInput = document.createElement('input');
        nameInput.className = 'form-input question-dialog-input';
        nameInput.placeholder = 'file name, e.g. app.py';
        nameInput.value = currentPath ? nameOf(currentPath) : '';
        nameInput.setAttribute('aria-label', 'File name');
        const folderSelect = document.createElement('select');
        folderSelect.className = 'form-select';
        folderSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Folder');
        info.folders.forEach(folder => {
          const option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = folder;
          option.textContent = folder;
          folderSelect.appendChild(option);
        });
        folderSelect.value = currentPath
          ? currentPath.slice(0, Math.max(currentPath.lastIndexOf('\\'), currentPath.lastIndexOf('/')))
          : info.default_folder;
        if (!folderSelect.value) folderSelect.value = info.default_folder;
        const error = document.createElement('p');
        error.className = 'text-danger small';
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
        const cancel = button('Cancel');
        const save = button('Save', 'btn btn-primary');
        actions.append(cancel, save);
        modal.append(nameInput, folderSelect, error, actions);
        nameInput.focus();
        cancel.addEventListener('click', () => { close(); resolve(null); });
        const submit = async () => {
          if (!nameInput.value.trim()) { error.textContent = 'Enter a file name.'; return; }
          save.disabled = true;
          try {
            const result = await writeFile(folderSelect.value, nameInput.value);
            if (result) { close(); resolve(result); }
          } catch (err) {
            error.textContent = err.message;
          }
          save.disabled = false;
        };
        save.addEventListener('click', submit);
        nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') submit(); });
      });
    }).catch(err => { status.textContent = err.message; resolve(null); });
  });

  const save = async () => {
    if (managedPath) {
      try {
        await Api.writeManagedFile(managedPath, editor.getValue());
        markSaved(managedPath);
        status.textContent = `Saved ${managedPath}`;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:fs-changed'));
        return { saved: true, path: managedPath };
      } catch (err) {
        status.textContent = `Save failed: ${err.message}`;
        return null;
      }
    }
    if (!currentPath) return saveAs();
    const folder = currentPath.slice(0, Math.max(currentPath.lastIndexOf('\\'), currentPath.lastIndexOf('/')));
    try {
      return await writeFile(folder, nameOf(currentPath), true);
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = `Save failed: ${err.message}`;
      return null;
    }
  };

  const open = async () => {
    if (isDirty() && !confirm('Discard unsaved changes in the editor?')) return;
    dialog('Open from file manager', (modal, close) => {
      modal.classList.add('is-resizable');
      const treeHost = document.createElement('div');
      treeHost.className = 'codebuilder-open-tree';
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
      const cancel = button('Cancel');
      cancel.addEventListener('click', close);
      actions.appendChild(cancel);
      modal.append(treeHost, actions);

      renderTree(treeHost, {
        manageRoots: true,
        onSelect: async (path, type) => {
          if (type !== 'file') return;
          try {
            const opened = await Api.readManagedFile(path);
            editor.setValue(opened.content);
            managedPath = opened.path;
            markSaved(opened.path);
            status.textContent = `Opened ${opened.path}`;
            close();
          } catch (err) {
            status.textContent = `Could not open ${path}: ${err.message}`;
          }
        }
      });
    });
  };

  const loadManagedPath = async (path, expectedEditorValue = null) => {
    if (isDirty() && editor.getValue() !== expectedEditorValue) {
      status.textContent = 'Save or discard your unsaved editor changes before viewing an orchestration file.';
      return false;
    }
    const opened = await Api.readManagedFile(path);
    editor.setValue(opened.content);
    managedPath = opened.path;
    currentPath = '';
    markSaved(opened.path);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:fs-changed'));
    return true;
  };

  const runInTerminal = async () => {
    const saved = await save();
    if (!saved && !currentPath) return;
    try {
      const { command } = await Files.runCommand(currentPath, editor.getValue());
      openTerminalWith?.(command);
      status.textContent = 'Press Enter in the terminal to run';
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = err.message;
    }
  };

  buttons.save?.addEventListener('click', save);
  buttons.saveAs?.addEventListener('click', saveAs);
  buttons.open?.addEventListener('click', open);
  buttons.runTerminal?.addEventListener('click', runInTerminal);
  editor.setSaveHandler?.(save);
  refreshLabel();

  return {
    refreshLabel,
    save,
    saveAs,
    open,
    loadManagedPath,
    isDirty,
    getCurrentPath: () => managedPath || currentPath,
  };
}
```
