## `frontend/static/js/squads/agents_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Agents section: agents grouped by squad with expandable prompt viewers.
 * Each squad gets a distinct accent color; unassigned agents sit at the bottom.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate, openInEditor } from '../shell.js';
import { renderAgentLibrary } from '../views/agent_library.js';
import { openSquadMap } from './squad_map.js';
import { toolOptionGroups } from '../tool_categories.js';

let kindFilter = 'all';
let search = '';

const SQUAD_COLORS = [
  '#3b82f6', '#8b5cf6', '#06b6d4', '#f59e0b', '#10b981',
  '#ec4899', '#f97316', '#6366f1', '#14b8a6', '#e11d48',
];

export function renderAgentsView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <details class="card">
        <summary>Agent library across environments</summary>
        <section class="ov-agents" data-role="agent-library" aria-label="Agent library"></section>
      </details>
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Agents</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Agents grouped by squad. Expand any agent to see its prompt.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">+ New agent</button>
      </header>
      <form class="card sq-create-card hidden" data-role="create">
        <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Agent kind">
          <label><input type="radio" name="kind" value="agent" checked> Primary agent <span class="text-muted small">library/*.md</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="kind" value="subagent"> Sub-agent <span class="text-muted small">subAgentLibrary/*.yaml</span></label>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row mt-2">
          <input class="form-input" name="agent_id" placeholder="id (e.g. reviewer)" maxlength="64" required>
          <input class="form-input" name="name" placeholder="Display name" maxlength="100">
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <input class="form-input" name="description" placeholder="What it does" maxlength="500">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create</button>
        </div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="create-error" role="alert"></p>
      </form>
      <div class="sq-toolbar">
        <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Filter by kind">
          ${['all', 'agent', 'subagent'].map(kind => `
            <label><input type="radio" name="filter" value="${kind}" ${kindFilter === kind ? 'checked' : ''}>
              ${kind === 'all' ? 'All' : kind === 'agent' ? 'Primary' : 'Sub-agents'}</label>`).join('')}
        </div>
        <input class="form-input sq-search" type="search" placeholder="Search agents or tools" value="${esc(search)}" aria-label="Search agents">
      </div>
      <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
      <div class="sq-agent-groups" data-role="grid"><p class="text-muted small">Loading agents…</p></div>
    </div>`;

  renderAgentLibrary(container.querySelector('[data-role="agent-library"]'));
  const grid = container.querySelector('[data-role="grid"]');
  const errorBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
  const createForm = container.querySelector('[data-role="create"]');
  let overview = { agents: [], squads: [], tools: [] };
  const promptCache = {};

  function squadsUsing(agentId) {
    return overview.squads.filter(squad =>
      squad.primary_agent === agentId || squad.subagents.includes(agentId));
  }

  function buildGroups() {
    const term = search.toLowerCase();
    const shown = overview.agents.filter(agent =>
      (kindFilter === 'all' || agent.kind === kindFilter) &&
      (!term || [agent.id, agent.name, agent.description, ...agent.tools].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(term)));

    const squadMap = new Map();
    const unassigned = [];
    for (const agent of shown) {
      const agentSquads = squadsUsing(agent.id);
      if (agentSquads.length) {
        for (const squad of agentSquads) {
          if (!squadMap.has(squad.squad_id)) squadMap.set(squad.squad_id, { squad, agents: [] });
          squadMap.get(squad.squad_id).agents.push(agent);
        }
      } else {
        unassigned.push(agent);
      }
    }
    return { squadGroups: [...squadMap.values()], unassigned };
  }

  function agentCardHtml(agent, color) {
    const available = overview.tools.filter(tool => !agent.tools.includes(tool.name));
    const isLead = overview.squads.some(s => s.primary_agent === agent.id);
    return `
      <article class="card sq-agent-card" data-agent="${esc(agent.id)}" style="border-left: 3px solid ${color}">
        <div class="sq-inspector-head">
          <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
          ${isLead ? '<span class="badge badge-accent">lead</span>' : ''}
          <span class="badge ${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'primary' : 'sub-agent'}</span>
          <span class="badge">${esc(agent.mode)}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || 'No description.')}</p>
        <div class="sq-chip-row">
          ${agent.tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
            <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-detach="${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
            || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
        </div>
        <select class="form-select" data-attach aria-label="Attach a tool to ${esc(agent.name)}">
          <option value="">+ Attach tool…</option>
          ${toolOptionGroups(available)}
        </select>
        <details class="sq-prompt-viewer" data-prompt-for="${esc(agent.id)}">
          <summary class="sq-prompt-toggle">View prompt</summary>
          <div class="sq-prompt-content"><p class="text-muted small">Loading…</p></div>
        </details>
        <div class="sq-inspector-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="edit">Edit prompt</button>
          ${agent.kind === 'agent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="chat">Chat</button>' : ''}
          ${agent.kind === 'subagent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-act="delete">Delete</button>' : ''}
        </div>
      </article>`;
  }

  function render() {
    const { squadGroups, unassigned } = buildGroups();
    const colorMap = new Map();
    overview.squads.forEach((s, i) => colorMap.set(s.squad_id, SQUAD_COLORS[i % SQUAD_COLORS.length]));

    let html = '';
    for (const { squad, agents } of squadGroups) {
      const color = colorMap.get(squad.squad_id);
      html += `
        <details class="sq-squad-group" open>
          <summary class="sq-squad-group-header" style="border-left: 4px solid ${color}">
            <span class="sq-squad-color-dot" style="background: ${color}"></span>
            <strong>${esc(squad.name)}</strong>
            <span class="badge">${agents.length} agent${agents.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
            <span class="badge">${esc(squad.default_pattern)}</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm sq-squad-link" data-open-squad="${esc(squad.squad_id)}">Open squad</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-map-squad="${esc(squad.squad_id)}" data-map-color="${color}">Map prompts</button>
          </summary>
          <div class="sq-agent-grid">
            ${agents.map(a => agentCardHtml(a, color)).join('')}
          </div>
        </details>`;
    }
    if (unassigned.length) {
      html += `
        <details class="sq-squad-group" open>
          <summary class="sq-squad-group-header sq-squad-group-unassigned">
            <strong>Unassigned</strong>
            <span class="badge">${unassigned.length} agent${unassigned.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
          </summary>
          <div class="sq-agent-grid">
            ${unassigned.map(a => agentCardHtml(a, 'var(--border-color)')).join('')}
          </div>
        </details>`;
    }
    grid.innerHTML = html || '<p class="text-muted">No agents match.</p>';
  }

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    render();
  }

  function showError(message) {
    errorBox.textContent = message;
    errorBox.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  async function updateAgent(request) {
    showError('');
    try {
      const updated = await request;
      const index = overview.agents.findIndex(agent => agent.id === updated.id);
      if (index >= 0) overview.agents[index] = updated;
      render();
    } catch (err) {
      showError(err.message);
    }
  }

  async function loadPrompt(agentId, contentEl) {
    if (promptCache[agentId]) {
      contentEl.innerHTML = `<pre class="sq-pre">${esc(promptCache[agentId])}</pre>`;
      return;
    }
    try {
      const { prompt } = await Api.getAgentPrompt(agentId);
      promptCache[agentId] = prompt;
      contentEl.innerHTML = `<pre class="sq-pre">${esc(prompt)}</pre>`;
    } catch (err) {
      contentEl.innerHTML = `<p class="text-muted small">Could not load prompt: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
    }
  }

  container.addEventListener('toggle', event => {
    const viewer = event.target.closest('[data-prompt-for]');
    if (!viewer || !viewer.open) return;
    const contentEl = viewer.querySelector('.sq-prompt-content');
    if (contentEl.querySelector('.sq-pre')) return;
    loadPrompt(viewer.dataset.promptFor, contentEl);
  }, true);

  container.addEventListener('change', event => {
    if (event.target.name === 'filter') { kindFilter = event.target.value; render(); }
    const card = event.target.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (card && event.target.hasAttribute('data-attach') && event.target.value) {
      updateAgent(Api.attachAgentTool(card.dataset.agent, event.target.value));
    }
  });
  container.querySelector('.sq-search').addEventListener('input', event => {
    search = event.target.value;
    render();
  });

  container.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    if (button.dataset.act === 'toggle-create') { createForm.classList.toggle('hidden'); return; }
    if (button.dataset.openSquad) { navigate('squads', { squadId: button.dataset.openSquad }); return; }
    if (button.dataset.mapSquad) {
      openSquadMap(button.dataset.mapSquad, button.dataset.mapColor, overview);
      return;
    }
    const card = button.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (!card) return;
    const agent = overview.agents.find(a => a.id === card.dataset.agent);
    if (button.dataset.detach) updateAgent(Api.detachAgentTool(agent.id, button.dataset.detach));
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'edit') openInEditor(agent.path);
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'chat') navigate('chat', agent.id);
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'delete') {
      if (!confirm(`Delete sub-agent "${agent.id}"? Its YAML file will be removed.`)) return;
      try {
        await Api.deleteSubagent(agent.id);
        await load();
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
      }
    }
  });

  createForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(createForm);
    const createError = createForm.querySelector('[data-role="create-error"]');
    createError.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      const id = String(data.get('agent_id')).trim();
      await Api.createSquadMember(data.get('kind'), id, String(data.get('name')).trim() || id, String(data.get('description')).trim());
      createForm.reset();
      createForm.classList.add('hidden');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      createError.textContent = err.message;
      createError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  });

  load().catch(err => {
    grid.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger">Could not load agents: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/architect_canvas.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squad Architect canvas: draws one lead and ordered sub-agent handoffs as inline SVG.
 */
import { esc } from '../shell.js';

const NODE_W = 156;
const NODE_H = 58;
const GAP = 28;
const LEAD_Y = 24;
const MEMBER_Y = 210;

function clip(text, max) {
  const value = String(text || '');
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : value;
}

function nodeSvg(node, x, y, { role, selected }) {
  const tools = node.tools?.length || 0;
  const subtitle = role === 'lead'
    ? `lead · ${tools} tool${tools === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
    : `${node.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'} · ${tools} tool${tools === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  return `
    <g class="sq-node sq-node-${role === 'lead' ? 'lead' : node.kind}${selected ? ' is-selected' : ''}"
       data-node-id="${esc(node.id)}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${esc(node.name || node.id)} (${esc(subtitle)})">
      <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${NODE_W}" height="${NODE_H}" rx="10"></rect>
      <text class="sq-node-title" x="${x + 12}" y="${y + 24}">${esc(clip(node.name || node.id, 19))}</text>
      <text class="sq-node-sub" x="${x + 12}" y="${y + 43}">${esc(subtitle)}</text>
    </g>`;
}

function edge(x1, y1, x2, y2, cls = '') {
  const midY = (y1 + y2) / 2;
  return `<path class="sq-edge ${cls}" d="M${x1},${y1} C${x1},${midY} ${x2},${midY} ${x2},${y2}" marker-end="url(#sq-arrow)"></path>`;
}

export function renderArchitectCanvas(host, blueprint, { selectedId = null, onSelect = () => {} } = {}) {
  const members = (blueprint.members || []).filter(Boolean);
  const count = Math.max(members.length, 1);
  const width = Math.max(560, count * NODE_W + (count + 1) * GAP);
  const height = MEMBER_Y + NODE_H + 70;
  const leadX = (width - NODE_W) / 2;
  const leadBottom = LEAD_Y + NODE_H;
  const leadCenter = width / 2;
  const startX = (width - (members.length * NODE_W + (members.length - 1) * GAP)) / 2;
  const memberX = index => startX + index * (NODE_W + GAP);

  const edges = [];
  const extras = [];
  if (members.length) {
    if (blueprint.lead) {
      edges.push(edge(leadCenter - 30, leadBottom, memberX(0) + NODE_W / 2, MEMBER_Y));
    }
    members.forEach((_, i) => {
      if (i === members.length - 1) return;
      const y = MEMBER_Y + NODE_H / 2;
      edges.push(`<path class="sq-edge" d="M${memberX(i) + NODE_W},${y} L${memberX(i + 1)},${y}" marker-end="url(#sq-arrow)"></path>`);
    });
    if (blueprint.lead) {
      const last = memberX(members.length - 1) + NODE_W / 2;
      edges.push(edge(last, MEMBER_Y, leadCenter + 30, leadBottom, 'sq-edge-return'));
    }
    members.forEach((_, i) => {
      extras.push(`<text class="sq-step" x="${memberX(i) + NODE_W - 16}" y="${MEMBER_Y - 8}">${i + 1}</text>`);
    });
  }

  host.innerHTML = `
    <svg class="sq-canvas" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="group" aria-label="Squad structure">
      <defs>
        <marker id="sq-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" class="sq-arrow-head"></path>
        </marker>
      </defs>
      ${edges.join('')}
      ${extras.join('')}
      ${blueprint.lead ? nodeSvg(blueprint.lead, leadX, LEAD_Y, { role: 'lead', selected: selectedId === blueprint.lead.id }) : ''}
      ${members.map((m, i) => nodeSvg(m, memberX(i), MEMBER_Y, { role: 'member', selected: selectedId === m.id })).join('')}
      ${members.length ? '' : `<text class="sq-empty" x="${leadCenter}" y="${MEMBER_Y + 30}">${blueprint.lead ? 'No members yet — the lead works alone.' : 'Add members to build a workflow.'}</text>`}
    </svg>`;

  const select = target => {
    const node = target.closest('[data-node-id]');
    if (node) onSelect(node.dataset.nodeId);
  };
  host.querySelector('svg').addEventListener('click', event => select(event.target));
  host.querySelector('svg').addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
      event.preventDefault();
      select(event.target);
    }
  });
}

```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/builder_steps.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Step-by-step squad builder: Basics → Lead → Members → Tools → Review & save.
 * Works on a local draft and only writes through the Squad Architect API on save.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate } from '../shell.js';
import { renderArchitectCanvas } from './architect_canvas.js';
import { toolOptionGroups } from '../tool_categories.js';

const STEPS = ['Basics', 'Lead agent', 'Members', 'Tools', 'Review'];
const LEAD_HANDOFF = 'read_squad_scratchpad';
const MEMBER_HANDOFF = 'write_squad_scratchpad';

function sameList(a = [], b = []) {
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((value, i) => value === b[i]);
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} host
 * @param {{overview: object, initial?: object|null, onSaved: Function, onCancel: Function}} options
 */
export function renderBuilder(host, { overview, initial = null, onSaved, onCancel }) {
  let agents = overview.agents || [];
  const toolCatalog = overview.tools || [];
  const byId = () => Object.fromEntries(agents.map(agent => [agent.id, agent]));

  const draft = {
    squad_id: initial?.squad_id || null,
    name: initial?.name || '',
    description: initial?.description || '',
    pattern: 'sequential',
    lead: initial?.lead?.id || '',
    members: (initial?.members || []).filter(member => member?.kind === 'subagent').map(member => member.id),
    tools: {}
  };
  let step = 0;
  let validation = null;

  const toolsFor = id => draft.tools[id] ?? [...(byId()[id]?.tools || [])];
  const nodeFor = id => ({ ...byId()[id], tools: toolsFor(id) });

  function payload() {
    const spec = id => {
      const changed = draft.tools[id] && !sameList(draft.tools[id], byId()[id]?.tools || []);
      return changed ? { agent_id: id, tools: draft.tools[id] } : { agent_id: id };
    };
    return {
      squad_id: draft.squad_id,
      name: draft.name.trim(),
      description: draft.description.trim(),
      pattern: draft.pattern,
      lead: draft.lead ? spec(draft.lead) : null,
      members: draft.members.map(spec)
    };
  }

  function canAdvance() {
    if (step === 0) return draft.name.trim().length > 0;
    if (step === 1) return true;
    return true;
  }

  function render() {
    host.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sq-builder card">
        <div class="card-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${draft.squad_id ? `Edit squad · ${esc(draft.name)}` : 'New squad'}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">Choose an optional lead and an ordered set of sub-agents. Each step runs once at a time and passes its result forward.</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="cancel">Close</button>
        </div>
        <ol class="sq-stepper">
          ${STEPS.map((label, i) => `
            <li class="${i === step ? 'is-current' : i < step ? 'is-done' : ''}">
              <button type="button" data-step="${i}" ${i > step && !canAdvance() ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                <span class="sq-step-num">${i + 1}</span>${esc(label)}
              </button>
            </li>`).join('')}
        </ol>
        <div class="sq-step-body">${stepBody()}</div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="sq-builder-nav">
          <button type="button" class="btn" data-act="back" ${step === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>Back</button>
          <span class="spacer"></span>
          ${step < STEPS.length - 1
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="next" ${canAdvance() ? '' : 'disabled'}>Next: ${esc(STEPS[step + 1])}</button>`
            : `<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="save" ${validation?.ok ? '' : 'disabled'}>Save squad</button>`}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    if (step === 4) afterReviewRender();
  }

  function stepBody() {
    if (step === 0) {
      return `
        <label class="sq-field"><span>Squad name</span>
          <input class="form-input" data-field="name" maxlength="80" value="${esc(draft.name)}" placeholder="e.g. Research Squad"></label>
        <label class="sq-field"><span>What does this squad do?</span>
          <input class="form-input" data-field="description" maxlength="500" value="${esc(draft.description)}"></label>
        <p class="sq-field text-muted small">The workflow is always sequential to keep local model use predictable. You control the exact run order in the Members step.</p>`;
    }
    if (step === 1) {
      const primaries = agents.filter(agent => agent.kind === 'agent');
      return `
        <p class="text-muted small">The lead produces the final answer after sub-agents complete.
          <strong>Optional:</strong> skip if the last member already produces the final output.</p>
        <div class="sq-choice-grid">
          <label class="sq-choice ${!draft.lead ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
            <input type="radio" name="lead" value="" ${!draft.lead ? 'checked' : ''}>
            <strong>No lead</strong>
            <span class="text-muted small">The last member's output becomes the final answer (no synthesis step).</span>
          </label>
          ${primaries.map(agent => `
            <label class="sq-choice ${draft.lead === agent.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
              <input type="radio" name="lead" value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${draft.lead === agent.id ? 'checked' : ''}>
              <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
              <span class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || agent.id)}</span>
              <span class="sq-chip-row">${(agent.tools || []).slice(0, 4).map(t => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(t)}</span>`).join('')}</span>
            </label>`).join('')}
        </div>
        ${createMemberForm('agent', true)}`;
    }
    if (step === 2) {
      const candidates = agents.filter(agent => (!draft.lead || agent.id !== draft.lead) && agent.kind === 'subagent');
      const group = `
        <h4 class="sq-group-title">Sub-agents <span class="text-muted small">run one at a time and hand their result to the next step</span></h4>
        <div class="sq-choice-grid">
          ${candidates.map(agent => `
            <label class="sq-choice ${draft.members.includes(agent.id) ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
              <input type="checkbox" name="member" value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${draft.members.includes(agent.id) ? 'checked' : ''}>
              <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
              <span class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || agent.id)}</span>
            </label>`).join('') || '<p class="text-muted small">None available.</p>'}
        </div>`;
      return `
        <div class="sq-two-col">
          <div>
            ${group}
            ${createMemberForm('subagent')}
          </div>
          <aside class="sq-order card">
            <h4>Run order</h4>
            ${draft.members.length ? `<ol class="sq-order-list">
              ${draft.members.map((id, i) => `
                <li><span>${esc(byId()[id]?.name || id)}</span>
                  <span class="sq-order-actions">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-move="${i}:-1" ${i === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="Move up">↑</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-move="${i}:1" ${i === draft.members.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="Move down">↓</button>
                  </span></li>`).join('')}
            </ol>` : '<p class="text-muted small">Pick members on the left.</p>'}
            <p class="text-muted small">Each step receives the task and the previous step's result—not the entire conversation.</p>
          </aside>
        </div>`;
    }
    if (step === 3) {
      const ids = [draft.lead, ...draft.members].filter(Boolean);
      return `
        <p class="text-muted small">Tools decide what each agent can do. Assigning tools switches a chat-mode agent to agent mode.
          Squad runs control the order and withhold direct sub-agent delegation.
          Need something new? <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="build-tool">Build a tool in the workbench</button></p>
        <div class="sq-tool-table">
          ${ids.map((id, index) => toolRow(id, index === 0)).join('')}
        </div>`;
    }
    return `
      <div class="sq-review">
        <div class="sq-canvas-host" data-role="preview"></div>
        <div class="sq-validation" data-role="validation"><p class="text-muted small">Checking blueprint…</p></div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function toolRow(id, isLead) {
    const tools = toolsFor(id);
    const agent = byId()[id] || { id, name: id, kind: 'agent' };
    const handoff = isLead ? LEAD_HANDOFF : agent.kind === 'subagent' ? MEMBER_HANDOFF : null;
    const missingHandoff = handoff && !tools.includes(handoff);
    const available = toolCatalog.filter(tool => !tools.includes(tool.name));
    return `
      <div class="sq-tool-row">
        <div class="sq-tool-owner">
          <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
          <span class="badge ${isLead ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${isLead ? 'lead' : agent.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sq-chip-row">
          ${tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
            <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-remove-tool="${esc(id)}|${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
            || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
        </div>
        <div class="sq-tool-add">
          <select class="form-select" data-add-tool="${esc(id)}" aria-label="Add a tool to ${esc(agent.name)}">
            <option value="">+ Add tool…</option>
            ${toolOptionGroups(available)}
          </select>
          ${missingHandoff ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-quick-tool="${esc(id)}|${handoff}">Add ${handoff}</button>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function createMemberForm(defaultKind, allowPrimary = false) {
    return `
      <details class="sq-create">
        <summary>Create a new ${allowPrimary ? 'lead agent or sub-agent' : 'sub-agent'}</summary>
        <div class="form-row mt-2">
          <select class="form-select" data-new="kind" aria-label="Kind">
            <option value="subagent" ${defaultKind === 'subagent' ? 'selected' : ''}>Sub-agent (subAgentLibrary/*.yaml)</option>
            ${allowPrimary ? `<option value="agent" ${defaultKind === 'agent' ? 'selected' : ''}>Primary agent (library/*.md)</option>` : ''}
          </select>
          <input class="form-input" data-new="id" placeholder="id (e.g. summarizer)" maxlength="64">
          <input class="form-input" data-new="name" placeholder="Display name" maxlength="100">
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <input class="form-input" data-new="description" placeholder="What it does" maxlength="500">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="create-member">Create</button>
        </div>
      </details>`;
  }

  async function afterReviewRender() {
    const preview = host.querySelector('[data-role="preview"]');
    renderArchitectCanvas(preview, {
      pattern: draft.pattern,
      lead: draft.lead ? nodeFor(draft.lead) : null,
      members: draft.members.map(nodeFor)
    });
    const box = host.querySelector('[data-role="validation"]');
    try {
      validation = await Api.validateSquadBlueprint(payload());
    } catch (err) {
      validation = { ok: false, errors: [err.message], warnings: [] };
    }
    box.innerHTML = `
      <h4>${validation.ok ? '✓ Ready to save' : 'Fix before saving'}</h4>
      ${validation.errors.map(e => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(e)}</p>`).join('')}
      ${validation.warnings.map(w => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-warn">${esc(w)}</p>`).join('')}
      ${!validation.errors.length && !validation.warnings.length ? '<p class="text-muted small">No issues found.</p>' : ''}
      <p class="text-muted small">Saving registers the squad and writes tool changes into the agents' definition files.</p>`;
    const save = host.querySelector('[data-act="save"]');
    if (save) save.disabled = !validation.ok;
  }

  function showError(message) {
    const box = host.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
    box.textContent = message;
    box.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  function setTools(id, tools) {
    draft.tools[id] = tools;
    validation = null;
    render();
  }

  host.addEventListener('input', event => {
    const field = event.target.dataset.field;
    if (!field) return;
    draft[field] = event.target.value;
    const next = host.querySelector('[data-act="next"]');
    if (next) next.disabled = !canAdvance();
  });

  host.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.name === 'lead') {
      draft.lead = target.value;
      if (draft.lead) draft.members = draft.members.filter(id => id !== draft.lead);
      render();
    } else if (target.name === 'member') {
      draft.members = target.checked
        ? [...draft.members, target.value]
        : draft.members.filter(id => id !== target.value);
      render();
    } else if (target.dataset.addTool && target.value) {
      setTools(target.dataset.addTool, [...toolsFor(target.dataset.addTool), target.value]);
    }
  });

  host.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    showError('');
    if (button.dataset.step !== undefined) { step = Number(button.dataset.step); render(); return; }
    if (button.dataset.move) {
      const [index, delta] = button.dataset.move.split(':').map(Number);
      const list = [...draft.members];
      [list[index], list[index + delta]] = [list[index + delta], list[index]];
      draft.members = list;
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (button.dataset.removeTool) {
      const [id, tool] = button.dataset.removeTool.split('|');
      setTools(id, toolsFor(id).filter(name => name !== tool));
      return;
    }
    if (button.dataset.quickTool) {
      const [id, tool] = button.dataset.quickTool.split('|');
      setTools(id, [...toolsFor(id), tool]);
      return;
    }
    const act = button.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'cancel') onCancel();
    else if (act === 'back') { step -= 1; render(); }
    else if (act === 'next' && canAdvance()) { step += 1; render(); }
    else if (act === 'build-tool') navigate('tools');
    else if (act === 'create-member') {
      const form = button.closest('.sq-create');
      const value = key => form.querySelector(`[data-new="${key}"]`).value.trim();
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        const created = await Api.createSquadMember(value('kind'), value('id'), value('name') || value('id'), value('description'));
        agents = (await Api.getSquadsOverview()).agents || agents;
        if (step === 1 && created.kind === 'agent') draft.lead = created.id;
        else if (created.kind === 'subagent' && created.id !== draft.lead && !draft.members.includes(created.id)) {
          draft.members.push(created.id);
        }
        render();
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    } else if (act === 'save') {
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        const saved = await Api.saveSquadBlueprint(payload());
        onSaved(saved.blueprint, saved.warnings || []);
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  });

  render();
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/run_client.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squad run client: starts an ordered orchestration run and follows its SSE telemetry stream.
 * Shared by the Runs section and anything else that launches a squad.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';

export const PATTERN_INFO = {
  sequential: {
    label: 'Ordered workflow',
    summary: 'Sub-agents run one at a time; each receives the previous handoff. If a lead is assigned, it synthesizes the final answer.'
  }
};

/**
 * Start a run and stream its events. Resolves once the run is accepted.
 * @returns {Promise<{traceId: string, squadId: string, close: () => void}>}
 */
export async function startSquadRun({
  squadId, query, pattern = null, parameters = {}, onEvent = () => {}, onComplete = () => {}, onClosed = () => {}
}) {
  const started = await Api.startOrchestrationRun(squadId, query, 'all', parameters, pattern);
  const source = new EventSource(`/api/orchestration/stream/${encodeURIComponent(started.trace_id)}`);
  const seen = new Set();
  let finished = false;
  source.addEventListener('telemetry', message => {
    const event = JSON.parse(message.data);
    if (seen.has(event.sequence)) return;
    seen.add(event.sequence);
    onEvent(event);
    if (event.event_type === 'RUN_COMPLETE') {
      finished = true;
      source.close();
      onComplete(started.trace_id, event.data || {});
    }
  });
  source.addEventListener('error', () => {
    if (source.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED && !finished) onClosed();
  });
  return { traceId: started.trace_id, squadId: started.squad_id, close: () => source.close() };
}

/** One readable line per telemetry event; prompts and tool arguments are never in the stream. */
export function describeEvent(event) {
  const detail = event.data || {};
  const text = [
    `${event.sender} → ${event.receiver}`,
    detail.summary || '',
    detail.tool_name ? `tool=${detail.tool_name}` : '',
    detail.status ? `status=${detail.status}` : '',
    detail.duration_ms !== undefined ? `${detail.duration_ms}ms` : '',
    detail.path ? `path=${detail.path}` : '',
    detail.error || ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return {
    time: new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(),
    type: event.event_type,
    text,
    status: detail.status || ''
  };
}

/** Code-change preview carried by an event, if any (the editor can review those lines). */
export function codeChangeFromEvent(event) {
  const detail = event.data || {};
  if (!['CODE_CHANGE_PREVIEW', 'CODE_CHANGE_APPLIED'].includes(event.event_type) || !detail.path) return null;
  return {
    path: detail.path,
    changedLines: Array.isArray(detail.changed_lines) ? detail.changed_lines : [],
    fileExists: detail.file_exists !== false
  };
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/runs_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Runs section: start a squad workflow, follow the live trace and inspect handoffs.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate } from '../shell.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from '../markdown.js';
import { createAgentMeters, runHealthHtml } from '../agent_meters.js';
import { PATTERN_INFO, codeChangeFromEvent, describeEvent, startSquadRun } from './run_client.js';
import { openSquadScratchpad } from '../squad_scratchpad.js';

let activeRun = null;
const recentRuns = [];
let lastSquadId = null;
let markdownTexts = [];

function markdownSlot(text, className = '') {
  markdownTexts.push(String(text ?? ''));
  return `<div class="sq-md prompt-rich-markdown ${className}" data-md="${markdownTexts.length - 1}"></div>`;
}

export function stopRunStream() {
  activeRun?.close();
  activeRun = null;
}

function stepRows(steps = []) {
  return steps.map(step => `
    <tr class="${step.status === 'ERROR' ? 'is-error' : ''}">
      <td>${step.step_number}</td><td>${esc(step.agent_id)}</td><td>${esc(step.phase)}</td>
      <td>${esc(step.status)}</td><td>${esc(step.error_reason || step.details)}</td>
    </tr>`).join('');
}

function payloadSections(payload) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return payload == null ? '' : `<h4>Result payload</h4><pre class="sq-pre">${esc(JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2))}</pre>`;
  }
  const parts = [];
  if (payload.routing) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Routing decision</h4>
      <p>Chose <strong>${esc(payload.routing.chosen.join(', '))}</strong>${payload.routing.skipped?.length ? `, skipped ${esc(payload.routing.skipped.join(', '))}` : ''}.</p>
      ${payload.routing.reason ? `<p class="text-muted small">${esc(payload.routing.reason)}</p>` : ''}`);
  }
  const outputs = payload.fanout_results || payload.member_results;
  if (outputs && Object.keys(outputs).length) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Member outputs</h4>${Object.entries(outputs).map(([id, text]) => `
      <details class="sq-output"><summary>${esc(id)}</summary>${markdownSlot(text)}</details>`).join('')}`);
  }
  if (payload.fanout_errors && Object.keys(payload.fanout_errors).length) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Member errors</h4>${Object.entries(payload.fanout_errors).map(([id, error]) =>
      `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(id)}: ${esc(error)}</p>`).join('')}`);
  }
  const rest = payload.routing || payload.fanout_results ? payload.scratchpad_payload : payload;
  if (rest != null) parts.push(`<h4>Scratchpad payload</h4><pre class="sq-pre">${esc(JSON.stringify(rest, null, 2))}</pre>`);
  return parts.join('');
}

export function renderRunsView(container, payload = null) {
  if (payload?.squadId) lastSquadId = payload.squadId;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Runs</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Run one controlled workflow at a time and watch each handoff.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn" data-act="squad-scratchpads">Squad scratchpads</button>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-runs">
        <section class="card sq-run-form">
          <label class="sq-field"><span>Squad</span>
            <select class="form-select" data-role="squad"><option>Loading…</option></select></label>
          <p class="text-muted small" data-role="squad-summary"></p>
          <label class="sq-field"><span>Request</span>
            <textarea class="form-input" rows="5" data-role="query" placeholder="Describe the work for this squad"></textarea></label>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="run">▶ Run squad</button>
          <p class="small" data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
          <h4 class="mt-3">This session</h4>
          <ul class="sq-recent" data-role="recent"></ul>
        </section>
        <section class="card sq-trace">
          <div class="card-head">
            <h3>Live trace</h3>
            <span class="text-muted small">Prompts, tool arguments and document text are never streamed.</span>
          </div>
          <div class="agent-meters" data-role="agents"></div>
          <ol class="sq-timeline" data-role="timeline"><li class="text-muted small">Start a run to see its trace.</li></ol>
        </section>
        <section class="card sq-result" data-role="result">
          <h3>Result</h3>
          <p class="text-muted small">The final answer and every hand-off appear here when the run completes.</p>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const squadSelect = container.querySelector('[data-role="squad"]');
  const summary = container.querySelector('[data-role="squad-summary"]');
  const query = container.querySelector('[data-role="query"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  const timeline = container.querySelector('[data-role="timeline"]');
  const meters = createAgentMeters(container.querySelector('[data-role="agents"]'));
  meters.reset();
  const resultBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="result"]');
  const recent = container.querySelector('[data-role="recent"]');
  const runButton = container.querySelector('[data-act="run"]');
  container.querySelector('[data-act="squad-scratchpads"]').addEventListener('click', () => openSquadScratchpad());
  let squads = [];
  let codeChange = null;

  const currentSquad = () => squads.find(squad => squad.squad_id === squadSelect.value);

  function setStatus(text, kind = 'muted') {
    status.textContent = text;
    status.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  function syncSquad() {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    if (!squad) return;
    lastSquadId = squad.squad_id;
    syncPattern();
  }

  function syncPattern() {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    summary.textContent = squad
      ? `${squad.primary_agent} leads ${squad.subagents.join(', ') || 'no members'}. ${PATTERN_INFO.sequential.summary}`
      : '';
  }

  function renderRecent() {
    recent.innerHTML = recentRuns.map(run => `
      <li><button type="button" class="sq-link" data-trace="${esc(run.traceId)}">${esc(run.squadName)}</button>
        <span class="badge ${run.status === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : run.status === 'running' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-success'}">${esc(run.status)}</span>
        <span class="text-muted small">${esc(run.pattern)} · ${esc(run.time)}</span></li>`).join('')
      || '<li class="text-muted small">No runs yet.</li>';
  }

  function addTimelineEvent(event) {
    meters.onEvent(event);
    if (timeline.querySelector('.text-muted')) timeline.replaceChildren();
    const line = describeEvent(event);
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    item.className = `sq-event sq-event-${line.type.toLowerCase()}${line.status === 'error' ? ' is-error' : ''}`;
    item.innerHTML = `<span class="sq-event-time">${esc(line.time)}</span>
      <span class="sq-event-type">${esc(line.type.replaceAll('_', ' ').toLowerCase())}</span>
      <span class="sq-event-text">${esc(line.text)}</span>`;
    timeline.appendChild(item);
    while (timeline.children.length > 300) timeline.firstElementChild.remove();
    timeline.scrollTop = timeline.scrollHeight;
    const change = codeChangeFromEvent(event);
    if (change) codeChange = change;
  }

  async function showResult(traceId) {
    resultBox.innerHTML = '<h3>Result</h3><p class="text-muted small">Loading…</p>';
    let result;
    try {
      result = await Api.getOrchestrationRunResult(traceId);
    } catch (err) {
      resultBox.innerHTML = `<h3>Result</h3><p class="text-danger small">${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
      return;
    }
    markdownTexts = [];
    resultBox.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-head">
        <h3>Result</h3>
        <span class="badge ${result.status === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-success'}">${esc(result.status)}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="text-muted small">${esc(PATTERN_INFO[result.pattern]?.label || result.pattern)} · trace ${esc(result.trace_id)}</p>
      ${runHealthHtml(result.agent_stats)}
      <h4>Final answer</h4>
      ${markdownSlot(result.final_answer || '(No final answer returned.)', 'sq-answer')}
      ${payloadSections(result.result_payload)}
      <h4>Execution steps</h4>
      <table class="sq-steps"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Agent</th><th>Phase</th><th>Status</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${stepRows(result.execution_trace)}</tbody></table>
      <div class="sq-inspector-actions mt-2">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="squad-scratchpad">View squad scratchpad</button>
        ${result.scratchpad_snapshot && Object.keys(result.scratchpad_snapshot).length
          ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="scratchpad">View scratchpad</button>' : ''}
        ${codeChange?.fileExists && codeChange.changedLines.length
          ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="review">Review ${codeChange.changedLines.length} changed lines · ${esc(codeChange.path)}</button>` : ''}
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="open-squad">Open squad</button>
      </div>
      <pre class="sq-pre hidden" data-role="scratchpad"></pre>`;
    resultBox.dataset.squad = result.squad_id || '';
    resultBox.querySelectorAll('[data-md]').forEach(slot => {
      appendMarkdown(slot, markdownTexts[Number(slot.dataset.md)]);
    });
    resultBox.dataset.trace = traceId;
    meters.setFromStats(result.agent_stats);
  }

  resultBox.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const act = event.target.closest('button')?.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'squad-scratchpad') {
      await openSquadScratchpad(resultBox.dataset.trace);
    } else if (act === 'scratchpad') {
      const box = resultBox.querySelector('[data-role="scratchpad"]');
      try {
        box.textContent = JSON.stringify(await Api.getOrchestrationRunScratchpad(resultBox.dataset.trace), null, 2);
      } catch (err) {
        box.textContent = err.message;
      }
      box.classList.toggle('hidden');
    } else if (act === 'review') {
      navigate('editor', { path: codeChange.path, managedFile: true, previewLines: codeChange.changedLines });
    } else if (act === 'open-squad' && resultBox.dataset.squad) {
      navigate('squads', { squadId: resultBox.dataset.squad });
    }
  });

  recent.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const trace = event.target.closest('[data-trace]')?.dataset.trace;
    if (trace) showResult(trace);
  });
  squadSelect.addEventListener('change', syncSquad);

  runButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    const text = query.value.trim();
    if (!squad) return;
    if (!text) { setStatus('Enter a request first.', 'danger'); query.focus(); return; }
    stopRunStream();
    codeChange = null;
    timeline.replaceChildren();
    meters.reset();
    runButton.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Starting run…');
    const parameters = {};
    const record = {
      squadName: squad.name, pattern: 'sequential', status: 'running',
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), traceId: ''
    };
    try {
      activeRun = await startSquadRun({
        squadId: squad.squad_id,
        query: text,
        parameters,
        onEvent: addTimelineEvent,
        onComplete: async (traceId, detail) => {
          activeRun = null;
          record.status = detail.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'success';
          renderRecent();
          setStatus(`Run ${detail.status || 'complete'} in ${detail.duration_ms ?? '?'} ms`, detail.status === 'error' ? 'danger' : 'success');
          await showResult(traceId);
        },
        onClosed: () => setStatus('Trace stream closed before completion. Open the run below once it finishes.', 'warning')
      });
      record.traceId = activeRun.traceId;
      recentRuns.unshift(record);
      recentRuns.splice(20);
      renderRecent();
      setStatus(`Running · trace ${activeRun.traceId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(`Could not start run: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      runButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  renderRecent();
  Api.getOrchestrationSquads().then(data => {
    squads = data.squads || [];
    squadSelect.innerHTML = squads.map(squad =>
      `<option value="${esc(squad.squad_id)}" ${squad.squad_id === lastSquadId ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(squad.name)}</option>`).join('')
      || '<option value="">No squads yet</option>';
    runButton.disabled = !squads.length;
    syncSquad();
  }).catch(err => setStatus(`Could not load squads: ${err.message}`, 'danger'));
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/squad_map.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squad Map — side-panel graph + editable prompts with connection controls.
 *
 * Layout: [ graph sidebar | prompt col | edge strip | prompt col | … ]
 *
 * Interactions:
 *   Click a graph NODE  → highlights the matching prompt column with the
 *                         agent's color and scrolls to it.
 *   Click a graph EDGE  → opens the connection-config popout for the two
 *                         agents that edge connects.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc } from '../shell.js';
import { loadMonaco } from '../codebuilder/codebuilder_editor.js';

const HANDOFF_TOOLS = {
  call_subagent:          { label: 'Delegation',       color: '#f59e0b', desc: 'Lead can call this sub-agent' },
  read_squad_scratchpad:  { label: 'Read scratchpad',  color: '#22c55e', desc: 'Reads the squad scratchpad' },
  write_squad_scratchpad: { label: 'Write scratchpad', color: '#22c55e', desc: 'Writes results to scratchpad' },
};

const NODE_W = 140, NODE_H = 46, PAD_Y = 50;
const MIN_FONT = 11, MAX_FONT = 22, DEFAULT_FONT = 14, FONT_STEP = 1;

function clip(text, max) { const s = String(text || ''); return s.length > max ? s.slice(0, max - 1) + '…' : s; }

function dedup(lead, rawMembers) {
  const members = (rawMembers || []).filter(Boolean);
  return lead ? members.filter(m => m.id !== lead.id) : members;
}

/* ── Edge data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function buildEdges(lead, members, blueprint) {
  const allNodes = [...members, lead].filter(Boolean);
  const edges = [];
  for (const node of allNodes) {
    const isLead = node.id === lead?.id;
    for (const tool of node.tools || []) {
      const info = HANDOFF_TOOLS[tool];
      if (!info) continue;
      if (tool === 'call_subagent') {
        for (const tid of node.allowed_subagents || [])
          edges.push({ from: node.id, to: tid, tool, label: info.label, color: info.color, kind: 'delegation' });
      } else if (tool === 'write_squad_scratchpad' && !isLead && lead) {
        edges.push({ from: node.id, to: lead.id, tool, label: info.label, color: info.color, kind: 'handoff' });
      } else if (tool === 'read_squad_scratchpad' && isLead) {
        for (const m of members)
          edges.push({ from: m.id, to: node.id, tool, label: info.label, color: info.color, kind: 'handoff' });
      }
    }
  }
  const ac = 'var(--primary)';
  if (members.length) {
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length - 1; i++)
      edges.push({ from: members[i].id, to: members[i + 1].id, tool: null, label: `step ${i + 2}`, color: ac, kind: 'flow' });
    if (lead) {
      edges.push({ from: members.at(-1)?.id, to: lead.id, tool: null, label: 'synthesis', color: ac, kind: 'flow' });
    }
  }
  return edges;
}

/* ── SVG — vertical layout for the side panel ────────────────────── */

function renderGraph(lead, members, edges, squadColor) {
  const allNodes = [...members, lead].filter(Boolean);
  if (!allNodes.length) return '<p class="text-muted small">No agents.</p>';

  const svgW = 200;
  const svgH = allNodes.length * (NODE_H + PAD_Y) + 20;
  const cx = (svgW - NODE_W) / 2;

  const positions = new Map();
  allNodes.forEach((n, i) => positions.set(n.id, { x: cx + NODE_W / 2, y: 16 + i * (NODE_H + PAD_Y) + NODE_H / 2 }));

  const dash = { flow: '', delegation: '6 3', handoff: '3 3' };

  let svg = `<svg class="sq-map-canvas" viewBox="0 0 ${svgW} ${svgH}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <defs>
      <marker id="sqm-arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
        <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="var(--text-muted)"/>
      </marker>
      ${Object.values(HANDOFF_TOOLS).map(info => `
        <marker id="sqm-arr-${info.color.replace('#','')}" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="${info.color}"/>
        </marker>`).join('')}
    </defs>`;

  // Edges — each gets a wide invisible hit-area + the visible path
  const drawn = new Set();
  for (const e of edges) {
    const from = positions.get(e.from), to = positions.get(e.to);
    if (!from || !to) continue;
    const key = `${e.from}-${e.to}-${e.kind}`;
    if (drawn.has(key)) continue;
    drawn.add(key);
    const off = e.kind === 'delegation' ? -18 : e.kind === 'handoff' ? 18 : 0;
    const mc = e.color.startsWith('#') ? e.color.replace('#', '') : '';
    const mk = mc ? `sqm-arr-${mc}` : 'sqm-arr';
    const fy = from.y + (from.y < to.y ? NODE_H / 2 : -NODE_H / 2);
    const ty = to.y   + (to.y < from.y ? NODE_H / 2 : -NODE_H / 2);
    const midY = (fy + ty) / 2;
    const d = `M${from.x + off},${fy} C${from.x + off},${midY} ${to.x + off},${midY} ${to.x + off},${ty}`;
    // Invisible wider hit area for clicking
    svg += `<path class="sq-map-edge-hit" d="${d}" data-edge-from="${esc(e.from)}" data-edge-to="${esc(e.to)}"
      fill="none" stroke="transparent" stroke-width="14" style="cursor:pointer"/>`;
    // Visible edge
    svg += `<path class="sq-map-edge-vis" d="${d}" data-edge-from="${esc(e.from)}" data-edge-to="${esc(e.to)}"
      fill="none" stroke="${e.color}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="${dash[e.kind] || ''}"
      marker-end="url(#${mk})" opacity="0.7" style="pointer-events:none"/>`;
  }

  // Nodes
  for (const [i, node] of allNodes.entries()) {
    const x = cx, y = 16 + i * (NODE_H + PAD_Y), isLead = node.id === lead?.id;
    svg += `
      <g class="sq-map-node" data-node="${esc(node.id)}" data-node-color="${isLead ? squadColor : 'var(--border-color)'}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${esc(node.name)}">
        <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${NODE_W}" height="${NODE_H}" rx="8"
          fill="var(--bg-card)" stroke="${isLead ? squadColor : 'var(--border-color)'}" stroke-width="${isLead ? 2 : 1.5}"
          ${!isLead && node.kind === 'subagent' ? 'stroke-dasharray="5 3"' : ''}/>
        <text x="${x + 8}" y="${y + 19}" fill="var(--text-main)" font-size="11" font-weight="600">${esc(clip(node.name, 18))}</text>
        <text x="${x + 8}" y="${y + 34}" fill="var(--text-muted)" font-size="9">${isLead ? 'synthesis' : `step ${i + 1}`} · ${(node.tools || []).length} tools</text>
      </g>`;
  }

  svg += '</svg>';
  return svg + `<div class="sq-map-legend">
    <span style="color:var(--primary)">— flow</span>
    <span style="color:#f59e0b">- - delegation</span>
    <span style="color:#22c55e">··· scratchpad</span>
    <span class="text-muted" style="margin-left:auto">click arrow to configure</span>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── Edge popout (opens on edge click in graph) ──────────────────── */

function openEdgePopout(dialog, leftNode, rightNode, edges, liveNodes, blueprint, squadColor, refreshGraph, showStatus) {
  dialog.querySelector('.sq-map-edge-popout')?.remove();

  const relevant = edges.filter(e =>
    (e.from === leftNode.id && e.to === rightNode.id) ||
    (e.from === rightNode.id && e.to === leftNode.id));

  const tools = Object.entries(HANDOFF_TOOLS);

  const popout = document.createElement('div');
  popout.className = 'sq-map-edge-popout';
  popout.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-map-edge-popout-body">
      <header class="sq-map-edge-popout-head">
        <strong>Connections</strong>
        <span class="text-muted">${esc(leftNode.name)} ↔ ${esc(rightNode.name)}</span>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="close-popout">✕</button>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-map-edge-popout-current">
        <h4>Active connections</h4>
        ${relevant.length ? relevant.map(e => `
          <div class="sq-map-epop-row" style="border-left: 3px solid ${e.color}; padding-left: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">
            <span style="font-size: 1.1rem">${e.from === leftNode.id ? '→' : '←'}</span>
            <strong>${esc(e.label)}</strong>
            <span class="text-muted"> · ${e.kind}</span>
          </div>`).join('') : '<p class="text-muted">No direct connections between these agents.</p>'}
      </div>
      <hr style="border-color: var(--border-color); margin: 0.75rem 0;">
      <h4>Toggle tools</h4>
      <p class="text-muted small">Check a box to give an agent that tool; uncheck to remove it.</p>
      <div class="sq-map-epop-toggles">
        ${tools.map(([tool, info]) => {
          const lHas = (leftNode.tools || []).includes(tool);
          const rHas = (rightNode.tools || []).includes(tool);
          return `
            <div class="sq-map-epop-tool">
              <div class="sq-map-epop-tool-head">
                <span class="sq-map-epop-dot" style="background:${info.color}"></span>
                <strong>${esc(info.label)}</strong>
                <span class="text-muted small">${esc(tool)}</span>
              </div>
              <p class="text-muted small" style="margin:0.15rem 0 0.3rem">${esc(info.desc)}</p>
              <label class="sq-map-epop-cb">
                <input type="checkbox" ${lHas ? 'checked' : ''}
                  data-toggle-tool="${esc(tool)}" data-toggle-agent="${esc(leftNode.id)}">
                <span>${esc(leftNode.name)}</span>
              </label>
              <label class="sq-map-epop-cb">
                <input type="checkbox" ${rHas ? 'checked' : ''}
                  data-toggle-tool="${esc(tool)}" data-toggle-agent="${esc(rightNode.id)}">
                <span>${esc(rightNode.name)}</span>
              </label>
            </div>`;
        }).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;

  popout.querySelector('[data-act="close-popout"]').addEventListener('click', () => popout.remove());
  popout.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === popout) popout.remove(); });

  popout.addEventListener('change', async event => {
    const cb = event.target;
    if (!cb.dataset.toggleTool || !cb.dataset.toggleAgent) return;
    const tool = cb.dataset.toggleTool;
    const agentId = cb.dataset.toggleAgent;
    const attach = cb.checked;
    cb.disabled = true;
    try {
      const updated = attach
        ? await Api.attachAgentTool(agentId, tool)
        : await Api.detachAgentTool(agentId, tool);
      const node = liveNodes.find(n => n.id === updated.id);
      if (node) Object.assign(node, updated);
      refreshGraph();
      showStatus(`${attach ? 'Attached' : 'Detached'} ${tool} ${attach ? 'to' : 'from'} ${agentId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      cb.checked = !attach;
      showStatus(`Could not ${attach ? 'attach' : 'detach'} tool: ${err.message}`, true);
    } finally {
      cb.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  dialog.appendChild(popout);
}

/* ── Prompt column selection highlight ───────────────────────────── */

function selectPromptCol(promptsHost, agentId, color) {
  // Clear previous selection
  promptsHost.querySelectorAll('.sq-map-prompt-col').forEach(col => {
    col.classList.remove('sq-map-col-selected');
    col.style.removeProperty('--sel-color');
  });
  // Also clear node selection in graph
  const graphHost = promptsHost.closest('.sq-map-dialog')?.querySelector('[data-role="graph"]');
  if (graphHost) graphHost.querySelectorAll('.sq-map-node').forEach(n => n.classList.remove('is-selected'));

  if (!agentId) return;

  const col = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-col="${CSS.escape(agentId)}"]`);
  if (col) {
    col.classList.add('sq-map-col-selected');
    col.style.setProperty('--sel-color', color);
    col.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
  }
  // Highlight matching node
  if (graphHost) {
    const nodeEl = graphHost.querySelector(`[data-node="${CSS.escape(agentId)}"]`);
    if (nodeEl) nodeEl.classList.add('is-selected');
  }
}

/* ── Dialog ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export async function openSquadMap(squadId, squadColor, overview) {
  const dialog = document.createElement('dialog');
  dialog.className = 'sq-map-dialog';
  dialog.innerHTML = `
    <header class="sq-map-head">
      <h2>Squad map</h2>
      <p class="text-muted small" data-role="subtitle">Loading…</p>
      <div class="sq-map-font-controls">
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="font-down" title="Smaller text">A−</button>
        <span class="sq-map-font-label" data-role="font-label">${DEFAULT_FONT}px</span>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="font-up" title="Larger text">A+</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sq-map-layout-controls">
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm cb-btn-active" data-act="toggle-graph" title="Toggle graph sidebar">Graph</button>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="expand" title="Toggle fullscreen">Expand</button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-act="close">Close</button>
    </header>
    <div class="sq-map-body" data-role="body">
      <aside class="sq-map-graph" data-role="graph"><p class="text-muted small">Loading…</p></aside>
      <div class="sq-map-resize-handle" data-role="resize" title="Drag to resize"></div>
      <div class="sq-map-prompts" data-role="prompts"><p class="text-muted small">Loading prompts…</p></div>
    </div>
    <p data-role="status" class="small sq-map-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>`;
  document.body.append(dialog);

  const body = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="body"]');
  const graphHost = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="graph"]');
  const promptsHost = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="prompts"]');
  const subtitle = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="subtitle"]');
  const statusEl = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  const fontLabel = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="font-label"]');
  const resizeHandle = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="resize"]');

  let fontSize = DEFAULT_FONT;
  let graphVisible = true;
  let expanded = false;
  const dirty = new Map();
  const editors = new Map(); // agentId → monaco editor instance
  let liveNodes = [];
  let leadNode = null;
  let blueprint = null;

  function applyFontSize() {
    promptsHost.style.setProperty('--map-font-size', `${fontSize}px`);
    fontLabel.textContent = `${fontSize}px`;
    for (const ed of editors.values()) {
      if (ed.updateOptions) ed.updateOptions({ fontSize });
    }
  }
  applyFontSize();

  function showStatus(msg, isError = false) {
    statusEl.textContent = msg;
    statusEl.classList.toggle('text-danger', isError);
  }

  function refreshGraph() {
    const lead = leadNode, members = liveNodes.filter(n => n.id !== lead?.id);
    const edges = buildEdges(lead, members, blueprint);
    graphHost.innerHTML = renderGraph(lead, members, edges, squadColor);

    const colsHost = promptsHost.querySelector('[data-role="cols"]');
    if (!colsHost) return;
    for (const node of liveNodes) {
      const row = colsHost.querySelector(`[data-tools-for="${CSS.escape(node.id)}"]`);
      if (!row) continue;
      row.innerHTML = (node.tools || []).map(t => {
        const hi = HANDOFF_TOOLS[t];
        return `<span class="sq-chip" ${hi ? `style="border-color:${hi.color};color:${hi.color}"` : ''}>${esc(t)}</span>`;
      }).join('') || '<span class="text-muted small">no tools</span>';
    }
  }

  dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
    for (const ed of editors.values()) ed.dispose();
    editors.clear();
    dialog.remove();
  });
  dialog.addEventListener('cancel', event => {
    if (dirty.size && !confirm(`You have unsaved changes in ${dirty.size} prompt(s). Close anyway?`)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    dialog.close();
  });

  // Graph interactions: node click → highlight column, edge click → config popout
  graphHost.addEventListener('click', event => {
    // Edge click?
    const edgeHit = event.target.closest('.sq-map-edge-hit');
    if (edgeHit) {
      const fromId = edgeHit.dataset.edgeFrom, toId = edgeHit.dataset.edgeTo;
      const fromNode = liveNodes.find(n => n.id === fromId);
      const toNode = liveNodes.find(n => n.id === toId);
      if (fromNode && toNode) {
        const lead = leadNode, members = liveNodes.filter(n => n.id !== lead?.id);
        const edges = buildEdges(lead, members, blueprint);
        openEdgePopout(dialog, fromNode, toNode, edges, liveNodes, blueprint, squadColor, refreshGraph, showStatus);
      }
      return;
    }
    // Node click?
    const nodeEl = event.target.closest('[data-node]');
    if (nodeEl) {
      selectPromptCol(promptsHost, nodeEl.dataset.node, squadColor);
    }
  });

  // Click on a prompt column header → also highlight it and select graph node
  promptsHost.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const header = event.target.closest('.sq-map-prompt-header');
    if (!header) return;
    const col = header.closest('.sq-map-prompt-col');
    if (!col) return;
    const agentId = col.dataset.col;
    selectPromptCol(promptsHost, agentId, squadColor);
  });

  // Button actions
  dialog.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const btn = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    const act = btn.dataset.act;

    if (act === 'close') {
      if (dirty.size && !confirm(`You have unsaved changes in ${dirty.size} prompt(s). Close anyway?`)) return;
      dialog.close();
    }
    if (act === 'font-down') { fontSize = Math.max(MIN_FONT, fontSize - FONT_STEP); applyFontSize(); }
    if (act === 'font-up')   { fontSize = Math.min(MAX_FONT, fontSize + FONT_STEP); applyFontSize(); }
    if (act === 'toggle-graph') {
      graphVisible = !graphVisible;
      graphHost.classList.toggle('sq-map-graph-hidden', !graphVisible);
      resizeHandle.classList.toggle('sq-map-resize-hidden', !graphVisible);
      btn.classList.toggle('cb-btn-active', graphVisible);
    }
    if (act === 'expand') {
      expanded = !expanded;
      dialog.classList.toggle('sq-map-expanded', expanded);
      btn.textContent = expanded ? 'Shrink' : 'Expand';
    }
    if (act === 'save') {
      const agentId = btn.dataset.agent;
      const ed = editors.get(agentId);
      if (!ed) return;
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Saving…';
      Api.setAgentPrompt(agentId, ed.getValue()).then(() => {
        dirty.delete(agentId);
        btn.textContent = 'Saved'; btn.classList.remove('cb-btn-danger'); btn.classList.add('cb-btn-success');
        const dot = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${CSS.escape(agentId)}"]`);
        if (dot) dot.hidden = true;
        setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Save'; btn.classList.remove('cb-btn-success'); }, 1500);
      }).catch(err => { btn.textContent = 'Save'; showStatus(`Save failed: ${err.message}`, true); })
        .finally(() => { btn.disabled = false; });
    }
    if (act === 'save-all') {
      if (!dirty.size) return;
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Saving…';
      const errs = [];
      (async () => {
        for (const [agentId] of dirty) {
          const ed = editors.get(agentId);
          if (!ed) continue;
          try {
            await Api.setAgentPrompt(agentId, ed.getValue());
            dirty.delete(agentId);
            const dot = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${CSS.escape(agentId)}"]`);
            if (dot) dot.hidden = true;
            const sb = promptsHost.querySelector(`button[data-agent="${CSS.escape(agentId)}"][data-act="save"]`);
            if (sb) sb.classList.remove('cb-btn-danger');
          } catch (err) { errs.push(`${agentId}: ${err.message}`); }
        }
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = `Save all (${dirty.size})`;
        showStatus(errs.length ? errs.join('; ') : 'All prompts saved.', !!errs.length);
      })();
    }
  });

  // Resize handles — graph sidebar + prompt column dividers
  let resizeTarget = null; // the element being resized
  function startResize(e, target) {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    resizeTarget = target;
    dialog.style.cursor = 'col-resize';
    dialog.classList.add('sq-map-resizing');
  }
  resizeHandle.addEventListener('mousedown', e => startResize(e, graphHost));
  // Column dividers (delegated)
  promptsHost.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    const div = e.target.closest('.sq-map-col-divider');
    if (!div) return;
    const col = div.previousElementSibling;
    if (col?.classList.contains('sq-map-prompt-col')) startResize(e, col);
  });
  dialog.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (!resizeTarget) return;
    if (resizeTarget === graphHost) {
      const bodyRect = body.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - bodyRect.left;
      const clamped = Math.max(100, Math.min(bodyRect.width * 0.5, x));
      graphHost.style.width = `${clamped}px`;
      graphHost.style.flexBasis = `${clamped}px`;
      graphHost.style.flexShrink = '0';
    } else {
      const rect = resizeTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
      const w = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const clamped = Math.max(180, Math.min(900, w));
      resizeTarget.style.flex = `0 0 ${clamped}px`;
      resizeTarget.style.minWidth = `${clamped}px`;
    }
  });
  dialog.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    if (!resizeTarget) return;
    resizeTarget = null;
    dialog.style.cursor = '';
    dialog.classList.remove('sq-map-resizing');
  });

  dialog.showModal();

  try {
    blueprint = await Api.getSquadBlueprint(squadId);
    const lead = blueprint.lead;
    const members = dedup(lead, blueprint.members);
    leadNode = lead;
    liveNodes = [...members, lead].filter(Boolean);

    subtitle.textContent = `${blueprint.name} · ${blueprint.pattern} · ${liveNodes.length} agent${liveNodes.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;

    const edges = buildEdges(lead, members, blueprint);
    graphHost.innerHTML = renderGraph(lead, members, edges, squadColor);

    let colsHtml = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < liveNodes.length; i++) {
      const node = liveNodes[i];
      colsHtml += `
        <section class="sq-map-prompt-col" data-col="${esc(node.id)}">
          <header class="sq-map-prompt-header" style="border-top: 3px solid ${node.id === lead?.id ? squadColor : 'var(--border-color)'}">
            <strong>${esc(node.name)}</strong>
            <span class="badge">${node.id === lead?.id ? 'lead · synthesis' : `step ${i + 1}`}</span>
            <span class="badge" style="opacity:0.6">${node.path?.endsWith('.yaml') || node.path?.endsWith('.yml') ? 'yaml' : 'md'}</span>
            <span class="sq-map-dirty-dot" data-dirty="${esc(node.id)}" hidden title="Unsaved changes"></span>
            <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="save" data-agent="${esc(node.id)}">Save</button>
          </header>
          <div class="sq-map-prompt-tools sq-chip-row" data-tools-for="${esc(node.id)}">
            ${(node.tools || []).map(t => {
              const hi = HANDOFF_TOOLS[t];
              return `<span class="sq-chip" ${hi ? `style="border-color:${hi.color};color:${hi.color}"` : ''}>${esc(t)}</span>`;
            }).join('') || '<span class="text-muted small">no tools</span>'}
          </div>
          <div class="sq-map-prompt-body" data-prompt-body="${esc(node.id)}">
            <p class="text-muted small">Loading prompt…</p>
          </div>
        </section>`;
      if (i < liveNodes.length - 1) {
        colsHtml += `<div class="sq-map-col-divider" title="Drag to resize column"></div>`;
      }
    }

    promptsHost.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sq-map-prompts-toolbar">
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-sm" data-act="save-all">Save all (0)</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sq-map-prompts-cols" data-role="cols">${colsHtml}</div>`;

    const saveAllBtn = promptsHost.querySelector('[data-act="save-all"]');
    function updateSaveAllLabel() { saveAllBtn.textContent = `Save all (${dirty.size})`; }

    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      liveNodes.map(async node => {
        try { const { prompt } = await Api.getAgentPrompt(node.id); return { id: node.id, prompt }; }
        catch (err) { return { id: node.id, prompt: null, error: err.message }; }
      })
    );

    // Create Monaco editors for each prompt
    let monaco;
    try { monaco = await loadMonaco(); } catch { monaco = null; }

    for (const result of results) {
      const val = result.status === 'fulfilled' ? result.value : null;
      if (!val) continue;
      const el = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-prompt-body="${CSS.escape(val.id)}"]`);
      if (!el) continue;
      if (val.prompt != null) {
        const node = liveNodes.find(n => n.id === val.id);
        const lang = node?.path?.endsWith('.yaml') || node?.path?.endsWith('.yml') ? 'yaml' : 'markdown';

        if (monaco) {
          el.innerHTML = '';
          el.classList.add('sq-map-editor-host');
          const ed = monaco.editor.create(el, {
            value: val.prompt,
            language: lang,
            theme: 'vs-dark',
            automaticLayout: true,
            fontSize: fontSize,
            fontFamily: "'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace",
            lineNumbers: 'on',
            minimap: { enabled: false },
            scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
            wordWrap: 'on',
            wrappingIndent: 'indent',
            padding: { top: 8, bottom: 8 },
            renderLineHighlight: 'line',
            folding: true,
            glyphMargin: false,
            lineDecorationsWidth: 4,
            lineNumbersMinChars: 3,
            readOnly: false,
            ariaLabel: `Prompt for ${val.id} (${lang})`,
          });
          editors.set(val.id, ed);
          ed.onDidChangeModelContent(() => {
            dirty.set(val.id, true);
            const dot = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${CSS.escape(val.id)}"]`);
            if (dot) dot.hidden = false;
            const sb = promptsHost.querySelector(`button[data-agent="${CSS.escape(val.id)}"][data-act="save"]`);
            if (sb) sb.classList.add('cb-btn-danger');
            updateSaveAllLabel();
          });
        } else {
          // Fallback: plain textarea if Monaco unavailable
          const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
          textarea.className = 'sq-map-editor';
          textarea.dataset.editor = val.id;
          textarea.value = val.prompt;
          textarea.spellcheck = false;
          textarea.setAttribute('aria-label', `Prompt for ${val.id}`);
          el.replaceChildren(textarea);
          const fallbackEd = {
            getValue: () => textarea.value,
            dispose: () => {},
            updateOptions: () => {},
          };
          editors.set(val.id, fallbackEd);
          textarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
            dirty.set(val.id, true);
            const dot = promptsHost.querySelector(`[data-dirty="${CSS.escape(val.id)}"]`);
            if (dot) dot.hidden = false;
            const sb = promptsHost.querySelector(`button[data-agent="${CSS.escape(val.id)}"][data-act="save"]`);
            if (sb) sb.classList.add('cb-btn-danger');
            updateSaveAllLabel();
          });
        }
      } else {
        el.innerHTML = `<p class="text-muted small">Could not load prompt: ${esc(val.error || 'unknown error')}</p>`;
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    showStatus(`Error: ${err.message}`, true);
  }
}
```
