## `frontend/static/js/squads/squads_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squads home: every registered squad, the Squad Architect canvas for the selected one,
 * and an inspector for the selected agent (tools, delegation, editor and chat shortcuts).
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate, openInEditor } from '../shell.js';
import { renderArchitectCanvas } from './architect_canvas.js';
import { renderBuilder } from './builder_steps.js';
import { PATTERN_INFO } from './run_client.js';
import { toolOptionGroups } from '../tool_categories.js';

let selectedSquadId = null;
let selectedNodeId = null;

function healthBadge(status = 'healthy') {
  const cls = status === 'healthy' ? 'badge-success' : status === 'degraded' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-danger';
  return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function metricsLine(metrics = {}) {
  return `${metrics.total_runs || 0} runs · ${metrics.successful_runs || 0} ok · ${metrics.failed_runs || 0} failed · avg ${Math.round(metrics.average_duration_ms || 0)} ms`;
}

export function renderSquadsView(container, payload = null) {
  if (payload?.squadId) selectedSquadId = payload.squadId;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Squads</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Build an ordered workflow with sub-agent steps that pass results forward, and an optional lead for synthesis.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="new">+ New squad</button>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-home">
        <aside class="sq-list" data-role="list" aria-label="Squads"><p class="text-muted small">Loading squads…</p></aside>
        <section class="sq-detail" data-role="detail"></section>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const list = container.querySelector('[data-role="list"]');
  const detail = container.querySelector('[data-role="detail"]');
  let overview = { squads: [], agents: [], tools: [] };

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    if (!overview.squads.some(squad => squad.squad_id === selectedSquadId)) {
      selectedSquadId = overview.squads[0]?.squad_id || null;
    }
    renderList();
    if (payload?.builder === 'new') openBuilder(null);
    else await renderDetail();
  }

  function renderList() {
    list.innerHTML = overview.squads.map(squad => `
      <button type="button" class="sq-card ${squad.squad_id === selectedSquadId ? 'is-selected' : ''}" data-squad="${esc(squad.squad_id)}">
        <span class="sq-card-head"><strong>${esc(squad.name)}</strong>${healthBadge(squad.metrics?.last_status)}</span>
        <span class="sq-card-flow">
          <span class="badge badge-accent">${esc(PATTERN_INFO[squad.default_pattern]?.label || squad.default_pattern)}</span>
          ${squad.primary_agent
            ? `${esc(squad.primary_agent)} → ${squad.subagents.length} member${squad.subagents.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
            : `${squad.subagents.length} member${squad.subagents.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (no lead)`}
        </span>
        <span class="text-muted small">${esc(metricsLine(squad.metrics))}</span>
      </button>`).join('') || `
      <div class="sq-empty-state">
        <p>No squads yet.</p>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="new">Build your first squad</button>
      </div>`;
  }

  async function renderDetail() {
    if (!selectedSquadId) {
      detail.innerHTML = `<div class="card sq-empty-state"><p class="text-muted">Select or create a squad to see its structure.</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    detail.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">Loading blueprint…</p>';
    let blueprint;
    try {
      blueprint = await Api.getSquadBlueprint(selectedSquadId);
    } catch (err) {
      detail.innerHTML = `<div class="error-panel">Could not load squad: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    const nodes = [blueprint.lead, ...blueprint.members].filter(Boolean);
    if (!nodes.some(node => node.id === selectedNodeId)) selectedNodeId = blueprint.lead?.id || null;
    const missing = blueprint.members.filter(member => !member).length;

    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card sq-architect">
        <div class="sq-architect-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${esc(blueprint.name)}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(blueprint.description || 'No description.')}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="sq-architect-actions">
            <span class="badge badge-accent">Ordered workflow</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="edit">Edit in builder</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" data-act="run">▶ Run</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-act="delete">Delete</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small sq-pattern-note">${esc(PATTERN_INFO.sequential.summary)}
          ${blueprint.dedicated_pipeline ? ' This squad uses its dedicated Plan → Build → Test → Fix pipeline.' : ''}
          ${missing ? ` <span class="text-danger">${missing} member definition(s) are missing.</span>` : ''}</p>
        <div class="sq-architect-body">
          <div class="sq-canvas-host" data-role="canvas"></div>
          <aside class="sq-inspector" data-role="inspector"></aside>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small">${esc(metricsLine(blueprint.metrics))}</p>
      </div>`;

    const canvas = detail.querySelector('[data-role="canvas"]');
    const draw = () => renderArchitectCanvas(canvas, blueprint, {
      selectedId: selectedNodeId,
      onSelect: id => { selectedNodeId = id; draw(); renderInspector(); }
    });
    const inspector = detail.querySelector('[data-role="inspector"]');

    function renderInspector() {
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      if (!node) { inspector.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">Select an agent.</p>'; return; }
      const isLead = node.id === blueprint.lead?.id;
      const available = overview.tools.filter(tool => !node.tools.includes(tool.name));
      inspector.innerHTML = `
        <div class="sq-inspector-head">
          <strong>${esc(node.name)}</strong>
          <span class="badge ${isLead ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${isLead ? 'lead' : node.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'}</span>
          <span class="badge">${esc(node.mode)}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small">${esc(node.description || 'No description.')}</p>
        <code class="small">${esc(node.path)}</code>
        <h4>Tools</h4>
        <div class="sq-chip-row">
          ${node.tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
            <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-detach="${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
            || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
        </div>
        <select class="form-select mt-2" data-role="attach" aria-label="Attach a tool">
          <option value="">+ Attach tool…</option>
          ${toolOptionGroups(available)}
        </select>
        ${node.allowed_subagents?.length ? `
          <h4>May call</h4>
          <div class="sq-chip-row">${node.allowed_subagents.map(id => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(id)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="inspector-error"></p>
        <div class="sq-inspector-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="open-editor">Edit prompt</button>
          ${node.kind === 'agent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="chat">Chat</button>' : ''}
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="tools">Build a tool</button>
        </div>`;

    }

    async function applyToSelected(request) {
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      try {
        Object.assign(node, await request);
        draw();
        renderInspector();
      } catch (err) {
        const error = inspector.querySelector('[data-role="inspector-error"]');
        error.textContent = err.message;
        error.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    }
    inspector.addEventListener('change', event => {
      if (event.target.dataset.role === 'attach' && event.target.value) {
        applyToSelected(Api.attachAgentTool(selectedNodeId, event.target.value));
      }
    });
    inspector.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('button');
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      if (!button || !node) return;
      if (button.dataset.detach) applyToSelected(Api.detachAgentTool(node.id, button.dataset.detach));
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'open-editor') openInEditor(node.path);
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'chat') navigate('chat', node.id);
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'tools') navigate('tools', { attachTo: node.id });
    });

    detail.querySelector('.sq-architect-actions').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const act = event.target.closest('button')?.dataset.act;
      if (act === 'edit') openBuilder(blueprint);
      else if (act === 'run') navigate('runs', { squadId: blueprint.squad_id });
      else if (act === 'delete') {
        if (!confirm(`Delete squad "${blueprint.name}"? Only the registration and its metrics are removed; agent files stay.`)) return;
        try {
          await Api.deleteOrchestrationSquad(blueprint.squad_id);
          selectedSquadId = null;
          await load();
        } catch (err) {
          alert(`Could not delete squad: ${err.message}`);
        }
      }
    });

    draw();
    renderInspector();
  }

  function openBuilder(initial) {
    payload = null;
    const host = document.createElement('div');
    detail.replaceChildren(host);
    renderBuilder(host, {
      overview,
      initial,
      onCancel: () => renderDetail(),
      onSaved: async (blueprint, warnings) => {
        selectedSquadId = blueprint.squad_id;
        selectedNodeId = blueprint.lead?.id || null;
        await load();
        if (warnings.length) {
          detail.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',
            `<div class="sq-msg sq-msg-warn">Saved with notes: ${warnings.map(esc).join(' · ')}</div>`);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  container.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const squadButton = event.target.closest('[data-squad]');
    if (squadButton) {
      selectedSquadId = squadButton.dataset.squad;
      selectedNodeId = null;
      renderList();
      renderDetail();
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-act="new"]')) openBuilder(null);
  });

  load().catch(err => {
    list.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load squads: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/tools_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Tools section: the tool catalog with who uses each tool, attaching tools to agents, and
 * the Tool Workbench (generate → test → promote) for building new ones.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc } from '../shell.js';
import { renderTestingView } from '../testing.js';
import { groupTools, toolCategory } from '../tool_categories.js';

export function renderToolsView(container, payload = null) {
  let attachTo = payload?.attachTo || '';
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Tools</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Give agents the abilities they need. Build a new tool below, test it, promote it, then attach it.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-msg sq-msg-ok hidden" data-role="promoted" role="status"></div>
      <section class="card">
        <div class="card-head">
          <h3>Tool catalog</h3>
          <input class="form-input sq-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter tools" aria-label="Filter tools">
        </div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="sq-tool-catalog" data-role="catalog"><p class="text-muted small">Loading tools…</p></div>
      </section>
      <div data-role="workbench"></div>
    </div>`;

  const catalog = container.querySelector('[data-role="catalog"]');
  const errorBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
  const promoted = container.querySelector('[data-role="promoted"]');
  let overview = { agents: [], tools: [] };
  let filter = '';

  const agentOptions = (exclude = []) => overview.agents
    .filter(agent => !exclude.includes(agent.id))
    .map(agent => `<option value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${agent.id === attachTo ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(agent.name)} (${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'primary' : 'sub-agent'})</option>`)
    .join('');

  function render() {
    const term = filter.toLowerCase();
    const tools = overview.tools.filter(tool =>
      !term || `${tool.name} ${tool.provider} ${tool.description} ${toolCategory(tool)}`.toLowerCase().includes(term));
    catalog.innerHTML = groupTools(tools).map(([category, items]) => `
      <section class="sq-tool-category" aria-label="${esc(category)}">
      <h4>${esc(category)} <span class="text-muted small">(${items.length})</span></h4>
      ${items.map(tool => {
      const users = overview.agents.filter(agent => agent.tools.includes(tool.name));
      const description = Array.isArray(tool.description) ? tool.description.join(' ') : (tool.description || '');
      return `
        <div class="sq-tool-item" data-tool="${esc(tool.name)}">
          <div>
            <strong>${esc(tool.name)}</strong> <span class="badge">${esc(tool.provider)}</span>
            ${tool.custom ? '<span class="badge badge-accent">custom</span>' : ''}
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(description.split('\n')[0] || 'No description.')}</p>
            <code class="small">${esc(tool.signature)}</code>
          </div>
          <div class="sq-tool-users">
            <span class="small text-muted">${users.length ? `Used by ${users.map(u => esc(u.name)).join(', ')}` : 'Not used by any agent'}</span>
            <span class="sq-tool-add">
              <select class="form-select" aria-label="Agent to attach ${esc(tool.name)} to">
                <option value="">Attach to…</option>${agentOptions(users.map(u => u.id))}
              </select>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-attach>Attach</button>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}
      </section>`).join('') || '<p class="text-muted small">No tools match.</p>';
  }

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    render();
  }

  async function attach(agentId, tool) {
    errorBox.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      const updated = await Api.attachAgentTool(agentId, tool);
      attachTo = agentId;
      await load();
      return updated;
    } catch (err) {
      errorBox.textContent = err.message;
      errorBox.classList.remove('hidden');
      return null;
    }
  }

  container.querySelector('.sq-search').addEventListener('input', event => {
    filter = event.target.value;
    render();
  });
  catalog.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-attach]');
    if (!button) return;
    const row = button.closest('[data-tool]');
    const agentId = row.querySelector('select').value;
    if (agentId) await attach(agentId, row.dataset.tool);
  });

  // A tool promoted in the workbench can be attached straight away.
  container.addEventListener('novous:tool-promoted', async event => {
    const name = event.detail.name;
    await load();
    promoted.classList.remove('hidden');
    promoted.innerHTML = `
      <span><strong>${esc(name)}</strong> is in the tool catalog. Attach it to an agent:</span>
      <select class="form-select" aria-label="Agent for ${esc(name)}"><option value="">Choose agent…</option>${agentOptions()}</select>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Attach</button>`;
    promoted.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const agentId = promoted.querySelector('select').value;
      if (!agentId) return;
      const updated = await attach(agentId, name);
      if (updated) promoted.innerHTML = `<span>Attached <strong>${esc(name)}</strong> to ${esc(updated.name)}.</span>`;
    });
  });

  renderTestingView(container.querySelector('[data-role="workbench"]'));
  load().catch(err => {
    catalog.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load tools: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/views/agent_library.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Agent library: every agent across environments in one searchable,
 * filterable list, grouped by environment, with chat/open, edit and delete actions.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { iconSvg } from '../icons.js';
import { esc, navigate, refreshAgents } from '../shell.js';

const ENVIRONMENTS = {
  workspace: { label: 'Workspace', open: 'Chat', openTab: 'chat', passId: true },
  'prompt-creation': { label: 'Prompt Creation', open: 'Open', openTab: 'prompt-creation', passId: false },
  codebuilder: { label: 'Code Builder', open: 'Open', openTab: 'codebuilder', passId: false },
};

// Filters survive re-renders of the Overview.
const filters = { text: '', environment: 'all', mode: 'all', sort: 'name' };
const collapsedGroups = new Set();

const SORTS = {
  name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  tools: (a, b) => (b.tools?.length || 0) - (a.tools?.length || 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  model: (a, b) => String(a.model || '').localeCompare(String(b.model || '')) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
};

async function loadAllAgents() {
  const [workspace, prompt, codebuilder] = await Promise.all([
    Api.getAgents('workspace'),
    Api.getAgents('prompt-creation'),
    Api.getCodeBuilderAgents(),
  ]);
  const tag = (list, environment) => (list.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment }));
  return [...tag(workspace, 'workspace'), ...tag(prompt, 'prompt-creation'), ...tag(codebuilder, 'codebuilder')];
}

function matches(agent) {
  if (filters.environment !== 'all' && agent.environment !== filters.environment) return false;
  if (filters.mode !== 'all' && agent.mode !== filters.mode) return false;
  const term = filters.text.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!term) return true;
  return [agent.name, agent.id, agent.description, agent.model, ...(agent.tools || [])]
    .join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(term);
}

function agentRow(agent) {
  const env = ENVIRONMENTS[agent.environment];
  const tools = agent.tools || [];
  const initials = String(agent.name || agent.id).split(/[\s_-]+/).map(part => part[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `
    <li class="ov-agent" data-agent="${esc(agent.id)}" data-env="${esc(agent.environment)}">
      <span class="ov-avatar ov-avatar-${esc(agent.environment)}" aria-hidden="true">${esc(initials)}</span>
      <div class="ov-agent-main">
        <div class="ov-agent-title">
          <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
          <code>${esc(agent.id)}</code>
        </div>
        <p>${esc(agent.description || 'No description.')}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-agent-meta">
        <span class="badge ${agent.mode === 'agent' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${esc(agent.mode)}</span>
        <span class="ov-tools" title="${esc(tools.join(', ') || 'No tools')}">${tools.length} tool${tools.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
        <span class="ov-model" title="Model">${esc(agent.model || 'default model')}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-agent-actions">
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-act="open">${iconSvg(env.openTab === 'chat' ? 'send' : 'play')}<span>${env.open}</span></button>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" data-act="edit" title="Edit prompt" aria-label="Edit ${esc(agent.name)}">${iconSvg('file-code')}</button>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost ov-delete" data-act="delete" title="Delete agent" aria-label="Delete ${esc(agent.name)}">${iconSvg('trash-2')}</button>
      </div>
    </li>`;
}

export function renderAgentLibrary(host) {
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="ov-agents-head">
      <div>
        <h3>Agent library <span class="text-muted small" data-role="total"></span></h3>
        <p class="text-muted small">Search agents across environments by name, id, description, model or tool.</p>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">${iconSvg('plus')}<span>New agent</span></button>
    </div>
    <form class="ov-create hidden" data-role="create">
      <div class="ov-create-grid">
        <label><span>Id</span><input class="form-input" name="id" placeholder="reviewer" required maxlength="64"></label>
        <label><span>Display name</span><input class="form-input" name="name" placeholder="Code Reviewer" maxlength="100"></label>
        <label class="ov-create-wide"><span>Description</span><input class="form-input" name="description" placeholder="What this agent is for" maxlength="500"></label>
        <label><span>Environment</span>
          <select class="cb-select" name="environment">
            ${Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => `<option value="${key}">${env.label}</option>`).join('')}
          </select></label>
        <label><span>Mode</span>
          <select class="cb-select" name="mode"><option value="chat">chat</option><option value="agent">agent (uses tools)</option></select></label>
        <label class="ov-create-wide"><span>Custom environment name <em class="text-muted">(optional)</em></span>
          <input class="form-input" name="environment_name" maxlength="64"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-create-actions">
        <p class="small text-danger" data-role="create-error" role="alert"></p>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-ghost" data-act="toggle-create">Cancel</button>
        <button type="submit" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary">Create agent</button>
      </div>
    </form>
    <div class="ov-toolbar">
      <label class="ov-search">
        ${iconSvg('search')}
        <input type="search" class="form-input" placeholder="Search agents…  ( / )" value="${esc(filters.text)}" aria-label="Search agents">
      </label>
      <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Environment" data-role="envs"></div>
      <select class="cb-select" data-role="mode" aria-label="Mode">
        <option value="all">Any mode</option><option value="agent">Agent mode</option><option value="chat">Chat mode</option>
      </select>
      <select class="cb-select" data-role="sort" aria-label="Sort">
        <option value="name">Sort: name</option><option value="tools">Sort: most tools</option><option value="model">Sort: model</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="ov-groups" data-role="groups"><p class="text-muted small">Loading agents…</p></div>`;

  const groupsBox = host.querySelector('[data-role="groups"]');
  const envBox = host.querySelector('[data-role="envs"]');
  const search = host.querySelector('input[type="search"]');
  const createForm = host.querySelector('[data-role="create"]');
  host.querySelector('[data-role="mode"]').value = filters.mode;
  host.querySelector('[data-role="sort"]').value = filters.sort;
  let agents = [];

  function render() {
    const counts = agents.reduce((acc, agent) => ({ ...acc, [agent.environment]: (acc[agent.environment] || 0) + 1 }), {});
    host.querySelector('[data-role="total"]').textContent = `· ${agents.length}`;
    envBox.innerHTML = [['all', 'All', agents.length], ...Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => [key, env.label, counts[key] || 0])]
      .map(([key, label, count]) => `
        <label><input type="radio" name="ov-env" value="${key}" ${filters.environment === key ? 'checked' : ''}>
          ${esc(label)} <span class="ov-count">${count}</span></label>`).join('');

    const shown = agents.filter(matches).sort(SORTS[filters.sort]);
    if (!shown.length) {
      groupsBox.innerHTML = agents.length
        ? `<div class="ov-empty"><p>No agents match these filters.</p><button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-act="clear-filters">Clear filters</button></div>`
        : `<div class="ov-empty"><p>No agents yet.</p><button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">Create the first one</button></div>`;
      return;
    }
    groupsBox.innerHTML = Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => {
      const items = shown.filter(agent => agent.environment === key);
      if (!items.length) return '';
      return `
        <details class="ov-group" data-group="${key}" ${collapsedGroups.has(key) ? '' : 'open'}>
          <summary><span>${esc(env.label)}</span><span class="ov-count">${items.length}</span></summary>
          <ul class="ov-agent-list">${items.map(agentRow).join('')}</ul>
        </details>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  async function load() {
    try {
      agents = await loadAllAgents();
      render();
    } catch (err) {
      groupsBox.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load agents: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
    }
  }

  search.addEventListener('input', () => { filters.text = search.value; render(); });
  host.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.name === 'ov-env') filters.environment = target.value;
    else if (target.dataset.role === 'mode') filters.mode = target.value;
    else if (target.dataset.role === 'sort') filters.sort = target.value;
    else return;
    render();
  });
  host.addEventListener('toggle', event => {
    const group = event.target.closest?.('[data-group]');
    if (!group) return;
    if (group.open) collapsedGroups.delete(group.dataset.group);
    else collapsedGroups.add(group.dataset.group);
  }, true);

  // "/" jumps to search, like most list UIs.
  const onKey = event => {
    if (!host.isConnected) { document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); return; }
    if (event.key === '/' && !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement?.tagName || '')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      search.focus();
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

  host.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    const act = button.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'toggle-create') {
      createForm.classList.toggle('hidden');
      if (!createForm.classList.contains('hidden')) createForm.querySelector('[name="id"]').focus();
      return;
    }
    if (act === 'clear-filters') {
      Object.assign(filters, { text: '', environment: 'all', mode: 'all' });
      search.value = '';
      host.querySelector('[data-role="mode"]').value = 'all';
      render();
      return;
    }
    const row = button.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (!row) return;
    const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === row.dataset.agent && a.environment === row.dataset.env);
    const env = ENVIRONMENTS[agent.environment];
    if (act === 'open') navigate(env.openTab, env.passId ? agent.id : null);
    else if (act === 'edit') navigate('editor', agent.path || `library/${agent.id}.md`);
    else if (act === 'delete') {
      if (!confirm(`Delete ${env.label} agent "${agent.name}"? Its definition file will be removed.`)) return;
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        await Api.deleteAgent(agent.id, agent.environment);
        await refreshAgents();
        await load();
      } catch (err) {
        alert(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  });

  createForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(createForm);
    const errorBox = createForm.querySelector('[data-role="create-error"]');
    errorBox.textContent = '';
    const id = String(data.get('id')).trim();
    try {
      await Api.createAgent(id, String(data.get('name')).trim() || id, String(data.get('description')).trim(),
        data.get('mode'), '', data.get('environment'), String(data.get('environment_name')).trim());
      createForm.reset();
      createForm.classList.add('hidden');
      filters.text = '';
      search.value = '';
      await refreshAgents();
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      errorBox.textContent = err.message;
    }
  });

  load();
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/views/file_manager_view.js`
```javascript
/** Manage workspace folders and browse their files. */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { navigate } from '../shell.js';
import { renderTree } from '../tree.js';

export function renderFileManagerView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>File Manager</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Configure allowed workspace folders and browse their files.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="ov-layout">
        <section class="card">
          <h3>Workspace folders</h3>
          <p class="text-muted small">Add absolute folder paths, one per line. Removing a folder only removes it from the picker.</p>
          <ul class="root-path-list" data-role="roots" aria-label="Configured workspace folders"></ul>
          <label class="small" for="file-manager-paths">Folder paths</label>
          <textarea id="file-manager-paths" class="form-input root-path-input" rows="3"
            placeholder="E:\\Projects"></textarea>
          <div class="root-management-actions">
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-roots-action="add">Add folders</button>
            <button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-roots-action="remove">Remove folders</button>
          </div>
          <p class="small" data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </section>
        <section class="card dash-tree-card">
          <h3>Workspace files</h3>
          <div class="tree-pane" data-role="tree"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const rootList = container.querySelector('[data-role="roots"]');
  const input = container.querySelector('#file-manager-paths');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  const actionButtons = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-roots-action]')];
  const tree = renderTree(container.querySelector('[data-role="tree"]'), {
    manageRoots: true,
    onSelect: path => navigate('editor', { path, managedFile: true })
  });

  function setStatus(message, kind = 'muted') {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  async function refreshRoots() {
    const config = await Api.getFileManagerRoots();
    const createItem = (root, missing) => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      const name = document.createElement('strong');
      const path = document.createElement('code');
      name.textContent = root.name;
      path.textContent = root.path;
      item.append(name, path);
      if (missing) {
        item.classList.add('root-missing');
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'badge badge-danger';
        badge.textContent = 'missing';
        const remove = document.createElement('button');
        remove.type = 'button';
        remove.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
        remove.textContent = 'Remove';
        remove.dataset.removeRoot = root.path;
        item.append(badge, remove);
      }
      return item;
    };
    rootList.replaceChildren(
      ...config.roots.map(root => createItem(root, false)),
      ...(config.missing || []).map(root => createItem(root, true))
    );
  }

  rootList.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-remove-root]');
    if (!button) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.manageFileManagerRoots('remove', [button.dataset.removeRoot]);
      await refreshRoots();
      await tree.reload();
      setStatus('Removed the missing folder from the picker.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(`Could not remove folder: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  actionButtons.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const paths = input.value.split(/\r?\n/).map(path => path.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!paths.length) {
      setStatus('Paste at least one absolute folder path.', 'danger');
      input.focus();
      return;
    }
    actionButtons.forEach(item => { item.disabled = true; });
    setStatus('Updating workspace folders…');
    try {
      const action = button.dataset.rootsAction;
      const result = await Api.manageFileManagerRoots(action, paths);
      const changed = action === 'add' ? result.added : result.removed;
      setStatus(`${action === 'add' ? 'Added' : 'Removed'} ${changed.length} folder(s).`, 'success');
      await refreshRoots();
      await tree.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(`Could not update workspace folders: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      actionButtons.forEach(item => { item.disabled = false; });
    }
  }));

  refreshRoots().catch(error => setStatus(`Could not load workspace folders: ${error.message}`, 'danger'));
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/views/knowledge_view.js`
```javascript
/** Manage knowledge sources and their background indexing jobs. */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { AppState, esc } from '../shell.js';
import { ragWarningNodes } from '../rag_warnings.js';

export function renderKnowledgeView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Knowledge sources</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Manage indexed folders used by knowledge retrieval.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <section class="card root-management">
        <h3>Sources</h3>
        <ul class="root-path-list rag-base-list" data-role="sources" aria-label="Knowledge sources">
          <li class="text-muted small">Loading sources…</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="small" data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <details class="ov-add-source" open>
          <summary>Add a knowledge source</summary>
          <form data-role="add-source">
            <label class="small" for="knowledge-name">Source name</label>
            <input id="knowledge-name" class="form-input" name="name" type="text" required
              placeholder="Business decisions">
            <label class="small" for="knowledge-path">Folder to index</label>
            <textarea id="knowledge-path" class="form-input root-path-input" name="path" rows="2" required
              placeholder="E:\\Documents\\Knowledge"></textarea>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save knowledge source</button>
          </form>
        </details>
      </section>
      <section class="card root-management">
        <h3>Indexing</h3>
        <div class="root-management-actions">
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="index">Index selected source</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="pause">Pause</button>
          <button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-action="stop">Stop indexing</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="resume">Resume</button>
          <button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-action="clear">Clear selected index</button>
        </div>
        <p class="small" data-role="job" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading indexing status…</p>
        <div class="root-management-actions" data-role="error-actions" hidden>
          <span class="small" data-role="error-question"></span>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="error-retry">Retry this file</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="error-skip">Skip this file</button>
          <button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-action="error-skip-all">Skip all remaining errors</button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>`;

  const sourceList = container.querySelector('[data-role="sources"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  const jobStatus = container.querySelector('[data-role="job"]');
  const selectedActionButtons = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-action]')];
  let sources = [];
  let selectedSourceId = null;

  function showStatus(message, kind = 'muted') {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  function renderSources() {
    sourceList.replaceChildren();
    sources.forEach(source => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      item.className = `rag-base-item${source.selected ? ' rag-base-selected' : ''}`;
      item.dataset.sourceId = source.id;
      const name = document.createElement('strong');
      name.textContent = `${source.name}${source.active ? '' : ' (archived)'}`;
      const path = document.createElement('code');
      path.textContent = source.path;
      const detail = document.createElement('span');
      detail.className = 'small text-muted';
      detail.textContent = `${source.selected ? 'Selected · ' : ''}${source.exists ? 'Folder available' : 'Folder unavailable'}${source.cloud_provider ? ` · ${source.cloud_provider}` : ''} · ${source.documents} document(s) · ${source.chunks} chunks`;
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'root-management-actions';
      const addAction = (label, action, disabled = false) => {
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'btn btn-sm';
        button.textContent = label;
        button.dataset.sourceAction = action;
        button.disabled = disabled;
        actions.appendChild(button);
      };
      addAction(source.selected ? 'Selected' : 'Select', 'select', source.selected || !source.active);
      addAction('Open folder', 'open', !source.exists);
      addAction('Rename', 'rename');
      addAction(source.active ? 'Archive' : 'Restore', source.active ? 'archive' : 'restore');
      addAction('Delete branch', 'delete');
      item.append(name, path, detail, ...ragWarningNodes(source.warnings), actions);
      sourceList.appendChild(item);
    });
    if (!sources.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('li');
      empty.className = 'text-muted small';
      empty.textContent = 'No knowledge sources yet.';
      sourceList.appendChild(empty);
    }
  }

  async function loadSources() {
    const data = await Api.getRagBases();
    sources = data.bases || [];
    selectedSourceId = sources.find(source => source.selected && source.active)?.id
      || (sources.some(source => source.id === selectedSourceId && source.active)
        ? selectedSourceId
        : sources.find(source => source.active)?.id)
      || null;
    if (!sources.some(source => source.id === selectedSourceId)) selectedSourceId = null;
    renderSources();
    const selected = sources.find(source => source.id === selectedSourceId);
    showStatus(selected
      ? `Selected source: ${selected.name} — ${selected.path}${selected.exists ? '' : ' (folder unavailable)'}` +
        (selected.cloud_provider ? ` · ${selected.cloud_provider} folder: online-only files are downloaded before indexing` : '')
      : 'No knowledge sources yet. Save a named source to create the first branch.');
  }

  function renderJob(job) {
    AppState.ragScanJob = job;
    const base = sources.find(source => source.id === job.base_id);
    const progress = `${job.completed || 0}/${job.discovered || 0} file(s) checked · ` +
      `${job.indexed || 0} indexed · ${job.unchanged || 0} unchanged · ` +
      `${job.skipped?.length || 0} skipped · ${job.errors?.length || 0} errors`;
    const current = job.current ? ` — ${job.current}${job.phase ? ` (${job.phase})` : ''}` : '';
    const firstError = job.errors?.[0];
    const errors = job.errors?.length
      ? `; ${job.errors.length} error(s), e.g. ${firstError.path || ''} — ${firstError.error || 'see server log'}`
      : '';
    const pending = job.pending_error
      ? ` · Needs a choice: ${job.pending_error.path} — ${job.pending_error.error}`
      : '';
    const resumeAt = job.resume_at ? ` · Scheduled resume ${new Date(job.resume_at).toLocaleString()}` : '';
    const warnings = job.warnings?.length
      ? ` ⚠ ${job.warnings.map(warning => warning.message).join(' ')}`
      : '';
    const labels = {
      queued: 'Starting',
      running: 'Indexing',
      pausing: 'Pausing after current file',
      stopping: 'Stopping after current file',
      stopped: 'Stopped',
      awaiting_decision: 'Waiting for your choice',
      paused: 'Paused',
      completed: 'Complete',
      completed_with_skips: 'Complete (some files skipped)',
      completed_with_errors: 'Complete with errors',
      unavailable: 'Folder unavailable',
      idle: 'Waiting to start'
    };
    const state = labels[job.status] || job.status;
    jobStatus.textContent = job.status === 'idle'
      ? 'Index status: Waiting to start.'
      : `${base?.name || 'Knowledge source'}: ${state} — ${progress}${pending ? ` — ${pending}` : errors}${resumeAt}${current}${warnings}`;
    jobStatus.className = `small ${
      warnings && ['completed', 'completed_with_skips'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
        : ['completed', 'completed_with_skips', 'running', 'queued'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-success'
        : ['paused', 'pausing', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
          : ['failed', 'completed_with_errors', 'unavailable'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-danger'
            : 'text-muted'
    }`;

    const active = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'stopping'].includes(job.status);
    const blocksMutation = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'stopping', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
    const selectedJob = !job.base_id || job.base_id === selectedSourceId;
    container.querySelector('[data-action="index"]').disabled = active || !selectedSourceId;
    container.querySelector('[data-action="pause"]').disabled = !active || job.status === 'pausing';
    container.querySelector('[data-action="stop"]').disabled =
      !['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
    container.querySelector('[data-action="resume"]').disabled =
      !selectedJob || !['paused', 'unavailable', 'failed'].includes(job.status);
    container.querySelector('[data-action="clear"]').disabled = !selectedSourceId || blocksMutation;
    const errorActions = container.querySelector('[data-role="error-actions"]');
    errorActions.hidden = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
    container.querySelector('[data-role="error-question"]').textContent = job.pending_error
      ? 'Retry this file, skip only it, or skip all remaining errors?'
      : '';
    errorActions.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
      button.disabled = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
    });
    sourceList.querySelectorAll('[data-source-action="delete"]').forEach(button => {
      const source = button.closest('[data-source-id]');
      button.disabled = blocksMutation && job.status !== 'paused' && job.base_id === source.dataset.sourceId;
    });
  }

  async function refreshJob() {
    try {
      renderJob(await Api.getRagScan());
    } catch (error) {
      jobStatus.textContent = `Could not load indexing status: ${error.message}`;
      jobStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
    }
  }

  sourceList.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-source-action]');
    if (!button) return;
    const item = button.closest('[data-source-id]');
    const source = sources.find(entry => entry.id === item.dataset.sourceId);
    if (!source) return;
    const action = button.dataset.sourceAction;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      if (action === 'select') {
        await Api.selectRagBase(source.id);
        selectedSourceId = source.id;
        await loadSources();
        showStatus(`Selected "${source.name}".`, 'success');
      } else if (action === 'open') {
        await Api.openRagBaseFolder(source.id);
        showStatus(`Opened folder for "${source.name}".`, 'success');
      } else if (action === 'rename') {
        const name = prompt('New knowledge source name:', source.name);
        if (name === null || !name.trim()) {
          button.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        await Api.renameRagBase(source.id, name);
        await loadSources();
        showStatus(`Renamed source to "${name.trim()}".`, 'success');
      } else if (action === 'archive' || action === 'restore') {
        if (action === 'archive' &&
            !confirm(`Archive "${source.name}"? Its folder and index will be kept.`)) {
          button.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        if (action === 'archive') await Api.archiveRagBase(source.id);
        else {
          await Api.restoreRagBase(source.id);
          selectedSourceId = source.id;
        }
        await loadSources();
        showStatus(`${action === 'archive' ? 'Archived' : 'Restored'} "${source.name}".`, 'success');
      } else if (action === 'delete') {
        if (!confirm(`Delete "${source.name}" and its index? The folder and its files will remain.`)) {
          button.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        const result = await Api.deleteRagBase(source.id);
        await loadSources();
        showStatus(`Deleted "${result.name}" and ${result.documents_removed} indexed document(s).`, 'success');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showStatus(`Could not ${action} source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  container.querySelector('[data-role="add-source"]').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const button = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const added = await Api.addRagBase(String(data.get('name')).trim(), String(data.get('path')).trim());
      selectedSourceId = added.id;
      await loadSources();
      form.reset();
      showStatus(`Saved "${added.name}" for ${added.path}.`, 'success');
    } catch (error) {
      showStatus(`Could not save source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  selectedActionButtons.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const action = button.dataset.action;
    if (action.startsWith('error-') && !AppState.ragScanJob?.pending_error) return;
    if (action === 'clear' &&
        !confirm(`Clear the saved index for "${sources.find(source => source.id === selectedSourceId)?.name}"? The source folder and files will remain.`)) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      if (action === 'index') {
        const job = await Api.reindexRag(selectedSourceId);
        renderJob(job);
        if (job.status === 'paused') {
          showStatus('The previous scan is still paused. Resume it to retry unfinished files.', 'warning');
        } else if (['queued', 'running'].includes(job.status)) {
          showStatus('Indexing started.', 'success');
        } else {
          showStatus(`The scan was not started (status: ${job.status}).`, 'warning');
        }
      } else if (action === 'pause') {
        renderJob(await Api.pauseRagScan());
        showStatus('Indexing paused after the current file finishes.', 'success');
      } else if (action === 'stop') {
        renderJob(await Api.stopRagScan());
        showStatus('Indexing will stop after the current file finishes.', 'success');
      } else if (action === 'resume') {
        renderJob(await Api.resumeRagScan());
        showStatus('Indexing resumed.', 'success');
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        const result = await Api.clearRagIndex(selectedSourceId);
        await loadSources();
        showStatus(`Cleared ${result.removed} indexed document(s).`, 'success');
      } else if (action.startsWith('error-')) {
        const decision = {
          'error-retry': 'retry',
          'error-skip': 'skip',
          'error-skip-all': 'skip_all'
        }[action];
        renderJob(await Api.decideRagScanError(decision));
        showStatus(
          decision === 'retry' ? 'Retrying the failed file.'
            : decision === 'skip' ? 'Skipped this file; Novous will ask again if another file fails.'
              : 'Skipping all remaining file errors automatically.',
          'success'
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showStatus(`Could not ${action}: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      await refreshJob();
    }
  }));

  loadSources()
    .then(refreshJob)
    .catch(error => showStatus(`Could not load knowledge sources: ${error.message}`, 'danger'));
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!container.isConnected) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      return;
    }
    refreshJob();
  }, 1500);
}

```

## `frontend/static/js/views/models_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Models section: the context window and tool limit each installed model runs with.
 * Suggested values follow the model's size; saving a profile overrides them. Changes apply to
 * the next message, and the chat keeps its history.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc } from '../shell.js';

export function renderModelsView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Models</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Context window and tool limit for each installed model. Smaller models do best with a smaller window and fewer tools.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn" data-act="refresh">Refresh</button>
      </header>
      <p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error hidden" data-role="status" role="alert"></p>
      <div class="model-profile-list" data-role="list"><p class="text-muted">Loading models…</p></div>
    </div>`;

  const list = container.querySelector('[data-role="list"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');

  function showStatus(message) {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  function modelCard(model) {
    const size = model.parameter_size || (model.size_b ? `${model.size_b}B` : 'size unknown');
    const native = model.native_context || 131072;
    const suggested = model.suggested;
    const capabilities = model.capabilities.map(c => `<span class="badge">${esc(c)}</span>`).join(' ');
    const notes = [];
    if (!model.available) notes.push('Ollama could not describe this model, so suggested values are used.');
    if (model.capabilities.length && !model.capabilities.includes('tools')) {
      notes.push('This model does not list tool support, so tool calls may fail.');
    }
    return `
      <article class="card model-profile-card" data-model="${esc(model.model)}">
        <div class="model-profile-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${esc(model.model)}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(size)} · model maximum ${model.native_context ? `${model.native_context} tokens` : 'unknown'}</p>
          </div>
          <span class="badge ${model.source === 'saved' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${model.source === 'saved' ? 'Saved' : 'Suggested'}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="model-profile-caps">${capabilities}</p>
        ${notes.map(note => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(note)}</p>`).join('')}
        <form class="model-profile-form" data-role="form">
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Context window (tokens)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="num_ctx" min="2048" max="${native}" step="256"
                   value="${model.num_ctx}" required>
          </label>
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Reply reserve (tokens)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="reply_reserve" min="256" step="128"
                   value="${model.reply_reserve}" required>
          </label>
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Tools sent (blank = all)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="max_tools" min="0" max="64"
                   value="${model.max_tools ?? ''}" placeholder="all">
          </label>
          <div class="model-profile-actions">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Save</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="reset" ${model.source === 'suggested' ? 'disabled' : ''}>Reset to suggested</button>
            <span class="text-muted small">Suggested: ${suggested.num_ctx} tokens, ${suggested.max_tools ?? 'all'} tools</span>
          </div>
          <p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        </form>
      </article>`;
  }

  async function load() {
    showStatus('');
    try {
      const data = await Api.getModelProfiles();
      if (data.error) showStatus(data.error);
      list.innerHTML = data.models.length
        ? data.models.map(modelCard).join('')
        : '<p class="text-muted">No installed models found. Pull a model in Ollama, then refresh.</p>';
    } catch (err) {
      list.innerHTML = '';
      showStatus(`Could not load models: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  container.querySelector('[data-act="refresh"]').addEventListener('click', load);

  list.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target.closest('[data-role="form"]');
    const card = form.closest('[data-model]');
    const error = form.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const maxTools = String(data.get('max_tools') ?? '').trim();
    error.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      await Api.saveModelProfile(card.dataset.model, {
        num_ctx: Number(data.get('num_ctx')),
        reply_reserve: Number(data.get('reply_reserve')),
        max_tools: maxTools === '' ? null : Number(maxTools)
      });
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      error.textContent = err.message;
      error.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  });

  list.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-act="reset"]');
    if (!button) return;
    const card = button.closest('[data-model]');
    try {
      await Api.resetModelProfile(card.dataset.model);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(`Could not reset ${card.dataset.model}: ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  load();
}

```

## `frontend/static/js/views/workspace_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Workspace view: manage squad folders and link to squad workflows.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { AppState, esc, navigate, refreshSquads } from '../shell.js';

export function renderWorkspaceView(container) {
  const squads = AppState.squads || [];

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Squad folders</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Create and organize the folders used by the squad workspace.</p>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-action="show-create">New folder</button>
      </header>
      <form class="card hidden" data-role="create-form">
        <label class="small" for="workspace-squad-name">Folder name</label>
        <input id="workspace-squad-name" class="form-input" name="name" maxlength="64"
          placeholder="e.g. Research" required>
        <label class="small" for="workspace-squad-description">Description</label>
        <input id="workspace-squad-description" class="form-input" name="description" maxlength="500">
        <p class="small text-danger" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="toolbar-row">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Create folder</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-action="cancel-create">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </form>
      <section class="card">
        <ul class="squad-list" data-role="squad-list">
          ${squads.map(squad => `
            <li class="squad-item">
              <div>
                <strong>${esc(squad.name)}</strong>
                <span class="text-muted">${esc(squad.description || squad.path)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="toolbar-row">
                <button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" data-open-squads>Open squads</button>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" type="button" data-delete-squad="${esc(squad.name)}">Delete</button>
              </div>
            </li>`).join('')
            || '<li class="text-muted small">No squad folders yet.</li>'}
        </ul>
        <p class="small" data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </section>
    </div>`;

  const form = container.querySelector('[data-role="create-form"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  container.querySelector('[data-action="show-create"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
    form.classList.remove('hidden');
    form.querySelector('[name="name"]').focus();
  });
  container.querySelector('[data-action="cancel-create"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
    form.classList.add('hidden');
    form.reset();
  });
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const submit = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    submit.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.createSquad(String(data.get('name')).trim(), String(data.get('description')).trim());
      await refreshSquads();
      renderWorkspaceView(container);
    } catch (error) {
      form.querySelector('[data-role="error"]').textContent = error.message;
    } finally {
      submit.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  container.querySelector('[data-role="squad-list"]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const openButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-squads]');
    if (openButton) {
      navigate('squads');
      return;
    }
    const deleteButton = event.target.closest('[data-delete-squad]');
    if (!deleteButton) return;
    const name = deleteButton.dataset.deleteSquad;
    if (!confirm(`Delete squad folder "${name}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    deleteButton.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.deleteSquad(name);
      await refreshSquads();
      renderWorkspaceView(container);
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = `Could not delete squad folder: ${error.message}`;
      status.className = 'small text-danger';
      deleteButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });
}

```

```markdown
---
id: caller-01

  - write_chat_scratchpad

---
# calling subagents

## Role
You are an AI agent designed to facilitate communication and task delegation among multiple subagents. Your specialized identity is that of a "calling subagents" agent, and your function is to read the current state of the conversation from the scratchpad, decide which subagent to call based on the context and requirements of the conversation, and write the response back to the scratchpad. You are a coordinating agent that ensures the efficient and effective interaction between the main agent and its subagents to achieve the desired outcomes.

## Purpose
The purpose of this agent is to read the current state of the conversation from the scratchpad, determine which subagent is best suited to handle the next step based on the context and requirements of the conversation, and write the subagent's response back to the scratchpad, ensuring seamless and effective communication and task delegation among the subagents.

## Responsibilities
- Read the current state of the conversation from the scratchpad.
- Determine which subagent is best suited to handle the next step based on the context and requirements of the conversation.
- Write the response from the called subagent back to the scratchpad.
- Ensure seamless and effective communication and task delegation among the subagents.
- Maintain the flow of the conversation by coordinating between the main agent and the subagents.
- Handle any errors or issues that arise during the communication and task delegation process.

## Execution Instructions
1. Read the current state of the conversation from the scratchpad using the `read_chat_scratchpad` tool.
2. Analyze the context and requirements of the conversation to determine which subagent is best suited to handle the next step.
3. Call the identified subagent using the `call_subagent` tool.
4. Receive the response from the called subagent.
5. Write the response from the subagent back to the scratchpad using the `write_chat_scratchpad` tool.
6. Ensure seamless and effective communication and task delegation among the subagents.
7. Maintain the flow of the conversation by coordinating between the main agent and the subagents.
8. Handle any errors or issues that arise during the communication and task delegation process.

## Boundaries
- The agent must not modify the AGENT ID or AGENT NAME.
- The agent must not execute any actions outside of its defined responsibilities.
- The agent must not access or modify any data beyond the information provided in the scratchpad.
- The agent must not initiate communication with the main agent or any other external entities without being prompted by the conversation context.
- The agent must not alter the conversation history or context in any way.
- The agent must not make decisions based on personal preferences or opinions.
- The agent must not disclose any confidential or sensitive information.
- The agent must not attempt to bypass or interfere with the security measures in place.
- The agent must not generate content that is harmful, inappropriate, or violates ethical standards.
- The agent must not assume roles or identities beyond its designated purpose as a "calling subagents" agent.

## Communication
- The agent reports its actions and decisions by writing relevant information back to the scratchpad using the `write_chat_scratchpad` tool.
- The agent communicates results by relaying the responses from called subagents back to the scratchpad.
- The agent ensures seamless communication by coordinating between the main agent and subagents, writing necessary updates and instructions to the scratchpad.
- The agent handles errors or issues by writing error messages or alternative instructions to the scratchpad, facilitating troubleshooting and resolution.

## Available Tools

### read_chat_scratchpad
Read one entry from this chat's scratchpad by agent name and title. Paired with write_chat_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

Parameters:
- agent (required): [TOOL 1 AGENT] - Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
- title (required): [TOOL 1 TITLE] - The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
- index: [TOOL 1 INDEX] - 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
- offset: [TOOL 1 OFFSET] - Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

Return format: See the tool documentation above. If it does not specify a format, inspect the actual result; do not assume JSON.

### write_chat_scratchpad
Save content to this chat's scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_chat_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_chat_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

Parameters:
- agent (required): [TOOL 2 AGENT] - Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
- title (required): [TOOL 2 TITLE] - The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
- content (required): [TOOL 2 CONTENT] - The text to save.

Return format: See the tool documentation above. If it does not specify a format, inspect the actual result; do not assume JSON.

### call_subagent
Dynamically invoke a background sub-agent from subAgentLibrary/ with a task prompt and parameters. In a chat, its output is saved to the chat scratchpad as agent=<subagent_id>, title=result.

Parameters:
- subagent_id (required): [TOOL 3 SUBAGENT_ID] - The canonical sub-agent ID.
- task_prompt (required): [TOOL 3 TASK_PROMPT] - Instructions for the sub-agent describing the work to perform.
- parameters: [TOOL 3 PARAMETERS] - JSON string of key-value pairs passed to the sub-agent. Default {}.

Return format: See the tool documentation above. If it does not specify a format, inspect the actual result; do not assume JSON.

```

```markdown
## Role
Helpful Assistant that will Answear Questions and use tools to pefomr actions

## Hallucination Control
You must strictly adhere to the information present in the provided context or the results returned by the tool calls. If you do not know the answer or cannot find the necessary information, you must state clearly that you do not have the information rather than fabricating a response. Always verify any action taken based on a tool result before proceeding.


## Scratchpad
You must utilize a dedicated scratchpad to plan complex multi-step operations, intermediate calculations, or complex file paths before attempting to execute external tools. The scratchpad should be used for internal reasoning and planning; the final output to the user should be clear and actionable based on this planning.

Note: you have read_chat_scratchpad but not write_chat_scratchpad. You never write your own scratchpad entries; use read_chat_scratchpad only to read entries other tools or agents have already saved (for example, the full text a read_file call stashed under agent=read_file). This asymmetry is intentional, not a missing tool.

## Available Tools

### create_folder
Create workspace folders using relative paths.  - Creates a folder, including any missing parent directories, at the specified path. - Uses exist_ok=True to avoid errors if the directory already exists. - Returns JSON describing the folder creation operation.

Parameters:
- path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.

### map_files
Return a directory tree and save a copy in the shared agent-memory scratchpad.

Parameters:
- path: The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.

### delete_file
Delete a file or directory from the workspace by relative path.

Parameters:
- path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.

### read_file
Read a UTF-8 text or Docling-supported document from the configured file-manager root.  PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT documents are text-extracted with Docling; OCR is enabled for PDFs to support scanned pages. Text files are limited to 1 MB; documents to 25 MB and 1 MB of extracted text. Inside a chat, the full text is saved to the chat scratchpad as agent=read_file, title=<path>, and read_chat_scratchpad pages through it. Returns JSON with the request, path, the first page of content (with next_offset when the file is longer), and scratchpad context for fetching the rest.

Parameters:
- path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.
- request: An optional question or focus area to guide what is returned.

### write_file
Write UTF-8 content to a workspace file by relative path (bare filenames go in the root).  Overwrites existing files and creates missing parent directories. Supports formats such as .txt, .md, .py, .json, .html, .css, and .js. Returns JSON with the resolved path and bytes written.

Parameters:
- path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.
- content (required): The text to save.

### read_chat_scratchpad
Read one entry from this chat's scratchpad by agent name and title. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

Parameters:
- agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
- title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
- index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
- offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.
```

```markdown
# Coding Planner

## Role
You plan Python code for the CodeBuilder editor. The Code Builder writes the code from your plan, a tester checks it, and a troubleshooter fixes failures. You only plan; you never write the full module or claim that code was written, run, or tested.

## Planning rules
1. The exact user request is the only source of requirements. Do not add features, frameworks, or files the user did not ask for.
2. Target one self-contained Python module using the standard library unless the user asks otherwise.
3. If the editor already contains code, plan the change to that code and keep existing behavior.
4. Interactive or entry-point code belongs under if __name__ == "__main__": so the module can be imported and tested.
5. If something essential is unclear, state your assumption in one line and continue.

## Output format
Short Markdown, no full code:
- **Goal:** one sentence.
- **Functions/classes:** name, inputs, what it returns or does.
- **Flow:** how the pieces fit together, including the main entry point.
- **Checks:** 2-4 concrete behaviors the tester should assert.

## Tools (chat use only)
When chatting directly, you may use map_files, read_file, and project_status to inspect the workspace. Use read_coding_scratchpad with the agent name and title to read a specific plan, code, or test result, and write_coding_scratchpad with your agent name, a title, and the content to leave a plan or note the squad should follow. After writing, call read_coding_scratchpad with the exact same agent and title to confirm the saved content matches what you wrote; only treat the plan or note as saved once that read-back confirms it, retrying the write once if it doesn't match. Never invent file contents or tool results. This planner is read-only for workspace files.

## Available Tools

### map_files
Return a directory tree and save a copy in the shared agent-memory scratchpad.

Parameters:
- path: The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.

### read_file
Read a UTF-8 text or Docling-supported document from the configured file-manager root.  PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT documents are text-extracted with Docling; OCR is enabled for PDFs to support scanned pages. Text files are limited to 1 MB; documents to 25 MB and 1 MB of extracted text. Inside a chat, the full text is saved to the chat scratchpad as agent=read_file, title=<path>, and read_chat_scratchpad pages through it. Returns JSON with the request, path, the first page of content (with next_offset when the file is longer), and scratchpad context for fetching the rest.

Parameters:
- path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.
- request: An optional question or focus area to guide what is returned.

### project_status
Return the current project state metadata for this workspace.

### read_coding_scratchpad
Read one coding scratchpad entry by agent name and title. Paired with write_coding_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

Parameters:
- agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
- title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
- index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
- offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

### write_coding_scratchpad
Save content to the coding scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_coding_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_coding_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

Parameters:
- agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
- title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
- content (required): The text to save.
```
