            f"User request: {ctx.query}\n\n{self._buffer_section(ctx.code)}\n\n"
            f"{self._run_notes_section(ctx.trace_id)}\n"
            f"The latest test failed with this evidence:\n{evidence}\n\n"
            "Find the root cause in the module and fix it with the smallest correct change. "
            "Interactive or entry-point code must stay under `if __name__ == \"__main__\":`. "
            "Return the COMPLETE corrected module in exactly one ```python block, then 1-3 "
            "short lines explaining the cause and the fix."
        )
        reply = self._ask_agent(ctx, "fix", prompt, attempt)
        code = self.extract_python_block(reply)
        if code is None or code == ctx.code:
            reason = "no Python code block" if code is None else "an unchanged module"
            self._handoff(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "nothing_found", {"summary": f"Troubleshooter returned {reason}."})
            self._note(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "fix", f"Fix attempt {attempt}: returned {reason}", reply, "nothing_found")
            self._record(ctx, "fix", "ERROR", f"Troubleshooter returned {reason}")
            self._step_status(ctx, "fix", "error", attempt, f"Returned {reason}.")
            return False
        lines = self.apply_code(ctx, code, "code-troubleshooter")
        self._handoff(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "success", {"summary": "Applied fix to editor.", "changed_lines": len(lines)})
        self._note(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "fix", f"Fix attempt {attempt} ({len(lines)} lines changed)", reply)
        self._record(ctx, "fix", "SUCCESS", f"Applied fix attempt {attempt} ({len(lines)} changed lines)")
        self._step_status(ctx, "fix", "success", attempt, f"{len(lines)} lines changed")
        return True

    def _fix_loop(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext) -> bool:
        """Fix and retest until the tests pass or attempts run out."""
        for attempt in range(1, self.MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
            if not self.step_fix(ctx, attempt):
                return False
            if self.step_test(ctx, attempt):
                return True
        ctx.notes.append(f"Tests still fail after {self.MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS} fix attempts.")
        return False

    @staticmethod
    def _summary(ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, action: str, passed: bool | None) -> str:
        lines = [f"**{action.capitalize()}** finished."]
        for step in ctx.steps:
            mark = "✓" if step.status == "SUCCESS" else "✗"
            lines.append(f"- {mark} {step.details}")
        if passed is True:
            lines.append("\nThe module passed its checks.")
        elif passed is False and ctx.last_test:
            detail = (ctx.last_test.get("stderr") or ctx.last_test.get("stdout") or "").strip()
            if detail:
                lines.append(f"\nLast failure:\n```\n{detail[-1_500:]}\n```")
        lines.extend(ctx.notes)
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # --- entry point -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def run(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        if not request.trace_id:
            request.trace_id = f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
            telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(request.trace_id)
        trace_id = request.trace_id
        action = self.ACTION_ALIASES.get(request.workflow_action, request.workflow_action)
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(CODE_SQUAD_ID) or {}
        squad_scratchpad.begin(trace_id, CODE_SQUAD_ID, request.user_query)
        params = request.parameters or {}
        editor_code = params.get("editor_code")
        ctx = CodeSquadRunContext(
            trace_id=trace_id,
            request=request,
            code=editor_code if isinstance(editor_code, str) else "",
            plan=str(params.get("plan") or ""),
            model=str(params.get("model") or "") or None,
        )
        if codebuilder_run_state.get_editor_code(trace_id) is None:
            codebuilder_run_state.begin(trace_id, ctx.code, request.user_query, action)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            trace_id, "RUN_STARTED", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
            {"squad_id": CODE_SQUAD_ID, "pattern": squad.get("default_pattern", "sequential")},
        )
        status = "success"
        passed: bool | None = None
        try:
            if action == "plan":
                self.step_plan(ctx)
            elif action == "build":
                if not ctx.plan:
                    stored = code_scratchpad.latest("plan")
                    ctx.plan = stored["content"] if stored else ""
                if not self.step_build(ctx):
                    status = "error"
            elif action == "test":
                passed = self.step_test(ctx)
            elif action == "fix":
                if ctx.last_test is None and self.step_test(ctx):
                    passed = True
                    ctx.notes.append("Tests already pass; no fix was needed.")
                else:
                    passed = self._fix_loop(ctx)
            else:  # all
                self.step_plan(ctx)
                if not self.step_build(ctx):
                    status = "error"
                else:
                    passed = self.step_test(ctx) or self._fix_loop(ctx)
            if passed is False:
                status = "error"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, passed)
        except PipelineCancelled:
            status = "cancelled"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, None) + "\n\nStopped by user."
        except Exception as exc:
            status = "error"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, None) + f"\n\nWorkflow failed: {exc}"
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
                {"error": f"Workflow failed: {exc}", "status": "error"},
            )

        self._note(
            ctx, "orchestrator", "summary", f"{action.capitalize()} {status}: {request.user_query[:120]}",
            final_answer, status if status in {"success", "error"} else "nothing_found",
        )
        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        squad_registry.record_squad_run(CODE_SQUAD_ID, status == "success", duration_ms)
        handoffs = codebuilder_run_state.get_handoffs(trace_id)
        response = OrchestrationResponse(
            trace_id=trace_id,
            pattern=request.pattern or "sequential",
            query=request.user_query,
            status=status,
            final_answer=final_answer,
            result_payload={
                "action": action,
                "plan": ctx.plan,
                "code": ctx.code,
                "last_test": ctx.last_test,
            },
            execution_trace=ctx.steps,
        )
        squad_scratchpad.finish(trace_id, status)
        # Save before RUN_COMPLETE so the client's result fetch never races a 404.
        run_results.save(
            trace_id,
            {
                **response.model_dump(),
                "squad_id": CODE_SQUAD_ID,
                "agent_stats": summarize_agent_usage(telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id)),
                "scratchpad_snapshot": {
                    "latest_subagent_result": handoffs[-1] if handoffs else {},
                    "subagent_history": handoffs,
                },
            },
        )
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
            {"status": status, "duration_ms": duration_ms},
        )
        telemetry_bus.finish_trace(trace_id)
        return response


# --- Dispatch and background runs ------------------------------------------------------

class PipelineRegistry:
    """Runs the controlled sequential workflow and handles legacy pattern aliases.

    Requests for ``code-squad`` always go to the Code Development Squad pipeline.
    """

    PATTERNS: Dict[str, Type[BasePattern]] = {
        "sequential": SequentialPattern,
    }

    def get_pattern(self, pattern_name: str | None) -> BasePattern:
        key = squad_registry.normalize_pattern((pattern_name or "sequential").lower().strip())
        return self.PATTERNS[key]()

    @staticmethod
    def resolve_pattern(request: OrchestrationRequest) -> str:
        """A run's explicit pattern wins; otherwise the registered squad's default applies."""
        if request.pattern:
            return squad_registry.normalize_pattern(request.pattern)
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(request.squad_id or "") if request.squad_id else None
        return squad_registry.normalize_pattern(str((squad or {}).get("default_pattern") or "sequential"))

    def run_orchestration(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        if request.squad_id == CODE_SQUAD_ID:
            return code_squad_pipeline.run(request)
        request.pattern = self.resolve_pattern(request)
        return self.get_pattern(request.pattern).execute(request)


class OrchestrationRunService:
    """Runs one squad workflow at a time and bounds the accepted queue."""

    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = 1, capacity: int = 10):
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers, thread_name_prefix="orchestration")
        self._capacity = BoundedSemaphore(capacity)

    def start_rule_flow(self, squad_id: str, query: str, flow: dict,
                        profiles: dict[str, AgentProfile], max_steps: int) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Queue a saved rule-based flow on the same worker as existing squads."""
        if not self._capacity.acquire(blocking=False):
            raise RunCapacityError("Orchestration capacity is full. Try again after a run completes.")
        trace_id = f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        try:
            telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(trace_id)
            self._executor.submit(self._run_rule_flow, trace_id, squad_id, query, flow, profiles, max_steps)
        except Exception:
            self._capacity.release()
            raise
        return {"trace_id": trace_id, "squad_id": squad_id}

    def _run_rule_flow(self, trace_id: str, squad_id: str, query: str, flow: dict,
                       profiles: dict[str, AgentProfile], max_steps: int) -> None:
        steps = []
        current = flow["start"]
        handoff = ""
        status = "error"
        answer = "Workflow did not complete."
        started = time.monotonic()
        scratchpad_started = False
        try:
            squad_scratchpad.begin(trace_id, squad_id, query)
            scratchpad_started = True
            telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "RUN_STARTED", "orchestrator", squad_id,
                                    {"squad_id": squad_id, "pattern": "rules"})
            for number in range(1, max_steps + 1):
                profile = profiles[current]
                telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", "orchestrator", current,
                                        {"summary": "Agent step started", "status": "running"})
                try:
                    agent = Agent(model=profile.model, tools=[], profile=profile, session=trace_id)
                    if profile.mode == "agent" and profile.tools:
                        apply_model_limits(agent, profile, agent.model)
                        if agent.tools_missing or agent.tools_dropped:
                            raise ValueError("Model cannot access all configured tools: " +
                                             ", ".join(agent.tools_missing + agent.tools_dropped))
                    else:
                        agent.num_ctx = model_profiles.effective(agent.model)["num_ctx"]
                    prompt = f"User request:\n{query}"
                    if handoff:
                        prompt += f"\n\nPrevious step handoff:\n{handoff}"
                    session_token = set_current_session_id(trace_id)
                    try:
                        with telemetry_bus.agent_context(trace_id, current):
                            answer = str(agent.think(prompt)).strip()
                    finally:
                        reset_current_session_id(session_token)
                    if not answer:
                        raise RuntimeError("Agent returned an empty result.")
                    if agent.failures:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Agent reported failures: {agent.failures}")
                    outcome = "success"
                except Exception as exc:
                    outcome = "failure"
                    answer = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                steps.append({"step_number": number, "agent_id": current, "status": outcome,
                              "result": answer})
                telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", current, "orchestrator",
                                        {"summary": f"Agent step {outcome}", "status": outcome})
                handoff = f"Agent: {current}\nOutcome: {outcome}\nResult:\n{answer}"
                route = next((r for r in flow["routes"] if r["from"] == current and r["on"] == outcome), None)
                if route is None:
                    status = "success" if outcome == "success" else "error"
                    break
                if number == max_steps:
                    answer = f"Step limit ({max_steps}) reached before routing to {route['to']}.\n\nLast result:\n{answer}"
                    status = "error"
                    break
                current = route["to"]
        except Exception as exc:
            answer = f"Workflow failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            status = "error"
        finally:
            try:
                if scratchpad_started:
                    try:
                        squad_scratchpad.finish(trace_id, status)
                    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
                        status = "error"
                        answer = f"Could not finish the run scratchpad: {exc}\n\nLast result:\n{answer}"
                run_results.save(trace_id, {
                    "trace_id": trace_id, "squad_id": squad_id, "pattern": "rules",
                    "status": status, "final_answer": answer, "execution_trace": steps,
                })
                telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", squad_id,
                                        {"status": status, "duration_ms": int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)})
                telemetry_bus.finish_trace(trace_id)
            finally:
                self._capacity.release()

    def start(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Validate and queue a run; returns its new ``trace_id`` and ``squad_id``."""
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(request.squad_id or "")
        if squad is None:
            raise ValueError("A registered squad_id is required.")
        squad_registry._validate_definition(
            squad["name"], squad["primary_agent"], list(squad.get("subagents") or [])
        )
        if request.workflow_action != "all" and squad["squad_id"] != CODE_SQUAD_ID:
            raise ValueError("Plan, Build, Test, and Fix actions are only available for code-squad.")
        editor_code = request.parameters.get("editor_code", "")
        if not isinstance(editor_code, str):
            raise ValueError("The editor_code parameter must be text.")
        if len(editor_code.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_EDITOR_CONTENT_BYTES:
            raise EditorBufferTooLargeError("The CodeBuilder editor buffer exceeds the 1 MB workflow limit.")
        request.pattern = squad_registry.normalize_pattern(request.pattern or squad["default_pattern"])
        if not self._capacity.acquire(blocking=False):
            raise RunCapacityError("Orchestration capacity is full. Try again after a run completes.")
        request.trace_id = f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        try:
            codebuilder_run_state.begin(
                request.trace_id,
                editor_code,
                user_query=request.user_query,
                workflow_action=request.workflow_action,
                editor_path=str(request.parameters.get("editor_path") or ""),
            )
            telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(request.trace_id)
            self._executor.submit(self._run_background, request)
        except Exception:
            # If trace initialization fails, do not leave a stale editor buffer behind.
            codebuilder_run_state.discard(request.trace_id)
            self._capacity.release()
            raise
        return {"trace_id": request.trace_id, "squad_id": squad["squad_id"]}

    def _run_background(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> None:
        trace_id = request.trace_id or ""
        try:
            pipeline_registry.run_orchestration(request)
        except Exception:
            if squad_scratchpad.get(trace_id) is not None:
                squad_scratchpad.finish(trace_id, "error")
            history = telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id)
            run_results.save(
                trace_id,
                {
                    "trace_id": request.trace_id,
                    "squad_id": request.squad_id,
                    "status": "error",
                    "final_answer": "Workflow failed. See the execution trace for details.",
                    "result_payload": None,
                    "execution_trace": [],
                },
            )
            if not any(event["event_type"] == "RUN_COMPLETE" for event in history):
                receiver = request.squad_id or "orchestrator"
                telemetry_bus.log_event(
                    trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", receiver,
                    {"error": "Orchestration execution failed", "status": "error"},
                )
                telemetry_bus.log_event(
                    trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", receiver,
                    {"status": "error", "duration_ms": 0},
                )
                telemetry_bus.finish_trace(trace_id)
        finally:
            self._capacity.release()


telemetry_bus = TelemetryBus()
run_results = OrchestrationRunResults()
codebuilder_run_state = CodeBuilderRunState()
squad_registry = SquadRegistry()
code_handoffs = CodeHandoffNormalizer()
subagent_runner = SubAgentRunner()
rag_retriever = RagRetriever()
code_squad_pipeline = CodeSquadPipeline()
pipeline_registry = PipelineRegistry()
run_service = OrchestrationRunService()

````

## `orchestration/schemas_orchestration.py`
```python
"""Pydantic schemas for generic orchestration tasks and the Code Development Squad."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, List, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class TraceStep(BaseModel):
    step_number: int
    agent_id: str
    phase: str
    status: str
    details: str
    error_reason: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: str


class OrchestrationRequest(BaseModel):
    trace_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        max_length=80,
        pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$",
        description="Optional trace ID assigned by the orchestration service",
    )
    squad_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Registered squad to associate with this run"
    )
    pattern: Optional[Literal["sequential", "fanout", "router"]] = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Legacy execution strategy. All accepted values run sequentially; leave unset for the squad default."
        ),
    )
    primary_agent: str = Field(
        default="", description="Main user-facing agent ID from library/; empty for leadless squads"
    )
    subagents: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Ordered sub-agent IDs from subAgentLibrary/.",
    )
    workflow_action: Literal["all", "plan", "build", "test", "fix", "troubleshoot"] = Field(
        default="all",
        description="Code Development Squad action; 'troubleshoot' is an alias for 'fix'.",
    )
    user_query: str = Field(..., description="User query or task prompt")
    parameters: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Custom parameters")


SquadPattern = Literal["sequential", "fanout", "router"]


class SquadCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    primary_agent: str = Field(default="", max_length=80, description="Primary agent; empty for leadless squads")
    subagents: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    default_pattern: SquadPattern = Field(
        default="sequential",
        description="Execution is always sequential; fanout and router are accepted as legacy aliases.",
    )
    max_parallel: int = Field(
        default=1, ge=1, le=4,
        description="Deprecated compatibility field; squad steps always run sequentially.",
    )


class SquadUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    primary_agent: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=80)
    subagents: Optional[List[str]] = Field(default=None, max_length=20)
    default_pattern: Optional[SquadPattern] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Execution is always sequential; fanout and router are accepted as legacy aliases.",
    )
    max_parallel: Optional[int] = Field(
        default=None, ge=1, le=4, description="Deprecated compatibility field; execution is sequential."
    )


class SubagentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    subagent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


class OrchestrationResponse(BaseModel):
    trace_id: str
    pattern: str
    query: str
    status: str
    final_answer: str
    result_payload: Optional[Any] = None
    execution_trace: List[TraceStep] = Field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class CodeSquadRunContext:
    """Mutable state of one Code Development Squad run."""

    trace_id: str
    request: OrchestrationRequest
    code: str
    plan: str = ""
    model: str | None = None
    last_test: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    steps: list[TraceStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def query(self) -> str:
        return self.request.user_query

```

## `ragMemory/README_ragMemory.md`
````markdown
# ragMemory: knowledge sources (RAG)

`ragMemory` is the long-term knowledge base: named **knowledge sources** (a name plus
a folder) are scanned in the background, split into chunks, embedded with a local
**Ollama** model (`nomic-embed-text` by default) and stored in **ChromaDB**. Agents and
apps then retrieve the passages most relevant to a question.

The component has no dependency on the rest of Novous, so the same code and the same
databases can be reused in other applications (see
[Reuse in another application](#reuse-in-another-application)).

## Knowledge sources

Novous supports multiple named knowledge sources from **Knowledge Sources** in
Chat & Test Controls. Each source connects one folder to a matching name and a
separate index. Select a source to search or manage its indexed files.
No implicit default source is created. Older default-source configuration is
migrated to a named branch, retaining its legacy index until that branch is
explicitly deleted.

Agent tools expose a live Knowledge TOC with each branch's exact saved name,
ID, active/archive status, and indexed-document/chunk counts. Agents should
look up a requested branch by name, then pass its ID to search or document
tools. Searching returns relevant indexed passages for the agent's context;
listing documents returns metadata only, while reading a specific indexed
document returns its extracted text. Archived branches remain accessible by ID
because archiving preserves the index.

Sources may point to folders that are currently unavailable; their name and
path remain saved, and indexing reports that the folder cannot be scanned.
Archiving removes a source from active selection without deleting its path or
index. Archived sources can be restored later.

Branches can be renamed without changing their folder or index. Deleting a
branch removes its saved source entry and indexed vectors; it never deletes
files from the linked folder. A branch cannot be deleted while its scan is
queued, running, pausing, stopping, awaiting a file-error decision, or paused.
Deleting a paused branch cancels any scheduled resume and stops its paused
worker before removing the branch. For other active scans, use **Stop
indexing** to stop after the current file finishes; wait until the job status
is **Stopped** before deleting the branch. A stopped source is excluded from
automatic scans until indexing is manually started again.

## Indexing

Indexing runs as a background job. The dialog shows progress and document
errors, and supports pausing or stopping between files, resuming, and
scheduling a resume.
Scheduled resumes use the local time selected in the browser and require the
Novous server and computer to remain running and awake. Completed files remain
indexed; on resume, unchanged files are skipped. Stale-document cleanup occurs
only after a scan reaches completion.

When indexing a file fails, the scan pauses for a choice: retry that file, skip
only that file and ask again on a later error, or skip all remaining errors.
Completion reports checked, indexed, unchanged, skipped, and failed counts so
skipped files are not mistaken for successfully indexed files.

Supported files: `.txt .md .markdown .rst .html .htm .csv .json .xml .yaml .yml
.log .py .js .ts .css .toml .ini .sql .sh .ps1` read as text, and `.pdf .docx
.pptx .odt` through Docling. If Docling's PDF parser cannot load, PDFs with
selectable text fall back to PyMuPDF; scanned PDFs that need OCR still require a
working OCR-capable parser. Text is split into 1,400-character chunks with a
200-character overlap, preferring paragraph breaks.

The automatic scanner cycles through active sources for updates every
60 seconds, with a small delay between files (see `RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS`).

## Storage

Everything lives under one folder, **`RAG_HOME`** (inside Novous: `ragMemory/`):

```
RAG_HOME/
  rag_config.json                 # sources: id, name, folder path, active, selected
  data/
    rag_scan_job.json             # current/last background index job
    rag_indexes/
      <source id>.sqlite3         # manifest: documents (path, mtime, size, chunks) + meta
      chroma/                     # ChromaDB: one collection "kb_<source id>" per source
```

* The **manifest** decides what needs reindexing (file modified time and size) and
  records the embedding model and vector size (`meta` table).
* The **Chroma collection** stores each chunk's text, its embedding and
  `{path, chunk_index}` metadata, using cosine distance. A search hit's `score` is the
  cosine similarity, `1 - distance`.
* Each index refuses vectors from a different embedding model or size. After you change
  `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL`, clear and reindex the existing sources.

**Migration from the old format:** before Chroma, vectors were stored as JSON text in
a `chunks` table inside each `.sqlite3` file. The first time an old index is opened,
its stored vectors are copied into Chroma (no re-embedding), the original file is
kept as `<id>.sqlite3.pre-chroma.bak`, and the old table is dropped. You can delete
the `.bak` files once you're happy with the result. On first start, state from the
former `agentMemory/` package is also moved here; nothing is overwritten.

## Code layout

| Module | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `interface_ragMemory.py` | **The only doorway into the component.** The `/api/rag/*` FastAPI `router`, plus the Python functions `configure`, `get_service`, `list_knowledge_sources`, `selected_source_id`, `search_knowledge`, `list_documents`, `read_document`, `add_text`, `add_source`, `start_scan`, `scan_status` and `start_document_scanner` |
| `mcp_ragMemory.py` | MCP server (stdio) exposing the knowledge base as tools; calls only the interface |
| `schemas_ragMemory.py` | `RagConfig`, `KnowledgeBase`, `DocumentRecord`, `ChunkData`, `ScanJobState`, `ScanStatus`, `ScanDecision`, `SearchHit` |
| `logic_ragMemory.py` | `RagDatabaseEngine` (SQLite manifest + Chroma vectors), `OllamaEmbedder`, `RagConfigStore` (`rag_config.json`), `DocumentIndexer` (parse, chunk, embed), `DocumentScannerService` (background job and scanner loop), `RagMemoryService` (facade) and the `create_rag_memory(home)` factory |
| `pyproject.toml` | Makes the folder pip-installable as `novous-ragmemory` (import name `ragMemory`) |

Within Novous, `server.py` mounts `interface_ragMemory.router` and calls
`start_document_scanner()` at startup. `tools/logic_tools.py`, `orchestration/` and
`core_engine/` use the interface functions. Nothing outside this folder (except the
tests) imports `logic_ragMemory`.

## Reuse in another application

### 1. Prerequisites

* Python 3.10+.
* [Ollama](https://ollama.com) running locally, with the embedding model pulled:

  ```
  ollama pull nomic-embed-text
  ```

  To use Ollama on another machine, set `OLLAMA_HOST`, for example
  `OLLAMA_HOST=http://192.168.1.20:11434`.

### 2. Install

Pick one of the following:

* **pip, editable** (picks up changes made in Novous automatically):

  ```
  pip install -e "E:/NovousV3_claude/ragMemory[documents,mcp]"
  ```

* **pip from git**:

  ```
  pip install "novous-ragmemory[documents,mcp] @ git+<repo-url>#subdirectory=ragMemory"
  ```

* **Copy the folder**: copy `ragMemory/` (without `data/` and `rag_config.json`, unless
  you want the databases too) into the other project's root and install its
  dependencies: `pip install ollama "chromadb>=1.0" fastapi`, plus `docling
  docling-slim[format-pdf-docling] pymupdf` for PDF/Office files and `mcp` for the MCP
  server.

Extras: `documents` (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/ODT parsing) and `mcp` (the MCP server).

### 3. Configure

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RAG_HOME` | the `ragMemory/` folder | Where `rag_config.json` and `data/` live |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `nomic-embed-text:latest` | Ollama embedding model (`NOVOUS_EMBEDDING_MODEL` still works) |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` | `16` | Chunks per Ollama embed call |
| `RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS` | `0.15` | Pause between files while scanning; `0` disables it (`NOVOUS_RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS` still works) |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama server address |

**Outside Novous, always set `RAG_HOME`** (or call `configure(home)`). Otherwise a pip
install would write its data into `site-packages`. Set environment variables before
`ragMemory` is first imported.

### 4. Use it from Python

```python
from ragMemory import interface_ragMemory as rag

rag.configure("C:/MyApp/rag")                      # rag_config.json + data/ go here

source = rag.add_source("Manuals", "C:/MyApp/manuals")   # absolute folder; becomes selected
rag.add_text("faq", "Resetting the device: hold power for 10 s.", source["id"])

rag.start_scan(source["id"])                       # background indexing of the folder
print(rag.scan_status()["status"])                 # queued / running / completed ...

hits = rag.search_knowledge("how do I reset it?", top_k=5, source_id=source["id"])
for hit in hits["results"]:
    print(round(hit["score"], 3), hit["path"], hit["content"][:80])
```

To check for folder changes every 60 seconds, call `rag.start_document_scanner()`.
`rag.get_service()` returns the full `RagMemoryService` (rename, archive, pause/resume,
clear index, and so on) when the doorway functions aren't enough.

### 5. Use it from a FastAPI app

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from ragMemory import interface_ragMemory as rag

rag.configure("C:/MyApp/rag")
app = FastAPI()
app.include_router(rag.router)                      # adds /api/rag/*

@app.on_event("startup")
def start_rag():
    rag.start_document_scanner()
```

The routes are the ones the Novous UI uses: `GET /api/rag/bases`, `POST /api/rag/bases`,
`GET /api/rag/documents`, `POST /api/rag/documents` (add text), `POST /api/rag/reindex`,
`GET /api/rag/scan`, and the rest in `interface_ragMemory.py`.

### 6. Use it from any agent, through MCP

The MCP server offers the tools `list_knowledge_sources`, `search_knowledge`,
`list_documents`, `read_document`, `add_text`, `add_source`, `reindex_source` and
`scan_status`.

```
python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag          # read/search + on-demand indexing
python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag --scan   # also auto-scan folders
ragmemory-mcp --home C:/MyApp/rag                               # same, when pip-installed
```

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add ragmemory -- python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag
```

Claude Desktop and other MCP clients (`mcpServers` config):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ragmemory": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["-m", "ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory", "--home", "C:/MyApp/rag"],
      "env": { "OLLAMA_HOST": "http://localhost:11434" }
    }
  }
}
```

If you copied the folder instead of installing it, add `"cwd"` pointing to the folder
that *contains* `ragMemory/`, so that `-m ragMemory...` resolves.

### 7. Reuse the databases

To move an existing knowledge base (for example the one Novous built) to another app or
machine:

1. Stop indexing: stop the Novous server, or wait until the scan status isn't running.
2. Copy `rag_config.json` and the whole `data/` folder from the old `RAG_HOME` into the
   new app's `RAG_HOME`. The `.sqlite3` manifests and the `chroma/` folder belong
   together, so copy both.
3. Use the **same embedding model** (`RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL`) in the new app. A
   different model would produce incompatible vectors, and search would ask you to
   reindex.

Search and document reads work straight away, even if the source folders don't exist
on the new machine. Only rescans need the folders. To point a source at its new
location, use `rag.get_service().set_rag_folder(path)` (for the selected source) or edit
`path` in `rag_config.json`. Paths are stored as absolute paths, and documents indexed
from the old path are replaced on the next full scan.

Several apps can point `RAG_HOME` at the **same** folder to share one knowledge base,
as long as only one of them runs the background scanner.

````

"""RAG doorway: the only entry point into ragMemory for everything outside the package.

* ``router``: the FastAPI routes under /api/rag/*; ``server.py`` (or any FastAPI app)
  mounts it with ``app.include_router(router)``.
* Python functions for tools, orchestration, the MCP server and other applications:
  ``configure`` picks the data home, the rest delegate to the active RagMemoryService.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from ragMemory import logic_ragMemory
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import RagMemoryService

router = APIRouter()
_service: RagMemoryService | None = None


def configure(home: str | Path | None = None) -> RagMemoryService:
    """Use the RAG config and indexes under ``home``; ``None`` restores the default home."""
    global _service
    if _service is not None:
        _service.scanner.stop_scanner()
    _service = logic_ragMemory.create_rag_memory(home) if home else None
    return get_service()


def get_service() -> RagMemoryService:
    """The active RAG service (the module default unless ``configure`` chose a home)."""
    return _service or logic_ragMemory.rag_memory


def start_document_scanner() -> bool:
    """Start automatic background indexing of the configured knowledge sources."""
    return get_service().start_document_scanner()


def list_knowledge_sources() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Every named source with its id, folder, status and indexed document/chunk counts."""
    return get_service().list_rag_bases()


def selected_source_id() -> str:
    return get_service().config.selected_knowledge_base_id()


def search_knowledge(
    query: str, top_k: int = 5, document_path: str = "", source_id: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Semantic search in one source; ``document_path`` limits it to that (absolute) file."""
    return get_service().search_knowledge_base(query, top_k, document_path, source_id)


def list_documents(source_id: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return get_service().list_documents(source_id)


def read_document(path: str, source_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Indexed metadata plus ``chunks_data`` (text and vectors) of one document."""
    return get_service().get_document(path, source_id)


def add_text(title: str, text: str, source_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Embed pasted text as the document ``manual:<title>``."""
    return get_service().add_text_document(title, text, source_id)


def add_source(name: str, folder: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Register a named source for an absolute folder path and select it."""
    return get_service().add_rag_base(name, folder)


def start_scan(source_id: str | None = None, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Start a background index job for one source; poll ``scan_status``."""
    return get_service().start_rag_scan(source_id, force=force)


def scan_status() -> dict[str, Any]:

## `ragMemory/logic_ragMemory.py`
```python
"""RAG domain logic: named knowledge sources, their isolated indexes, document
parsing/chunking/embedding, the background scanner and semantic search.

Storage per knowledge source: a small SQLite manifest (``rag_indexes/<id>.sqlite3``:
documents and meta) plus a ChromaDB collection (``rag_indexes/chroma/``, collection
``kb_<id>``) holding the chunk text and its Ollama embedding vectors.

Object graph (built by ``create_rag_memory``): RagDatabaseEngine is used by
RagConfigStore; both feed DocumentIndexer, which embeds through OllamaEmbedder;
DocumentScannerService drives the indexer; RagMemoryService is the facade over all of
them. Nothing here imports other Novous components, so the folder can be reused as is;
callers outside this package go through ``interface_ragMemory``.
"""

import json
import logging
import os
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import threading
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import lru_cache
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable, Iterator

import ollama

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)
COMPONENT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
# RAG_HOME holds rag_config.json and data/; inside Novous it is this folder.
RAG_HOME = Path(os.environ.get("RAG_HOME") or COMPONENT_ROOT).expanduser().resolve()
DATA_DIR = RAG_HOME / "data"
LEGACY_ROOT = COMPONENT_ROOT.parent / "agentMemory"


def _env(name: str, default: str) -> str:
    """Read a RAG_* setting, falling back to its former NOVOUS_* name."""
    return os.environ.get(f"RAG_{name}") or os.environ.get(f"NOVOUS_{name}") or default


def migrate_legacy_layout() -> list[str]:
    """Move RAG state left by the former ``agentMemory`` package, once.

    Only paths that do not exist yet in ``ragMemory/`` are moved, so this is a
    no-op after the first start and never overwrites newer data.
    """
    moved = []
    candidates = [
        (LEGACY_ROOT / "rag_config.json", COMPONENT_ROOT / "rag_config.json"),
        (LEGACY_ROOT / "data" / "rag_indexes", COMPONENT_ROOT / "data" / "rag_indexes"),
        (LEGACY_ROOT / "data" / "rag_scan_job.json", COMPONENT_ROOT / "data" / "rag_scan_job.json"),
    ] + [
        (
            LEGACY_ROOT / "data" / f"knowledge.sqlite3{suffix}",
            COMPONENT_ROOT / "data" / f"knowledge.sqlite3{suffix}",
        )
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm")
    ]
    for source, target in candidates:
        if source.exists() and not target.exists():
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
            moved.append(str(target))
    return moved


@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
def _volume_label(anchor: str) -> str:
    """The Windows volume label of a drive root such as ``G:\\``; empty elsewhere."""
    if os.name != "nt" or not anchor:
        return ""
    import ctypes

    label = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(261)
    if not ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetVolumeInformationW(anchor, label, 261, None, None, None, None, 0):
        return ""
    return label.value


class _ScanStopped(Exception):
    pass


class RagDatabaseEngine:
    """Index storage: a SQLite manifest of documents plus a ChromaDB vector collection.

    Each named knowledge source has its own manifest file; ``use_database`` routes the
    operations of the current context to that file and to its Chroma collection
    (``<manifest folder>/chroma``, collection ``kb_<manifest stem>``). Chroma clients are
    opened per operation, like the SQLite connections, so no file stays locked.
    """

    VECTOR_STORE = "chroma"

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Path = DATA_DIR):
        self.DATABASE_PATH = Path(data_dir) / "knowledge.sqlite3"
        self._active_path: ContextVar[Path | None] = ContextVar("rag_database_path", default=None)
        self._vector_lock = threading.RLock()

    @contextmanager
    def use_database(self, path: Path) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Route database operations in this context to a named knowledge-base index."""
        token = self._active_path.set(Path(path))
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._active_path.reset(token)

    def _database_path(self) -> Path:
        return self._active_path.get() or self.DATABASE_PATH

    @contextmanager
    def connect(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        database_path = self._database_path()
        database_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        connection = sqlite3.connect(database_path, timeout=30)
        try:
            connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
            connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
            yield connection
            connection.commit()
        except Exception:
            connection.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            connection.close()

    @staticmethod
    def collection_name(database_path: Path) -> str:
        clean = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", database_path.stem)[:60].strip("_-")
        return f"kb_{clean or 'default'}"

    @contextmanager
    def _client(self, create: bool = True) -> Iterator[Any]:
        """Open the Chroma client next to the active manifest; ``None`` if absent and not creating."""
        import chromadb
        from chromadb.config import Settings

        chroma_dir = self._database_path().parent / "chroma"
        with self._vector_lock:
            if not create and not chroma_dir.is_dir():
                yield None
                return
            with chromadb.PersistentClient(
                path=str(chroma_dir), settings=Settings(anonymized_telemetry=False)
            ) as client:
                yield client

    @contextmanager
    def vectors(self, create: bool = True) -> Iterator[Any]:
        """Open this index's Chroma collection for one operation.

        Yields ``None`` when ``create`` is false and the collection does not exist yet.
        """
        name = self.collection_name(self._database_path())
        with self._client(create) as client:
            if client is None:
                yield None
                return
            if create:
                collection = client.get_or_create_collection(
                    name, metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"}, embedding_function=None
                )
            elif name in {item.name for item in client.list_collections()}:
                collection = client.get_collection(name, embedding_function=None)
            else:
                yield None
                return
            collection.max_batch_size = client.get_max_batch_size()
            yield collection

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            connection.executescript(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
                    path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    modified_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    indexed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    chunks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                );
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value TEXT NOT NULL
                );
                """
            )
            columns = {row["name"] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(documents)")}
            if "chunks" not in columns:
                connection.execute(
                    "ALTER TABLE documents ADD COLUMN chunks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
                )
            legacy_chunks = connection.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'chunks'"
            ).fetchone()
        if legacy_chunks:
            self._migrate_legacy_chunks()

    def _migrate_legacy_chunks(self) -> None:
        """Move vectors stored as JSON in the former ``chunks`` table into Chroma, once.

        The stored embeddings are reused, so no Ollama calls are made. The manifest is
        backed up to ``<name>.pre-chroma.bak`` before the old table is dropped.
        """
        database_path = self._database_path()
        backup = database_path.with_name(f"{database_path.name}.pre-chroma.bak")
        with self.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)")
        if not backup.exists():
            shutil.copy2(database_path, backup)

        dimensions = None
        with self.connect() as connection, self.vectors() as collection:
            total = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chunks").fetchone()[0]
            cursor = connection.execute(
                "SELECT path, chunk_index, content, embedding FROM chunks ORDER BY path, chunk_index"
            )
            while rows := cursor.fetchmany(min(1000, collection.max_batch_size)):
                embeddings = [json.loads(row["embedding"]) for row in rows]
                dimensions = dimensions or len(embeddings[0])
                collection.upsert(
                    ids=[self._chunk_id(row["path"], row["chunk_index"]) for row in rows],
                    embeddings=embeddings,
                    documents=[row["content"] for row in rows],
                    metadatas=[{"path": row["path"], "chunk_index": row["chunk_index"]} for row in rows],
                )
            if collection.count() < total:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"Chroma migration of {database_path} stored {collection.count()} of {total} chunks."
                )
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE documents SET chunks = "
                "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chunks c WHERE c.path = documents.path)"
            )
            connection.execute("DROP TABLE chunks")
            self._set_meta(connection, "vector_store", self.VECTOR_STORE)
            if dimensions:
                self._set_meta(connection, "embedding_dimensions", str(dimensions))
        with self.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute("VACUUM")
        LOGGER.info("Migrated %d RAG chunks from %s into Chroma.", total, database_path)

    @staticmethod
    def _chunk_id(path: str, chunk_index: int) -> str:
        return f"{path}#{chunk_index}"

    def replace_document(self,
        path: str,
        modified_ns: int,
        size_bytes: int,
        indexed_at: str,
        chunks: Iterable[tuple[str, list[float]]],
    ) -> None:
        """Replace one indexed document and all of its chunks.

        The manifest row is written last, so an interrupted replace leaves the document
        unlisted and the next scan indexes it again.
        """
        chunks = list(chunks)
        with self.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE path = ?", (path,))
        with self.vectors(create=bool(chunks)) as collection:
            if collection is not None:
                collection.delete(where={"path": path})
                numbered = list(enumerate(chunks))
                for offset in range(0, len(numbered), collection.max_batch_size):
                    batch = numbered[offset:offset + collection.max_batch_size]
                    collection.add(
                        ids=[self._chunk_id(path, index) for index, _ in batch],
                        embeddings=[vector for _, (_, vector) in batch],
                        documents=[content for _, (content, _) in batch],
                        metadatas=[{"path": path, "chunk_index": index} for index, _ in batch],
                    )
        with self.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO documents(path, modified_ns, size_bytes, indexed_at, chunks) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (path, modified_ns, size_bytes, indexed_at, len(chunks)),
            )

    def document_metadata(self, path: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            row = connection.execute(
                "SELECT path, modified_ns, size_bytes, indexed_at FROM documents WHERE path = ?",
                (path,),
            ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None

    def list_documents(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            rows = connection.execute(
                """
                SELECT path, modified_ns, size_bytes, indexed_at, chunks
                FROM documents ORDER BY path COLLATE NOCASE
                """
            ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def _delete_vectors(self, paths: list[str]) -> None:
        if not paths:
            return
        with self.vectors(create=False) as collection:
            if collection is None:
                return
            for offset in range(0, len(paths), 500):
                collection.delete(where={"path": {"$in": paths[offset:offset + 500]}})

    def delete_document(self, path: str) -> bool:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            cursor = connection.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE path = ?", (path,))
        self._delete_vectors([path])
        return cursor.rowcount > 0

    def delete_documents_under(self, prefix: str, keep_paths: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """Remove stale documents below a normalized source directory."""
        normalized_prefix = prefix.rstrip("/\\").replace("\\", "/") + "/"
        normalized_keep = {path.replace("\\", "/") for path in keep_paths}
        with self.connect() as connection:
            rows = connection.execute("SELECT path FROM documents").fetchall()
            stale = [
                row["path"] for row in rows
                if row["path"].replace("\\", "/").startswith(normalized_prefix)
                and row["path"].replace("\\", "/") not in normalized_keep
            ]
            connection.executemany("DELETE FROM documents WHERE path = ?", [(path,) for path in stale])
        self._delete_vectors(stale)
        return stale

    def clear_all(self) -> int:
        """Delete every indexed document and chunk; returns the document count removed."""
        with self.connect() as connection:
            count = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents").fetchone()[0]
            connection.execute("DELETE FROM documents")
            connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM meta WHERE key IN ('embedding_model', 'embedding_dimensions')"
            )
        self.drop_vectors()
        return count

    def drop_vectors(self) -> None:
        """Delete this index's Chroma collection."""
        name = self.collection_name(self._database_path())
        with self._client(create=False) as client:
            if client is not None and name in {item.name for item in client.list_collections()}:
                client.delete_collection(name)

    @staticmethod
    def _set_meta(connection: sqlite3.Connection, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO meta(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value",
            (key, value),
        )

    def get_meta(self, key: str) -> str | None:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            row = connection.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = ?", (key,)).fetchone()
        return row["value"] if row else None

    def set_meta(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        with self.connect() as connection:
            self._set_meta(connection, key, value)

    def check_embedding_space(self, model: str, dimensions: int, record: bool = True) -> None:
        """Refuse vectors from a different model or size than the ones already indexed."""
        stored_model = self.get_meta("embedding_model")
        stored_dimensions = self.get_meta("embedding_dimensions")
        has_documents = bool(self.list_documents())
        if has_documents and (
            (stored_model and stored_model != model)
            or (stored_dimensions and int(stored_dimensions) != dimensions)
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"This index was built with '{stored_model or 'unknown model'}' "
                f"({stored_dimensions or '?'} dimensions) but '{model}' produces "
                f"{dimensions}. Clear and reindex this knowledge base."
            )
        if record and (stored_model != model or stored_dimensions != str(dimensions)):
            self.set_meta("embedding_model", model)
            self.set_meta("embedding_dimensions", str(dimensions))

    @staticmethod
    def _chunk_rows(result: dict) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        embeddings = result.get("embeddings")
        rows = [
            {
                "path": metadata["path"],
                "chunk_index": int(metadata["chunk_index"]),
                "content": content,
                "embedding": [float(value) for value in embeddings[index]] if embeddings is not None else [],
            }
            for index, (content, metadata) in enumerate(zip(result["documents"], result["metadatas"]))
        ]
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: (row["path"], row["chunk_index"]))
        return rows

    def list_chunks(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.vectors(create=False) as collection:
            if collection is None:
                return []
            return self._chunk_rows(collection.get(include=["documents", "metadatas", "embeddings"]))

    def get_document_chunks(self, path: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.vectors(create=False) as collection:
            if collection is None:
                return []
            return self._chunk_rows(collection.get(
                where={"path": path}, include=["documents", "metadatas", "embeddings"]
            ))

    def query_chunks(self, vector: list[float], top_k: int, path: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return the ``top_k`` nearest chunks with a cosine similarity ``score``."""
        with self.vectors(create=False) as collection:
            if collection is None or not collection.count():
                return []
            result = collection.query(
                query_embeddings=[vector],
                n_results=int(top_k),
                where={"path": path} if path else None,
                include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"],
            )
        return [
            {
                "path": metadata["path"],
                "chunk_index": int(metadata["chunk_index"]),
                "score": 1.0 - float(distance),
                "content": content,
            }
            for content, metadata, distance in zip(
                result["documents"][0], result["metadatas"][0], result["distances"][0]
            )
        ]


class OllamaEmbedder:
    """Local Ollama embeddings; ``OLLAMA_HOST`` selects a remote Ollama server."""

    def __init__(self, model: str | None = None, batch_size: int | None = None):
        self.model = model or _env("EMBEDDING_MODEL", "nomic-embed-text:latest")
        self.batch_size = max(1, int(batch_size or _env("EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE", "16")))

    def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        vectors = []
        for offset in range(0, len(texts), self.batch_size):
            requested = texts[offset:offset + self.batch_size]
            try:
                from core_engine.logic_core_engine import serialized_ollama_embed

                response = serialized_ollama_embed(model=self.model, input=requested)
            except ollama.ResponseError as exc:
                if getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 404:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f"Embedding model '{self.model}' is not installed. Run: ollama pull {self.model}"
                    ) from exc
                raise
            batch = response.get("embeddings") if isinstance(response, dict) else response.embeddings
            if len(batch) != len(requested):
                raise RuntimeError("Embedding model returned a different number of vectors than requested.")
            vectors.extend([[float(value) for value in vector] for vector in batch])
        if vectors and any(len(vector) != len(vectors[0]) for vector in vectors):
            raise RuntimeError("Embedding model returned vectors with inconsistent dimensions.")
        return vectors


class RagConfigStore:
    """Configuration and persistence for named RAG knowledge bases (``rag_config.json``)."""

    def __init__(self, database: RagDatabaseEngine, home: Path = RAG_HOME):
        self.database = database
        self.CONFIG_PATH = Path(home) / "rag_config.json"
        self.DATA_DIR = Path(home) / "data"

    def _read_config(self) -> dict:
        if not self.CONFIG_PATH.is_file():
            return {}
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            return {}
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

    def _normalized_config(self) -> dict:
        data = self._read_config()
        original = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True)
        bases = data.get("knowledge_bases")
        if not isinstance(bases, list) or not bases:
            legacy_path = str(data.get("knowledge_base_path") or "").strip()
            if legacy_path:
                legacy_folder = Path(legacy_path)
                bases = [{
                    "id": "legacy",
                    "name": legacy_folder.name or "Legacy source",
                    "path": legacy_path,
                    "active": True,
                    "legacy_index": True,
                }]
            else:
                bases = []

        valid_bases = []
        nonlegacy_names = {
            str(entry.get("name", "")).strip().casefold()
            for entry in bases
            if isinstance(entry, dict)
            and entry.get("name")
            and not (
                str(entry.get("id")) == "default"
                or str(entry.get("name", "")).strip().casefold() == "default knowledge base"
            )
        }
        used_names = set()
        for entry in bases:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("id") or not entry.get("path"):
                continue
            base = dict(entry)
            path = str(base["path"])
            legacy_name = str(base.get("name", "")).strip().casefold() == "default knowledge base"
            legacy_source = str(base.get("id")) == "default" or legacy_name
            if legacy_source and not base.get("legacy_name_migrated"):
                folder_name = Path(path).name.strip() or "Legacy source"
                base["name"] = folder_name
                if folder_name.casefold() in used_names or folder_name.casefold() in nonlegacy_names:
                    base["name"] = f"{folder_name} (legacy index)"
                base["legacy_name_migrated"] = True
            base["name"] = " ".join(str(base.get("name") or Path(path).name or "Knowledge source").split())
            if base["name"].casefold() in used_names:
                suffix = 2
                while f"{base['name']} ({suffix})".casefold() in used_names:
                    suffix += 1
                base["name"] = f"{base['name']} ({suffix})"
            used_names.add(base["name"].casefold())
            valid_bases.append(base)
        bases = valid_bases
        data["knowledge_bases"] = bases
        data.pop("knowledge_base_path", None)

        valid_ids = {
            str(base.get("id"))
            for base in bases
            if isinstance(base, dict) and base.get("id")
        }
        selected = str(data.get("selected_knowledge_base") or "")
        active_ids = [
            str(base["id"]) for base in bases if base.get("active", True)
        ]
        if selected not in valid_ids or not any(
            str(base["id"]) == selected and base.get("active", True)
            for base in bases
        ):
            data["selected_knowledge_base"] = next(
                iter(active_ids),
                None,
            )
        if json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True) != original:
            self._write_config(data)
        return data

    def _write_config(self, data: dict) -> None:
        self.CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        descriptor, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=self.CONFIG_PATH.parent, suffix=".tmp")
        try:
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                json.dump(data, handle, indent=2)
                handle.write("\n")
            os.replace(temp_name, self.CONFIG_PATH)
        except Exception:
            Path(temp_name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise

    def configured_path(self) -> str:
        """Return the selected named source folder."""
        return str(self.get_knowledge_base()["path"])

    def knowledge_base_path(self, base_id: str | None = None) -> Path:
        """Return the selected or specified knowledge-base folder."""
        base = self.get_knowledge_base(base_id)
        return Path(str(base["path"])).expanduser().resolve()

    def get_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        key = base_id or data.get("selected_knowledge_base")
        if not key:
            raise ValueError("No knowledge source exists. Add a named source first.")
        for base in data["knowledge_bases"]:
            if isinstance(base, dict) and str(base.get("id")) == key:
                return dict(base)
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown knowledge base: {key}")

    def list_knowledge_bases(self, include_archived: bool = True) -> list[dict]:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        bases = [
            dict(base) for base in data["knowledge_bases"]
            if isinstance(base, dict) and (include_archived or base.get("active", True))
        ]
        selected = data["selected_knowledge_base"]
        for base in bases:
            base["selected"] = str(base.get("id")) == selected
        return bases

    def selected_knowledge_base_id(self) -> str:
        selected = self._normalized_config().get("selected_knowledge_base")
        if not selected:
            raise ValueError("No knowledge source exists. Add a named source first.")
        return str(selected)

    def database_path(self, base_id: str | None = None) -> Path | None:
        base = self.get_knowledge_base(base_id)
        if base.get("legacy_index"):
            return None
        return self.DATA_DIR / "rag_indexes" / f"{base['id']}.sqlite3"

    def database_context(self, base_id: str | None = None):
        """Select the isolated index for one named source."""
        path = self.database_path(base_id)
        if path is None:
            return nullcontext()
        return self.database.use_database(path)

    def select_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str) -> dict:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        base = next(
            (
                entry for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                if isinstance(entry, dict) and str(entry.get("id")) == str(base_id)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if base is None or not base.get("active", True):
            raise ValueError(f"Active knowledge base not found: {base_id}")
        data["selected_knowledge_base"] = str(base_id)
        self._write_config(data)
        return dict(base)

    def add_knowledge_base(self, name: str, raw_path: str) -> dict:
        clean_name = " ".join(str(name or "").split())
        raw = str(raw_path or "").strip().strip('"')
        if not clean_name:
            raise ValueError("A knowledge-base name is required.")
        if clean_name.casefold() == "default knowledge base":
            raise ValueError("The default knowledge-base name is reserved; choose a branch name.")
        if not raw:
            raise ValueError("A knowledge-base folder path is required.")
        path = Path(raw).expanduser()
        if not path.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("The RAG folder path must be absolute.")
        path = path.resolve()
        data = self._normalized_config()
        if any(
            str(base.get("name", "")).casefold() == clean_name.casefold()
            for base in data["knowledge_bases"]
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"A knowledge source named '{clean_name}' already exists.")
        base = {
            "id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "name": clean_name,
            "path": str(path),
            "active": True,
            "legacy_index": False,
        }
        data["knowledge_bases"].append(base)
        data["selected_knowledge_base"] = base["id"]
        self._write_config(data)
        return base

    def rename_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str, name: str) -> dict:
        clean_name = " ".join(str(name or "").split())
        if not clean_name:
            raise ValueError("A knowledge-source name is required.")
        if clean_name.casefold() == "default knowledge base":
            raise ValueError("The default knowledge-base name is reserved; choose a branch name.")
        data = self._normalized_config()
        base = next(
            (
                entry for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                if str(entry.get("id")) == str(base_id)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if base is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown knowledge base: {base_id}")
        if any(
            str(entry.get("id")) != str(base_id)
            and str(entry.get("name", "")).casefold() == clean_name.casefold()
            for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"A knowledge source named '{clean_name}' already exists.")
        base["name"] = clean_name
        self._write_config(data)
        return dict(base)

    def delete_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str) -> dict:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        base = next(
            (
                entry for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                if str(entry.get("id")) == str(base_id)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if base is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown knowledge base: {base_id}")
        data["knowledge_bases"].remove(base)
        if data.get("selected_knowledge_base") == str(base_id):
            data["selected_knowledge_base"] = next(
                (
                    str(entry["id"])
                    for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                    if entry.get("active", True)
                ),
                None,
            )
        self._write_config(data)
        return dict(base)

    def archive_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str) -> dict:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        base = next(
            (
                entry for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                if isinstance(entry, dict) and str(entry.get("id")) == str(base_id)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if base is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown knowledge base: {base_id}")
        base["active"] = False
        if data["selected_knowledge_base"] == str(base_id):
            data["selected_knowledge_base"] = next(
                (
                    str(item["id"])
                    for item in data["knowledge_bases"]
                    if item.get("active", True)
                ),
                None,
            )
        self._write_config(data)
        return dict(base)

    def restore_knowledge_base(self, base_id: str) -> dict:
        data = self._normalized_config()
        base = next(
            (
                entry for entry in data["knowledge_bases"]
                if isinstance(entry, dict) and str(entry.get("id")) == str(base_id)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if base is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown knowledge base: {base_id}")
        base["active"] = True
        data["selected_knowledge_base"] = str(base_id)
        self._write_config(data)
        return dict(base)

    def set_knowledge_base_path(self, raw_path: str) -> Path:
        """Change the selected named source folder."""
        raw = str(raw_path or "").strip().strip('"')
        if not raw:
            raise ValueError("A knowledge-source folder path is required.")
        path = Path(raw).expanduser()
        if not path.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("The RAG folder path must be absolute.")
        path = path.resolve()
        if not path.is_dir():
            raise ValueError(f"The RAG folder does not exist or is not a directory: {path}")
        data = self._normalized_config()
        selected = data.get("selected_knowledge_base")
        if not selected:
            raise ValueError("Select or add a named knowledge source first.")
        base = next(item for item in data["knowledge_bases"] if str(item["id"]) == selected)
        base["path"] = str(path)
        self._write_config(data)
        return path


class DocumentIndexer:
    """Document discovery, parsing, chunking and embedding through ``OllamaEmbedder``."""

    LEGACY_PREFIX = "workspace/Knowledge Base"
    ROOT_META_KEY = "knowledge_root"
    WARNINGS_META_KEY = "scan_warnings"
    MANUAL_PREFIX = "manual:"
    MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES = 100_000_000
    CHUNK_CHARACTERS = 1400
    CHUNK_OVERLAP = 200
    SCAN_FILE_DELAY_SECONDS = max(0.0, float(
        os.environ.get("RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS")
        or os.environ.get("NOVOUS_RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS")
        or "0.15"
    ))
    TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".txt", ".md", ".markdown", ".rst", ".html", ".htm", ".csv",
        ".json", ".xml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".log",
        ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".css", ".toml", ".ini", ".sql", ".sh", ".ps1",
    }
    DOCLING_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".docx", ".pptx", ".odt"}
    # OFFLINE | RECALL_ON_OPEN | RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS: OneDrive/cloud files not on disk yet.
    CLOUD_PLACEHOLDER_ATTRIBUTES = 0x1000 | 0x40000 | 0x400000
    # HIDDEN | SYSTEM: desktop.ini, Thumbs.db and similar files are not documents.
    HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES = 0x2 | 0x4
    CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = max(1.0, float(_env("CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT", "120")))
    GENERIC_CLOUD = "the cloud sync app"
    CLOUD_OFFLINE_TIPS = {
        "OneDrive": "right-click the folder in File Explorer and choose 'Always keep on this device'",
        "Google Drive": "right-click the folder in File Explorer and choose 'Offline access' > 'Available offline'",
    }
    # Google Docs/Sheets/Slides etc.: link files whose content exists only on Google's servers.
    GOOGLE_NATIVE_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".gdoc", ".gsheet", ".gslides", ".gdraw", ".gform", ".gjam", ".gsite", ".gmap", ".gtable",
    }
    # "auto" parses PDFs without OCR and retries with OCR only when no text came out.
    PDF_OCR = _env("PDF_OCR", "auto").strip().lower()

    def __init__(self,
        config: RagConfigStore,
        database: RagDatabaseEngine,
        embedder: OllamaEmbedder | None = None,
    ):
        self.config = config
        self.database = database
        self.embedder = embedder or OllamaEmbedder()
        self._doc_converter = None
        self._ocr_converter = None
        self.scan_lock = threading.RLock()
        # Set when the background scanner stops; also interrupts per-file throttling.
        self.stop_event = threading.Event()

    def _is_cloud_placeholder(self, path: Path) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(path.stat(), "st_file_attributes", 0) & self.CLOUD_PLACEHOLDER_ATTRIBUTES)

    def cloud_provider(self, path: Path) -> str | None:
        """Name the sync service a file or folder lives in ("Google Drive", "OneDrive"), if any."""
        if _volume_label(path.anchor) == "Google Drive":
            return "Google Drive"
        for variable in ("OneDrive", "OneDriveConsumer", "OneDriveCommercial"):
            root = os.environ.get(variable)
            if root and path.is_relative_to(Path(root)):
                return "OneDrive"
        if path.exists() and self._is_cloud_placeholder(path):
            return self.GENERIC_CLOUD
        return None

    def _read_source(self, path: Path, phase=None) -> bytes:
        """Read a document's bytes; files in a cloud folder get a download time limit."""
        provider = self.cloud_provider(path)
        if provider is None:
            return path.read_bytes()
        if phase:
            online_only = self._is_cloud_placeholder(path)
            phase(f"{'downloading' if online_only else 'reading'} from {provider}")
        outcome: dict[str, Any] = {}

        def read() -> None:
            try:
                outcome["data"] = path.read_bytes()
            except OSError as exc:
                outcome["error"] = exc

        # A read stuck inside the sync app cannot be cancelled, so it is left to finish on its own.
        reader = threading.Thread(target=read, name="rag-cloud-read", daemon=True)
        reader.start()
        reader.join(self.CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        advice = (
            f"It is online-only (not stored on this PC). Check that {provider} is running, "
            f"signed in and not paused, then choose Retry. To keep these files on this PC, "
            f"{self.CLOUD_OFFLINE_TIPS.get(provider, 'make the folder available offline in the sync app')}."
        )
        if reader.is_alive():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"File not downloaded: {provider} did not deliver it within "
                f"{self.CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:g} seconds. {advice}"
            )
        if "error" in outcome:
            exc = outcome["error"]
            winerror = getattr(exc, "winerror", None)
            code = f"WinError {winerror}" if winerror else f"error {exc.errno}"
            raise RuntimeError(f"File not downloaded: {provider} could not deliver it ({code}). {advice}") from exc
        return outcome["data"]

    @staticmethod
    def _build_converter(ocr: bool):
        from docling.datamodel.base_models import InputFormat
        from docling.datamodel.pipeline_options import PdfPipelineOptions
        from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter, PdfFormatOption

        return DocumentConverter(format_options={
            InputFormat.PDF: PdfFormatOption(pipeline_options=PdfPipelineOptions(do_ocr=ocr)),
        })

    @staticmethod
    def _convert(converter, path: Path, data: bytes) -> str:
        from docling.datamodel.base_models import DocumentStream

        result = converter.convert(DocumentStream(name=path.name, stream=BytesIO(data)))
        return result.document.export_to_markdown()

    @staticmethod
    def _has_text(markdown: str) -> bool:
        return bool(re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", markdown, flags=re.S).strip())

    def _document_text(self, path: Path, data: bytes | None = None, phase=None) -> str:
        suffix = path.suffix.lower()
        if suffix not in self.TEXT_EXTENSIONS | self.DOCLING_EXTENSIONS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported knowledge-base file type: {path.suffix or '(no extension)'}")
        if data is None:
            data = self._read_source(path, phase)
        if suffix in self.TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
            return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if phase:
            phase("parsing")
        try:
            if self._doc_converter is None:
                try:
                    self._doc_converter = self._build_converter(ocr=self.PDF_OCR == "always")
                except ImportError as exc:
                    if suffix == ".pdf":
                        return self._pdf_text_fallback(path, exc, data)
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Docling is required to index PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT files."
                    ) from exc
            text = self._convert(self._doc_converter, path, data)
            if suffix == ".pdf" and self.PDF_OCR == "auto" and not self._has_text(text):
                if phase:
                    phase("parsing with OCR")
                if self._ocr_converter is None:
                    self._ocr_converter = self._build_converter(ocr=True)
                text = self._convert(self._ocr_converter, path, data)
        except ImportError as exc:
            if suffix == ".pdf":
                return self._pdf_text_fallback(path, exc, data)
            raise
        return text

    def _pdf_text_fallback(self, path: Path, docling_error: ImportError, data: bytes) -> str:
        try:
            import fitz
        except ImportError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Docling's PDF parser could not load and the PyMuPDF fallback is unavailable."
            ) from exc

        LOGGER.warning("Docling PDF parser unavailable; using PyMuPDF for %s: %s", path, docling_error)
        with fitz.open(stream=data, filetype="pdf") as document:
            text = "\n\n".join(page.get_text("text") for page in document)
        if not text.strip():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No selectable text could be extracted from {path}; scanned PDFs require a working OCR parser."
            )
        return text

    def _chunk_text(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        clean = text.strip()
        if not clean:
            return []
        chunks = []
        start = 0
        while start < len(clean):
            end = min(start + self.CHUNK_CHARACTERS, len(clean))
            if end < len(clean):
                boundary = clean.rfind("\n\n", start, end)
                if boundary > start + self.CHUNK_CHARACTERS // 2:
                    end = boundary
            chunk = clean[start:end].strip()
            if chunk:
                chunks.append(chunk)
            if end >= len(clean):
                break
            start = max(start + 1, end - self.CHUNK_OVERLAP)
        return chunks

    @property
    def EMBEDDING_MODEL(self) -> str:
        return self.embedder.model

    def _embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        vectors = self.embedder.embed(texts)
        if vectors:
            self.database.check_embedding_space(self.embedder.model, len(vectors[0]))
        return vectors
