```python
"""Application-facing API for Squad Development."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import yaml

from core_engine.logic_agent_management import agent_management
from orchestration.logic_orchestration import RunCapacityError, run_results, squad_registry
from core_engine.logic_core_engine import tool_catalog
from squad_developement import agent_design, experimentation, flow_design, prompt_starter

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/squad-development", tags=["Squad Development"])


class SquadRequest(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str


class AgentRequest(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    kind: str
    prompt: str
    tools: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=200)


class TextRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str


class StarterChoiceRequest(BaseModel):
    variable: str
    value: str


class StarterTemplateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str
    body: str


class StarterGenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    model: str
    prompt: str




class FlowRequest(BaseModel):
    start: str = ""
    routes: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)


class DraftToolRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str
    tool: str


class DraftSkillRequest(BaseModel):
    content: str
    skill_id: str


class RunRequest(BaseModel):
    query: str


def invoke(func, *args):
    try:
        return func(*args)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except FileExistsError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except (ValueError, TypeError, yaml.YAMLError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except RunCapacityError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/template")
def generic_prompt():
    return {"prompt": invoke(agent_design.get_generic_prompt)}


@router.put("/template")
def update_generic_prompt(request: TextRequest):
    return {"prompt": invoke(agent_design.save_generic_prompt, request.content)}


@router.get("/prompt-starter/defaults")
def starter_defaults():
    return {
        "agent": invoke(agent_management.render_prompt_starter_definition),
        "subagent": invoke(squad_registry.default_subagent_template),
    }


@router.post("/prompt-starter/parse-agent")
def parse_starter_agent(request: TextRequest):
    return invoke(agent_design.parse_prompt_starter_agent, request.content)


@router.post("/format-yaml")
def format_yaml(request: TextRequest):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.format_pasted_yaml, request.content)}


@router.get("/tools")
def list_tools():
    return {"tools": tool_catalog.list_tools()}


@router.get("/prompt-starter/choices")
def starter_choices():
    return {"choices": invoke(prompt_starter.get_choices)}


@router.post("/prompt-starter/choices")
def add_starter_choice(request: StarterChoiceRequest):
    return {"choices": invoke(prompt_starter.add_choice, request.variable, request.value)}


@router.post("/prompt-starter/choices/delete")
def delete_starter_choice(request: StarterChoiceRequest):
    return {"choices": invoke(prompt_starter.remove_choice, request.variable, request.value)}


@router.post("/prompt-starter/generate")
def starter_generate(request: StarterGenerateRequest):
    return {"text": invoke(agent_design.generate_text, request.model, request.prompt)}


@router.get("/prompt-starter/templates")
def list_templates():
    return {"templates": invoke(prompt_starter.get_templates)}


@router.post("/prompt-starter/templates")
def save_template(request: StarterTemplateRequest):
    return {"templates": invoke(prompt_starter.save_template, request.name, request.body)}


@router.delete("/prompt-starter/templates/{name}")
def delete_template(name: str):
    return {"templates": invoke(prompt_starter.delete_template, name)}


@router.get("/tools/{name}/instructions")
def tool_instructions(name: str):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.tool_instructions, name)}


@router.get("/squads")
def list_squads():
    return {"squads": invoke(flow_design.list_squads)}


@router.post("/squads", status_code=201)
def create_squad(request: SquadRequest):
    return invoke(flow_design.create_squad, request.id, request.name)


@router.get("/squads/{squad_id}")
def get_squad(squad_id: str):
    return invoke(flow_design.read_squad, squad_id)


@router.post("/squads/{squad_id}/agents", status_code=201)
def create_agent(squad_id: str, request: AgentRequest):
    return invoke(agent_design.create_agent, squad_id, request.id, request.name, request.kind, request.prompt, request.tools)


@router.get("/squads/{squad_id}/agents/{agent_id}")
def get_agent(squad_id: str, agent_id: str):
    return invoke(agent_design.get_agent, squad_id, agent_id)


@router.put("/squads/{squad_id}/agents/{agent_id}")
def save_agent(squad_id: str, agent_id: str, request: TextRequest):
    return invoke(agent_design.save_agent, squad_id, agent_id, request.content)


@router.post("/squads/{squad_id}/agents/{agent_id}/draft-tool")
def add_draft_tool(squad_id: str, agent_id: str, request: DraftToolRequest):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.add_draft_tool, squad_id, agent_id, request.content, request.tool)}


@router.post("/squads/{squad_id}/agents/{agent_id}/draft-skill")
def add_draft_skill(squad_id: str, agent_id: str, request: DraftSkillRequest):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.add_draft_skill, squad_id, agent_id, request.content, request.skill_id)}


@router.get("/squads/{squad_id}/skills")
def list_skills(squad_id: str):
    return {"skills": invoke(agent_design.list_skills, squad_id)}


@router.get("/squads/{squad_id}/skills/{skill_id}")
def get_skill(squad_id: str, skill_id: str):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.get_skill, squad_id, skill_id)}


@router.put("/squads/{squad_id}/skills/{skill_id}")
def save_skill(squad_id: str, skill_id: str, request: TextRequest):
    return {"content": invoke(agent_design.save_skill, squad_id, skill_id, request.content)}

@router.put("/squads/{squad_id}/flow")
def save_flow(squad_id: str, request: FlowRequest):
    return invoke(flow_design.save_flow, squad_id, request.start, request.routes)


@router.get("/squads/{squad_id}/notes")
def get_notes(squad_id: str):
    return {"content": invoke(experimentation.get_notes, squad_id)}


@router.put("/squads/{squad_id}/notes")
def save_notes(squad_id: str, request: TextRequest):
    return {"content": invoke(experimentation.save_notes, squad_id, request.content)}


@router.post("/squads/{squad_id}/runs", status_code=202)
def start_run(squad_id: str, request: RunRequest):
    return invoke(experimentation.start_experiment, squad_id, request.query)


@router.get("/runs/{trace_id}")
def get_run(trace_id: str):
    result = run_results.get(trace_id)
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Run is not complete.")
    return result
```

## `squad_developement/prompt_starter.py`
```python
"""Reusable Prompt Starter choices and templates shared across squads."""

import os
import re
import tempfile
import threading

import yaml

from squad_developement import flow_design

_lock = threading.Lock()
_templates_lock = threading.Lock()
_VARIABLE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9 _-]{0,63}$")
_TEMPLATE_NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]{0,63}$")


def _path():
    path = flow_design.ROOT / "prompt_starter_choices.yaml"
    if path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Prompt Starter choices cannot be a symbolic link.")
    return path


def _validate(choices):
    if not isinstance(choices, dict) or len(choices) > 100:
        raise ValueError("Prompt Starter choices must contain at most 100 variables.")
    for key, values in choices.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not _VARIABLE.fullmatch(key):
            raise ValueError("Variable names must use uppercase letters, digits, spaces, hyphens or underscores.")
        if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 100:
            raise ValueError(f"{key} must have at most 100 choices.")
        if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or len(value) > 2000 for value in values):
            raise ValueError(f"Choices for {key} must be nonempty text of at most 2000 characters.")
        if len(set(values)) != len(values):
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate choices for {key} are not allowed.")
    if len(yaml.safe_dump(choices, allow_unicode=True).encode("utf-8")) > 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("Prompt Starter choices must be at most 1 MB.")
    return choices


def get_choices():
    path = _path()
    if not path.exists():
        return {}
    return _validate(yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def _write_choices(choices):
    _validate(choices)
    path = _path()
    temporary = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", newline="", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
            temporary = handle.name
            yaml.safe_dump(choices, handle, sort_keys=True, allow_unicode=True)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if temporary and os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def add_choice(variable, value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("Choice must be text.")
    value = value.strip()
    with _lock:
        choices = get_choices()
        values = choices.setdefault(variable, [])
        if value not in values:
            values.append(value)
        _write_choices(choices)
        return choices


def remove_choice(variable, value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("Choice must be text.")
    value = value.strip()
    with _lock:
        choices = get_choices()
        values = choices.get(variable) or []
        if value not in values:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No saved choice to delete for {variable}.")
        values.remove(value)
        if not values:
            del choices[variable]
        _write_choices(choices)
        return choices


# --- Templates ---

def _templates_path():
    path = flow_design.ROOT / "prompt_starter_templates.yaml"
    if path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Prompt Starter templates cannot be a symbolic link.")
    return path


def _validate_templates(templates):
    if not isinstance(templates, list) or len(templates) > 50:
        raise ValueError("At most 50 templates are allowed.")
    names = set()
    for entry in templates:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            raise ValueError("Each template must be a mapping.")
        name = entry.get("name", "")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not _TEMPLATE_NAME.fullmatch(name):
            raise ValueError("Template names must start with a letter or digit and be at most 64 characters.")
        if name in names:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate template name: {name}")
        names.add(name)
        body = entry.get("body", "")
        if not isinstance(body, str) or not body.strip():
            raise ValueError(f"Template '{name}' must have nonempty body text.")
        if len(body.encode("utf-8")) > 500_000:
            raise ValueError(f"Template '{name}' must be at most 500 KB.")
    if len(yaml.safe_dump(templates, allow_unicode=True).encode("utf-8")) > 2_000_000:
        raise ValueError("Templates file must be at most 2 MB.")
    return templates


def _write_templates(templates):
    path = _templates_path()
    temporary = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", newline="", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
            temporary = handle.name
            yaml.safe_dump(templates, handle, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if temporary and os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def get_templates():
    path = _templates_path()
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if data is None:
        return []
    return _validate_templates(data)


def save_template(name, body):
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not _TEMPLATE_NAME.fullmatch(name):
        raise ValueError("Template name must start with a letter or digit and be at most 64 characters.")
    if not isinstance(body, str) or not body.strip():
        raise ValueError("Template body must not be empty.")
    if len(body.encode("utf-8")) > 500_000:
        raise ValueError("Template body must be at most 500 KB.")
    with _templates_lock:
        templates = get_templates()
        existing = next((t for t in templates if t["name"] == name), None)
        if existing:
            existing["body"] = body
        else:
            templates.append({"name": name, "body": body})
        _validate_templates(templates)
        _write_templates(templates)
    return templates


def delete_template(name):
    with _templates_lock:
        templates = get_templates()
        before = len(templates)
        templates = [t for t in templates if t["name"] != name]
        if len(templates) == before:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Template '{name}' not found.")
        _write_templates(templates)
    return templates

```

```python
"""Squads doorway: FastAPI router for /api/squads-architect/* (squad blueprints, members
and per-agent tool assignment). Runs go through /api/orchestration/run/start."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from squads.logic_squads import squad_architect
from squads.schemas_squads import (
    AgentPromptRequest,
    BlueprintValidation,
    MemberCreateRequest,
    SquadBlueprint,
    ToolAssignmentRequest,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/squads-architect", tags=["Squads"])


@router.get("/overview")
def get_squads_overview():
    try:
        return squad_architect.overview()
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/agents/{agent_id}")
def get_squad_agent(agent_id: str):
    try:
        node = squad_architect.describe_agent(agent_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if node is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found.")
    return node


@router.get("/agents/{agent_id}/prompt")
def get_agent_prompt(agent_id: str):
    try:
        text = squad_architect.get_agent_prompt(agent_id)
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if text is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found.")
    return {"agent_id": agent_id, "prompt": text}


@router.put("/agents/{agent_id}/prompt")
def set_agent_prompt(agent_id: str, req: AgentPromptRequest):
    try:
        return squad_architect.set_agent_prompt(agent_id, req.prompt)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/blueprints/{squad_id}")
def get_squad_blueprint(squad_id: str):
    blueprint = squad_architect.get_blueprint(squad_id)
    if blueprint is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Squad not found.")
    return blueprint


@router.post("/blueprints/validate", response_model=BlueprintValidation)
def validate_squad_blueprint(blueprint: SquadBlueprint):
    return squad_architect.validate(blueprint)


@router.post("/blueprints")
def save_squad_blueprint(blueprint: SquadBlueprint):
    try:
        return squad_architect.save_blueprint(blueprint)
    except LookupError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/members", status_code=201)
def create_squad_member(request: MemberCreateRequest):
    try:
        return squad_architect.create_member(request.kind, request.agent_id, request.name, request.description)
    except FileExistsError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/tools/attach")
def attach_agent_tool(request: ToolAssignmentRequest):
    try:
        return squad_architect.attach_tool(request.agent_id, request.tool)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/tools/detach")
def detach_agent_tool(request: ToolAssignmentRequest):
    try:
        return squad_architect.detach_tool(request.agent_id, request.tool)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
```

## `squads/logic_squad_folders.py`
```python
"""Metadata-folder management for squads in the Workspace tree."""

import json
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path


class SquadManager:
    """Manage squad metadata folders under ``workspace/squads``."""

    SQUAD_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "workspace" / "squads"
    _NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9 _-]{0,63}$")

    def _slug(self, name: str) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", name.strip().lower()).strip("-")

    def _validate(self, name: str) -> str:
        name = name.strip()
        if not self._NAME_PATTERN.match(name):
            raise ValueError("Squad name must be 1-64 chars (letters, digits, spaces, '-', '_').")
        return name

    def list_squads(self) -> list[dict]:
        squads = []
        if not self.SQUAD_ROOT.is_dir():
            return squads
        for child in sorted(self.SQUAD_ROOT.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name.lower()):
            if not child.is_dir():
                continue
            meta_file = child / "squad.json"
            if meta_file.is_file():
                try:
                    meta = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                    meta = {}
            else:
                meta = {}
            squads.append({
                "id": child.name,
                "name": meta.get("name", child.name),
                "description": meta.get("description", ""),
                "path": f"squads/{child.name}",
            })
        return squads

    def create_squad(self, name: str, description: str = "") -> dict:
        name = self._validate(name)
        slug = self._slug(name)
        squad_dir = self.SQUAD_ROOT / slug
        if squad_dir.exists():
            raise ValueError(f"Squad already exists: {name}")
        squad_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        meta = {"name": name, "description": description.strip(), "id": slug}
        (squad_dir / "squad.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return {"created": True, "squad": meta}

    def rename_squad(self, old_name: str, new_name: str) -> dict:
        new_name = self._validate(new_name)
        src = self.SQUAD_ROOT / self._slug(old_name)
        if not src.is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Squad not found: {old_name}")
        dst = self.SQUAD_ROOT / self._slug(new_name)
        if dst.exists():
            raise ValueError(f"Squad already exists: {new_name}")
        src.rename(dst)
        meta_file = dst / "squad.json"
        meta = {}
        if meta_file.is_file():
            try:
                meta = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                meta = {}
        meta["name"] = new_name
        meta["id"] = dst.name
        meta_file.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return {"renamed": True, "squad": meta}

    def delete_squad(self, name: str) -> dict:
        squad_dir = self.SQUAD_ROOT / self._slug(name)
        if not squad_dir.is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Squad not found: {name}")
        shutil.rmtree(squad_dir)
        return {"deleted": True, "id": squad_dir.name}


squad_manager = SquadManager()

```

## `squads/logic_squads.py`
```python
"""Squad Architect: design-time composition of a lead and ordered sub-agent steps.

A blueprint names a lead agent, its ordered sub-agent members and the tools each member
carries. This service checks a blueprint and applies it through the packages that own
each concern; it never runs an LLM itself:

- squad registration and patterns  -> ``orchestration.squad_registry``
- agent files, tools, allow-lists  -> ``core_engine.agent_library``
- new primary agents               -> ``core_engine.agent_management``
- registered tools                 -> ``core_engine.tool_catalog``
"""

from typing import Any

from core_engine.logic_core_engine import agent_library, tool_catalog
from core_engine.logic_agent_management import agent_management
from orchestration.logic_orchestration import CODE_SQUAD_ID, squad_registry
from squads.schemas_squads import BlueprintValidation, SquadBlueprint, SquadMember

# Tools the workflow uses for scratchpad inspection and member handoffs.
LEAD_HANDOFF_TOOL = "read_squad_scratchpad"
MEMBER_HANDOFF_TOOL = "write_squad_scratchpad"

_KIND_BY_DEFINITION = {"prompt": "agent", "subagent": "subagent"}


class SquadArchitect:
    """Builds, validates and applies squad blueprints."""

    # --- Reading -------------------------------------------------------------------

    def get_agent_prompt(self, agent_id: str) -> str | None:
        """Return the raw prompt text for a primary agent or sub-agent."""
        clean = agent_library.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
        definition = agent_library.definition_kind(clean)
        if definition is None:
            return None
        if definition == "prompt":
            md_path = agent_library.LIBRARY_ROOT / f"{clean}.md"
            if not md_path.is_file():
                return None
            _, body = agent_library._read_agent_markdown(md_path)
            return body
        _, body = agent_library.parse_subagent_yaml(clean)
        return body

    def set_agent_prompt(self, agent_id: str, prompt_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Replace the prompt body of a primary agent or sub-agent, keeping all metadata intact."""
        clean = agent_library.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
        definition = agent_library.definition_kind(clean)
        if definition is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Agent not found: {agent_id}")
        path = agent_library._definition_file(definition, clean)
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        newline = "\r\n" if "\r\n" in text else "\n"
        lines = text.splitlines()
        prefix, _, layout = agent_library._split_prompt_body(definition, lines)
        body = prompt_text.splitlines()
        result = agent_library._join_prompt_body(prefix, body, layout)
        path.write_text(
            newline.join(result) + (newline if text.endswith(("\n", "\r")) else ""),
            encoding="utf-8", newline="",
        )
        return {"agent_id": clean, "saved": True}

    def describe_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """One node of the squad graph: identity, kind, mode, tools and delegation allow-list."""
        definition = agent_library.definition_kind(agent_id)
        if definition is None:
            return None
        assigned = agent_library.get_agent_tools(definition, agent_id)
        if definition == "prompt":
            profile = agent_library.load_agent_definition_from_md(agent_library.LIBRARY_ROOT / f"{agent_id}.md")
            name, description = profile.name, profile.description
        else:
            meta, _ = agent_library.parse_subagent_yaml(agent_id)
            name, description = meta.get("name") or agent_id, meta.get("description") or ""
        return {
            "id": assigned["agent_id"],
            "kind": _KIND_BY_DEFINITION[definition],
            "name": str(name),
            "description": str(description),
            "mode": assigned["mode"],
            "tools": assigned["tools"],
            "allowed_subagents": [entry["id"] for entry in assigned["subagents"]],
            "path": assigned["path"],
        }

    def list_agents(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        catalog = squad_registry.list_agent_catalog()
        nodes = []
        for entry in catalog["agents"] + catalog["subagents"]:
            try:
                node = self.describe_agent(entry["id"])
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                node = None
            if node is not None:
                nodes.append(node)
        return nodes

    def overview(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Everything the Squads home screen needs in one call."""
        return {
            "squads": squad_registry.list_squads(),
            "agents": self.list_agents(),
            "tools": tool_catalog.list_tools(),
            "patterns": list(squad_registry.SQUAD_PATTERNS),
        }

    def get_blueprint(self, squad_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(squad_id)
        if squad is None:
            return None
        return {
            "squad_id": squad["squad_id"],
            "name": squad["name"],
            "description": squad.get("description", ""),
            "pattern": squad["default_pattern"],
            "lead": self.describe_agent(squad["primary_agent"]) if squad.get("primary_agent") else None,
            "members": [self.describe_agent(member_id) for member_id in squad["subagents"]],
            "metrics": squad["metrics"],
            "dedicated_pipeline": squad["squad_id"] == CODE_SQUAD_ID,
        }

    # --- Validation ----------------------------------------------------------------

    def validate(self, blueprint: SquadBlueprint) -> BlueprintValidation:
        errors: list[str] = []
        warnings: list[str] = []
        known_tools = {meta["name"] for meta in tool_catalog.list_tools()}

        if blueprint.lead is not None:
            lead = self._describe_or_none(blueprint.lead.agent_id)
            if lead is None:
                errors.append(f"Lead agent not found: {blueprint.lead.agent_id}")
            elif lead["kind"] != "agent":
                errors.append(f"The lead must be a primary agent from library/, not a sub-agent: {lead['id']}")
        else:
            lead = None

        member_ids = [member.agent_id for member in blueprint.members]
        if len(set(member_ids)) != len(member_ids):
            errors.append("Squad members must not contain duplicates.")
        if blueprint.lead is not None and blueprint.lead.agent_id in member_ids:
            errors.append("The lead cannot also be a squad member.")
        members = {}
        for member_id in member_ids:
            node = self._describe_or_none(member_id)
            if node is None:
                errors.append(f"Member not found: {member_id}")
            elif node["kind"] != "subagent":
                errors.append(f"Squad member must be a sub-agent, not a primary agent: {member_id}")
            else:
                members[member_id] = node

        nodes_to_check = [blueprint.lead, *blueprint.members] if blueprint.lead else list(blueprint.members)
        for node_spec in nodes_to_check:
            unknown = [tool for tool in node_spec.tools or [] if tool not in known_tools]
            if unknown:
                errors.append(f"{node_spec.agent_id}: unknown tools {', '.join(unknown)}")

        if blueprint.lead_delegates:
            errors.append("Squad runs are orchestrated in order; dynamic agent delegation is disabled.")
        if blueprint.lead is None and not member_ids:
            errors.append("A squad must have at least a lead or members.")
        elif blueprint.lead is not None and not member_ids:
            warnings.append("No members: the lead will answer alone after an empty scratchpad barrier.")
        elif blueprint.lead is None:
            warnings.append("No lead agent: the last member's output will be the final answer (no synthesis step).")

        if lead is not None:
            lead_tools = self._final_tools(blueprint.lead, lead)
            if LEAD_HANDOFF_TOOL not in lead_tools:
                warnings.append(f"The lead has no {LEAD_HANDOFF_TOOL}, so it cannot read member handoffs.")
            if lead_tools and lead["mode"] != "agent":
                warnings.append("The lead is in chat mode; it will be switched to agent mode so its tools run.")
        for member_id, node in members.items():
            spec = next(m for m in blueprint.members if m.agent_id == member_id)
            tools = self._final_tools(spec, node)
            if node["kind"] == "subagent" and MEMBER_HANDOFF_TOOL not in tools:
                warnings.append(f"{member_id} has no {MEMBER_HANDOFF_TOOL}, so its result will not reach the lead.")
        return BlueprintValidation(ok=not errors, errors=errors, warnings=warnings)

    # --- Applying ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def save_blueprint(self, blueprint: SquadBlueprint) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Register or update the squad, then write each member's tools and the lead's allow-list."""
        validation = self.validate(blueprint)
        if not validation.ok:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(validation.errors))

        pattern = squad_registry.normalize_pattern(blueprint.pattern)
        primary_agent_id = blueprint.lead.agent_id if blueprint.lead else ""
        member_ids = [member.agent_id for member in blueprint.members]
        if blueprint.squad_id:
            squad = squad_registry.update_squad(
                blueprint.squad_id,
                name=blueprint.name,
                description=blueprint.description,
                primary_agent=primary_agent_id,
                subagents=member_ids,
                default_pattern=pattern,
                max_parallel=1,
            )
            if squad is None:
                raise LookupError(f"Squad not found: {blueprint.squad_id}")
        else:
            squad = squad_registry.create_squad(
                blueprint.name, blueprint.description, primary_agent_id,
                member_ids, pattern, 1,
            )

        for spec in blueprint.members:
            if spec.tools is not None:
                self._write_tools(spec.agent_id, spec.tools)
        self._apply_lead(blueprint)
        return {
            "blueprint": self.get_blueprint(squad["squad_id"]),
            "warnings": validation.warnings,
        }

    def _apply_lead(self, blueprint: SquadBlueprint) -> None:
        """Persist explicit lead tool changes; the orchestrator controls all squad handoffs."""
        if blueprint.lead is None or blueprint.lead.tools is None:
            return
        lead = self.describe_agent(blueprint.lead.agent_id)
        tools = self._final_tools(blueprint.lead, lead)
        agent_library.set_agent_tools(
            "prompt", lead["id"], tools, mode="agent" if tools else None
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _final_tools(spec: SquadMember, node: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
        return list(spec.tools) if spec.tools is not None else list(node["tools"])

    def _describe_or_none(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        try:
            return self.describe_agent(agent_id)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return None

    def _write_tools(self, agent_id: str, tools: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        kind = agent_library.definition_kind(agent_id)
        if kind is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Agent not found: {agent_id}")
        known_tools = {meta["name"] for meta in tool_catalog.list_tools()}
        unknown = [tool for tool in tools if tool not in known_tools]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown tools: {', '.join(unknown)}")
        agent_library.set_agent_tools(kind, agent_id, tools, mode="agent" if tools else None)
        return self.describe_agent(agent_id)

    def attach_tool(self, agent_id: str, tool: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        node = self.describe_agent(agent_id)
        if node is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Agent not found: {agent_id}")
        if tool in node["tools"]:
            return node
        return self._write_tools(agent_id, [*node["tools"], tool])

    def detach_tool(self, agent_id: str, tool: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        node = self.describe_agent(agent_id)
        if node is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Agent not found: {agent_id}")
        return self._write_tools(agent_id, [name for name in node["tools"] if name != tool])

    def create_member(self, kind: str, agent_id: str, name: str, description: str = "") -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Scaffold a new primary agent (library/*.md) or sub-agent (subAgentLibrary/*.yaml)."""
        if kind == "agent":
            created = agent_management.scaffold_agent(agent_id, name, description, mode="agent")
            return self.describe_agent(created["agent_id"])
        if kind == "subagent":
            created = squad_registry.create_subagent(agent_id, name, description)
            return self.describe_agent(created.get("subagent_id") or agent_id)
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown member kind: {kind}")


squad_architect = SquadArchitect()

```

```python
"""Data contracts for squad-folder management."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class SquadRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    description: str = ""


class SquadRenameRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    new_name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
```

## `squads/schemas_squads.py`
```python
"""Pydantic schemas for a lead, ordered sub-agent members and their tool assignments."""

from typing import List, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

SquadPattern = Literal["sequential", "fanout", "router"]
MemberKind = Literal["agent", "subagent"]


class SquadMember(BaseModel):
    agent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    tools: Optional[List[str]] = Field(
        default=None, max_length=40, description="Tools to assign; None keeps the agent's current tools"
    )


class SquadBlueprint(BaseModel):
    squad_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Existing squad to update; None creates one")
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    pattern: SquadPattern = Field(
        default="sequential",
        description="Execution is sequential; fanout and router are accepted as legacy aliases.",
    )
    lead: Optional[SquadMember] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Primary synthesis agent; None skips synthesis and uses the last member's output directly.",
    )
    members: List[SquadMember] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    lead_delegates: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Deprecated; dynamic delegation is disabled during squad runs.",
    )


class BlueprintValidation(BaseModel):
    ok: bool
    errors: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class MemberCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    kind: MemberKind
    agent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


class ToolAssignmentRequest(BaseModel):
    agent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    tool: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)


class AgentPromptRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., max_length=100000)

```

## `subAgentLibrary/code-analyzer.yaml`
```yaml
id: code-analyzer
name: Code Analysis Sub-Agent
description: Background worker that inspects code files and writes structural diagnostics to the shared scratchpad.
type: subagent
mode: agent
model: qwen2.5-coder:14b
environment: workspace
version: 1
tools:
  - read_file
  - map_files
  - read_coding_scratchpad
  - write_coding_scratchpad
prompt: |
  # Code Analysis Sub-Agent Prompt

  ## role
  You are the Code Analysis Sub-Agent. Your task is to inspect code files and write structured diagnostics to the shared agent scratchpad.

  ## purpose
  Read target files using read_file and save findings with write_coding_scratchpad, agent "code-analyzer", title "result".

  ## boundaries
  - Do not modify workspace files directly.
  - Output clean, structured diagnostic output without conversational chitchat.

  ## output format & scratchpad handoff
  Always call write_coding_scratchpad with:
  - agent: "code-analyzer"
  - title: "result"
  - content: a JSON object such as
  {
    "analyzed_file": "<path>",
    "issues_found": [],
    "suggestions": []
  }

  Then call read_coding_scratchpad with agent "code-analyzer" and title "result" to confirm the saved content matches what you wrote. Only finish once that read-back confirms it; if the content is missing or doesn't match, retry the write once before reporting failure.

  ## Available Tools

  ### read_file
  Read a UTF-8 text or Docling-supported document from the configured file-manager root.  PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT documents are text-extracted with Docling; OCR is enabled for PDFs to support scanned pages. Text files are limited to 1 MB; documents to 25 MB and 1 MB of extracted text. Inside a chat, the full text is saved to the chat scratchpad as agent=read_file, title=<path>, and read_chat_scratchpad pages through it. Returns JSON with the request, path, the first page of content (with next_offset when the file is longer), and scratchpad context for fetching the rest.

  Parameters:
  - path (required): The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.
  - request: An optional question or focus area to guide what is returned.

  ### map_files
  Return a directory tree and save a copy in the shared agent-memory scratchpad.

  Parameters:
  - path: The file or folder path, relative to the workspace root.

  ### read_coding_scratchpad
  Read one coding scratchpad entry by agent name and title. Paired with write_coding_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
  - offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

  ### write_coding_scratchpad
  Save content to the coding scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_coding_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_coding_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - content (required): The text to save.

```

id: code-builder
name: Code Builder Sub-Agent
description: Writes or changes the single Python module in the CodeBuilder editor.

  # Code Builder

  You write Python code for the CodeBuilder editor. The orchestrator shows your code
  in the editor and runs it, so you only need to reply with code and a short note.

  ## rules
  - Do exactly what the user request asks. Follow the plan when one is given.
  - Produce one complete, runnable Python module. Use only the standard library unless the user asks otherwise.
  - When the editor already has code, change it as requested and keep everything else working.
  - Put interactive or entry-point code (input(), loops waiting on the user, servers) under if __name__ == "__main__": so the module can be imported and tested.
  - No placeholders, no "rest of code here", no undefined names.

  ## reply format
  1. Exactly one ```python block containing the COMPLETE module.
  2. Then 1-3 short lines saying what you did.

````

id: code-troubleshooter

description: Fixes the CodeBuilder module using the real test failure output.
type: subagent
mode: agent
model: qwen2.5-coder:14b
environment: workspace
squad: code-squad
version: 2
tools: []

  You fix the Python module in the CodeBuilder editor. You receive the module and
  the real output of a failed run (stderr, traceback, diagnostics). The orchestrator
  applies your corrected module to the editor and runs the tests again.

  ## rules
  - Read the traceback and find the root cause in the module.
  - Make the smallest correct change; keep the rest of the module unchanged.
  - Do not hide errors with broad try/except, and do not delete the requested features.
  - If the failing line is in the test checks rather than the module, fix the module only if it really breaks the user's request.
  - Keep interactive or entry-point code under if __name__ == "__main__":.

  ## reply format
  1. Exactly one ```python block containing the COMPLETE corrected module.
  2. Then 1-3 short lines: the cause and the fix.

````

## `subAgentLibrary/problem-analyst.yaml`
````yaml
id: problem-analyst
name: Problem Analyst Sub-Agent
description: Reads the Problem Statement and questionnaire answers, analyzes each root cause part, narrows down to the most likely cause, and writes a structured analysis report to the scratchpad.
type: subagent
mode: agent
model: gemma4:e2b
environment: workspace
squad: analysis-squad
version: 5
tools:
  - read_squad_scratchpad
  - write_squad_scratchpad
prompt: |
  # Problem Analyst

  ## Role
  You analyze the Problem Statement and the user's questionnaire answers to narrow the root cause parts down to the single most likely cause, then write a structured analysis report.

  ## Step 1 — Read the Input
  Call read_squad_scratchpad twice:
  1. Agent "problem-statement-builder", title "problem_statement" — the Problem Statement with parts.
  2. Agent "questionnaire", title "result" — the user's answers to the investigation questions.

  Read each result in full. If content is truncated, call again with a higher offset.
  If either result is missing or empty, report the failure and stop.

  ## Step 2 — Analyze Each Part
  For every part in the Problem Statement:
  - Compare its premise and supporting_clues against the user's answers.
  - List evidence from the answers that supports this part.
  - List evidence from the answers that contradicts this part.
  - Assign a confidence level.

  Confidence levels:
  - Strongly supported — multiple answers point directly to this part.
  - Partially supported — some answers support it, but gaps remain.
  - Weakly supported — only indirect or thin evidence.
  - Eliminated — the answers clearly rule this out.
  - Inconclusive — not enough information to judge.

  ## Step 3 — Narrow to One Part
  Compare all parts and select the one with the strongest evidence.
  If no single part stands out, pick the most likely and explain why the others are less supported.
  If the evidence is genuinely equal, say so — but still rank them.

  ## Step 4 — Write the Analysis Report
  Build a JSON object with this structure and save it to the scratchpad:

  ```json
  {
    "title": "Analysis Report: <short problem name>",
    "problem_overview": "one paragraph summarizing the problem and desired outcome",
    "part_analyses": [
      {
        "part_title": "title from the Problem Statement",
        "supporting_evidence": ["evidence from answers"],
        "contradictory_evidence": ["evidence from answers"],
        "confidence": "one of the confidence levels",
        "reasoning": "why this confidence level was assigned"
      }
    ],
    "conclusion": {
      "selected_part": "title of the most likely root cause",
      "explanation": "paragraph explaining why this part was selected over the others",
      "remaining_unknowns": ["information still missing"],
      "recommended_next_steps": ["what to do next"]
    }
  }
  ```

  Call write_squad_scratchpad with:
  - agent: "problem-analyst"
  - title: "result"
  - content: the complete JSON analysis report.

  Then call read_squad_scratchpad with agent "problem-analyst" and title "result" to confirm
  the saved content matches what you wrote. If the content is missing or doesn't match, retry
  the write once before reporting failure.

  Only stop once that read-back confirms the save. The pipeline runs the report builder next.

  ## Hallucination Rules
  - Use ONLY facts from the Problem Statement and the user's questionnaire answers.
  - Do not invent evidence, scenarios, or examples.
  - Do not treat an unanswered question as confirmation.
  - If evidence is insufficient, say so. Do not fill gaps with assumptions.
  - Do not add technical details the user did not provide.

  ## Boundaries
  - Do not create the HTML report — the report builder does that.
  - Do not call other agents. The pipeline handles sequencing.
  - Do not ask the user questions. That phase is over.
  - Stop after the scratchpad write succeeds.

  ## Available Tools

  ### read_squad_scratchpad
  Read one entry from the current squad run's scratchpad by agent name and title. Paired with write_squad_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
  - offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

  ### write_squad_scratchpad
  Save content to the current squad run's scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_squad_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_squad_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - content (required): The text to save.

````

````yaml
id: problem-report-builder
name: Problem Report Builder Sub-Agent
description: Reads all investigation data from the scratchpad and builds a polished standalone HTML/CSS report with the full problem breakdown, analysis, and conclusion.
type: subagent
mode: agent
model: gemma4:e2b
environment: workspace
squad: analysis-squad
version: 4
tools:
  - read_squad_scratchpad
  - write_squad_scratchpad
prompt: |
  # Problem Report Builder

  ## Role
  You read everything in the scratchpad and build a polished, standalone HTML report.

  ## Step 1 — Read All Scratchpad Data
  Call read_squad_scratchpad for each of these. Use offset if any result is truncated.

  1. Agent "problem-statement-builder", title "problem_statement" — the Problem Statement with parts.
  2. Agent "inquisitive", title "questions" — the investigation questions.
  3. Agent "questionnaire", title "result" — the user's answers.
  4. Agent "problem-analyst", title "result" — the analysis report with conclusion.

  Read all four before writing any HTML.

  ## Step 2 — Build the HTML Report
  Create a complete standalone HTML document with embedded CSS. No external files, no JavaScript, no libraries.

  ### Design
  - Dark background (#1a1a2e), light text (#e0e0e0).
  - Accent color (#0f3460) for headers and cards, highlight (#e94560) for key findings.
  - Centered layout, max-width 900px, comfortable padding.
  - Clean sans-serif font (system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif).
  - Cards with subtle borders and rounded corners for each section.
  - Responsive — works on both desktop and mobile.
  - All CSS in a single <style> element inside <head>.

  ### Report Sections
  Build these sections in order:

  1. **Header**
     Large report title from the analyst's title field. Subtitle with the date.

  2. **Problem Overview**
     The problem, desired outcome, known facts, and constraints from the Problem Statement. Present as readable paragraphs, not raw JSON.

  3. **Root Cause Parts**
     One card per part from the Problem Statement. Each card shows:
     - Part title as the card heading.
     - Premise paragraph.
     - Supporting clues as a list.
     - Unknowns as a list.

  4. **Investigation Questions & Answers**
     Show each question and the user's answer side by side or stacked. Use the questions from inquisitive and answers from questionnaire.

  5. **Analysis**
     For each part, show the analyst's evaluation:
     - Supporting evidence.
     - Contradictory evidence.
     - Confidence level — use color coding:
       - Strongly supported: green (#27ae60)
       - Partially supported: yellow (#f39c12)
       - Weakly supported: orange (#e67e22)
       - Eliminated: red (#e74c3c)
       - Inconclusive: gray (#95a5a6)
     - Reasoning paragraph.

  6. **Conclusion**
     The selected root cause part, highlighted prominently.
     The analyst's explanation paragraph for why this was chosen.

  7. **Next Steps**
     Remaining unknowns and recommended next steps from the analyst's conclusion.

  8. **Footer**
     "Generated by Novous Analysis Squad" and the date.

  ## Step 3 — Save the Report
  Call write_squad_scratchpad with:
  - agent: "problem-report-builder"
  - title: "result"
  - content: a JSON object with these fields:

  ```json
  {
    "report_title": "title of the report",
    "html": "the complete HTML document as a string",
    "report_summary": "one sentence summary of the conclusion"
  }
  ```

  Then call read_squad_scratchpad with agent "problem-report-builder" and title "result" to
  confirm the saved content matches what you wrote. Only stop once that read-back confirms it;
  if the content is missing or doesn't match, retry the write once before reporting failure.

  ## Hallucination Rules
  - Use ONLY data from the four scratchpad reads. Do not invent any content.
  - Present the analyst's confidence levels exactly as given.
  - Do not upgrade or downgrade any finding.
  - Do not add evidence, examples, or recommendations that are not in the scratchpad.
  - If a field is missing or empty, show "Not available" — do not fill it with guesses.

  ## Boundaries
  - Do not call other agents.
  - Do not write files to the workspace.
  - Do not modify any scratchpad entries other than your own result.
  - Stop after saving the report.

  ## Available Tools

  ### read_squad_scratchpad
  Read one entry from the current squad run's scratchpad by agent name and title. Paired with write_squad_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
  - offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

  ### write_squad_scratchpad
  Save content to the current squad run's scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_squad_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_squad_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - content (required): The text to save.

````

## `subAgentLibrary/rag-retriever.yaml`
```yaml
id: rag-retriever
name: RAG Retrieval Sub-Agent
description: Background worker that searches knowledge branches and writes retrieved passages to the shared scratchpad.
type: subagent
mode: agent
model: hermes3:8b
environment: workspace
squad: knowledge-squad
version: 1
tools:
  - get_knowledge_catalog
  - search_knowledge_branch
  - list_knowledge_branch_documents
  - read_knowledge_branch_document
  - read_chat_scratchpad
  - write_chat_scratchpad
prompt: |
  # RAG Retrieval Sub-Agent Prompt

  ## role
  You are the RAG Retrieval Sub-Agent. Your task is to find relevant passages in the Novous knowledge branches and write the retrieved evidence to the shared agent scratchpad.

  ## purpose
    The call_subagent runtime performs retrieval and writes the scratchpad result for rag-retriever directly. This worker definition documents the same contract for explicit agent runs: call get_knowledge_catalog to identify the branch, search it, then write exactly one of "success", "nothing_found", or "error" to the scratchpad. Include error details in the content when status is "error".

  ## boundaries
  - Do not modify workspace files or knowledge branches.
  - Do not invent passages, document names, or branch IDs.
  - Report exactly what the knowledge tools returned.
  - Output clean, structured retrieval output without conversational chitchat.

  ## output format & scratchpad handoff
  Always call write_chat_scratchpad with the retrieved evidence:
  - agent: "rag-retriever"
  - title: "result"
  - content: a JSON object such as
  {
    "status": "success",
    "query": "<query>",
    "knowledge_branch_id": "<branch id>",
    "results": []
  }
  Use "nothing_found" instead of "success" when retrieval completes without relevant passages. Use "error" when retrieval fails, and include the error message in the content.

  Then call read_chat_scratchpad with agent "rag-retriever" and title "result" to confirm the saved content matches what you wrote. Only finish once that read-back confirms it; if the content is missing or doesn't match, retry the write once before reporting failure.

  ## Available Tools

  ### get_knowledge_catalog
  Get the live Knowledge TOC: exact branch names, IDs, status, and indexed document/chunk counts. Use this first to find a branch ID.

  ### search_knowledge_branch
  Find relevant passages for a question in one knowledge branch. Get its ID from get_knowledge_catalog and pass it as knowledge_branch_id; results are source text for answering the user.

  Parameters:
  - query (required): The search query text.
  - top_k: Maximum number of results to return. Default 5.
  - knowledge_branch_id: The branch ID from the knowledge catalog.

  ### list_knowledge_branch_documents
  List indexed document names, paths, and chunk counts in a branch. Use get_knowledge_catalog first and pass the matching branch ID; this lists metadata, not document contents.

  Parameters:
  - knowledge_branch_id: The branch ID from the knowledge catalog.

  ### read_knowledge_branch_document
  Read the full indexed text of one document. Use get_knowledge_catalog and list_knowledge_branch_documents first, then pass the exact listed path and branch ID.

  Parameters:
  - document_path (required): Path of the indexed document within the knowledge branch.
  - knowledge_branch_id: The branch ID from the knowledge catalog.

  ### read_chat_scratchpad
  Read one entry from this chat's scratchpad by agent name and title. Paired with write_chat_scratchpad: call this immediately after writing, with the exact same agent and title, to verify the saved content before relying on it. index 0 is the newest match; use offset to read the rest of long content. If nothing matches, the result lists the agent and title pairs that exist.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - index: 0 for the newest matching entry, 1 for the one before it. Default 0.
  - offset: Character position to start reading at; use next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

  ### write_chat_scratchpad
  Save content to this chat's scratchpad under an agent name and a title. Paired with read_chat_scratchpad: after saving, you must call read_chat_scratchpad with the same agent and title to confirm the content was saved correctly before reporting success. Returns a JSON object with saved, store, agent, title, and id.

  Parameters:
  - agent (required): Your agent's name or ID, used to file and retrieve scratchpad entries. Example: rag-retriever.
  - title (required): The title the entry was saved under, for example result.
  - content (required): The text to save.
```
